(-ती) 1 A name of DURGĀ, in her capacity of daughter of HIMĀLA, the sovereign of the snowy mountains. 2 DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A female cowherd or Gopī. 4 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 5 Another tree, (Celtis orientalis.) 6 A red clay, commonly called Saurāṣṭrī, or Surat earth. 7 A name applied to several rivers. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, अण् aff. of descent or relation.
पार्व्वत: पार्व्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Mountain, produced in the mountains. m. (-तः) A tree called the large Nimb, (Melia sempervirens.) f. (-ती) 1 A name of DURGĀ, in her capacity of daughter of HIMĀLA, the sovereign of the snowy mountains. 2 DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A female cowherd or Gopī. 4 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 5 Another tree, (Celtis orientalis.) 6 A red clay, commonly called Saurāṣṭrī, or Surat earth. 7 A name applied to several rivers. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, अण् aff. of descent or relation.
पार्वतीनन्दन: पार्व्वतीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. पार्व्वती the goddess, and नन्दन a son.
पार्व्वतीनन्दन: पार्व्वतीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. पार्व्वती the goddess, and नन्दन a son.
पार्वतीय: पार्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountain, mountaineer. E. पर्व्वतीय, and अण् added.
पार्व्वतीय: पार्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountain, mountaineer. E. पर्व्वतीय, and अण् added.
पार्वतेय: पार्व्वतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain or mountain-born, &c. n. (-यं) 1 Antimony. 2 A plant bearing a pungent fruit. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and ढक् aff.
पार्व्वतेय: पार्व्वतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain or mountain-born, &c. n. (-यं) 1 Antimony. 2 A plant bearing a pungent fruit. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and ढक् aff.
पार्वायनान्तीय: पार्व्वायनान्तीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Occurring at the end of a Parva or a solstice, (a sacrifice, &c.) E. पर्व्व, and अयन solstice, अन्त end, छ aff.
पार्व्वायनान्तीय: पार्व्वायनान्तीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Occurring at the end of a Parva or a solstice, (a sacrifice, &c.) E. पर्व्व, and अयन solstice, अन्त end, छ aff.
पार्शव: पार्शव m. (-वः) A warrior armed with an axe. E. पर्शु an axe, and अण् aff.
पार्श्व: पार्श्व mfn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वा-र्श्वं) Near, proximate, by the side of. mn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वं) 1 A side, the part of the body below the armpit. 2 The curve or circumference of a wheel. 3 Side of any square figure. n. (-र्श्वं) 1 A multitude of ribs, the thorax. 2 A fraudulent or crooked expedient. m. (-र्श्वः) The twenty-third Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. स्पृश to touch, श्वण Uṇādi aff., and पृ substituted for the root, or पर्शु a rib, aff. अण्.
पार्श्वक: पार्श्वक m. (-कः) 1 A pilferer, a swindler, any one who seeks wealth or other objects, by dishonest or indirect means. 2 A rib. E. पार्श्व a dishonest means, a side, and कन् aff.
पार्श्वगत: पार्श्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Close to, beside. E. पार्श्व, and गत gone to.
पार्श्वतस्: पार्श्वतस् ind. By or from the side of, &c. E. पार्श्व the side, and तसि aff.
पार्श्वतीय: पार्श्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the side of. E. पार्श्वतस्, and छ aff.; the final अस् rejected.
पार्श्वपरिवर्तन: पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning upon the side. E. पार्श्व, and परिवर्त्तन turning.
पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन: पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning upon the side. E. पार्श्व, and परिवर्त्तन turning.
पार्श्वभाग: पार्श्वभाग m. (-गः) The side, the flank. E. पाश्व the side, and भाग part.
पार्श्वशय: पार्श्वशय mfn. (-यः-या-र्य) 1 Sleeping on. 2 Sleeping beside the side. E. पार्श्व, and शी to sleep, aff. अच्.
पार्श्वशूल: पार्श्वशूल n. (-लं) Spasm of the chest, stitch. E. पार्श्व, and शूल sharp pain.
पार्श्वस्थ: पार्श्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Staying near or close to, or at the side. m. (-स्थः) 1 A sort of chorus to the Indian drama, an actor in the prelude, and interpreter of the plot. 2 An associate, a companion. E. पार्श्व the side, (of the manager, &c.) स्थ who stays.
पार्श्वाचान्त: पार्श्वाचान्त n. (-न्तं) Food not to be taken after one of the party has washed his mouth. E. पार्श्व, and आचान्त sipped.
पार्श्वास्थि: पार्श्वास्थि n. (-स्थि) A rib. E. पार्श्व the side, and अस्थि a bone.
पार्श्विक: पार्श्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Lateral, belonging to the side, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A juggler. 2 A partisan, a sidesman, an associate or companion. E. पार्श्व the side, and ठक् aff.
पार्श्वोदरप्रिय: पार्श्वोदरप्रिय m. (-यः) A crab. E. पार्श्व the side, उदर the belly. and प्रिप fond of; going sidelong.
पार्षत: पार्षत m. (-तः) A Pāṇḍu prince. f. (-ती) A name of DRAUPADĪ. E. पृषत the name of a king, अण् aff. of descent.
पार्षद: पार्षद m. (-दः) A spectator, a person present in a congregation or assembly. E. पर्षद an assembly, अण् aff.; also with ण्य aff., पार्षद्य; or derived from परिषद, पारिषद.
पार्ष्णि: पार्ष्णि mf. (-र्ष्णिः) 1 The heel. 2 The rear of an army. 3 The back. 4 Enquiry, asking. 5 A kick. f. (-र्ष्णिः) 1 A violent woman, one intoxicated literally or figuratively, &c. 2 A name of KUNTĪ the mother of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. पृष to sprinkle, &c. Uṇādi aff. नि.
पार्ष्णिग्राह: पार्ष्णिग्राह m. (-हः) 1 An enemy in the rear. 2 A commander in the rear of his army or reserve. E. पार्ष्णि the rear, and ग्राह who takes.
पार्ष्णित्र: पार्ष्णित्र n. (-त्रं) A reserve, a body of forces in the rear. E. पार्ष्णि the rear, and त्रा to preserve, aff. क.
पाल: पाल r. 1st and 10th cls. (पालयति) To guard, to preserve or protect.

पाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Who or what guards or preserves. m. (-लः) 1 A nourisher, a protector. 2 A spitting pot. f. (-ली) 1 The sharp edge of a sword. 2 A woman with a beard. 3 A louse. 4 A line, a row or range. 5 A pot, a boiler. E. पाल to nourish, aff. अच्; ङीष् added; also with इ aff. पालि.
पालक: पालक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what protects, nourishes, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A horse-keeper, a groom. 2 A cherisher, a protector, a guardian. E. पाल to nourish, aff. वुन्.
पालकाप्य: पालकाप्य m. (-प्यः) A name of a Muni or saint, a form of the divine physician DHANVANTARI.
पालघ्न: पालघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A mushroom. E. पाल earth, derived from पाल to nourish, and घ्न destructive.
पालङ्क: पालङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 2 A sort of beet root, (Beta bengalensis.) 3 A hawk. f. (-ङ्की) Incense, the resin of the olibanum; also पालङ्क्या. E. पाल nourishing, अङ्क what goes or gives, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
पालङ्क्या: पालङ्क्या f. (-ङ्क्या) Gum olibanum. E. पालङ्क the olibanum tree, यत् added.
पालन: पालन n. (-नं) 1 Preserving, guarding, protecting, cherishing, nourishing. 2 The milk of a cow that has recently calved. E. पाल to nourish, aff. ल्युट्.
पालयत्: पालयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Protecting, cherishing. E. पाल to protect, शतृ aff.
पालयितृ: पालयितृ mfn. (ता-त्री-तृ) Protecting, cherishing, a protector, &c. E. पाल to nourish, तृच् aff.
पालाश: पालाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Of a green colour. 2 Belonging to the Palāśa tree, made of its wood, &c. m. (-शः) Green, (the colour.) E. पलाश a leaf, or the tree, aff. अञ्.
पालाशखण्ड: पालाशखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A country in India, the western part of Behar. E. पलाश belonging to the Palāśa tree, &c. खण्ड district; abounding in the Butea frondosa.
पालि: पालि f. (-लिः) 1 The sharp edge of a sword, or any cutting instrument. 2 The tip of the ear. 3 A line, a row or range. 4 A mark, a spot, a stain. 5 A louse. 6 A woman with a beard. 7 A boundary, a limit. 8 A raised bank, a causeway, a bridge. 9 A circumference. 10 Maintenance of a scholar during the period of his studies, by his teacher. 11 Praise, eulogium. 12 The hip or haunch. 13 A Prastha or measure so called. E. पाल to nourish, इ aff., and in most cases, ङीष् being optionally added, also पाली: see पाल.
पालिका: पालिका f. (-का) 1 The sharp edge of a cutting instrument. 2 A sort of ladle or knife for skimming milk, curds, &c. 3 The lobe of the ear. E. पाली as above, with कन् added; see also पालक.
पालित: पालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, nourished. m. (-तः) The Śākhoṭa tree. E. पाल to nourish, aff. क्त.
पालिन्: पालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Who or what nourishes or protects. E. पाल to protect, णिनि aff.
पालिन्द: पालिन्द m. (-न्दः) A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) f. (-न्दी) Teöri; see the next. E. पाल to nourish, (the bee,) aff. किन्दच्.
पालिन्धी: पालिन्धी f. (-न्धी) A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum), the black sort. E. see the last, aff. किन्धच्.
पावक: पावक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Who or what renders pure, a purifier, purificatory. m. (-कः) 1 Fire, or its deified personification. 2 Social fire, one lighted in common. 3 A fire lighted on taking possession of a house. 4 A saint, a person purified by religious abstraction. 5 A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa). 6 Leadwort, (Plumbago zeylanica.) 7 Marking nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) 8 A vermifuge plant: see विडङ्ग. f. (-की) Wife of AGNI. E. पू to purify, ण्वुल् aff.
पावकारणि: पावकारणि m. (-णिः) A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition. E. पावक fire, अरणि touch-wood.
पावकि: पावकि m. (-किः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. पावक, and इञ् aff. indirectly this deity is the son of fire.
पावन: पावन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Purifying, expurgatory, purificatory. n. (-नं) 1 Water. 2 Penance, expiation, purification by acts of austerity and devotion. 3 Cow-dung. 4 The Eleocarpus seed. 5 A kind of grass, (Costus.) m. (-नः) 1 The inspired poet VYĀSA. 2 Fire generally, or for various ceremonial purposes. 3 Incense. f. (-नी) 1 Yellow myrobalan. 2 A cow. 3 The Ganges, or the goddess GAṄGĀ. 4 Holy basil. E. पू to cleanse or purify, aff. ल्युट्.
पावनध्वनि: पावनध्वनि m. (-निः) A conch shell. E. पावन, and ध्वनि sound.
पावमान: पावमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purificatory, purifying. f. (-नी) An expiatory text. E. पू to purify, शानच् aff.
पावित: पावित mfn. (-तः-ता-त) Purified. E. पू to purify, causal v. क्त aff.
पाविन्: पाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Who or what purifies. E. पू to purify, घिणुन् aff.
पाव्य: पाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is to be or must be purified. E. पू to purify, ण्यत् aff.
पाश: पाश m. (-शः) 1 A fetter, a chain, a tye, the string for fastening tamed animals, or the net or noose for catching birds, deer, &c. 2 A noose as a weapon of combat. 3 In composition with words signifying hair, quantity, as केशपाशः much or flowing hair. 4 In composition with कर्ण, beauty, as कर्णपाशः a handsome ear. 5 In composition with छत्र and other woods, depreciation, as छत्रपाशः an inelegant or shabby umbrella. E. पश to bind, aff. घञ्; where it is used in composition, it is in fact but a technical aff.
पाशक: पाशक m. (-कः) A dice, particularly the long sort used in playing Chaupai. E. पश to bind, ण्वुल् aff.
पाशपाणि: पाशपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VARUṆA, the regent of water. E. पाश a sort of noose, and पाणि the hand, VARUṆA being represented as holding a cord in one hand, shaped like a sling or a noose.
पाशबद्ध: पाशबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Noosed, snared, caught or bound. E. पाश, and बद्ध bound.
पाशबन्ध: पाशबन्ध n. (-न्धं) A noose, a snare, a halter, a net, &c. E. पाश, and बन्ध a binding.
पाशभृत्: पाशभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 VARUṆA. 2 A soldier, &c. armed with a noose. E. पाश, and भृत् who has.
पाशव: पाशव n. (-वं) A flock, a herd. E. पशु an animal, अण् aff.
पाशवपालन: पाशवपालन n. (-नं) Pasturage or meadow grass. E. पाशव, and पालन supporting.
पाशित: पाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tied, fettered, bound. E. पाश a fetter, and इतच् aff.
पाशिन्: पाशिन् m. (-शी) 1 One armed with a net or noose. 2 A deer-catcher or fowler, using a net or noose. 3 A name of VARUṆA. 4 A name of YAMA. E. पाश a fetter, इनि aff.
पाशीकृत: पाशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tied, fettered. E. पाश a fetter, कृत made, and ई substituted for the final of the first word.
पाशुपत: पाशुपत m. (-तः) 1 A follower and worshipper of ŚIVA, in one of his forms as the supreme deity of the Hindū triad. 2 A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. पशुपति a name of ŚIVA, अण् aff.
पाशुपतास्त्र: पाशुपतास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) ŚIVA'S trident. E. पाशुपत, and अस्त्र a weapon.
पाशुपाल्य: पाशुपाल्य n. (-ल्यं) The business of a grazier, rearing and keeping cattle. E. पशु an animal, पाल nourishing, ष्यञ् aff.
पाश्चात्य: पाश्चात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Behind, being behind. 2 Subsequent. 3 Western. E. पश्चात्, and जा aff.
पाश्या: पाश्या f. (-श्या) A number of nooses. E. पाश, and यत् aff.
पाषक: पाषक m. (-कः) An ornament for the feet.
पाषण्ड: पाषण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A heretick, an impostor, one who not conforming to the orthodox tenets of Hindū faith, assumes the external characteristicks of tribe or sect, a Jain, a Bauddha, &c. 2 Any sect not Hindū. E. पाप sin, षण to give, ड aff., deriv. irr.
पाषण्डक: पाषण्डक m. (-कः) A heretick, an impostor. E. कन् added to the preceding.
पाषण्डिन्: पाषण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A heretick, &c.: see पाषण्ड. E. पाषण्ड, and इनि added.
पाषाण: पाषाण m. (-णः) A stone in general. f. (-णी) A small stone used as a weight. E. पिश to grind, (condiments upon,) घञ् aff. आनच् added, and the deriv. irr.
पाषाणदारक: पाषाणदारक m. (-कः) A sort of hatchet for cutting stones, a stonecutter's chisel. E. पाषाण a stone, and दारक what tears or breaks; also पाषाणदारण, from दारण rending, tearing.
पाषाणदारण: पाषाणदारण m. (-णः) An instrument for cutting stones; see the last.
पाषाणभेदिन्: पाषाणभेदिन् m. (-दी) A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) E. पाषाण a stone, and भेदिन् dividing; growing amongst stones and rocks.
पाहात: पाहात m. (-तः) The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.)
पि: पि r. 1st. cl. (पियति) To go, to move.
पिक: पिक m. (-कः) The Indian cuckoo, (Cuculus Indicus.) f. (-की) The female. E. पि imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. क.
पिकबन्धु: पिकबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The mango tree. E. पिक the Kokila, and बन्धु friend; the favourite haunt of that bird.
पिकराग: पिकराग m. (-गः) The mango tree. E. पिक, and राग fondness.
पिकवल्लभ: पिकवल्लभ m. (-भः) The mango tree. E. पिक, and वल्लभ beloved.
पिकाक्ष: पिकाक्ष n. (-क्ष) A vegetable, and perfume, commonly Rocanī. E. पिक the Kokila, and अक्ष an eye; having red blossoms.
पिकाङ्ग: पिकाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A small bird, commonly Cāṭakīya. E. पिक the Kokila, and अङ्ग body or form.
पिकानन्द: पिकानन्द m. (-न्दः) The spring season. E. पिक the Kokila, and आनन्द delight.
पिक्क: पिक्क m. (-क्कः) A young elephant. E. पिक् imitative sound, and कै to utter, aff. क.
पिङ्ग: पिङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Of a tawny colour. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Tawny, (the colour.) 2 A rat. n. (-ङ्गं) A young animal. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 A yellow dye: see गोरोचना. 2 Asafoetida. 3 A tubular vessel of the body, which according to the Yoga system, is the channel of respiration and circulation for one side. 4 A name of DURGĀ. 5 Turmerick. 6 Bambu manna. (-ङ्गी) A sort of Mimosa, (M. suma, Rox.) E. पिजि to colour, aff. अच्; or पिङ्ग tawny, aff. टाप्, &c.
पिङ्गकपिशा: पिङ्गकपिशा f. (-शा) A cockroach. E. पिङ्ग tawny, and कपिश brown.
पिङ्गचक्षुस्: पिङ्गचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A crab. E. पिङ्ग tawny, and चक्षुस् the eye.
पिङ्गजट: पिङ्गजट m. (-टः) ŚIVA. E. पिङ्ग tawny, and जटा braided hair.
पिङ्गल: पिङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a tawny colour, brown, yellowish. m. (-लः) 1 Tawny, (the colour,) a dull brown, or yellow. 2 An attendant upon the sun. 3 The sun. 4 A fabulous being in the form of a Nāga, or serpent of the lower regions, to whom a treatise on prosody is ascribed; he is hence considered as a Muni, or inspired and divine personage. 5 A name of ŚIVA. 6 One of KUVERA'S divine treasures. 7 A monkey. 8 Fire. 9 An ichneumon. 10 A sort of poison. 11 A small owl. 12 The 51st year of the Hindū cycle. n. (-लं) 1 Brass. 2 Yellow orpiment. f. (-ला) 1 The female elephant of the south quarter. 2 A pious whore, commemorated in the Bhāgavata. 3 A particular vessel of the body, the right of three canals which run from the os-coccygis to the head, and which are the chief passages of breath and air, according to the anatomy of the Yoga school of philosophy. 4 An astrological house or period. 5 The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 6 Heartpea. E. पिजि to colour, Uṇādi aff. अलच्; or पिङ्गल of a tawny hue, fem. aff. टाप्.
पिङ्गलिका: पिङ्गलिका f. (-का) A sort of crane: see वलाक. E. पिङ्गल of a tawny colour, कन् aff.
पिङ्गाक्ष: पिङ्गाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) A name of ŚIVA. E. पिङ्ग reddish brown, and अक्ष an eye.
पिङ्गाश: पिङ्गाश m. (-शः) 1 A sort of fish, (Pimelodius pangasius, HAM.) 2 The head man or proprietor of a village. n. (-शं) Virgin gold. f. (-शी) The indigo plant. E. पिङ्ग tawny, आश flesh, from अश to eat, aff. अण्.
पिङ्गास्य: पिङ्गास्य m. (-स्यः) A fish: see the last.
पिङ्गेक्षण: पिङ्गेक्षण m. (-णः) A name of ŚIVA. E. पिङ्ग tawny, and ईक्षण eye.
पिचण्ड: पिचण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The belly. 2 The back of an animal. E. अपि certainly, चम to eat, aff. ड, initial of the prefix rejected; also पिचिण्ड.
पिचण्डिल: पिचण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bigbellied, corpulent. E. पिचण्ड the belly, and इलच् aff.
पिचण्डिका: पिचण्डिका f. (-का) The instep; also पिचिण्डिका.
पिचव्य: पिचव्य m. (-व्यः) The cotton plant. E. पिचु cotton, and यत् aff.
पिचिण्ड: पिचिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The belly or abdomen. 2 The back of an animal. E. अपि certainly, चम to eat, aff. ड, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
पिचिण्डिल: पिचिण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bigbellied, corpulent, potbellied. E. पिचिण्ड a belly, and इलच् aff.
पिचु: पिचु m. (-चुः) 1 Cotton. 2 The name of an Asura. 3 A Karṣa or weight of two Tolas: see कर्ष. 4 A sort of leprosy. 5 One of the eight faces of BHAIRAVA. E. पिच Sautra root, to rub, Uṇādi aff. उ.
पिचुक: पिचुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
पिचुतूल: पिचुतूल n. (-लं) Cotton. E. पिचु and तूल both meaning the same, cotton.
पिचुमन्द: पिचुमन्द m. (-न्दः) The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) E. पिचु a sort of leprosy, and मन्द to be slow, in the causal form, to make slow or check, aff. अच्; also पिचुमर्द्द.
पिचुमर्द: पिचुमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) The Nimb tree: see the last. E. पिचु as before, मृद to destroy, aff. अच्.
पिचुमर्द्द: पिचुमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) The Nimb tree: see the last. E. पिचु as before, मृद to destroy, aff. अच्.
पिचुल: पिचुल m. (-लः) 1 Cotton; also पिचु. 2 The tamarisk, (T. Indica.) 3 A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) 4 The diver or water-crow. E. पिचु cotton, ला to get, &c. aff. क.
पिच्च: पिच्च r. 1st cl. (पिच्चति) To cut, to divide.
पिच्चट: पिच्चट m. (-टः) 1 Tin. 2 Lead. 3 Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia. E. पिच्च to divide, aff. अच्, and ढौक for ढौक to go, aff. ड.
पिच्छ: पिच्छ r. 6th cl. (पिच्छति) 1 To pain or torture. 2 To hinder. r. 10th cl. (पिच्छयति) To cut, to divide.

पिच्छ n. (-च्छं) 1 The tail of a peacock. 2 A crest. m. (-च्छः) A tail in general. f. (-च्छा) 1 The gum of the silk cotton tree. 2 A line, a row or range. 3 A diseased affection of a horse's feet. 4 The nut of the Areca, betel nut. 5 A plantain. 6 The scum of boiled rice. 7 A sort of body dress, or jacket. 8 The venomous saliva of a snake. 9 The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 10 A sheath, a coat or cover. E. पिच्छ to divide, aff. घञ् or अच्.
पिच्छलदला: पिच्छलदला f. (-ला) The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. पिच्छल for पिच्छिल a tree, and दल a leaf.
पिच्छवत्: पिच्छवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Tailed, having a tail. E. पिच्छ, and मतुप् aff.
पिच्छिल: पिच्छिल mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Sauce mixed with rice gruel. 2 Sauce, gravy, or condiments with water or Ghee. 3 Broth, soup. 4 Moist, and split pulse. f. (-ला) 1 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2 A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.) 3 A timber tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 4 The name of a river. 5 An esculent root, (Arum Indicum.) m. (-लः) The tamarisk, (Tamarix Indica). mfn. adj. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a tail. E. पिच्छा rice water, scum, &c. and इलच् aff.
पिच्छिलत्वच्: पिच्छिलत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) 1 An orange. 2 Orange peel. E. पिच्छिल said to mean an orange, and त्वच् skin.
पिज: पिज (इ) पिजि r. 2nd cl. (पिंक्ते) 1 To tinge, to dye or colour, to impinge. 2 To touch. 3 To tinkle. 4 To adore. r. 1st and 10th cls. (पिञ्जति पिञ्जयति) 1 To kill or injure. 2 To be strong. 3 To give. 4 To dwell. 5 To speak. 6 To shine.
पिञ्ज: पिञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Disturbed in mind, confused, confounded. m. (-ञ्जः) Killing, slaughter. n. (-ञ्जं) Strength, power. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 Hurting, injuring, injury. 2 Cotton. 3 Turmerick. 4 A sort of palm (?) 5 A switch. E. पिजि to hurt or kill, aff. अच्.
पिञ्जट: पिञ्जट m. (-टः) The concrete rheum of the eyes. E. पिजि to give pain, अटच् aff.
पिञ्जन: पिञ्जन n. (-नं) A bow used for cleaning cotton. E. पिजि to touch, aff. ल्युट्.
पिञ्जर: पिञ्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Yellow or tawny, reddish yellow. m. (-रः) A sort of colour, tawny brown, a reddish yellow, or a mixture of red and yellow. 2 A horse, probably a bay or chesnut horse. n. (-रं) 1 Gold. 2 Yellow orpiment. 3 A cage. 4 The ribs or the cavity formed by them, the thorax: see पञ्जर. E. पिजि to dye or tinge, अरच् aff.
पिञ्जल: पिञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Confounded, overcome with terror or grief. m. (-लः) An army panick-struck, or in great disorder. n. (-लं) 1 The leaf of the Kuśa grass. 2 Yellow orpiment. f. (-ली) Two blades of Kusa grass, used as a vessel, or to take up articles with, at sacrifices. E. पिजि to hurt, &c. aff. अलच्.
पिञ्जिका: पिञ्जिका f. (-का) A roll of cotton, from which the threads are spun. E. पिञ्जा cotton, कन् added in the fem. form.
पिञ्जूल: पिञ्जूल n. (-लं) The wick of a lamp. E. पिजि to hurt, &c. Uṇādi aff. ऊलच्.
पिञ्जूष: पिञ्जूष m. (-षः) The wax of the ear. E. पिजि to stain, ऊष aff.
पिञ्जेट: पिञ्जेट m. (-टः) The excretion, or concrete rheum of the eyes.
पिञ्जोला: पिञ्जोला f. (-ला) The noise, or rustling of leaves.
पिट: पिट r. 1st cl. (पेटयति) 1 To sound. 2 To assemble or heap together.
पिट m. (-टः) 1 A basket for holding grain, a sort of cupboard or granary made of bambus or canes. 2 A basket, a box. n. (-टं) A house, a hovel. E. पिट to collect, क aff.
पिटक: पिटक mfn. subst. (-कः-का-कं) A boil. m. (-कः) 1 A basket, a box. 2 A large basket, or receptacle of basket work, for keeping grain, &c. a granary. E. पिट to collect, aff. क्वुन्; also षिट and पेटक.
पिटङ्काश: पिटङ्काश m. (-शः) A species of pike, (Esox scolopax.)
पिटाक: पिटाक m. (-कः) The name of a saint. E. पिट to collect, and आक Uṇādi aff.
पिट्टक: पिट्टक n. (-कं) The tartar or excretion of the teeth. E. पिट to collect, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
पिठ: पिठ r. 1st cl. (पेठति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To feel pain or affliction.
पिठ m. (-ठः) Pain, distress. E. पिठ, and क aff.
पिठर: पिठर mf. (-रः-री) A pot, a pan. n. (-रं) 1 A churning stick. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 3 A sort of building, a hut or watch box made of bambus and mats, or as it is  sometimes explained, a kind of store room or scullery. E. पिठ pain, रा to take, aff. क.
पिड: पिड (इ,) पिडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पिण्डति-ते पिण्डयति) To accumulate, to assemble, to heap together.
पिडक: पिडक mf. (-कः-का) A small boil, a pimple.
पिण्ड: पिण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A lump, a heap, a cluster, a quantity or collection. mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) An oblation to deceased ancestors, as a ball or lump of meat, or rice, mixed up with milk, curds, flowers, &c. and offered to the manes at the several Śrāddhas, by the nearest surviving relations. m. (-ण्डः) 1 A ball, a globe. 2 A mouthful, or roundish lump of food, considered as equivalent to a mouthful. 3 Presenting water or cake to a deceased relation. 4 The body. 5 The side immediately below the armpit. 6 A part of a house; a sort of portico or shed, in front of the door. 7 Coarse, gross, thick, solid. 8 Strength, power. 9 Myrrh. 10 Frankincense. 11 The China rose. 12 Food. 13 Flesh, meat. 14 The projection of an elephant's frontal sinus. 15 The embryo or fetus in an early stage of gestation. 16 A sum, (in arithmetic.) 17 (In astronomy) The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle, or 3°-45' n. (-पडं) 1 Livelihood, means of living. 2 Iron. 3 Fresh butter. f. (-ण्डी) 1 A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.) 2 A sort of palm, (Phœnix dactylifera.) 3 A flowering shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria flor. plen.) 4 Performance of certain gesticulations, accompanying the silent repetition of prayers, &c. in meditation on real or divine knowledge. 5 The nave of a wheel. 6 A house. E. पिडि to heap, to gather, to collect, &c. aff. अच् or घञ्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
पिण्डक: पिण्डक m. (-कः) 1 Incense. 2 A goblin, a demon. E. पिण्ड as above, and कन् added.
पिण्डखर्जूर: पिण्डखर्ज्जूर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of date tree. E. पिण्ड a lump, a cluster, and खर्ज्जूर the date.
पिण्डखर्ज्जूर: पिण्डखर्ज्जूर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of date tree. E. पिण्ड a lump, a cluster, and खर्ज्जूर the date.
पिण्डगोस: पिण्डगोस m. (-सः) Gum myrrh; also पिण्ड and गोस severally.
पिण्डद: पिण्डद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Who or what gives the funeral cake to deceased ancestors. 2 One who supports or feeds another. m. (-दः) 1 The nearest male relation. 2 A patron, a master. E. पिण्ड, and द who or what gives.
पिण्डदान: पिण्डदान n. (-नं) Presentation of the obsequial cake. E. पिण्ड, and दान giving.
पिण्डन: पिण्डन m. (-नः) A mound or bank.
पिण्डनिर्वपन: पिण्डनिर्वपन n. (-नं) Presenting obsequial cakes to the manes. E. पिण्ड, and निर्वपन offering funeral oblations.
पिण्डपाद: पिण्डपाद m. (-दः) An elephant. E. पिण्ड a lump of flesh, and पाद a foot: also पिण्डपाद्य.
पिण्डपुष्प: पिण्डपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) 1 The flower of the Asoca tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 2 The China rose. 3 A lotus. 4 A flower, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) E. पिण्ड a cluster, and पुष्प a flower.
पिण्डपुष्पक: पिण्डपुष्पक m. (-कः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. पिण्ड a lump, पुष्प a flower, कन् added.
पिण्डफला: पिण्डफला f. (-ला) A bitter gourd. E. पिण्ड a lump, फल fruit.
पिण्डमात्रोपजीविन्: पिण्डमात्रोपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living, breathing, having no intellectual existence. E. पिण्ड, माच only, उपजीविन् subsisting.
पिण्डमुस्ता: पिण्डमुस्ता f. (-स्वा) A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) E. पिण्ड a lump, and मुस्ता Cyperus.
पिण्डमूल: पिण्डमूल n. (-लं) The carrot, (Daucus carota.) E. पिण्ड lump of flesh, and मूल a root; also with कन् added पिण्डमूलक.
पिण्डल: पिण्डल m. (-लः) A bridge, a causeway, a passage over a stream or ravine, &c. or a mound raised to form a path across inundated fields. E. पिण्ड a heap, (of earth, &c.) and ला to get, aff. ड.
पिण्डवीज: पिण्डवीज m. (-जः) A flowering shrub, (Oleander odorum.) E. पिण्ड, and वीज seed.
पिण्डस: पिण्डस m. (-सः) A beggar, a mendicant living upon alms. E. पिण्ड a ball of rice, &c. सद to go or get, aff. ड.
पिण्डात: पिण्डात m. (-तः) Incense. E. पिण्ड the same, अत to be, aff. अच्.
पिण्डाभ्र: पिण्डाभ्र n. (-भ्रं) Hail. E. पिण्ड a lump, and अभ्र a cloud.
पिण्डायस: पिण्डायस n. (-सं) Steel. E. पिण्ड, and अयस iron.
पिण्डार: पिण्डार m. (-रः) 1 A keeper or attendant on buffaloes. 2 A cowherd. 3 A beggar, a religious mendicant. 4 A tree, (Trewia nudiflora.) E. पिण्ड a heap, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.
पिण्डालु: पिण्डालु m. (-लुः) An esculent and medical root, described as sweet, cooling, and diuretic. E. पिण्ड a lump, and आलु an esculent root.
पिण्डाश: पिण्डाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) A beggar. E. पिण्ड a piece of meat, आश who eats; also पिण्डाशनः and पिण्डाशिन् (-शी)
पिण्डि: पिण्डि f. (-ण्डिः) The nave of a wheel. E. पिडि to collect, (the spokes,) aff. इन्; also पिण्डी and पिण्डिका.
पिण्डिका: पिण्डिका f. (-का) 1 The nave of a wheel. 2 The instep. 3 A stool or seat of various shapes and dimensions. E. पिण्डी as above, and कन् added.
पिण्डित: पिण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Multiplied, added. 2 Counted, numbered. 3 Thick, massy, lumpish. 4 Collected, heaped together. E. पिण्ड a lump, a heap, and इतच् aff.
पिण्डिन्: पिण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a Piṇḍa or ball of food, (a ceremony, an ancestor, &c.) m. (-ण्डी) 1 A beggar. 2 An offerer of oblations. E. पिण्ड, and इनि aff.
पिण्डिल: पिण्डिल m. (-लः) 1 A bridge, a mound, a causeway. 2 An astrologer, an arithmetician, a calculator of nativities, &c. f. (-ला) A sort of cucumber, (C. madraspatanus.) E. पिण्ड a heap, &c. इलच् Uṇādi aff.
पिण्डीकरण: पिण्डीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, making up into a lump or ball. E. पिण्ड, and करण making, च्वि augment.
पिण्डीकृत: पिण्डीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made into a lump or ball. E. पिण्ड, and कृत made, च्वि augm.
पिण्डीतक: पिण्डीतक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa, Rox.) 2 A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 3 A plant, commonly Marüa; see मरुवक. E. पिण्डी a plant, तन to spread, to resemble, aff. ड and कन् added.
पिण्डीतगर: पिण्डीतगर m. (-रः) A plant, a species of tabernæmontana. E. पिण्डी the same, and तगर T. coronaria.
पिण्डीभूत: पिण्डीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lumped, heaped, made up in a lump or ball. E. पिण्ड, and भूत become, च्वि augm.
पिण्डीर: पिण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sapless, juiceless, arid, dry. m. (-रः) 1 The pomegranate. 2 Cuttle-fish bone. E. पिण्ड a ball, &c. ऋ to go, to resemble, aff. अप्, form irr.
पिण्डीशूर: पिण्डीशूर m. (-रः) A cot quean, an effeminate braggart. E. पिण्डी a house, and शूर a hero.
पिण्डोद्धरण: पिण्डोद्धरण n. (-णं) Participating in obsequial offerings, presenting them to common ancestors. E. पिण्ड, and उद्वरण sharing.
पिण्डोलि: पिण्डोलि f. (-लिः) Orts, leavings of a meal, or fragments dropped from the mouth. E. पिडि to heap, aff. ओलि.
पिण्या: पिण्या f. (-ण्या) Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.) E. पण to praise, ण्यत् aff., and इ substituted for the radical vowel: see पण्या.
पिण्याक: पिण्याक m. (-कः) 1 The sediments of seeds, &c. ground for oil; oil-cake, or the seeds after expression. 2 Saffron. 3 Asafœtida. 4 Incense. E. पिषु to pound or bruise, deriv. irr.
पितामह: पितामह m. (-हः) 1 A paternal grandfather. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ, the great father of all. f. (-ही) A paternal grandmother. E. पितृ a father, and मह aff.
पितृ: पितृ m. (-ता) A father. dual (-रौ) Mother and father, parents. plu. always. (-रः) 1 Paternal ancestors. 2 The manes, or the deceased and deified progenitors of mankind, inhabiting a peculiar region or heaven, or according to some, the orbit of the moon. E. पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.
पितृक: पितृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Paternal, ancestral, parental, obsequial, relating or belonging to parents or progenitors. E. पितृ a sire, and कन् aff.
पितॄक्थ: पितॄक्थ n. (-क्थं) Paternal property. E. पितृ, and ऋक्थ wealth.
पितृकर्मन्: पितृकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and कर्म्मन् act.
पितृकर्म्मन्: पितृकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and कर्म्मन् act.
पितृकार्य: पितृकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and कार्य्य to be done.
पितृकार्य्य: पितृकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and कार्य्य to be done.
पितृकानन: पितृकानन n. (-नं) A cemetery. E. पितृ an ancestor, and कानन a wood.
पितृक्रिया: पितृक्रिया f. (-या) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and क्रिया ceremony.
पितृगण: पितृगण m. (-णः) A class of progenitors, the sons of the Ṛṣis or Prajāpatis: the principal classes are the Sonasads descended from VIRĀṬA, the Agniṣvāttas from MARĪCI, Barhiṣads from ATRI, Somapās from BHṚGU, Haviṣmats from AṄGIRAS, Ājyapas from PULASTYA, Sukālins from VASIṢṬHA; there are also the Agnidagdhas and Anagnidagdhas, Kāvyas and Saumyas. E. पितृ father (of mankind), गण a troop.
पितृगामिन्: पितृगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Belonging to, or pertaining to a father. E. पितृ, and गामिन् what goes.
पितृगृह: पितृगृह n. (-हं) A burying ground, a cemetery. E. पितृ a deceased ancestor, and गृह a house.
पितृघातक: पितृघातक m. (-कः) A parricide. E. पितृ, and घातक slayer.
पितृतर्पण: पितृतर्पण n. (-णं) 1 The part of the hand between the middle finger and thumb, sacred to the manes. 2 Gifts in honour of deceased relations, distributed at the Śrāddhas or funeral ceremonies. 3 The act of throwing water out of the right hand at seasons of ablution, by way of offering to the manes, or deceased ancestors in general. E. पितृ a father, a progenitor, and तर्पण satisfying.
पितृतस्: पितृतस् ind. From or by the father. E. पितृ, and तसि aff.
पितृतिथि: पितृतिथि m. (-थिः) Day of new moon, on which she rises invisible. E. पितृ a progenitor, and तिथि a lunar day, sacred to the manes.
पितृतीर्थ: पितृतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) 1 Gaya, the city so called, where the performance of funeral sacrifices is peculiarly efficacious and meritorious. 2 The part between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes. E. पितृ a progenitor, and तीर्थ a place of pilgrimage.
पितृत्व: पितृत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Paternity. 2 The state or condition of a Pitṛ, or deified progenitor. E. त्व added to पितृ.
पितृदान: पितृदान n. (-नं) Gift in honour of deceased ancestors. E. पितृ a progenitor, and दान giving or gift; also with कन् added, पितृदानक n. (-कं)
पितृदैवत: पितृदैवत n. (-तं) The tenth lunar asterism or Magha. E. पितृ, and दैवत divinity, presiding over the asterism.
पितृपति: पितृपति m. (-तिः) YAMA, regent of the dead. E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, and पति lord.
पितृपद: पितृपद n. (-दं) The world or state of the manes. E. पितृ, and पद degree.
पितृपात्र: पितृपात्र n. (-त्रं) A cup or vessel used at obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and पात्र a cup.
पितृपितृ: पितृपितृ m. (-ता) A paternal grandfather. E. पितृ a father, and पितृ the same, a father's father.
पितृप्रसू: पितृप्रसू f. (-सूः) 1 Twilight. 2 A father's mother. E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, and प्रसू the parent; the first is the time when the manes are abroad.
पितृप्राप्त: पितृप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Received from a father. 2 Inherited patrimonially. E. पितृ, and प्राप्त obtained.
पितृबन्धु: पितृबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A remote or cognate kinsman by the father's side, as the son of the paternal grandfather's sister, of the paternal grandmother's sister, and of the father's maternal uncle. E. पितृ, and बन्धु a kinsman.
पितृबान्धव: पितृबान्धव m. (-वः) A remote kinsman of the paternal line: see the last. E. पितृ, and बान्धव a kinsman.
पितृभक्ति: पितृभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Filial duty to a father. E. पितृ, and भक्ति devotion.
पितृभोजन: पितृभोजन n. (-नं) 1 Food offered to the manes. 2 A father's food. 3 A kind of pulse: see Māṣa. E. पितृ, and भोजन food.
पितृभ्रातृ: पितृभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A father's brother. E. पितृ, and भ्रातृ a brother.
पितृमन्दिर: पितृमन्दिर n. (-रं) 1 The paternal mansion. 2 A cemetery. E. पितृ, and मन्दिर a dwelling.
पितृमेध: पितृमेध n. (-धं) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and मेध sacrifice.
पितृयज्ञ: पितृयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Obsequial rites. E. पितृ a progenitor, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
पितृयान: पितृयान n. (-नं) The carriage of the manes, a car to convey holy persons after their decease to heaven. E. पितृ a progenitor, and यान a vehicle.
पितृलोक: पितृलोक m. (-कः) The world or sphere of the manes: it is variously situated, but principally in the Bhuvas region or midheaven. E. पितृ, and लोक world.
पितृवत्: पितृवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a father living, &c. E. पितृ, and मतुप् poss. aff.
पितृवन: पितृवन n. (-नं) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, वन a wood.
पितृवनेचर: पितृवनेचर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A goblin. E. पितृवन a cemetery, in the seventh case, and चर who goes.
पितृवसति: पितृवसति f. (-तिः) A cemetery. E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, and वसति an abode.
पितृवाक्पर: पितृवाक्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Obedient to parents. E. पितृ, वाच् speech, पर attentive to.
पितृव्य: पितृव्य m. (-व्यः) A paternal uncle. E. पितृ a father, and व्यत् aff.
पितृव्रत: पितृव्रत m. (-तः) Who worships the manes. n. (-तं) Worship of ancestors, obsequial rites. E. पितृ, and व्रत obligation.
पितृश्राद्ध: पितृश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The obsequial ceremony of a father. E. पितृ, and श्राद्ध the rite.
पितृष्वसृ: पितृष्वसृ f. (-सा) A father's sister. E. पितृ a father, and खसृ a sister, स changed to ष; the compound may also be पितुःष्वसृ, पितुःखसृ, पितुस्खसृ.
पितृसन्निभ: पितृसन्निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Fatherly. E. पितृ, and सन्निभ like.
पितृसामान्य: पितृसामान्य n. (-न्यं) Ancestors collectively. E. पितृ, and सामान्य universality.
पितृसू: पितृसू f. (-सूः) 1 Twilight. 2 A father's mother. E. पितृ a ghost, and सू producing: see पितृप्रसू.
पितृस्थान: पितृस्थान m. (-नः) A guardian, a protector. n. (-नं) The abode of the manes. E. पितृ, and स्थान like, or in place of; a place, abode.
पितृस्थानीय: पितृस्थानीय m. (-यः) A guardian. E. पितृस्थान, and छ aff.
पितृस्वस्रीय: पितृस्वस्रीय mf. (-यः-या) A maternal aunt's son or daughter. E. पितृ, and स्वस्रीय sister's son, &c.
पितृहन्: पितृहन् m. (-हा) A parricide. E. पितृ, and हन् who kills.
पित्त: पित्त n. (-त्तं) Bile, the bilious humour. E. अपि certainly, दी to destroy, or देङ् to nourish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., or तप to inflame, aff. क्त, and the radical letters transposed.
पित्तघ्न: पित्तघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Antibilious. f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) n. (-घ्नं) Ghee. E. पित्त bile, and घ्न what destroys.
पित्तज्वर: पित्तज्वर m. (-रः) Bilious fever. E. पित्त bile, and ज्वर fever.
पित्तद्राविन्: पित्तद्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Removing bile, causing it to flow. E. पित्त, and द्राविन् what disperses.
पित्तरक्त: पित्तरक्त n. (-क्तं) Plethora: see रक्तपित्त. E. पित्त, and रक्त blood.
पित्तल: पित्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bilious, relating to the bilious humour. n. (-लं) 1 Brass. 2 The Bhojpatra or Birch tree, of which the bark is used for writing upon, &c. f. (-ला) A plant, (Jussieua repens.) E. पित्त bile, ला to get, to resemble, (in colour,) aff. ड.
पित्र्य: पित्र्य mfn. (-त्र्याः-त्र्या-त्र्यं) 1 Paternal, ancestral. 2 Obsequial, relating to deceased progenitors. m. (-त्र्यः) A father's elder brother. n. (-त्र्यं) The part of the hand between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes. f. (-त्र्या) 1 One of the lunar asterisms, also Magha. 2 Day of full moon. 3 Ceremonies performed in honour of the deceased on the day of full moon. E. पितृ a father, and यत् aff., रीङ् substituted for ऋ.
पित्सत्: पित्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Habitually falling or coming down. 2 Obtained, gained. m. (-सन्) A bird. E. पत to fall or alight, शतृ aff., and desiderative form; the reduplicate syllable omitted.
पित्सल: पित्सल n. (-लं) A road, a path, &c. E. पत to go, Uṇādi aff. सल, form irr.
पिदधत्: पिदधत् mfn. (-धन्-धन्ती-धत्) Covering, veiling, hiding. E. अपि before षा to have, शूतृ aff. and the initial rejected.
पिधान: पिधान n. (-नं) 1 A covering, a cover or concealment. 2 A lid, a top or cover. 3 A sheath. 4 A wrapper, a cloak, &c. E. अपि certainly, धा to have or hold, (from sight,) ल्युट् aff., and the initial rejected.
पिनद्ध: पिनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Clothed, accoutred, dressed. E. अपि, and नह to bind, aff. क्त.
पिनस: पिनस m. (-सः) Cold, catarrh: see पीनस.
पिनह्य: पिनह्य ind. Having put on or dressed. E. अपि before, नह to tie, ल्यप् aff.
पिनाक: पिनाक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The bow of ŚIVA. 2 A trident or threepronged spear. 3 The trident of ŚIVA. 4 A shower of dust. f. (-की) A musical instrument, a sort of viol. E. पा to preserve, (the world,) Uṇādi aff. आक, the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment.
पिनाकिन्: पिनाकिन् m. (-की) ŚIVA. E. पिनाक ŚIVA'S bow or trident, and इनि aff.
पिन्यास: पिन्यास n. (-सं) Asafœtida. E. अपि before न्यस (compounded of नि and अस to throw), to be given or place in condiments, aff. घञ्.
पिपतिषत्: पिपतिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Inclined or addicted to falling repeatedly. m. (-षन्) A bird. E. पत to come down, in the desiderative form, and शतृ participial aff.
पिपतिषा: पिपतिषा f. (-षा) Wish or inclination to come down, to fall, &c. E. पत to fall, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् aff.
पिपतिषु: पिपतिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Disposed to fall or descend. m. (-षुः) A bird. E. पत to fall, desid. form, उ aff.
पिपविषु: पिपविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to purify. E. पू to be pure, desid. v., उ aff.
पिपासत्: पिपासत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Thirsty, thirsting. E. पा to drink, desid. v., शतृ aff.
पिपासा: पिपासा f. (-सा) Thirst. E. पा to drink in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
पिपासित: पिपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thirsty, athirst. E. पिपासा thirst, and इतच् aff.
पिपासु: पिपासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Thirsty, athirst. E. पा to drink, desid. form, and उ aff.
पिपीतकी: पिपीतकी f. (-की) The twelfth of the month Vaiśākha, when giving away water is an act of merit. E. पिपीतक the name of a Brahman, said to have instituted the rite, ङीष् aff.
पिपीलक: पिपीलक m. (-कः) A large black ant. f. (-लिका) The common small red ant. E. पील to stop, repeated, कन् aff.
पिपृच्छिषु: पिपृच्छिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to ask. E. प्रच्छ to ask, desid. v. उ aff.
पिप्पटा: पिप्पटा f. (-टा) A kind of sweetmeat.
पिप्पल: पिप्पल m. (-लः) 1 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 2 A bird. 3 The sleeve of a jacket or coat. n. (-लं) Water. f. (-ली) Longpepper. E. (-पा) to preserve, aff. कलच्, and the root reiterated.
पिप्पलक: पिप्पलक n. (-कं) 1 A nipple. 2 Sewing thread.
पिप्पलीमूल: पिप्पलीमूल n. (-लं) The root of long-pepper. E. पिप्पली, and मल the root.
पिप्पिका: पिप्पिका f. (-का) The tartar of the teeth. E. पाय to increase, aff. इक, deriv. irr.
पिप्लु: पिप्लु m. (-प्लुः) A freckle, a mark. E. अपि certainly, प्लुष to burn or inflame, aff. डु.
पियाल: पियाल m. (-लः) A tree, called in Hindi also Chironji, (whence it has been named Chironjia sapida, Rox. in the catalogue it is termed Buchanania latifolia, Rox.;) in Bengal, commonly Piya or Piyal. E. पीय a Sautra root, to regard, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
पिल: पिल r. 10th cl. (पेलयति) To throw, to cast or send.
पिलुक: पिलुक m. (-कः) A tree: see पीलु. E. पिल to send, aff. कु, and कन् added.
पिलुनी: पिलुनी f. (-नी) A plant: see मूर्व्वा.
पिल्ल: पिल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ली-ल्लं) Blear-eyed. m. (-ल्लः) A bleared eye. E. पिल्ल considered as a substitute for क्लिन्न wet, &c.
पिल्लका: पिल्लका f. (-का) A female elephant. E. पिल्ल blear-eyed, aff. कन्; the elephant's eye being usually moist.
पिव: पिव (इ,) पिवि r. 1st cl. (पिन्वते) To sprinkle, to wet or moisten.
पिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Who or what drinks. E. पा to drink, अच् aff.
पिवत्: पिवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Drinking. E. पा to drink, शतृ aff.
पिश: पिश r. 1st cl. (पिशति) 1 To be decomposed, to be reduced to constituent parts. 2 To be organised. 3 To enlighten, to light.
पिशङ्ग: पिशङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a tawny or brown colour. m. (-ङ्गः) Tawny, (the colour.) E. पिश to be a component part, अङ्गच् aff.
पिशङ्गता: पिशङ्गता f. (-ता) Tawniness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, पिशङ्गत्व.
पिशङ्गिन्: पिशङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Brown, tawny. E. पिशङ्ग, and इनि aff.
पिशाच: पिशाच m. (-चः) A sprite, a fiend, a malevolent being something between an infernal imp and a ghost, but always described as fierce and malignant. f. (-ची) A female imp, a she demon. E. पिश for पिशित flesh, and अश to eat, aff. अण्, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, पिशाचक, पिशाचिका.
पिशाचकिन्: पिशाचकिन् m. (-की) KUVERA, the god of wealth. E. पिशाच a demon, इनि aff., and कुक् augment; the treasures of this deity being guarded by Piśācas, and other malignant beings.
पिशाचद्रु: पिशाचद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Trophis aspera.) E. पिशाच a goblin, and द्रु a tree; the favourite haunt of these beings.
पिशाचवृक्ष: पिशाचवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śākhoṭa tree: see the last. E. पिशाच, and वृक्ष a tree.
पिशाचसभ: पिशाचसभ n. (-भं) 1 An assemblage of goblins or fiends. 2 The place or hall of their assembly, pandemonium. E. पिशाच a goblin, and सभा assembly, but neuter in this compound.
पिशित: पिशित n. (-तं) Flesh. f. (-ता) Spikenard. E. पिश to be a component part, part. aff. क्त.
पिशिताशन: पिशिताशन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Eating meat. m. (-नः) A demon, a fiend, a cannibal. E. पिशित, and अशन food.
पिशिताशिन्: पिशिताशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating flesh or meat, carnivorous. m. (-शी) A goblin, a cannibal. E. पिशित, and अश to eat, aff. घिणुन्.
पिशुन: पिशुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Cruel, wicked. 2 Vile, low, contemptible. 3 Stupid, a fool. n. (-नं) Saffron. m. (-नः) 1 A spy, an informer. 2 A name of NĀRADA. 3 A crow. 4 Cotton. f. (-ना) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. पिश to be a part, उनन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel unchanged.
पिशुनवचन: पिशुनवचन n. (-नं) Evil speech, abuse, detraction, slander. E. पिशुन, and वचन speech.
पिशुनवाक्य: पिशुनवाक्य n. (-क्यं) Evil speech, bad report, detraction, slander. E. पिशुन, and वाक्य speech.
पिष: पिष r. 7th cl. (पिषष्टि) To grind, to pound, to bruise or powder. r. 10th cl. (पेषयति) 1 To injure. 2 To give. 3 To be strong. 4 To dwell. r. 1st and 10th cls. (पेषति पेषयति) To go or move.
पिष्ट: पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Ground, pounded, bruised. 2 Clasped, (as the hands,) squeezed, rubbed together. 3 Kneaded. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Lead. 2 The flour or meal of any thing that is ground. E. पिष to pound or bruise, aff. क्त.
पिष्टक: पिष्टक m. (-कः) 1 A cake made of the flour or meal of any grain. 2 A disease of the eyes, opacity of the cornea. n. (-कं) Oilcake. E. पिष्ट what is pounded, कन् aff.
पिष्टप: पिष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world, a division of the universe. E. पिश to go, अप् Uṇādi aff., and टन् augment; also पिष्टप.
पिष्टपचन: पिष्टपचन n. (-नं) A boiler, a seether, a sauce-pan. E. पिष्ट meal, &c. and पचन cooking.
पिष्टपशु: पिष्टपशु m. (-शुः) A type or effigy of a victim, made with flour. E. पिष्ट, and पशु an animal.
पिष्टपाकभृत्: पिष्टपाकभृत् m. (-भृत्) A boiler. E. विष्ट meal, पाक cooking, and भृत् what makes.
पिष्टपाचक: पिष्टपाचक n. (-कं) A boiler. E. पिष्ट, and पाचक what cooks.
पिष्टपूर: पिष्टपूर n. (-रं) Meal, made up into a sort of cake with clarified butter. E. पिष्ट meal, and पॄ to complete, aff. अच्.
पिष्टमय: पिष्टमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of meal or flour, &c. E. पिष्ट that which is ground, and मयट् transformative aff.
पिष्टवर्ति: पिष्टवर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A small cake, made of barley, rice or pulse ground to meal. E. पिष्ट meal, and वृत to be, and इञ् aff.
पिष्टवर्त्ति: पिष्टवर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A small cake, made of barley, rice or pulse ground to meal. E. पिष्ट meal, and वृत to be, and इञ् aff.
पिष्टसौरभ: पिष्टसौरभ n. (-भं) Sandal. E. पिष्ट ground, and सौरभ fragrant.
पिष्टात: पिष्टात m. (-तः) Perfumed powder, for scenting rooms, garments, &c. especially the scented dust, which the Hindus sprinkle over each other at the Holī or spring festival. E. पिष्ट pounded, (saffron, &c.) and अत to go or be, aff. अच्.
पिष्टिक: पिष्टिक n. (-कं) A cake made of rice flour. f. (-का) The meal of pulse steeped in water, peeled and ground. E. पिष्ट ground, ठक् aff.
पिस: पिस (ऋ) पिसृ r. 1st cl. (पेसति) To go or move. r. 10th cl. (पेसयति) 1 To go. 2 To be strong. 3 To injure or hurt. 4 To give. 5 To dwell. (इ) पिसि r. 10th cl. (पिंसयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. 3 To destroy.
पिहित: पिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, hidden, concealed. 2 Filled with. E. अपि before षा to have, aff. क्त, and the initial of the prefix rejected.
पी: पी (ङ,) पीङ् r. 4th cl. (पीयते) To drink.
पीच: पीच n. (-चं) The lower jaw, the chin.
पीठ: पीठ mfn. (-ठः-ठी-ठं) 1 A stool, a seat, a chair. 2 The seat of the religious student, made properly of Kuśa grass. 3 A place where some limb of PĀRVATĪ is supposed to have fallen, as after Daksha's sacrifice, her dead body was carried about by ŚIVA, and cut in pieces by the discus of VIṢṆU: there are fifty-one such places. 4 Complement of a segment, (in Geometry.) E. पिठ to feel pain, to be weary, aff. घञ्; deriv. irr.
पीठकेलि: पीठकेलि m. (-लिः) A male confidant, a parasite. E. पीठ a seat, and केलि sport.
पीठमर्द: पीठमर्द m. (-र्द्दः) A parasite, a companion. E. पीठ a seat, and मृद to rub, aff. घञ्.
पीठसर्पिन्: पीठसर्पिन् m. (-र्पी) A cripple, who moves about on a wheeled chair, &c. E. पीठ a seat, and सर्पिन् who moves.
पीठस्थान: पीठस्थान n. (-नं) A place where some limb of PĀRVATĪ is supposed to have fallen: see पीठ. E. पीठ, and स्थान place.
पीड: पीड (ऋ) पीडृ r. 10th cl. (पीडयति) 1 To give pain. 2 To oppose or resist. 3 To stir, to agitate. 4 To squeeze or pinch.
पीडन: पीडन n. (-नं) 1 Inflicting pain, paining, distressing. 2 Devastation, laying a country waste. 3 Squeezing, pressing, rubbing. E. पीड to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.
पीडा: पीडा f. (-डा) 1 Pain, anguish, suffering. 2 Compassion, charity, pity. 3 Devastation, laying waste. 4 A chaplet, a garland for the head. 5 The Saral tree, (Pinus longifolia.) E. पीड to pain, अङ् and टाप् affs.
पीडाकर: पीडाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Giving pain, afflicting, tormenting. E. पीडा, and कर who makes.
पीडाकरण: पीडाकरण n. (-णं) Torturing, tormenting. E. पीडा, and करण making.
पीडित: पीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Pained, suffering pain or distress. 3 Laid waste, destroyed, devastated. 4 Rubbed, chafed. 5 Squeezed, pressed. E. पीडा pain, इतच् aff.
पीड्यमान: पीड्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being pained or afflicted. 2 Suffering from. 3 Being squeezed or pressed. E. पीड to pain, pass. v., शानच् aff.
पीत: पीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Of a yellow colour. 2 Drank, quaffed. m. (-तः) 1 Yellow, the colour. 2 Safflower. 3 A topaz, a yellow gem. 4 A yellow pigment, prepared from the urine of kine. n. (-तं) 1 Drinking. 2 Yellow orpiment. f. (-ता) 1 Turmerick. 2 A medical plant, commonly Atais, (Betula.) E. पा to drink, aff. क्त; imbibed, literally, or figuratively, by the eye sight, &c.
पीतक: पीतक n. (-कं) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 Saffron. 3 Aloe-wood. 4 Brass. 5 Honey. m. (-कः) 1 A sort of gentian, (G. Cherayta.) 2 The Tūn tree. E. पीत yellow, aff. कन्.
पीतकदली: पीतकदली f. (-ली) A sort of plantain. E. पीत yellow, कदली plantain.
पीतकन्द: पीतकन्द n. (-न्दं) The carrot. E. पीत yellow, and कन्द root.
पीतकावेर: पीतकावेर n. (-रं) 1 Saffron. 2 Brass. E. पीत yellow, कावेर vile shape or substance.
पीतकाष्ठ: पीतकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Yellow sanders. E. पीत yellow, काष्ठ wood.
पीतघोषा: पीतघोषा f. (-षा) A sort of creeper with yellow flowers. E. पीत, and घोषा the plant; yellow Ghoṣā.
पीतचन्दन: पीतचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 A yellow fragrant wood, considered as a yellow species of Sandal wood. 2 Turmerick. 3 Saffron. E. पीत yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.
पीतचम्पक: पीतचम्पक m. (-कः) A lamp. E. पीत yellow, चम्पक a flower, and कन् aff. of comparison; like the Campa in colour.
पीतता: पीतता f. (-ता) Yellowness. E. पीत्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व पीतत्वं.
पीततुण्ड: पीततुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The tailor bird, (Sylvia sutoria.) E. पीत yellow, and तुण्ड a beak; the whole bird is of a light yellow colour.
पीततैला: पीततैला f. (-ला) A sort of creeper, a species of the heart-pea. E. पीत yellow, तैल oil.
पीतदारु: पीतदारु n. (-रुः) 1 A sort of pine, (P. Devadāru.) 2 Another kind of pine, (Pinus longifolia.) E. पीत yellow, and दारु wood.
पीतदुग्धा: पीतदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) 1 A cow tied up to be milked. 2 Any milch cow. E. पीत drank, दुग्ध milk.
पीतद्रु: पीतद्रु m. (-द्रुः) 1 A sort of Curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.) 2 A species of pine, (P. longifolia.) E. पीत yellow, and द्रु a tree.
पीतन: पीतन m. (-नः) 1 The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) 2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 3 The waved leaf fig tree, n. (-नं) 1 Saffron. 2 A sort of pine: see पीतदारु. 3 Yellow orpiment. E. पीत yellow, णी to go, or be, aff. ड.
पीतपर्णी: पीतपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, commonly Bichhati; a name applied to the nettle, or a plant of the same class, (Tragia involucrata.) E. पीत yellow, and पर्ण leaf.
पीतपादा: पीतपादा f. (-दा) A small bird, the Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. पीत yellow, पाद a foot.
पीतपुष्प: पीतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A species of Karṇikāra. 2 A sort of Tabernæmontana. f. (-ष्पा-ष्पी) Yellow barleria. E. पीत yellow, and पुष्प a flower; it may be applied to any plant with yellow flowers.
पीतफल: पीतफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Trophis aspera.) E. पीत yellow, and फल fruit.
पीतबालुका: पीतबालुका f. (-का) 1 Turmerick. 2 Yellow sand. E. पीत yellow, and बालुका sand or dust.
पीतमणि: पीतमणि m. (-णिः) A yellow gem, a topaz. E. पीत yellow, and मणि a gem.
पीतमस्तक: पीतमस्तक m. (-कः) A small bird, (Loxia philippensis.) E. पीत yellow, and मस्तक the head.
पीतमुण्ड: पीतमुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A gallinule. E. पीत yellow, मुण्ड the head.
पीतमुद्ग: पीतमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of bean, a yellow variety of the Phaseo lus Mūṅg. E. पीत yellow, and मुद्ग Mūṅg.
पीतयूथी: पीतयूथी f. (-थी) Yellow jasmine. E. पीत, and यूथी jasmine.
पीतरक्त: पीतरक्त n. (-क्तं) A yellow coloured gem, perhaps the topaz. E. पीत yellow, and रक्त coloured.
पीतराग: पीतराग m. (-गः) 1 The fibres of the lotus. 2 A yellow colour. E. पीत, and राग colour.
पीतल: पीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a yellow colour. m. (-लः) Yellow, the colour. n. (-लं) Brass. E. पीत, and लच् aff.
पीतलक: पीतलक n. (-कं) Brass. E. पीतल yellow, कन् added.
पीतलोह: पीतलोह n. (-हं) Yellow brass, queen's metal, or a mixed metal, resembling gold. E. पीत yellow, and लोह iron.
पीतवासस्: पीतवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Dressed in yellow. m. (-साः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पीत yellow, वासस् vesture.
पीतशाल: पीतशाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Pentaptera.) E. पीत yellow, and शास्त the Śāl tree.
पीतसार: पीतसार m. (-रः) 1 Sandal. 2 A yellow gem, a topaz. 3 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) n. (-रं) A yellow sort of Sandal wood. E. पीत yellow, and सार essence.
पीतसारि: पीतसारि n. (-रि) Antimony. E. पीत yellow, सार essence, aff. इन्.
पीतसालक: पीतसालक m. (-कः) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) E. पीत yellow, सार essence, aff. क, and र changed to ल.
पीतसोम: पीतसोम m. (-मः) A Brāhmaṇa, by whom the juice of the acid asclepias is drank at a ceremony. E. पीत, and सोम the juice.
पीतस्कन्ध: पीतस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A hog. E. पीत for पीन large, and स्कन्ध a shoulder.
पीतस्फटिक: पीतस्फटिक m. (-कः) A precious gem, the topaz. E. पीत yellow, and स्फटिक crystal.
पीताब्धि: पीताब्धि m. (-न्धिः) The Muni AGASTYA. E. पीत drank, (by whom,) and अब्धि the ocean; the saint having on one occasion swallowed up the sea.
पीताम्बर: पीताम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dressed in yellow clothes. m. (-रः) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU in that form. 2 A dancer or actor. 3 A religious mendicant, wearing yellow garments. E. पीत yellow, अम्बर vesture, raiment.
पीताश्मन्: पीताश्मन् n. (-श्म) A topaz or any yellow gem. E. पीत, and अश्मन् a stone.
पीति: पीति m. (-तिः) A horse. f. (-तिः) 1 Drinking. 2 A dram shop. E. पा to drink, aff. क्तिन्.
पीतिका: पीतिका f. (-का) 1 Turmerick. 2 Yellow jasmine. E. पीत yellow, कन् aff., and fem. form.
पीतिन्: पीतिन् m. (-ती) A horse. E. पा to drink, क्तिन् aff., इन् added.
पीतु: पीतु m. (-तुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The chief elephant of a herd. E. पा to drink, (or dry up water,) and वुन् Uṇādi aff.
पीत्वा: पीत्वा ind. Having drank. E. पा to drink, क्त्वाच् aff.
पीथ: पीथ m. (-थः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 Time. n. (-थं) Water. E. पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. थक्, and the radical vowel changed.
पीथि: पीथि m. (-थिः) A horse: see पीति.
पीन: पीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fat, bulky, corpulent, large. E. प्यै to grow or enlarge, aff. क्त, form irr.
पीनस: पीनस m. (-सः) 1 Cough, catarrh. 2 Cold, affecting the nose, inflammation of the schneiderian membrane. E. पीन fat, षो to destroy, aff. क.
पीनसिन्: पीनसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Having a cold. E. पीनस, and इनि aff.
पीनोध्नी: पीनोध्नी f. (-ध्नी) A cow with full or large udders. E. पीन large, उधस् an udder, डीष् aff. and अनङ् augment.
पीयु: पीयु m. (-युः) 1 The sun. 2 Time. 3 An owl. 4 A crow. E. पीय a Sautra root, to regard, Uṇādi aff. उ.
पीयूष: पीयूष n. (-षं) The food of the gods, ambrosia, nectar. 2 Milk. mn. (-षः-षं) The milk of a cow during the first seven days after calving. E. पीय Sautra root, to be kind or love, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
पीयूषमहस्: पीयूषमहस् m. (-हाः) The moon. E. पीयूष nectar, and महस् light; whose rays are filled with nectar.
पीयूषरुचि: पीयूषरुचि m. (-चिः) The moon. E. पीयूष nectar; and रुचि light: see the last.
पील: पील r. 1st cl. (पीलति) 1 To stop, to cease to be or do. 2 To become stupid.
पीलक: पीलक m. (-कः) The large black ant. E. पील to stop, aff. क्वुन्.
पीलु: पीलु m. (-लुः) 1 The name of a tree, applied in some places to the Careya arborea, and in others to the Salvadora persica; it is very commonly assigned also to all exotic, and unknown trees. 2 An elephant. 3 An arrow. 4 A flower. 5 The blossom of the Saccharum sara. 6 An atom. 7 An insect. 8 The metacarpus, the central part of the hand. 9 The stem of the palm tree. E. पील to stop, aff. कु; also with कन् added पीलुक.
पीलुपर्णी: पीलुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A plant: see पीलु. 2 Bryonia grandis. 3 A sort of drug. E. पीलु the tree, and पर्ण a leaf.
पीव: पीव r. 1st cl. (पीवति) To be fat or corpulent.
पीवन्: पीवन् mfn. (-वा-वा-व) 1 Fat, large. 2 Strong, robust. m. (-वा) Air, wind. E. प्यै to swell or increase, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिन्.
पीवर: पीवर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Fat, large. f. (-रा-री) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) (-री) 1 A young woman. 2 A cow. E. प्ये to increase, Uṇādi aff. ष्वरच्.
पीवरस्तनी: पीवरस्तनी f. (-नी) 1 A cow with large udders. 2 A woman with large breasts. E. पीवर large, and स्तन a breast.
पीवा: पीवा f. (-वा) Water. E. पा to drink, वन Uṇādi aff. form irr.
पुंयोग: पुंयोग m. (-गः) Association or cohabitation with men. E. पुम्, and योग union.
पुंलिङ्ग: पुंलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) 1 The male organ. 2 The masculine gender, (in grammar.) E. पुम् male, and लिङ्ग mark.
पुंवृष: पुंवृष m. (-षः) The musk rat. E. पुम् male, and वृष a bull.
पुंश्चली: पुंश्चली f. (ली) A harlot, an unchaste woman. E. पुस a man, and चल to go, aff. अच् and ङीष्.
पुंश्चिह्न: पुंश्चिह्न n. (-ह्नं) The penis. E. पुम् male, and चिह्न mark.
पुंस: पुंस r. 10th cl. (पुसयति) To punish, to pain.
पुंसवन: पुंसवन n. (-नं) The first of the essential ceremonies of Hindū initiation; a religious and domestic festival held on the mother's perceiving the first signs of a living conception. 2 Milk. E. पुम् a male, षू to bear, aff. ल्युट्.
पुंस्त्व: पुंस्त्व n. (-स्त्वं) 1 Semen virile. 2 Manhood, virility. E. पुम् man, and त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल् aff., पुंस्ता f. (-स्ता.)
पुक्कश: पुक्कश m. (-शः) A Caṇḍāla, an outcaste: see पुक्कस.
पुक्कस: पुक्कस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Low, vile. m. (-सः) A Caṇḍāla, or man of an impure and degraded tribe or occupation, born of the Niṣāda by a Śūdra female. f. (-सी) 1 Indigo. 2 A bud, a blossom. 3 A woman of the Pukkasa tribe. E. पु for पुण्य purity, कु bad (understood,) कस to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
पुङ्ख: पुङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) The feathered part of an arrow. E. पुम् man, खन to destroy, aff. ड.
पुङ्ग: पुङ्ग mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं) A heap, a collection, a quantity. E. पुं man, and गम to go, aff. ड.
पुङ्गल: पुङ्गल m. (-लः) The soul. E. पुं man, and गल to pervade, aff. अच्; also read पुद्गल.
पुङ्गव: पुङ्गव m. (-वः) 1 A bull. 2 A drug, commonly Māṣāni. 3 (In composition,) Excellent, pre-eminent. E. पुं male, and गौ a cow, aff. अच्.
पुच्छ: पुच्छ r. 1st cl. (पुच्छति) To err, to be careless or inattentive.
पुच्छ mn. (-च्छः-च्छं) 1 A tail, the tail, the hinder part. 2 A horse's tail. 3 The tail of the peacock. 4 Any hairy tail. E. पुच्छ to be careless, क aff.
पुच्छटि: पुच्छटि n. (-टिः) Snapping or cracking the fingers.
पुच्छिन्: पुच्छिन् mfn. (-च्छी-च्छिनी-च्छि) Having a tail. m. (-च्छी) A cock. E. पुच्छ a tail, and इनि aff.
पुञ्ज: पुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A heap, a quantity, a collection. E. पुं man, जन to be born, aff. ड; also पुङ्ग and पुञ्जि f. (-ञ्जिः)
पुञ्जिष्ठ: पुञ्जिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Heaped, accumulated. E. पुञ्जि, and स्थ who or what stays.
पुट: पुट r. 1st cl. (पोटति) To rub, to press, to grind or pound. r. 6th cl. (पुटति) To embrace, to intertwine. r. 10th cl. (पोटयति) 1 To be or become small, or shallow. 2 To shine. 3 To speak. 4 To reduce to powder, to grind. (पुटयति) To fasten, to string, to bind together.

पुट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 A cover, a covering. 2 A plate or vessel, made of leaves. 3 A cloth worn to cover the privities. 4 An eyelid. 5 A cup or concavity, made of a leaf folded or doubled. 6 A concavity, a shallow cup or receptacle, as the hollow of the hand. m. (-टः) A horse's hoof. 2 A narrowing or contracting of any thing. 3 A folding or doubling of any thing, so as to form a cup or concavity. n. (-टं) Two vessels  joined together, the upper one inverted for the sublimation or digestion of medicaments. E. पुट to rub or bind, aff. क.
पुटक: पुटक n. (-कं) 1 A lotus. 2 A bag or vessel made of a leaf doubled over in a funnel-like shape. 3 Any shallow cup or concavity. E. पुट to unite, aff. ल्युट्.
पुटकिनी: पुटकिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. पुटक, and इनि aff.
पुटग्रीव: पुटग्रीव m. (-वः) 1 A pot, a jar, a pitcher. 2 A brass jug. E. पुट a contracting, from पुट, and ग्रीवा the neck; having a narrow neck.
पुटपाक: पुटपाक m. (-कः) Digesting, subliming. E. पुट, and पाक cooking.
पुटभेद: पुटभेद m. (-दः) 1 The bend of a river. 2 A city, a town. 3 A musical instrument. E. पुट a contraction, and भेद breaking.
पुटित: पुटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sewn, stitched. 2 Rubbed, ground. 3 Contracted. n. (-तं) Closing or shutting the hands, to hold any thing, the hollow of the hand. E. पुट rubbing, &c. and इतच् aff.
पुटोटज: पुटोटज u. (-जं) A white umbrella or parasol. E. पुट a covering, and उटज a house.
पुटोरक: पुटोरक m. (-कः) The cocoanut. E. पुट a covering, and उरक water.
पुट्ट: पुट्ट r. 10th cl. (पुट्टयति) To decrease, to diminish, to be or become small, low or shallow.
पुड: पुड r. 6th cl. (पुडति) 1 To leave, to quit. 2 To cover. (इ) पुडि r. 1st cl. (पुण्डति) To rub, to grind or pound, to reduce to dust or powder.
पुण: पुण r. 6th cl. (पुणति) To be pure or virtuous, to do a pious or holy act.
पुण्डरिन्: पुण्डरिन् m. (-री) A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya.
पुण्डरीक: पुण्डरीक m. (-कः) 1 The elephant of the south-east quarter. 2 A leopard. 3 A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) 4 A fragrant kind of mango. 5 Fever affecting an elephant. 6 A variety of the sugarcane. 7 A silk worm (कोषकार?) 8 A student's waterpot. 9 White, the colour. 10 A sort of leprosy. n. (-कं) 1 A white lotus. 2 A lotus in general. 3 A white umbrella. 4 A kind of drug. E. पुडि to rub or grind, or according to some, to adorn, Uṇādi aff. ईक, and the form irr.
पुण्डरीकाक्ष: पुण्डरीकाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A name of VIṢṆU, n. (-क्षं) A drug. E. पुण्डरीक a lotus, and अक्षि an eye, aff. षच्.
पुण्डरीयक: पुण्डरीयक n. (-कं) 1 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 2 A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya.
पुण्डर्य: पुण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A creeper, a medicinal plant, used as a remedy for diseased eyes. E. पुडि to dissipate, (disease,) अर्य्य aff.
पुण्डर्य्य: पुण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A creeper, a medicinal plant, used as a remedy for diseased eyes. E. पुडि to dissipate, (disease,) अर्य्य aff.
पुण्ड्र: पुण्ड्र n. (-ण्ड्रं) 1 A red variety of the common sugarcane, (Saccharum officinarum.) 2 The name of a Daitya or infernal being, considered as incarnate in ŚIŚUPĀLA. 3 A mark or line made on the forehead with Sandal, &c. 4 A sort of creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 5 A worm. 6 A white lotus. 7 The name of a country, the greater part of Bengal and part of Behar. m. plu. (-ण्ड्राः) The inhabitants of that country. E. पुडि to rub, aff. रक.
पुण्ड्रक: पुण्ड्रक m. (-कः) 1 A creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 2 A sort of sugarcane: see the last. E. कन् added to the preceding.
पुण्ड्रकेलि: पुण्ड्रकेलि m. (-लिः) An elephant. E. पुण्ड्र sugarcane, and केलि pastime.
पुण्य: पुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 Virtuous, pure, righteous. 2 Beautiful, pleasing. 3 Fragrant. n. (-ण्यं) 1 Virtue, moral or religious merit. 2 A good action. 3 Purity, purification. 4 A trough for watering cattle. f. (-ण्या) Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) E. पूञ् to be or make pure, यत् Uṇādi aff., and ण्वुक् augment.
पुण्यक: पुण्यक n. (-कं) A meritorious act or obligation of a religious nature, as fasting, praying, &c. E. पुण्य virtue, कन् added.
पुण्यकर्मन्: पुण्यकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Pious, virtuous. E. पुण्य, and कर्म्मन् act.
पुण्यकर्म्मन्: पुण्यकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Pious, virtuous. E. पुण्य, and कर्म्मन् act.
पुण्यकव्रत: पुण्यकव्रत n. (-तं) The worship of KṚṢṆA for a year, with daily presents, to be performed by a woman desirous of a son. E. पुण्यक, and व्रत religious obligation.
पुण्यकृत्: पुण्यकृत् mf. (-कृत्) Virtuous, pious. E. पुण्य virtue, and कृत् who acts.
पुण्यगन्ध: पुण्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The Champak, (Michelia champaca.) E. पुण्य pure, and गन्ध smell.
पुण्यजन: पुण्यजन m. (-नः) 1 A fiend, a goblin, a Rākṣasa. 2 A Yakṣa, a divine being attendant on KUVERA, the god of wealth. 3 A pious or virtuous man. E. पुण्य virtuous, and जन man.
पुण्यजनेश्वर: पुण्यजनेश्वर m. (-रः) KUVERA, the Hindu deity of wealth. E. पुण्यजन a Yakṣa, and ईश्वर master.
पुण्यतीर्थ: पुण्यतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) A holy shrine or place of pilgrimage. E. पुण्य, and तीर्थ sacred pool, &c.
पुण्यतृण: पुण्यतृण n. (-णं) White Kusa grass. E. पुण्य, and तृण grass: it is much used in religious ceremonies.
पुण्यदर्शन: पुण्यदर्शन m. (-नः) The blue jay. E. पुण्य lucky, and दर्शन appearance.
पुण्यफल: पुण्यफल m. (-लः) A grove, a garden. n. (-लं) The reward or consequence of good actions. E. पुण्य handsome or virtue, and फल fruit.
पुण्यभाज्: पुण्यभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Virtuous, addicted to virtue. E. पुण्य, and भाज् who possesses.
पुण्यभू: पुण्यभू f. (-भूः) The holy land of the Hindūs; the central part of Asia, bounded on the north by the Himāla, on the south by the Vindhya mountains, and on the east and west by the sea. E. पुण्य virtue, and भू land.
पुण्यभूमि: पुण्यभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 The holy land: see the last. 2 The mother of a male child. E. पुण्य virtue, and भूमि land.
पुण्यरात्र: पुण्यरात्र m. (-त्रः) A night on which any religious commemoration or ceremony is held. E. पुण्य, and रात्रि night, अच् aff.
पुण्यलोक: पुण्यलोक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise. E. पुण्य virtue, and लोक a world.
पुण्यवत्: पुण्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Fortunate, well-fated. 2 Virtuous, pious, righteous. E. पुण्य virtue, &c. aff. मतुप्.
पुण्यविजित: पुण्यविजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Merited, acquired by merit. E. पुण्य, and विजित conquered.
पुण्यशील: पुण्यशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Virtuous. E. पुण्य, and शील having.
पुण्यश्लोक: पुण्यश्लोक m. (-कः) 1 A name of NALA. 2 The epithet is also applied to YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and to VIṢṆU. f. (-का) 1 A name of DRAUPADĪ. 2 Of SĪTĀ. E. पुण्य holy, श्वोक verse: who is celebrated in sacred poems.
पुण्ययोग: पुण्ययोग m. (-गः) The influence or effect of virtuous actions. E. पुण्य, and योग union.
पुण्यस्थान: पुण्यस्थान n. (-नं) A sacred place, holy ground. E. पुण्य virtue, and स्थान a place.
पुण्यात्मन्: पुण्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Holy, pious. E. पुण्य, and आत्मन् spirit.
पुण्याह: पुण्याह n. (-हं) A holy day. E. पुण्य holy, and अहन् a day.
पुण्याहवाचन: पुण्याहवाचन n. (-नं) Repeating at sacrifices, &c. ‘This is a holy day,’ three times. E. पुण्याह, and वाचन saying.
पुण्योदय: पुण्योदय m. (-यः) Good fortune, as the result of virtuous acts in a former life. E. पुण्य, and उदय rise.
पुत्: पुत् n. (पुत्) A hell to which the childless are condemned.
पुत्तिका: पुत्तिका f. (-का) A small bee. E. पुत to go, तिका Uṇādi aff.
पुत्त्र: पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A son. 2 A child, in the language of the Vedas. 3 The fifth mansion from the point of conjunction of the sun, and a zodiacal sign. f. (-त्त्री) A daughter. du. always, (त्त्रौ) Son and daughter. E. पुत्, and त्रा to preserve, the hell, (from,) aff. क; or पूञ् to purify, aff. त्त्र; one त may be rejected in writing this word, and its derivatives, leaving पुत्र.
पुत्त्रक: पुत्त्रक m. (-कः) 1 A son. 2 A son, as it were, used as a term of endearment. 3 A fabulous animal: see शरभ. 4 A rogue, a cheat. 5 A particular mountain. 6 A sort of tree. 7 A grasshopper. f. (-त्रका or त्रिका) A daughter. E. पुत्र a son, कन् pleonasm; in the feminine form the substitution of इ for the penultimate vowel is optional.
पुत्त्रकाम्या: पुत्त्रकाम्या f. (-म्या) Wish or affection for progeny. E. पुत्त्र, and काम्यच् aff.
पुत्त्रजीव: पुत्त्रजीव m. (-वः) A tree, from the fruit of which necklaces are made of supposed prolific efficacy, (Nagelia putranjiva, Rox.) E. पुत्त्र a child, and जीव life.
पुत्त्रञ्जीवक: पुत्त्रञ्जीवक m. (-कः) A plant: see the last. E. पुत्त्र a child, and जीव to live, aff. खश् and कन् added.
पुत्त्रद: पुत्त्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what confers offspring. E. पुत्त्र, and द what gives.
पुत्त्रपौत्रीण: पुत्त्रपौत्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Descended from son to son. E. पुत्त्र, and पौत्र a grandson, खश् aff.
पुत्त्रपौत्रीणता: पुत्त्रपौत्रीणता f. (-ता) Perpetual descent from son to son, &c. E. पुत्त्रपौत्रीण, and तल् aff.
पुत्त्रप्रतिनिधि: पुत्त्रप्रतिनिधि m. (-धिः) A substitute for a son, as an adopted-son, &c. E. पुत्त्र, and प्रतिनिधि a substitute.
पुत्त्रवत्: पुत्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a son or offspring. E. पुत्त्र, and मतुप् poss. aff.
पुत्त्रवल: पुत्त्रवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a son or child. E. पुत्त्र, and वलच् aff.
पुत्त्रसू: पुत्त्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of a son. E. पुत्त्र a son, and सू a parent.
पुत्त्राचार्य्य: पुत्त्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A father instructed in sacred science by his son. E. पुत्त्र, and आचार्य्य a teacher.
पुत्त्रान्नाद: पुत्त्रान्नाद m. (-दः) One who is maintained by his son. E. पुत्त्र a son, अन्न food, and आद who takes.
पुत्त्रिका: पुत्त्रिका f. (-का) 1 A daughter. 2 A doll, a puppet. 3 The cotton or pappus of the tamarisk. E. पुत्त्री a daughter, कन् aff.
पुत्त्रिकापुत्त्र: पुत्त्रिकापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 The son of a daughter, appointed to raise issue for her father; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law. 2 A grandson. E. पुत्त्रिका a daughter, and पुत्त्र a son.
पुत्त्रिकाभर्त्तृ: पुत्त्रिकाभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A daughter's husband. E. पुत्त्रिका, and भर्त्तृ husband.
पुत्त्रिकाप्रसू: पुत्त्रिकाप्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of a daughter. E. पुत्त्रिका, and प्रसू a mother.
पुत्त्रिकासुत: पुत्त्रिकासुत m. (-तः) A daughter's son, a grandson. E. पुत्त्रिका, and सुत a son.
पुत्त्रिन्: पुत्त्रिन् m. (-त्त्री) The father of a son. f. (-णी) 1 The mother of a son, or of children generally. 2 A parasite plant. 3 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. पुत्त्र a son or offspring, इनि aff.
पुत्त्रीय: पुत्त्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a son, or child. E. पुत्त्र, and छ aff.; also पुत्त्र्य.
पुत्त्रीयत्: पुत्त्रीयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Wishing for a son. E. पुत्त्र, and क्यच् aff. or nominal v., शतृ aff.
पुत्त्रेप्सु: पुत्त्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desiring a son. E. पुत्त्र, and ईप्सु desirous.
पुत्त्रेष्टि: पुत्त्रेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sacrifice performed for the purpose of obtaining children. E. पुत्त्र offspring, and इष्टि sacrifice; also with कन् added in the feminine form, पुत्त्रेष्टिका.
पुत्त्रैश्वर्य्य: पुत्त्रैश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Resignation of property or power by a father to his son. E. पुत्त्र, and ऐश्वर्य्य masterhood.
पुत्त्र्य: पुत्त्र्य mfn. (-त्त्र्यः-त्त्र्या-त्त्र्यं) Belonging to a son, &c. E. पुत्त्र, and यत् aff.
पुथ: पुथ r. 4th cl. (पुथ्यति) To injure, to hurt or kill. r. 10th cl. (पोथयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak. (इ) पुथि r. 1st cl. (पुंथति) 1 To hurt. 2 To suffer pain or uneasiness.
पुद्गल: पुद्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Beautiful, handsome, of a handsome form or figure. 2 Having form or property. m. (-लः) 1 The body. 2 The soul. E. पूर what fills, and गल what decays, deriv. irr.
पुनःपाक: पुनःपाक m. (-कः) Repeated boiling or cooking. E. पुनर्, and पाक dressing.
पुनःपुनर्: पुनःपुनर् ind. Repeatedly, again and again. E. पुनर् again, repeated.
पुनःपुना: पुनःपुना f. (-ना) The Pumpun river in Behar. E. पुनर् again, repeated, irr.; perhaps from the meandering course of the river.
पुनःसंस्कार: पुनःसंस्कार m. (-रः) Repetition of any essential ceremony, as reinvestiture with the sacrificial string of a Brahman, who has forfeited it by unknowingly drinking spirits, &c. E. पुनर् again, संस्कार ceremony.
पुनर्: पुनर् ind. 1 Again. 2 But, on the contrary. 3 Assuredly, certainly. 4 A particle indicating division or change of subject. E. पण to praise, अर् aff., and the radical vowel changed to उ.
पुनरागत: पुनरागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come back, returned. E. पुनर्, and आगत come.
पुनरागमन: पुनरागमन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back. E. पुनर्, and आगमन coming.
पुनराधान: पुनराधान n. (-नं) Renewing or replacing a consecrated fire. E. पुनर्, and आधान placing.
पुनरावर्त: पुनरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Return, revolution. 2 Repeated birth. E. पुनर्, and आवर्त्त revolving.
पुनरावर्त्त: पुनरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Return, revolution. 2 Repeated birth. E. पुनर्, and आवर्त्त revolving.
पुनरावर्तिन्: पुनरावर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Returning. 2 Subject to successive births. E. पुनरावर्त्त, and इनि aff.
पुनरावर्त्तिन्: पुनरावर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Returning. 2 Subject to successive births. E. पुनरावर्त्त, and इनि aff.
पुनरुक्त: पुनरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Repeated, said over again. n. (-क्तं) Tautology, repetition. E. पुनर्, and उक्त said.
पुनरुक्तजन्मन्: पुनरुक्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A Brahman. E. पुनर् again, उक्त said, and जन्मन् birth; whose investiture is called a second birth.
पुनरुक्ति: पुनरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Repetition, tautology. E. पुनर्, and उक्ति saying.
पुनर्जन्मन्: पुनर्जन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Re-born, born again. n. (-न्म) Regeneration. E. पुनर्, and जन्म birth.
पुनर्जन्मजय: पुनर्जन्मजय m. (-यः) Liberation, final emancipation, freedom from transmigration. E. पुनर्जन्म, and जय victory.
पुनर्नव: पुनर्नव m. (-वः) A finger nail. f. (-वा) Hog weed, (Boerhavia diffusa alata.) E. पुनर् again, and नव new.
पुनर्भव: पुनर्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Re-born, born again. n. (-वं) Regeneration. m. (-वः) A finger nail. E. पुनर् again, and भव being.
पुनर्भविन्: पुनर्भविन् m. (-वी) The sentient soul. E. पुनर् again, भव being, and इनि possessive aff.; existing again after the dissolution of one body in another form.
पुनर्भू: पुनर्भू mfn. (-र्भूः-र्भूः-र्भू) Re-born, regenerated. f. (-र्भूः) 1 A virgin widow re-married. 2 Re-existence. E. पुनर् again, (a wife, &c.) भू being.
पुनर्वचन: पुनर्वचन n. (-नं) 1 Repeated text or injunction. 2 Saying any thing again. E. पुनर्, and वचन speaking.
पुनर्वसु: पुनर्वसु m. (-सुः) The seventh of the lunar asterisms, containing according to some authorities two, and to others, four stars; (in this sense it is properly confined to the dual number पुनर्व्वसू, though in the Vedas it is used in the singular.) 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 The name of a saint, and grammarian; also KĀTYĀYANA. 4 A name of ŚIVA. 5 Commencement of wealth. 6 A Loka or division of the universe. E. पुनर् again, वस to dwell, aff. कु.
पुनर्वसू: पुनर्वसू m. du. (-सूः) An asterism: see the last.
पुन्नक्षत्र: पुन्नक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) An asterism under which males are procreated. E. पु for पुमस्, and नक्षत्र asterism.
पुन्नाग: पुन्नाग m. (-गः) 1 A tree, from the flowers of which a yellowish dye is prepared, (Rottleria tinctoria). 2 A white lotus. 3 Nutmeg. 4 A chief, a head or pre-eminent man. 5 A white elephant. E. पुं male, नाग an elephant, or aff. of eminence.
पुपूषत्: पुपूषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to cleanse or purify. E. पू to purify, desid. v., शतृ aff.
पुपूषा: पुपूषा f. (-षा) Wish to cleanse or purify. E. पू to purify, desid. v., affs. अङ् and टाप्.
पुप्फुल: पुप्फुल m. (-लः) Flatulence, wind in the bowels. E. फुल to blow, form irr.
पुप्फुस: पुप्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs. E. स्फुर to swell, deriv. irr. it is also written फुप्फुस.
पुमनुज: पुमनुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born after, like, or according to a man. E. पुं, and अनुज born after.
पुमस्: पुमस् m. (पुमान्) A man or male. E. पा to preserve, (his own duties,) Uṇādi aff. डुम and सुम् added.
पुम्वत्: पुम्वत् ind. Manlily, like a man. E. पुं, and वति aff.
पुर्: पुर् f. (-पूः) A city. E. पुर to lead, क्विप् aff.
पुरःसर: पुरःसर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) One who goes first or before. m. (-रः) A leader, a preceder. adv. n. (-रं) By or with, i. e. preceded by, attended with, as कोपपुरःसर with rage. E. पुरस् before, सर who goes.
पुरःस्फुरत्: पुरःस्फुरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Opening or becoming manifest; before one. E. पुरस्, and स्फुरत् budding.
पुर: पुर r. 6th cl. (पुरति) To precede, to lead, to go before.

पुर nf. (-रं-री) A town, a city: a place containing large buildings surrounded by a ditch, and extending not less than one Kos in length, is called a city, a Pura or Nagara; if it extends not less than half a Kos, it is called a Kheṭa or town; if less than that, a Karvaṭa, or small market town; and any cluster of houses less than that, is a Grāma or village. n. (-रं) 1 A house. 2 Pātaliputra or Patna. 3 The body. 4 The calyx of a flower, or any receptacle or cup formed of leaves. 5 Skin. 6 An upper story. 7 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) m. (-रः) 1 A sort of resin, bdellium. 2 Yellow barleria. f. (-रा) 1 The east. 2 A perfume. E. पुर to precede, क aff.
पुरज्योतिस्: पुरज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) The region or world of AGNI or fire. E. पुर primary, from पुर to precede, with क aff., and ज्योतिस् light.
पुरञ्जन: पुरञ्जन m. (-नः) Life, the living principle. f. (-नी) Understanding. E. पुर the body, and जन what produces.
पुरञ्जय: पुरञ्जय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Victorious, conquering cities. m. (-यः) 1 The proper name of a king, the third of the race of the sun. E. पुर a city, जी to conquer, aff. खश्.
पुरण: पुरण m. (-णः) The ocean. E. पॄ to fill, क्यु Uṇādi aff.
पुरतटी: पुरतटी f. (-टी) A market, a village or small fair. E. पुर a city, तट a bank, and ङीप् diminutive or depreciative aff.
पुरतस्: पुरतस् ind. Before, in front. E. पुर to precede, aff. अतसुक्.
पुरदेवता: पुरदेवता f. (-ता) The tutelary deity of a town. E. पुर, and देवता deity.
पुरद्वार: पुरद्वार n. (-रं) A city gate. E. पुर a city, and द्वार a gate.
पुरद्विष्: पुरद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A name of ŚIVA. E. पुर a name of Tripura, the demon, and द्विष् who hates.
पुरन्द: पुरन्द m. (-न्दः) INDRA. E. पुर a city, दो to destroy, ड aff. with the power of ख.
पुरन्दर: पुरन्दर m. (-रः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A thief, a house-breaker. n. (-रं) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.) f. (-रा) A name of the Ganges. E. पुर a city, दॄ to tear or rend, aff. खक्ष्, deriv. irr.
पुरन्ध्रि: पुरन्ध्रि f. (-न्ध्रिः-न्ध्री) A woman, whose husband and children are living. E. पुर the body, घृ to uphold, aff. खच्, fem. aff. ङीप्, or the final is optionally short.
पुरवासिन्: पुरवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Inhabiting a city or town. E. पुद, and वासिन् inhabitant.
पुरश्छद: पुरश्छद m. (-दः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) mdu. (-दौ) The nipples.
पुरस्: पुरस् ind. 1 Eastward. 2 In front, before. 3 Prior, first. 4 Formerly. E. पुर to precede, aff. असुक्.
पुरस्करण: पुरस्करण n. (-णं) Making perfect, &c.: see पुरस्कार. E. पुरस, and करण doing.
पुरस्करणीय: पुरस्करणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be respected, &c.: see पुरस्कर्त्तव्य.
पुरस्कर्तव्य: पुरस्कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be made complete or perfect. 2 To be prepared, to be fitted out. 3 To be set before. 4 To be treated with deference or respect. E. पुरस्, कृ to make, तव्य aff.; also पुरस्करणीय and पुरस्काय्य.
पुरस्कर्त्तव्य: पुरस्कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be made complete or perfect. 2 To be prepared, to be fitted out. 3 To be set before. 4 To be treated with deference or respect. E. पुरस्, कृ to make, तव्य aff.; also पुरस्करणीय and पुरस्काय्य.
पुरस्कार: पुरस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Making perfect or complete, finishing, polishing. 2 Preparing, getting ready. 3 Arranging, putting in array. 4 Placing before. 5 Honouring, respecting. 6 Worshipping. 7 Sprinkling with holy water. 8 Promise. 9 Accusation. 10 Attacking, assailing. 11 Anticipating, expecting. E. पुरस्, and कार making.
पुरस्कार्य: पुरस्कार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be prepared, to be fitted out, &c.: see पुरस्कर्त्तव्य.
पुरस्कार्य्य: पुरस्कार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be prepared, to be fitted out, &c.: see पुरस्कर्त्तव्य.
पुरस्क्रिया: पुरस्क्रिया f. (-या) Making perfect, &c.: see पुरस्कार.
पुरस्कृत: पुरस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made perfect, finished, polished. 2 Prepared. 3 Placed in front. 4 Revered, adored, worshipped. 5 Honoured, respected. 6 Sprinkled with holy water, initiated, anointed. 7 Promised, agreed. 8 Accused, calumniated. 9 Facing, and contending with an enemy. 10 Distrest or harassed by an enemy. 11 Anticipated. E. पुर before, and कृत made.
पुरस्नात्: पुरस्नात् ind. 1 Eastward. 2 In front, before. 3 Prior, first, preceding. 4 Formerly. E. पुर to go before, अस्ताति aff.
पुरा: पुरा ind. 1 An ancient story. 2 Old. 3 Past. 4 Long past. 5 Near. 6 Future. 7 Proximate future. E. पुर to precede, affs. क and टाप्.
पुराकृत: पुराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done formerly or of old, done long ago. 2 Done or observed precedingly. 3 Begun, commenced. E. पुरा, and कृत done.
पुराण: पुराण n. (-णं) A Purāṇa or sacred and poetical work, supposed to be compiled or composed by the poet VYĀSA; and comprising the whole body of Hindu theology: each Purāṇa should treat of five topics especially; the creation, the destruction, and renovation of worlds; the genealogy of gods and heroes; the reigns of the Menus, and the transactions of their descendants: but great variety prevails in this respect, and few contain historical or genealogical matter. There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas. 1 BRĀHMA. 2 Pādma, or the lotus. 3 Brahmāṇḍa, or the egg of BRAHMA. 4 Āgneya, or Agni fire. 5 VAIṢṆAVA, or of VIṢṆU. 6 Garuḍa. 7 Brahmavaivarta, or transformations of BRAHMA, that is of KṚṢṆA, identified with the Supreme. 8 ŚAIVA, or of ŚIVA. 9 Liṅga. 10 NĀRADĪYA. 11 SKANDA. 12 MĀRKAṆḌEYA, so called from a Muni of that name. 13 Bhaviṣyat, or prophetic. 14 Mātsya, or the fish. 15 Vārāha, or boar. 16 Kaurma, or of the Kūrma or tortoise. 17 Vāmana, or dwarf, and 18 The Bhāgavata, or life of KṚṢṆA, which last is by some considered as a spurious and modern work: the Brahmavaivarta is also of very modern origin.
