The Purāṇas are reckoned to contain four hundred thousand stanzas: there are also eighteen Upapurāṇas or similar poems of inferior sanctity, and different appellations; the whole constitute the popular or poetical creed of the Hindus, and some of them or particular parts of them, are very generally read, and studied. m. (-णः) A karṣa or measure of silver equal to sixteen Paṇas of Cowries. mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) Old, ancient. E. पुरा old, and द्यु aff. or पुरा the same, णी to get or be, and ड aff.
पुराणग: पुराणग m. (-गः) 1 A reader or reciter of the Purāṇas. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. पुराण a sacred poem, and ग who goes or pervades.
पुराणपुरुष: पुराणपुरुष m. (-षः) VIṢṆU. E. पुराण old or primeval, and पुरुष man.
पुरातन: पुरातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Old, ancient. E. पुरा old, द्यु aff., and तुट् augment.
पुरातल: पुरातल n. (-लं) The part below the seven worlds.
पुराध्यक्ष: पुराध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The governor or mayor of a city. E. पुर, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
पुरारि: पुरारि m. (-रिः) ŚIVA. E. पुर the demon Pura, or more properly Tripura, and अरि foe.
पुरार्द्धविस्तर: पुरार्द्धविस्तर m. (-रः) Part of a town, a suburb, a ward, a division. E. पुर a city, अर्द्ध part, विस्तर extending.
पुरावसु: पुरावसु m. (-सुः) A name of BHĪṢMA. E. पुरा in former life, वसु a VASU or demigod, so called.
पुराविद्: पुराविद् mfn. (-विट्) Knowing or acquainted with the past. E. पुरा, and विद् who knows.
पुरावृत्त: पुरावृत्त n. (-त्तं) 1 History, traditionary or heroic. 2 Any old or legendary event. E. पुरा old, (time, or story,) and आवृत्त happened.
पुरावृत्तकथा: पुरावृत्तकथा f. (-था) An old story. E. पुरावृत्त, and कथा tale; also पुरावृत्ताख्यान, and similar compounds.
पुरासुहृत्: पुरासुहृत् m. (-हृत्) ŚIVA. E. पुर the demon, and असुहृत् a friend, with the negative prefix: see पुरारि, &c.
पुरि: पुरि f. (-रिः) 1 A town, a city. 2 A river. m. (-रिः) A king, a sovereign. E. पॄ to fill or to cherish, इ Uṇādi aff.: see पुर, and पुरी.
पुरीतत्: पुरीतत् mn. (-तत्) An entrail, a gut. E. पुरि or पुरि for पुर body, and तन to spread, to stretch, aff. क्विप्.
पुरीमोह: पुरीमोह m. (-हः) The thorn apple, (Datura:) see घुस्तूर. E. पुरी a town, and मोह intoxicating.
पुरीष: पुरीष n. (-षं) Fæces, excrement, ordure. E. पॄ to nourish or fill, (the body,) aff. ईषन्.
पुरीषण: पुरीषण m. (-णः) Fæces: see the last.
पुरीषम: पुरीषम m. (-मः) The black kidney bean, (Phaseolus mas or P. radiatus). E. पुरीष fæces, मा to mete or measure, ड aff.
पुरीषोत्सर्ग: पुरीषोत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) Voiding excrement. E. पुरीष, and उत्सर्ग abandoning.
पुरु: पुरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Much, many, exceeding. m. (-रुः) 1 The name of a king, the sixth monarch of the lunar line. 2 Heaven, or the world and residence of immortals. 3 The farina of a flower. 4 The name of a Daityas. f. (-रुः) The name of a river, said to run a little to the north-west of the Sarsūti. E. पॄ to cherish or fill, Uṇādi aff. कु.
पुरुद: पुरुद n. (-दं) Gold. E. पुरु much, दा to give, aff. क.
पुरुदंशक: पुरुदंशक m. (-कः) A goose. E. पुरु much, दंशक who bites.
पुरुदंशस्: पुरुदंशस् m. (-शाः) A name of INDRA. E. पुरु much, दशि to destroy, असि aff.
पुरुष: पुरुष m. (-षः) 1 A man, generally or individually, a male, mankind. 2 The soul. 3 God, the Supreme Being. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 BRAHMĀ. 6 Life, the living principle. 7 An atom. 8 A follower of the Sāṃkhya philosophy. 9 A friend. 10 A tree: see पुन्नाग. 11 A sort of tree, commonly Tila or Tilaka. n. (-षं) The mountain Meru. E. पुर the body, षम to abide, aff. क, and the vowel changed; or पुर to precede, Uṇādi aff. कुषन्; also पुरूष.
पुरुषक: पुरुषक n. (-कं) Rearing as a horse, standing like a man on two feet. E. पुरुष, and कन् aff.
पुरुषकार: पुरुषकार m. (-रः) 1 Manly act, virility. 2 Effort, exertion. 3 Any act of man, manhood. E. पुरुष, and कार a doing.
पुरुषता: पुरुषता f. (-ता) 1 Manhood, manliness. 2 Valour. E. तल् added to पुरुष; also पुरुषत्व.
पुरुषत्व: पुरुषत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Manhood, virility, manly nature or property. 2 Valour, prowess. E. त्व added to पुरुष a man.
पुरुषत्रा: पुरुषत्रा ind. With or amongst men or mankind, worldly, &c. E. पुरुष mankind, and त्रा aff.
पुरुषदन्तिका: पुरुषदन्तिका f. (-का) A medicinal root; see मेदा.
पुरुषदध्न: पुरुषदध्न mfn. (-ध्नः-ध्नी-ध्नं) Of the height, or measure of a man. E. पुरुष a man, दध्नच् aff. in this sense.
पुरुषद्धयस: पुरुषद्धयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Of the height, or measure of a man. E. पुरुष a man, and द्धयसच् aff.
पुरुषद्वेषिन्: पुरुषद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Manhating, misanthropic. f. (-णी) An ill tempered, or fractious woman. E. पुरुष a man, and द्वेषिन् who hates.
पुरुषपशु: पुरुषपशु m. (-शुः) A man, a human animal. E. पुरुष, and पशु beast.
पुरुषपुङ्गव: पुरुषपुङ्गव m. (-वः) An eminent, or excellent man. E. पुरुष, and पुङ्गव a bull.
पुरुषपुण्डरीक: पुरुषपुण्डरीक m. (-कः) 1 An excellent or superior man. 2 The seventh of the nine persons called Vāsudevas or Kṛṣṇas by the Jainas. E. पुरुव mankind, and पुण्डरीक a lotus, or here used to signify pre-eminence.
पुरुषमात्र: पुरुषमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of the height, or measure of a man. E. पुरुष a man, and माचच् aff.
पुरुषर्षभ: पुरुषर्षभ m. (-भः) An excellent man. E. पुरुष, and ऋषभ best.
पुरुषवर्जित: पुरुषवर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Desolate, destitute of human beings. E. पुरुष, and वर्जित void of.
पुरुषव्याघ्र: पुरुषव्याघ्र m. (-ध्रः) 1 A vulture. 2 An eminent, or distinguished man. E. पुरुष a man, and व्याघ्र a tiger; also implying preeminence.
पुरुषशार्दूल: पुरुषशार्द्दूल m. (-लः) An eminent man. E. पुरुष, and शार्द्दूल a tiger.
पुरुषशार्द्दूल: पुरुषशार्द्दूल m. (-लः) An eminent man. E. पुरुष, and शार्द्दूल a tiger.
पुरुषसमवाय: पुरुषसमवाय m. (-यः) A number of men. E. पुरुष, and समवाय assemblage.
पुरुषसिंह: पुरुषसिंह m. (-हः) 1 An eminent man. 2 The fifth of the Vāsudevas, according to the Jainas, and the son of ŚIVA. E. पुरुष mankind, and सिंह pre-eminent.
पुरुषाद्य: पुरुषाद्य m. (-द्यः) 1 A name of the first Jaina pontiff of the present age, ṚṢABHA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. पुरुष mankind, and आद्य first.
पुरुषाधम: पुरुषाधम m. (-मः) A low man, an outcaste. E. पुरुष a man, and अधम low, vile.
पुरुषाधिकार: पुरुषाधिकार m. (-रः) Manly office or duty. E. पुरुष, and अधिकार duty
पुरुषार्थ: पुरुषार्थ m. (-र्थः) A human object: as the gratification of desire, acquirement of wealth, discharge of duty, and final emancipation. n. adv. (-र्थ) For or on account of man. E. पुरुष, and अर्थ object.
पुरुषायुस्: पुरुषायुस् m. (-युः) Life of man, human existence. E. पुरुष, and आयुस् life.
पुरुषाशिन्: पुरुषाशिन् m. (-शी) A Rākṣasa, a cannibal. E. पुरुष, and अशिन् who eats.
पुरुषास्थिमालिन्: पुरुषास्थिमालिन् n. (-ली) ŚIVA. E. पुरुष a man, अस्थि a bone, माला a necklace, and इनि poss. aff.; wearing a necklace of human skulls.
पुरुषोक्ति: पुरुषोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The name or title of a man. E. पुरुष, and उक्ति saying.
पुरुषोक्तिक: पुरुषोक्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destitute, having no friends. E. पुरुषोक्ति, and कन् aff. having only the name of man.
पुरुषोत्तम: पुरुषोत्तम m. (-मः) An excellent or superior man. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A Jina, one of the generic terms for a deified chief of the Jaina sect. 4 The fourth of the nine Vāsudevas of the Jainas, the son of SOMA. E. पुरुष mankind, उत्तम best.
पुरुह: पुरुह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Much, many. E. पुरु many, हन् to destroy or surpass, aff. ड; also पुरुहृ with डु aff.
पुरुहु: पुरुहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु) Much, many. E. see the last.
पुरुहूत: पुरुहूत m. (-तः) A name of INDRA. E. पुरु much, हूत worshipped or invoked.
पुरूरवस्: पुरूरवस् m. (-वाः) 1 The son of BUDDHA, and second king of the lunar dynasty. 2 A demigod, of the class of Viśvadevas. E. पुरु much, रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. असि, form irr.
पुरोग: पुरोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Going before, preceding. 2 Chief, principal, pre-eminent. E. पुरस् before, and गम who goes.
पुरोगत: पुरोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preceded, gone before. E. पुरस्, and गत gone.
पुरोगति: पुरोगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Preceding, going before. m. (-तिः) A dog. f. (-तिः) Precedence, going before. E. पुरस् in front, and गति going.
पुरोगम: पुरोगम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Going before, preceding. E. पुरस् before, and गम who goes.
पुरोगमन: पुरोगमन n. (-नं) Going before, preceding. E. पुरस्, and गमन going.
पुरोगामिन्: पुरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going in front or before, preceding. E. पुरस्, and गामिन् who goes.
पुरोटि: पुरोटि m. (-टिः) The current of a river.
पुरोडाश: पुरोडाश m. (-शः) 1 Ghee or clarified butter as offered in oblations to fire, with cakes of ground barley meal, that have been well steeped in it. 2 The orts, or leavings of any substance, used in an oblation to fire. 3 A sort of flat ladle or spoon, used for placing the cakes in the sacrificial fire. 4 The juice of the acid asclepias as drank at certain sacrifices. 5 A Mantra, or prayer recited in offering oblations to fire. E. पुरस् first, दिश to shew, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; the first ceremony on all sacred occasions.
पुरोडाशीय: पुरोडाशीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit to be offered in oblations. E. पुरोडाश, and छ aff.
पुरोडाश्य: पुरोडाश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Fit or proper for offering with Ghee in oblation to fire. E. पुरोडाश as above, यत् aff.
पुरोद्भव: पुरोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of former or prior origin. f. (-वा) A drug; also called Mahāmeda. E. पुरम् formerly, उद्भव produced.
पुरोधस्: पुरोधस् m. (-धाः) The family or domestic priest. E. पुरस् before, घा to have, असि Uṇādi aff.
पुरोपनीत: पुरोपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Formerly had or possessed. E. पुरा, and उपनीत taken.
पुरोभागिन्: पुरोभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Malevolent, censorious. 2 Taking the first share. E. पुरस् first, भज to serve, aff. घिणुन्.
पुरोहित: पुरोहित m. (-तः) The Purohita or family priest, conducting all the ceremonials and sacrifices of a house or family. E. पुरस्, first, and हित held, revered.
पुर्व: पुर्व r. 1st cl. (पुर्वति) To fill. r. 10th cl. (पुर्वयति) 1 To dwell or inhabit. 2 To invite.
पुल: पुल r. 1st cl. (पोलति) 6th cl. (पुलति) and 10th cl. (पोलयति) To be great or large, to be lofty or high, to be heaped up or piled.

पुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Vast, great, extensive. m. (-लः) Erection of the hairs of the body, considered as a proof of exquisite delight. f. (-ला) 1 One of the paces of a horse, the canter or gallop. 2 The soft palate or uvula. E. पुल to be great, क aff.
पुलक: पुलक m. (-कः) 1 Erection of the hairs of the body, considered as occasioned by internal pleasure or satisfaction. 2 An insect of any class, affecting animals whether externally or internally. 3 A sort of stone. 4 Flaw or defect in a gem. 5 A ball of bread and sweetmeats with which elephants are fed. 6 Yellow orpiment. 7 A Gandharba or heavenly quirister. 8 A wine goblet or glass. 9 A sort of mustard. E. पुल to be great, क्वुन् aff.
पुलकाङ्ग: पुलकाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The noose or cord of VARUṆA.
पुलकित: पुलकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Having the hairs of the body erect. 2 Joyful. E. पुलक, and इतच् aff.
पुलकिन्: पुलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Having the down of the body erect. m. (-की) A sort of Kadamba, (Nauclea k.) E. पुलक, and इनि aff.
पुलकोद्गम: पुलकोद्गम m. (-मः) Erection of the hairs of the body. E. पुलक the same, उद्गम arising.
पुलस्ति: पुलस्ति m. (-स्तिः) The name of one of the seven Ṛṣis, and son of BRAHMĀ. E. पुल great, अस to throw or cast down, Uṇādi aff. ति; otherwise with स्त्यै to collect, and क aff. पुलस्त्य.
पुलस्त्य: पुलस्त्य m. (-स्त्यः) A Ṛṣi so named: see the last.
पुलह: पुलह m. (-हः) One of the seven divine sages, the sons of BRAHMĀ. E. पुल great, हा to abandon, aff. क.
पुलाक: पुलाक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 Shrivelled or blighted grain. 2 Rice water, (according to some medical authorities.) 3 A lump of boiled rice. 4 Brevity, compendium, abbreviation. 5 Smallness, a little. 6 Dispatch, celerity. E. पुल greatness, अक to be or go, aff. अच्.
पुलाकिन्: पुलाकिन् m. (-की) A tree. E. पुलाक dry grain, इनि aff.
पुलायित: पुलायित n. (-तं) A horse's gallop. E. पुल to be great, &c. aff. क्त.
पुलिन: पुलिन n. (-नं) 1 An island of alluvial formation, or one from which the water has recently withdrawn, or a small island or bank left in the middle of a river, upon the falling of the waters. 2 Any island. E. पुल to be great, इनन् Uṇādi aff.
पुलिन्द: पुलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A barbarian, a Mleccha, a savage or mountaineer, one who uses an uncultivated and unintelligible dialect. E. पुल to be large, Uṇādi aff. किन्दच्.
पुलोमजा: पुलोमजा f. (-जा) The wife of INDRA. E. पुलोमन् a saint so called, and जा born.
पुलोमजित्: पुलोमजित् m. (-जित्) INDRA. E. पुलोमन् as below, and जित् who conquers.
पुलोमद्विष्: पुलोमद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) INDRA. E. पुलोम, and द्विष् hostile; and other similar compounds.
पुलोमन्: पुलोमन् m. (-मा) The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, the father-in-law of INDRA, and destroyed by that deity.
पुलोमभिद्: पुलोमभिद् m. (-भित्) INDRA. E. पुलोम, and भिद to tear or destroy; the god having destroyed his father-in-law to prevent his curse, for the violation of the daughter.
पुलोमारि: पुलोमारि m. (-रिः) The god INDRA. E. पुलोम the saint PULOMĀ, and अरि enemy.
पुल्ल: पुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Expanded, full blown or spread. n. (-ल्लं) A flower. E. पुल to be large, aff. क्त, form irr.: see फुल्ल.
पुष: पुष r. 1st cl. (पोषति) 4th cl. (पुष्यति) and 9th cl. (पुष्णाति) To cherish or nurture, to rear, to bring up. (इर) पुषिर r. 4th cl. (पुष्यति) To share or divide. r. 10th. cl. (पोषयति) To put on, to wear. With परि or सम्, to cherish much, or bring up with care.
पुषा: पुषा f. (-षा) 1 Cherishing. 2 A plant: see लाङ्गलिकी. E. पुष to cherish, aff. क and टाप्.
पुषित: पुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nourished, nurtured. E. पुष to nourish, aff. क्त; also without the augment पुष्ट.
पुष्कर: पुष्कर n. (-रं) 1 The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 Water. 3 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphæa nelumbo.) 4 The tip of an elephant's trunk. 5 The head of a drum, or place where any musical instrument is struck. 6 A drug, (Costus speciosus.) 7 The name of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, now called Pokur, in the province of Ajmere, about four miles from the city of Ajmere, consisting of a small town on the bank of a lake, whence its name. 8 The blade of a sword. 9 The sheath of a sword. 10 One of the seven great Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. 11 An arrow. 12 The art or science of dancing. 13 War, battle. 14 Intoxication. 15 A cage. 16 A part. 17 Union. m. (-रः) 1 A pond or lake. 2 A disease. 3 The Indian crane. 4 A sort of snake. 5 The name of a king, the brother of NALA. 6 The son of VARUṆA. 7 The name of a mountain, that in Puṣkara Dvīpa. 8 A drum. 9 One of the principal clouds, that which occasions dearth. 10 An inauspicious astrological combination of a lucky lunation with an unlucky day, and three-fourths of a lunar mansion. E. पुष to nourish, Uṇādi aff. करन्.
पुष्करमूलक: पुष्करमूलक m. (-कः) The root of the Costus speciosus. E. पुष्कर as above, and मूलक root.
पुष्करशिफा: पुष्करशिफा f. (-फा) The root of the lotus.
पुष्करस्रज्: पुष्करस्रज् n. du. (-जौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga or paradise. E. पुष्कर a lotus, and स्रज् a necklace or chaplet; wearing such.
पुष्कराह्व: पुष्कराह्व m. (-ह्वः) The Indian crane. E. पुष्कर a lotus, and आह्वा an appellation; whence also any name of the lotus is applicable to the bird.
पुष्करिन्: पुष्करिन् m. (-री) An elephant. f. (-णी) 1 A square or large pond. 2 A piece of water, a lake. 3 A pool, where the lotus does or may grow. 4 A female elephant. E. पुष्कर as above, इनि possessive aff.
पुष्कल: पुष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Excellent, eminent, chief, best. 2 Much, many. 3 Full, filled, complete. 4 Near, approached. 5 Good, salutary. 6 Possessed of all good things. n. (-लं) The mountain Meru. m. (-लः) 1 The holy place Puṣkara. 2 The son of VARUṆA. 3 A measure of eight Kuñcis or sixty-four handfuls; in some places it means four times a double handful. 4 Alms to the extent of four mouthfuls of food. E. पुष to nourish, and कलन् Uṇādi aff.; otherwise पुष्कर as above, and ल interchanged with र.
पुष्ट: पुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Nourished, cherished. 2 Burnt. E. पुष to cherish, aff. क्त.
पुष्टाङ्ग: पुष्टाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Fat, fattened. E. पुष्ट, and अङ्ग body.
पुष्टि: पुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Cherishing, nourishing. 2 Increase, advance, thriving, prosperity. 3 One of the Mātṛkās or divine mothers, nourishment personified. E. पुष to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
पुष्टिका: पुष्टिका f. (-का) An oyster. E. पुष्ट, and कन् added, fem. form.
पुष्टिकान्त: पुष्टिकान्त m. (-न्तः) GAṆEŚA. E. पुष्टि prosperity, कान्त friend.
पुष्टिद: पुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Nourishing, cherishing. f. (-दा) 1 Increase, thriving. 2 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. पुष्टि, and द what gives.
पुष्प: पुष्प r. 4th. cl. (पुष्पति) To flower, to blossom.

पुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 A flower in general. 2 The menses. 3 Expansion, expanding. 4 The vehicle or car of KUVERA. 5 A disease of the eyes, specks on the eye, albugo. f. (-ष्पा) The capital of KARṆA, or Bhāgalpur. E. पुष्प to flower, &c. अच् aff.
पुष्पक: पुष्पक n. (-कं) 1 Calx of brass. 2 The chariot of KUVERA. 3 A disease of the eyes, albugo, specks on the eye. 4 A bracelet of diamonds or jewels. 5 A cup or vessel of iron. 6 A small earthen fire-place or furnace. 7 A sort of collyrium. 8 Green vitriol. E. कन् added to the last.
पुष्पकरण्डक: पुष्पकरण्डक n. (-कं) Avanti or Oujein, or the grove in its vicinity considered as sacred to MAHĀDEVA. E. पुष्प a flower, and करण्डक a basket.
पुष्पकरण्डिनी: पुष्पकरण्डिनी f. (-नी) Oujein: see the last.
पुष्पकासीश: पुष्पकासीश n. (-शं) The green sulphate of iron. E. पुष्प a flower, and कासीश green vitriol.
पुष्पकीट: पुष्पकीट m. (-टः) 1 A large black bee. 2 Any insect affecting flowers. E. पुष्प a flower, and कीट an insect.
पुष्पकेतन: पुष्पकेतन m. (-नः) The Hindu Cupid. E. पुष्प a flower, and केतन a symbol.
पुष्पकेतु: पुष्पकेतु m. (-तुः) 1 Calx of brass. 2 The god of love. E. पुष्प flower, and केतु mark or sign.
पुष्पगण्डिका: पुष्पगण्डिका f. (-का) Contrary purpose or effort of a man and woman.
पुष्पगिरि: पुष्पगिरि m. (-रिः) A fabulous mountain, the favourite resort of VARUṆA. E. पुष्प a flower, and गिरि a mountain, the hill of flowers.
पुष्पघातक: पुष्पघातक m. (-कः) A bambu. E. पुष्प flower, and घातक destroyer; the stem decaying after the plant flowers.
पुष्पचय: पुष्पचय n. (-यं) 1 A quantity of flowers. 2 Gathering flowers. E. पुष्प, and चय gathering.
पुष्पचाप: पुष्पचाप m. (-पः) KĀMADEVA, the Hindu Cupid. E. पुष्प a flower, and चाप a bow; who arms his bow with flowers.
पुष्पचामर: पुष्पचामर m. (-रः) 1 A plant, (Artemisia.) 2 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. पुष्प a flower, and चामर a Chowri, having a large bushy flower.
पुष्पद: पुष्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives flowers. m. (-दः) A tree. E. पुष्प a flower, and द what gives.
पुष्पदन्त: पुष्पदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The elephant of the north-west quarter. 2 A chief of the Gandharbas or Vidyādharas, attendant upon ŚIVA. 3 One of the Jinas or Jaina teachers. 4 A Nāga or serpent of the infernal regions. m. dual. (-न्तौ) The sun and moon. E. पुष्प flower, and दन्त a tooth.
पुष्पदन्तक: पुष्पदन्तक m. (-कः) A chief of the Gandharbas. E. कन् added to the last.
पुष्पद्रव: पुष्पद्रव m. (-वः) 1 The exudation or saccharine matter of flowers. 2 An infusion of flowers, as rose water, &c. E. पुष्प, and द्रव oozing, distilling.
पुष्पध: पुष्पध m. (-घः) The offspring of an outcaste Brahman.
पुष्पधन्वन्: पुष्पधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) KĀMADEVA. E. पुष्प, and धनु a bow, अनङ् aff. otherwise पुष्पधनुः see पुष्पचाष.
पुष्पनिकर: पुष्पनिकर m. (-रः) Throwing flowers. E. पुष्प, and नि before कॄ to throw, अच् aff.
पुष्पनिक्ष: पुष्पनिक्ष m. (-क्षः) A bee. E. पुष्प, and निक्ष who kisses.
पुष्पनिर्यास: पुष्पनिर्यास m. (-सः) Nectar of flowers. E. पुष्प, and निर्य्यास extract.
पुष्पन्धय: पुष्पन्धय m. (-यः) A bee. E. पुष्प a flower, धे to drink, aff. खश्.
पुष्पपथ: पुष्पपथ m. (-थः) The vulva. E. पुष्प the menses, and पथिन् a road अप् aff.
पुष्पपुर: पुष्पपुर n. (-रं) Pātaliputra or Palibothra. E. पुष्प flower, and पुर a city.
पुष्पप्रचय: पुष्पप्रचय m. (-यः) 1 Gathering fruit or flowers, &c. any way except by the hand. 2 Stealing flowers. E. पुष्प, and प्र before चि to collect, aff. अच्.
पुष्पप्रचाय: पुष्पप्रचाय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers with the hand. E. पुष्प, and प्र before चि to collect, घञ् aff.
पुष्पफल: पुष्पफल m. (-लः) 1 Elephant or wood apple. 2 A pumpkin gourd. E. पुष्प a flower, and फल fruit.
पुष्पभव: पुष्पभव m. (-वः) Nectar of flowers. E. पुष्प, and भव being.
पुष्पमास: पुष्पमास m. (-सः) Spring. E. पुष्प flower, and मास a month or season.
पुष्परक्त: पुष्परक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Dyed red with vegetable colour, as safflower, &c. m. (-क्तः) A shrub, (Hibiscus phæniceus.) E. पुष्प flower, and रक्त coloured, red.
पुष्परथ: पुष्परथ m. (-थः) A car or carriage for travelling or pleasure, or any purpose except war. E. पुष्प a flower, and रथ a car.
पुष्परस: पुष्परस m. (-सः) The nectar or honey of flowers. E. पुष्प, and रस juice.
पुष्परसाह्वय: पुष्परसाह्वय n. (-यं) Honey, nectar., E. पुष्परस, and आह्वय name.
पुष्पराग: पुष्पराग m. (-गः) A topaz. E. पुष्प a flower, and राग colour.
पुष्परेणु: पुष्परेणु m. (-णुः) The dust or farina of flowers. E. पुष्प, and रेणु dust.
पुष्परोचन: पुष्परोचन m. (-नः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. पुष्प, and रोचन pleasing.
पुष्पलाव: पुष्पलाव m. (-वः) A flower-seller, a garland-maker. f. (-वी) A female flower-gatherer. E. पुष्प, and लाव who cuts.
पुष्पलिक्ष: पुष्पलिक्ष m. (-क्षः) A bee. E. पुष्प a flower, लिह to lick, स aff.
पुष्पलिह्: पुष्पलिह् m. (-लिट्) A large black bee. E. पुष्प, and लिह to lick, क्विप् aff.
पुष्पवत्: पुष्पवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having flowers, flowery. m. always dual. (-न्तौ) The sun and moon. f. (-वती) A woman during menstruation. E. पुष्प a flower, or expansion as at rising, &c. and मतुप् aff.
पुष्पवन्त: पुष्पवन्त m. dual. (-न्तौ) The sun and moon. E. पुष्प a flower, अव to prevent, भच् aff.
पुष्पवर्ष: पुष्पवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A rain of flowers, flowers cast from heaven upon a hero or demigod, or on any great occasion. E. पुष्प, and वर्ष raining; also पुष्पवर्षण, पुष्पवृष्टि, &c.
पुष्पवाटी: पुष्पवाटी f. (-टी) A flower garden. E. पुष्प, and वाटी a garden.
पुष्पशकटी: पुष्पशकटी f. (-टी) Raining flowers, on any great occasion of rejoicing in earth and heaven.
पुष्पशर: पुष्पशर m. (-रः) KĀMADEVA, the god of love. E. पुष्प, and शर an arrow.
पुष्पशरासन: पुष्पशरासन m. (-नः) KĀMADEVA. E. पुष्प, and शरासन a quiver.
पुष्पशून्य: पुष्पशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Not bearing flowers, flowerless. E. पुष्प, and शून्य void of.
पुष्पशालिन्: पुष्पशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Flowery. E. पुष्प, and शालिन् having.
पुष्पश्री: पुष्पश्री f. (-श्रीः) Abundance, or beauty of flowers. E. पुष्प, and श्री wealth.
पुष्पसमय: पुष्पसमय m. (-यः) Spring. E. पुष्प, and समय a season.
पुष्पसार: पुष्पसार m. (-रः) The nectar, or honey of flowers. E. पुष्प, and सार essence.
पुष्पस्वेद: पुष्पस्वेद m. (-दः) The nectar, or honey of flowers. E. पुष्प, and स्वेद sweat, or exudation.
पुष्पहासा: पुष्पहासा f. (-सा) A woman during menstruation. E. पुष्प, and हास who smiles.
पुष्पहीन: पुष्पहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flowerless, not flowering. f. (-ना) 1 The glomerous fig tree. 2 A woman whose menstruation has ceased, a barren woman. E. पुष्प a flower, &c. and हीन abandoned.
पुष्पाजीव: पुष्पाजीव m. (-वः) A flowerman, a maker of garlands. E. पुष्प, and आजीव livelihood.
पुष्पाजीविन्: पुष्पाजीविन् m. (-वी) A flowerman, a maker of garlands. E. पुष्प, आजीव livelihood, इनि aff.
पुष्पाञ्जन: पुष्पाञ्जन n. (-नं) The calx of brass. E. पुष्प a flower, and अञ्जन collyrium.
पुष्पाञ्जलि: पुष्पाञ्जलि mf. (-लिः-ली) Presenting a nosegay or flowers, held in both hands opened, and hollowed. E. पुष्प, and अञ्जलि the hands joined, and opened; also similar compounds, as कुसुमाञ्जलि, प्रसूनाञ्जलि, &c.
पुष्पावचय: पुष्पावचय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers. E. पुष्प, and अवचय collecting.
पुष्पावचायिन्: पुष्पावचायिन् mf. (-यी-यिनी) A flower-gatherer. E. पुष्प, and अवचायिन् who collects.
पुष्पासव: पुष्पासव n. (-वं) Honey. E. पुष्प, and आसव spirit.
पुष्पास्त्र: पुष्पास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) KANDARPA, the Hindu Cupid. E. पुष्प, and अस्त्र a weapon; pointing his darts with flowers.
पुष्पाहर: पुष्पाहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what takes flowers. E. पुष्प, and आहर who or what takes.
पुष्पिका: पुष्पिका f. (-का) 1 The tartar of the teeth. 2 The mucus of the glans penis, or urethra. E. पुष्प a flower, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.
पुष्पित: पुष्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowered, in flower. f. (-ता) A woman during menstruation. E. पुष्प, and इतच् aff.
पुष्पिताग्रा: पुष्पिताग्रा f. (-ग्रा) A form of metre, a mixed kind and a variety of the Aupacchandasika; the line consisting of four or six short syllables, a pyrrhic or a dactyl, two trochees and a spondee.
पुष्पिन्: पुष्पिन् mfn. (-ष्पी-ष्पिणी-ष्पि) Flowering, bearing flowers. E. पुष्प, and इनि aff.
पुष्पेषु: पुष्पेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA. E. पुष्प, and इषु an arrow.
पुष्य: पुष्य mf. (-ष्यः-ष्या) 1 The eighth lunar asterism, comprising three stars, of which one is δ Cancer. 2 The month Paus, (Dec.Jan.) 3 The Kali, or fourth age. E. पुष to nourish, aff. क्यप.
पुष्यरथ: पुष्यरथ m. (-थः) Any sort of car or carriage, except a war chariot. E. पुष्य the asterism, and रथ a car; also पुष्परथ.
पुष्यलक: पुष्यलक m. (-कः) 1 The musk deer. 2 A pin, a bolt, a stake. 3 A naked mendicant. It is read in some places पुष्पलक.
पुस्त: पुस्त r. 10th cl. (पुस्तयति) 1 To respect. 2 To disregard, to treat with disrespect. 3 To bind. 4 To smear.

पुस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Filled. 2 Covered. n. (-स्तं) 1 Smearing, anointing, painting, plastering, &c. 2 Any thing made of metal, wood or clay, &c. nf. (-स्तं-स्ती) A book, a manuscript. E. पुस्त to bind, अच् aff.
पुस्तक: पुस्तक nf. (-कं-की) A book, a manuscript. E. कन् added to the last.
पुस्तकर्मन्: पुस्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Plaistering, painting, &c. see पुस्त. E. पुस्त as above, कर्म्मन् business.
पुस्तकर्म्मन्: पुस्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Plaistering, painting, &c. see पुस्त. E. पुस्त as above, कर्म्मन् business.
पुस्फुस: पुस्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs; also पुप्फुस and फुप्फुस.
पू: पू (ङ) पूङ् r. 1st cl. (पवते) (ञ्) पूञ् r. 9th cl. (पुनाति पुनीते) To purify, to cleanse, physically or metaphorically. r. 4th cl. (पूयते) To grow or become pure.
पूग: पूग m. (-गः) 1 The betelnut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 A heap, a quantity, a multitude. 3 Disposition, property, nature. 4 The Jack tree. n. (-गं) The fruit of the faufel, the betelnut. E. पू to cleanse, गन् Uṇādi aff.
पूगकृत: पूगकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assembled, collected. E. पूग, and कृत made.
पूगपात्र: पूगपात्र n. (-त्रं) A betel-box. E. पूग, and पात्र a vessel.
पूगपीठ: पूगपीठ n. (-ठं) A spitting pot. E. पूग betel, and पीठ a stool; chewing the pān producing an increased excretion of saliva.
पूगपुष्पिका: पूगपुष्पिका f. (-का) Flowers and betel presented to the principal guests at a marriage festival. E. पूग, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.
पूगफल: पूगफल n. (-लं) The Areca nut. E. पूग, and फल fruit.
पूगरोट: पूगरोट m. (-टः) The marshy date tree, (Phoenix or Elate paludosa.) पूग Areca, and रुट् to shine, to resemble, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added पूगरोटक.
पूज: पूज r. 10th cl. (पूजयनि) To adore, to reverence, to worship. With सम्, to pay respect to.
पूजक: पूजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Worshipping, a worshipper. E. पूज to worship, वुन् aff.
पूजत्: पूजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Worshipping, reverencing. E. पूज to worship, शतृ aff.
पूजन: पूजन n. (-नं) Worship, worshipping: see पूजा. f. (-नी) A sparrow. E. पूज to worship, and ल्युट् aff.
पूजनीय: पूजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be worshipped or revered. E. पूज and अनीयर् aff.
पूजयितव्य: पूजयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be worshipped. E. पूज to worship, and तव्य aff.
पूजयितृ: पूजयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Worshipping, a worshipper. E. पूज to worship, तृच् aff.
पूजा: पूजा f. (-जा) Worship, culture, respect, homage of superiors or adoration of the gods. E. पूज to worship, aff. अङ् and टाप.
पूजार्ह: पूजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worshipful, venerable, respectable, sacred. E. पूजा worship, अर्ह fit, deserving.
पूजित: पूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, adored, reverenced. E. पूज to worship, क्त aff.
पूजिल: पूजिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Venerable, respectable, worshipful, &c. m. (-लः) A deity. E. पूजा, and इलच् aff.
पूज्य: पूज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Worshipful, venerable, fit for or deserving adoration, &c. m. (-ज्यः) A father-in-law. E. पूज to worship, ण्यत् aff.
पूज्यमान: पूज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being reverenced or respected. E. पूज to worship, pass. v., शानच् aff.
पूण: पूण r. 10th cl. (पूणयति) To accumulate, to collect or heap together.
पूत्कारी: पूत्कारी f. (-री) 1 The capital of the Nāgas. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ.
पूत: पूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Threshed, winnowed. 3 Cleaned, cleansed. 4 Speaking the truth, sincere, honest. 5 Foul smelling, stinking. 6 Guarded, defended. n. (-तं) Truth, speaking truth. m. (-तः) 1 A conch shell. 2 Kusa grass. m. du. (-तौ) The buttocks. E. पू to purify, aff. क्त.
पूतक्रतायी: पूतक्रतायी f. (-यी) The wife of INDRA. E. पूतक्रतु INDRA, ङीप् aff.; in place of उ, ऐच् is inserted, and then changed before ई to आय.
पूतक्रतु: पूतक्रतु m. (-तुः) A name of INDRA. E. पूत pure, and क्रतु sacrifice.
पूतद्रु: पूतद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. पूत, and द्रु a tree.
पूतधान्य: पूतधान्य n. (-न्यं) Sesamum. E. पूत, and धान्य grain.
पूतना: पूतना f. (-ना) 1 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 2 The name of a female demon killed by KṚṢṆA. 3 A disease, atrophy and wasting in a child, ascribed to the malignant operations of the female fiend PŪTANĀ. E. पूत to be pure, nominal verb, युच् aff.
पूतनारि: पूतनारि m. (-रिः) KṚṢṆA. E. पूतना a female fiend, and अरि the foe.
पूतनासूदन: पूतनासूदन m. (-नः) KṚṢṆA. E. पूतना, and सूदन destroyer.
पूतनाहन्: पूतनाहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. पूतना, and हन् who kills: see the three words preceding.
पूतपाप: पूतपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified, freed from sin. E. पूत, and पाप sin.
पूतपाप्मन्: पूतपाप्मन् mfn. (-प्मा-प्मा-प्म) Purified from sin. E. पूत, and पाप्मन् sin.
पूतफल: पूतफल m. (-लः) The jack tree. E. पूत fetid, फल fruit.
पूतात्मन्: पूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 A saint, an ascetic, a pure or purified person. 2 A man of a cleanly person, or purified by ablution. E. पूत purified, आत्मन् spirit or self.
पूति: पूति f. (-तिः) 1 Purity, purification. 2 A stench, a stink. 3 Civet. E. पू to be pure, or पूय to stink, aff. क्तिन्.
पूतिक: पूतिक m. (-कः) Grey bonduc, (Cæsalpinia bonducella, Rox.) f. (-का) 1 A potherb, (Basella lucida, &c.) 2 A civet or polecat. n. (-कं) Ordure, excrement. E. पूति a stink, कन् aff.
पूतिकरज: पूतिकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) E. पूतिक the same, रञ्ज to colour, aff. अण्; also with the nasal retained पूतिकरञ्ज.
पूतिकर्णक: पूतिकर्णक m. (-कः) Fetid ulceration of the ear. E. पूति, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.
पूतिकामुख: पूतिकामुख m. (-खः) A bivalve shell. E. पूतिका a potherb, and मुख face, appearance.
पूतिकाष्ठ: पूतिकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A sort of pine, (P. devadaru.) E. पूति purity, काष्ठ wood; also with कन् added पूतिकाष्ठक.
पूतिगन्ध: पूतिगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Ill-smelling. n. (-न्धं) Sulphur. E. पूति a stink, and गन्ध smell.
पूतिगन्धि: पूतिगन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Ill-smelling. E. पूति stinking, गन्ध smell, and इन् substituted for the final.
पूतिगन्धिक: पूतिगन्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ill-smelling, fetid. E. पूति a stink, गन्ध smell, ठक् aff.
पूतितैला: पूतितैला f. (-ला) Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum halicacabum.) E. पूति stink, तैल oil.
पूतिपुष्पिका: पूतिपुष्पिका f. (-का) A variety of the common citron, (Citrus medica.) E. पूति stinking, and पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.
पूतिनस्य: पूतिनस्य n. (-स्यं) Fetid exhalation from the nostrils. E. पूति, and नस्य nostril.
पूतिफला: पूतिफला f. (-ला) A plant, (Psoralea corilifolia.) E. पूति stinking, and फल fruit.
पूतिफली: पूतिफली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. पूति stink, फल fruit.
पूतिमांस: पूतिमांस n. (-सं) Dead or decayed flesh. E. पूति, and मांस flesh.
पूतिवात: पूतिवात m. (-तः) The Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) 2 Foul air. E. पूति a stink, and वात wind.
पूतिवृक्ष: पूतिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. पूति a foul smell, and वृक्ष a tree.
पूतिशारिजा: पूतिशारिजा f. (-जा) The pole or civet-cat.
पूतीक: पूतीक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) 2 The polecat or civet-cat. f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.) E. पूति a stink or purity, कन् added, and the penultimate optionally long; also पूतिक.
पूतीकरज: पूतीकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) Also पूतीक, पूतिक, पूतिकरज, पूतीकरञ्ज, or पूतिकरञ्ज.
पूत्यण्ड: पूत्यण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The musk deer. 2 An insect with a fetid smell, the winged bug. E. पूति a stench, and अण्ड the testicle or any egg.
पून: पून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lost, destroyed. E. पू to purify, aff. क्र, deriv. irr; also पूत.
पूप: पूप m. (-पः) A cake. E. पू to purify, aff. पक्.
पूपला: पूपला f. (-ला) A sort of sweet cake, fried with Ghee or oil. E. पूप cake, ला to get or be, aff. क.
पूपशाला: पूपशाला f. (-ला) A baker's or confectioner's shop. E. पूप, and शाला a hall.
पूपाली: पूपाली f. (-ली) A sort of cake or biscuit, made of meal or barley, half baked or fried. E. पूप cake, आङ् before, ला to be or resemble, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीप्; also with कन् added पूपालिका.
पूपिका: पूपिका f. (-का) A sort of cake, half baked or fried in oil or Ghee. E. पूय a cake, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.
पूय: पूय (ई) पूयी r. 1st cl. (पूयते) 1 To split or cleave. 2 To stink.
पूय n. (-यं) Pus, matter, discharge from an ulcer or wound. E. पूय to stink, aff. अच्.
पूयन: पूयन n. (-नं) Pus, discharge from a wound or sore. E. पूय to stink, ल्युट् aff.
पूयरक्त: पूयरक्त n. (-क्तं) 1 Ichor, sanies. 2 Discharge of sanies from the nostrils. E. पूय, and रक्त blood.
पूयशोणित: पूयशोणित n. (-तं) Ichor, sanies. E. पूय, and शोणित blood.
पूयारि: पूयारि m. (-रिः) The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) E. पूय pus, and अरि inimical; the leaves being used to produce discussion, or the absorption of matter that has formed.
पूयालस: पूयालस m. (-सः) 1 Suppuration at the joints, white swelling. 2 Matter in the eye. E. पूय, and अलस idle.
पूर: पूर r. 4th cl. (ई) पूरी (पूर्य्यते) 1 To satisfy. 2 To fill. 3 To be satisfied. 4 To be full. r. 10th cl. (पूरयति) To satisfy.

पूर mfn. subst. (-रः-रा-रं) A sort of unleavened cake, fried with Ghee or oil. m. (-रः) 1 A piece of water, a large quantity of water, a lake. 2 The healing or cleansing of ulcers. adj. (-रः-रा-रं) Full, filled. E. पूर to fill, अच् aff.
पूरक: पूरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Filling, completing, or that which fills or completes. 2 Filling up. m. (-कः) 1 A citron, (Citrus medica.) 2 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier. 3 Closing the right nostril, and drawing up air through the left, a religious ceremonial. 4 The funeral cake or cakes that must be given to complete the obsequial rites. E. पूर to fill, aff. क्वुन्.
पूरकृत: पूरकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Filled. E. पूर, and कृत made.
पूरण: पूरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णी-णं) Filling, completing. n. (-णं) 1 Act of filling, completing or making up. 2 The final obsequial ball or cake. 3 Multiplication, (in arithmetic.) 4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 5 Rain, raining. nf. (-णं-णी) The cross threads in weaving a piece of cloth. m. (-णः) 1 A bridge, a causeway. 2 The ocean. 3 A medicinal oil or embrocation. f. (-णी) The silk cotton tree. E. पूर to fill, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
पूरयितृ: पूरयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Filling. E. पूर to fill, तृन् aff.
पूरयित्वा: पूरयित्वा ind. Having filled. E. पूर to fill, क्त्वाच् aff.
पूरिका: पूरिका f. (-का) A sort of unleavened cake, fried with Ghee or oil. E. पूरी as above, aff. कन्.
पूरित: पूरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Filled, full, complete. 2 Multiplied. 3 Overspread. E. पूर to be full, aff. क्त.
पूरुष: पूरुष m. (-षः) Man, male, mankind. E. पूर to be full, (the world,) aff. कुषन्; it is also written पुरुष, &c.
पूर्ण: पूर्ण r. 10th cl. (पूर्णयति) To accumulate, to collect or heap together.

पूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Full, filled, complete. 2 All, entire. 3 Strong, powerful, able. 4 Selfish, self-indulgent. f. (-र्णा) 1 Fifth, tenth, or fifteenth day of the half month. 2 Full moon. E. पूर to be full, aff. क्त, form irr.
पूर्णक: पूर्णक m. (-कः) A cock. f. (-र्णिका) A sort of bird, described as having a double or cleft beak; also नासाच्छिन्नी. E. पूर्ण full, कन् aff.
पूर्णकाम: पूर्णकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Satisfied, satiated. E. पूर्ण fulfilled, काम desire.
पूर्णकुम्भ: पूर्णकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A water vessel, one filled with holy water, used at the consecration of a king. 2 A full cup or jar. E. पूर्ण full, and कुम्भ a water jar.
पूर्णपाच: पूर्णपाच n. (-चं) 1 A full cup or vessel. 2 A vessel filled with clothes or ornaments, which are scrambled for by the guests and relations at a festival. 3 A vessel full of rice, presented at a sacrifice to the superintending and officiating priests; the Pūrṇa Pātra is properly a measure of 256 handfuls of rice; it may also be composed of as much as will satisfy one great eater. E. पूर्ण full, and पाच a vessel.
पूर्णमा: पूर्णमा f. (-मा) The day of full moon. E. पूर्ण full, मा the moon; also पूर्णिमा, &c.
पूर्णमास: पूर्णमास m. (-सः) A monthly sacrifice, performed on the day of full moon; also पार्णमास. f. (-सी) Day of full moon. E. पूर्ण complete, मास the month.
पूर्णवीज: पूर्णवीज m. (-जः) The citron. E. पूर्ण, and वीज seed.
पूर्णानक: पूर्णानक n. (-कं) 1 A vessel full of clothes, &c. at a feast: see पूर्णपात्र. 2 The sound of a drum. 3 A moon-beam. E. पूर्ण full, अन to go, or be, aff. वुन्; also read पूर्णालक.
पूर्णालक: पूर्णालक n. (-कं) A vessel of clothes or ornaments to be scrambled for. E. पूर्ण full, अल to ornament, aff. ण्वुल्; also sometimes written पूर्णानक.
पूर्णिमा: पूर्णिमा f. (-मा) Day of full moon. E. पूर्ण full, (the moon,) इमक् aff.
पूर्णेन्दु: पूर्णेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The moon, the full moon. E. पूर्ण, and इन्दु the moon.
पूर्त: पूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Filled, full, complete. 2 Covered, concealed. n. (-र्त्तं) 1 An act of pious liberality, as digging a well, planting a grove, building a temple, &c. 2 Nourishing, cherishing. E. पॄ to cherish or fill, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
पूर्त्त: पूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Filled, full, complete. 2 Covered, concealed. n. (-र्त्तं) 1 An act of pious liberality, as digging a well, planting a grove, building a temple, &c. 2 Nourishing, cherishing. E. पॄ to cherish or fill, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
पूर्ति: पूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Fulness, completion. E. पॄ to satisfy or fill, aff. क्तिच्.
पूर्त्ति: पूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Fulness, completion. E. पॄ to satisfy or fill, aff. क्तिच्.
पूर्तिन्: पूर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Filling, completing. 2 Effective. E. प to satisfy, णिनि aff.
पूर्त्तिन्: पूर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Filling, completing. 2 Effective. E. प to satisfy, णिनि aff.
पूर्व: पूर्व्व r. 1st cl. (पूर्व्वति) To fill. 10th cl. (पूर्व्वयति) 1 To dwell. 2 To invite: the root is written either पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व.

पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) 1 First, former, prior, preceding, initial. 2 East, eastern. 3 All, entire. 4 Before, in front of. m. plu. (-र्व्वाः) Ancestors, forefathers. f. (-र्व्वा) The east. n. (-र्व्वं) An ancient tradition. E. पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व to fill, to dwell, &c. aff. अच्; hence the derivative, and its compounds may be written either with ब or व; the second of the duplicate consonants may also be rejected, making it पूर्ब or पूर्व.
पूर्व्व: पूर्व्व r. 1st cl. (पूर्व्वति) To fill. 10th cl. (पूर्व्वयति) 1 To dwell. 2 To invite: the root is written either पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व.

पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) 1 First, former, prior, preceding, initial. 2 East, eastern. 3 All, entire. 4 Before, in front of. m. plu. (-र्व्वाः) Ancestors, forefathers. f. (-र्व्वा) The east. n. (-र्व्वं) An ancient tradition. E. पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व to fill, to dwell, &c. aff. अच्; hence the derivative, and its compounds may be written either with ब or व; the second of the duplicate consonants may also be rejected, making it पूर्ब or पूर्व.
पूर्वक: पूर्व्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Prior, before, preceding. E. पूर्व्व, and कन् added.
पूर्व्वक: पूर्व्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Prior, before, preceding. E. पूर्व्व, and कन् added.
पूर्वकाल: पूर्व्वकाल n. (-लं) Former time. E. पूर्व्व, and काल time.
पूर्व्वकाल: पूर्व्वकाल n. (-लं) Former time. E. पूर्व्व, and काल time.
पूर्वकालीन: पूर्व्वकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ancient, belonging to former times. E. पूर्व्वकाल, and ख aff.
पूर्व्वकालीन: पूर्व्वकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ancient, belonging to former times. E. पूर्व्वकाल, and ख aff.
पूर्वकाष्ठा: पूर्व्वकाष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The east, the eastern quarter. E. पूर्व्व, and काष्ठा quarter.
पूर्व्वकाष्ठा: पूर्व्वकाष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The east, the eastern quarter. E. पूर्व्व, and काष्ठा quarter.
पूर्वकृत: पूर्व्वकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done formerly, or in a prior existence. E. पूर्व्व, and कृत done.
पूर्व्वकृत: पूर्व्वकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done formerly, or in a prior existence. E. पूर्व्व, and कृत done.
पूर्वगङ्गा: पूर्व्वगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Narmadā river. E. पूर्व्व formerly, (called) गङ्गा the Ganges.
पूर्व्वगङ्गा: पूर्व्वगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Narmadā river. E. पूर्व्व formerly, (called) गङ्गा the Ganges.

पूषभासा: पूषभासा f. (-सा) The capital of INDRA. E. पूष the sun, भास् light, aff. टाप्, splendid as the sun.
पूषसुहृत्: पूषसुहृत् m. (-हृत्) ŚIVA. E. पूष the sun, and सुहृत् a friend.
पृ: पृ r. 3rd cl. (पिपर्त्ति) 1 To protect, to nourish. 2 To fill. 5th cl. (पृणोति) To satisfy, to please or content. r. 1st and 10th cls. (परति पारयत्ति) To fill, as the stomach or a vessel. r. 6th cl. (but with वि and आङ् prefixed, and ङ aff.) व्यापृङ् (व्याप्रियते) To be busy or active, to labor, to make exertions: see पॄ.
पृक्का: पृक्का f. (-क्का) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. स्पृश to touch, कन् aff., deriv. irr.
पृक्त: पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Touched, mixed, in contact or combination with. n. (-क्तं) Wealth, possessions. E. पृच to mix, aff. क्त.
पृक्ति: पृक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Touch, contact. E. पृच to touch, क्तिन् aff.
पृच: पृच (ई) पृची r. 2nd cl. (पृक्ते) r. 7th cl. (पृणक्ति) To touch, to be or bring in contact. r. 1st and 10th cls. (पर्चति पर्चयति) 1 To hinder or restrain. 2 To touch.
पृच्छक: पृच्छक m. (-कः) An inquirer, an investigator, an inquisitive person. E. प्रच्छ to ask, वुन् aff., र changed to ऋ.
पृच्छण: पृच्छण n. (-णं) Asking, inquiring. E. पृच्छ to ask, ल्युट् aff., र changed to ऋ.
पृच्छा: पृच्छा f. (-च्छा) Asking, questioning, a question or inquiry. E. प्रच्छ to inquire, aff. अङ् and टाप्, the semivowel changed to the corresponding vowel.
पृज: पृज (ई) पृजी r. 2d cl. (पृक्ते) To touch, to be in contact with.
पृण: पृण r. 6th cl. (पृणति) To please or gratify.
पृतना: पृतना f. (-ना) 1 An army. 2 A small army or division consisting of 243 elephants, as many chariots, 729 horse, and 1215 foot. E. पृ to fill, तन aff.
पृतनासाह्: पृतनासाह् m. (-षाट्) INDRA. E. पृतना an army, षह to bear or be equal to, क्विप् aff.
पृथ: पृथ r. 10th cl. (पर्थयति) To throw or cast, to send or direct.
पृथक्: पृथक् ind. 1 Without, except. 2 Separately, severally. E. पृथ to throw or dismiss, aff. ठक्.
पृथक्करण: पृथक्करण n. (-णं) Separating, distinguishing. E. पृथक्, and करण making.
पृथक्कृत: पृथक्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Separated, sundered, made distinct. E. पृथक्, and कृत made.
पृथक्क्षेत्र: पृथक्क्षेत्र m. plu. (-चाः) Children of one father by wives of different classes. E. पृथक् separately, and क्षेच a wife.
पृथक्त्व: पृथक्त्व n. (-त्वं) Individuality, separateness, severalty. E. त्व added to पृथक्; also with तल्, पृथक्ता.
पृथक्त्वचा: पृथक्त्वचा f. (-चा) A plant, commonly Mūrvā, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. पृथक् separately, त्वच् skin; having a fibrous bark from which bow-strings are made.
पृथक्पर्णी: पृथक्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. पृथक् separate, पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीप्.
पृथक्पिण्ड: पृथक्पिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A relation connected by oblation of water only. E. पृथक्, and पिण्ड obsequial cake.
पृथगात्मता: पृथगात्मता f. (-ता) Discrimination, judgment. E. पृथक् severally, आत्मन् real nature, तल् aff.; distinguishing the different nature of different things.
पृथगात्मन्: पृथगात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Several, separate, individual. m. (-त्मा) Individualised spirit, or that of an individual, as detached from universal spirit, or the soul of all. E. पृथक्, and आत्मन् self or soul.
पृथगात्मिका: पृथगात्मिका f. (-का) Individuality, separate or individual state of being. E. पृथक् separately, आत्मन् self, ठक् aff.
पृथग्गुण: पृथग्गुण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Having distinct properties. E. पृथक्, and गुण quality.
पृथग्जन: पृथग्जन m. (-नः) 1 An ignorant man, a fool. 2 A man of a low cast. 3 A sinner, a wicked or vicious man. m. plu. (-नाः) Children of one father by different mothers. E. पृथक् separate, away from, (virtue, &c.) and जन a man.
पृथग्विध: पृथग्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various, diversified, multiform. E. पृथक् several, विध sort.
पृथवी: पृथवी f. (-वी) The earth: see पृथिवी.
पृथा: पृथा f. (-था) KUNTĪ, the wife of PĀṆḌU. E. प्रथ to be famous, aff. अङ् and टाप्, and the semivowel changed.
पृथाज: पृथाज m. (-जः) 1 The son of KUNTĪ, ARJUNA, &c. 2 Name of a tree. E. पृथा, and ज born.
पृथापति: पृथापति m. (-तिः) PĀṆḌU, the nominal father of the Pāṇḍava princes. E. पृथा KUNTĪ, and पति husband.
पृथिका: पृथिका f. (-का) A centipede. E. पृथ to throw, aff. क्वुन् fem. form.
पृथिवि: पृथिवि f. (-विः) The earth: see the next.
पृथिवी: पृथिवी f. (-वी) The earth. E. प्रथ to be famous, Uṇādi aff. षिवन्, fem. aff. ङीप्, and the vowel substituted for the semivowel; also with the antepenultimate vowel changed to अ, पृथवी; or dropped altogether, पृथ्वी; or without the fem. aff. पृथिवि.
पृथिवीक्षित्: पृथिवीक्षित् m. (-क्षित्) A king. E. पृथिवी, and क्षित् who rules.
पृथिवीतल: पृथिवीतल n. (-लं) The surface of the ground. E. पृथिवी, and तल surface.
पृथिवीपति: पृथिवीपति m. (-तिः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha. 3 YAMA, regent of the dead. E. पृथिवी the earth, and पति master.
पृथिवीपाल: पृथिवीपाल m. (-लः) A king, a sovereign, a ruler. E. पृथिवी the earth, and पाल who nourishes.
पृथिवीशक्र: पृथिवीशक्र m. (-क्रः) A king. E. पृथिवी the earth, and शक्र INDRA.
पृथु: पृथु mfn. (-थुः-थु or थ्वी-थुः) 1 Large, great. 2 Smart, clever. m. (-थुः) 1 The fifth monarch of the solar dynasty in the second age. 2 A name of Agni or fire. f. (-थुः) 1 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) 2 A medicinal substance, commonly Hiṅgupatrī. 3 Opium. E. प्रथ to be famous, aff. कु, and र changed to ऋ.
पृथुक: पृथुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) The young of any animal. mn. (-कः-कं) Rice or grain flattened. f. (-का) Hingupatri: see पृथु. E. प्रथ to be famous, aff. कुकन् or पृथु as above, and कन् added.
पृथुरोमन्: पृथुरोमन् m. (-मा) A fish in general. E. पृथु large, and रोमन् hair of the human body, to which the scales of the fish may be considered analogous.
पृथुल: पृथुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Great, large. f. (-ला) A medicinal substance, Hiṅgupatrī. E. पृथु, and लच् aff.
पृथुशेखर: पृथुशेखर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. पृथु large, and शेखर a crest.
पृथुस्कन्ध: पृथुस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A boar. E. पृथु large; स्कन्ध shoulder.
पृथूदर: पृथूदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Large-bellied, stout, corpulent. m. (-रः) A ram. E. पृथु, and उदर the belly.
पृथ्वी: पृथ्वी f. (-थ्वी) 1 The earth. 2 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) 3 A medical substance and condiment, perhaps the leaf of the asafœtida plant, Hiṅgupatrī. 4 The mother of the seventh Jina, or Jains deified teacher, SUPĀRŚVA. 5 Cardamoms. E. the feminine form of पृथु, or पृथु the king so named, and ङीप् aff.; the domain of king PṚTHU.
पृथ्वीका: पृथ्वीका f. (-का) 1 Large cardamoms. 2 Small cardamoms. 3 A small pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) E. पृथ्वी as above, कन् aff.
पृथ्वीभर: पृथ्वीभर m. (-रः) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.
पृदाकु: पृदाकु m. (-कुः) 1 A snake. 2 A scorpion. 3 A tiger. 4 A leopard or the small hunting leopard. 5 An elephant. 6 A tree. E. पर्द to fart, Uṇādi aff. काकु; the vowel substituted for the semivowel.
पृश्नि: पृश्नि mfn. (-श्निः-श्निः-श्नि) 1 Small, short, thin. 2 Delicate, feeble. f. (-श्निः) 1 A ray of light. 2 A queen, the wife of SUTAPĀ, who being regenerated after death, became DEVAKĪ the mother of KṚṢṆA. 3 The earth. E. स्पृश to touch, नि Uṇādi aff., and the initial rejected; also पृष्णि.
पृश्निका: पृश्निका f. (-का) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
पृश्निगर्ब्भ: पृश्निगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पृश्नि the wife of a saint incarnate in DEVAKĪ, and गर्ब्भ the embryo.
पृश्निपर्णी: पृश्निपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, according to some of its synonyms, but in ROXBURGH'S Catalogue, Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. पृश्नि small, पर्ण a leaf.
पृश्निभद्र: पृश्निभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पृश्नि DEVAKĪ, and भद्र auspicious.
पृश्निशृङ्ग: पृश्निशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU, in that incarnation. 2 A name of GAṆEŚA. E. पृश्नि small, and शृङ्ग a crest.
पृश्नी: पृश्नी f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. पृष to sprinkle, नि aff., and डीप् added.
पृष: पृष (उ) पृषु r. 1st cl. (पर्षति) 1 To sprinkle. 2 To weary. 3 To hurt, to injure. 4 To give.
पृषत्: पृषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Sprinkling. n. sing. (-षत्) du. (-षती) plu. (-षन्ति) A drop of water or any liquid. mf. (-षन्-षती) The porcine deer. E. पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अति, or participial aff. शटृ; also पृषत् and पृषन्ति.
पृषत: पृषत m. (-तः) 1 A drop of water. 2 The porcine deer. E. पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अतच्: see the last.
पृषताम्पति: पृषताम्पति m. (-तिः) Air, wind, or its deified personification. E. पृषत् a deer, in the second case plural, and पति master.
पृषताश्व: पृषताश्व m. (-श्वः) Air, wind. E. पृषत् the porcine deer, and अश्व a horse: see पृषदश्व.
पृषत्क: पृषत्क m. (-त्कः) An arrow. E. पृपत् a deer, and कन् added; swift as a deer.
पृषदश्व: पृषदश्व m. (-श्वः) The god of air, or wind divinely personified. E. पृषत् the porcine deer, or a drop of rain, and अश्व a horse; whose steeds are like deer, or may be considered as the drops of rain, accompanying a gale.
पृषदाज्य: पृषदाज्य n. (-ज्यं) Ghee mixed with curds, forming an oblation. E. पृषत् sprinkling, and आज्य Ghee.
पृषद्वल: पृषद्वल m. (-लः) A horse of the wind. E. पृषत् a deer, वलच् aff.
पृषन्ति: पृषन्ति n. (-न्ति) A drop of water. E. पृष to sprinkle, aff. भिच्; according to the best authorities, however, this word is the plural inflection of पृषत्.
पृषाकरा: पृषाकरा f. (-रा) A small stone used as a weight.
पृषातक: पृषातक n. (-कं) An oblation of Ghee and curds. E. पृष sprinkling, अत to go or be, अच् and कन् aff.
पृषोदर: पृषोदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a spot or circle on the belly. E. पृषत् a drop of any thing liquid, and उदर the belly, form irregular and special; the word is most commonly in use as a grammatical term, being the leading word of a class in which the formation of each is peculiar to itself, and being thence applied to designate the rule which comprehends the whole of the series.
पृषोद्यान: पृषोद्यान n. (-नं) A small garden. E. पृषत्, and उद्यान a garden, त rejected.
पृष्ट: पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Asked, inquired. E. प्रच्छ to ask, क्त aff. and the vowel substituted for the semivowel.
पृष्टि: पृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A ray of light. 2 Touch. E. स्पृष to touch, &c. aff. क्तिन्.
पृष्ट्वा: पृष्ट्वा ind. Having asked. E. प्रच्छ to ask, क्त्वाच् aff.
पृष्ठ: पृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 The back. 2 The rear, the last, the back or hinder part of any thing. 3 The surface or superficies. E. पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
पृष्ठग्रन्थि: पृष्ठग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A hump on the back. E. पृष्ठ the back, ग्रन्थि a knot.
पृष्ठचक्षुस्: पृष्ठचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A crab. E. पृष्ठ the back, and चक्षुस् the eye.
पृष्ठतस्: पृष्ठतस् ind. Behind, at the back of. E. पृष्ठ the back, and तसि aff.
पृष्ठदृष्टि: पृष्ठदृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A bear. E. पृष्ठ, and दृष्टि sight, looking behind him.
पृष्ठफल: पृष्ठफल n. (-लं) Superficial contents of any figure. E. पृष्ठ, and फल fruit.
पृष्ठमांसाद: पृष्ठमांसाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A backbiter, a talebearer, a slanderer. E. पृष्ठ the back, मांस the flesh, अद to eat, aff. अच्.
पृष्ठमांसादन: पृष्ठमांसादन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A backbiter. n. (-नं) Backbiting, slandering. E. पृष्ठमांस, and अदन eating: see the last.
पृष्ठवंश: पृष्ठवंश m. (-शः) The back-bone. E. पृष्ठ the back, and वंश a bambu.
पृष्ठवाह्: पृष्ठवाह् m. (-वाट् or वाड्) An ox of burthen, or one in training. E. पृष्ठ, and वाह who bears; also प्रष्टवाह्.
पृष्ठवाह्य: पृष्ठवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) An ox of burthen, carrying any thing on his back. E. पृष्ठ the back, वह to bear, aff. ण्यत्.
पृष्ठशय: पृष्ठशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sleeping on the back. E. पृष्ठ, and शय who sleeps.
पृष्ठशृङ्ग: पृष्ठशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A wild goat. E. पृष्ठ the back, and शृङ्ग a horn, whose horn bends over towards the back.
पृष्ठशृङ्गिन्: पृष्ठशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 1 A buffalo. 2 An eunuch. 3 A name of BHĪMASENA. 4 A ram. E. पृष्ठ the back, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.
पृष्ठ्य: पृष्ठ्य mfn. (-ष्ठ्यः-ष्ठ्या-ष्ठ्यं) Relating or belonging to the back. m. (-ष्ठ्यः) A pack horse. n. (-ष्ठ्यं) A multitude of back bones. E. पृष्ठ the back, यत् aff.
पृष्णि: पृष्णि mfn. (-ष्णिः-ष्णिः-ष्णि) Small, short or thin: see पृश्नि. f. (-ष्णिः) 1 The heel: see पार्ष्णि. 2 A ray of light. E. पृष to sprinkle, नि Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
पॄ: पॄ r. 3rd cl. (पिपर्त्ति) 9th cl. (पृणाति) 10th cl. (पारयति) 1 To nourish, to protect. 2 To fill.
पेचक: पेचक m. (-कः) 1 An owl. 2 The root of an elephant's tail. 3 The tip of it. 4 A cloud. 5 A bed. 6 A louse. E. पच to spread, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, इट् inserted.
पेचकिन्: पेचकिन् m. (-की) An elephant. E. पेचक the root of an elephant's tail, इनि aff.
पेचिल: पेचिल m. (-लः) An elephant. E. पेच for पेचक as above, इलच् aff.
पेचु: पेचु m. (-चुः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. पिच to hurt, उ aff.; also with उलट् aff. पेचुल, fem. पेचुली.
पेचुली: पेचुली f. (-ली) An esculent root: see the last.
पेट: पेट mf. (-टः-टा or टी) A basket, a large basket. E. पिट to collect, घञ् and टाप् affs.
पेटक: पेटक mn. (-कः-कं) A basket for holding clothes, books, &c. n. (-कं) Multitude, quantity. E. पिट to collect, वुन् aff.
पेटाक: पेटाक m. (-कः) A basket. E. पेटा, and कन् added.
पेटिका: पेटिका f. (-का) A box, a basket. E. पेटा, and कन् added.
पेडा: पेडा f. (-डा) A basket, a large basket. E. पिड to collect, aff. अच् and टाप्.
पेण: पेण (ऋ) पेणृ r. 1st cl. (पेणति) 1 To go. 2 To embrace. 3 To grind: it is more usually read पैणृ.
पेत्व: पेत्व m. (-त्वः) A small part. n. (-त्वं) 1 Nectar. 2 Ghee or clarified butter. E. पा to drink, इत्व Uṇādi aff.
पेपीयमान: पेपीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be drank repeatedly. E. पा to drink, reit. v., शानच् aff.
पेय: पेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Drinkable, drink. n. (-यं) 1 Water. 2 Milk. f. (-या) 1 Rice gruel. 2 Decoction of any thing after straining. 3 Any drink with a small quantity of boiled rice. 4 Anise, (Pimpinella anisum.) E. पा to drink, aff. यत्.
पेयूष: पेयूष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 The milk of a cow, which has calved within seven days. 2 Fresh Ghee. 3 Amṛta or nectar. E. पीय Sautra root, for पा to drink, ऊसुन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel changed; otherwise पीयूष, q. v.
पेरु: पेरु m. (-रुः) 1 The ocean. 2 The golden mountain. 3 The sun. 4 Fire. E. पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. रु.
पेरोज: पेरोज n. (-जं) The turquoise: it is the Persian word فيروزه
पेल: पेल (ऋ) पेणृ r. 1st cl. (पेलति) To go or move.
पेल m. (-लः) 1 A small part. 2 Going. n. (-लं) A testicle. E. पिल to send, aff. घञ्, or पेल to go, अच् aff.
पेलव: पेलव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Delicate, fine. 2 Thin, slim, slender. 3 Soft. E. पेल, वा to get, aff. ड.
पेलिन्: पेलिन् m. (-ली) A horse. E. पेल going, and इनि aff.
पेव: पेव (ऋ) पेवृ r. 1st cl. (पेवते) To gratify by service, to serve, to attend on.
पेशल: पेशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dexterous, clever. 2 Beautiful, agreeable. 3 Fraudulent, crafty. 4 Soft, smooth. E. प्रिश to be a component part, अलच् aff; also पेषल and पेसल.
पेशस्कृत्: पेशस्कृत् m. (-कृत्) A sort of insect, a kind of wasp.
पेशि: पेशि m. (-शिः) The thunderbolt. f. (-शिः or शी) 1 An egg. 2 Split pease. E. पिश to be a part, Uṇādi aff. इन्; also with ङीप् added in the fem. form पेशी, as below.
पेशी: पेशी f. (-शी) 1 The egg of a bird. 2 A blown bud. 3 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 4 A ball of flesh or meat. 5 A sheath, a scabbard. 6 A muscle. 7 The name of a river. 8 The name of a female imp or demon. E. पिश to be a component part, aff. इन् and ङीप् added; also पेशि.
पेश्वर: पेश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what grinds. E. पिश to grind, वरच् aff.
पेष: पेष (ऋ) पेषृ r. 1st cl. (पेषते) To resolve or endeavour diligently.
पेषण: पेषण n. (-णं) 1 Grinding, reducing to dust or powder. 2 A hand mill, a stone and muller, any apparatus for grinding or pounding. 3 A plant, (a sort of Euphorbia with three lobes, commonly Teṅkāṭasij.) E. पिश to grind, aff. ल्युट्; also पेषणि, &c.
पेषणि: पेषणि f. (-णिः or णी) A stone slab on which condiments, &c. are ground, with a muller. E. पिश to grind, aff. अनि and ङीप् optionally added.
पेषल: पेषल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dexterous, clever. 2 Beautiful, handsome: see पेशल.
पेषाक: पेषाक m. (-कः) A small slab for grinding any thing upon. E. पिष to grind, Uṇādi aff. आक.
पेस: पेस (ऋ) पेसृ r. 1st cl. (पेसति) To go or move.
पेसल: पेसल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dexterous. 2 Handsome: see पेशल.
पेस्वर: पेस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Destructive. 2 Moving, going. 3 Splendid. E. पिस to hurt, &c. वरच् aff.
पै: पै r. 1st cl. (पायति) To dry, to wither.
पैञ्जूष: पैञ्जूष m. (-षः) The ear. E. पिजि to injure, aff. ऊषन्, and the radical vowel augmented, form irr.
पैठर: पैठर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Boiled in a pot, (flesh, &c.) E. पिठर a vessel, aff. अण्.
पैठीनसि: पैठीनसि m. (-सिः) A Muni, author of a system of laws.
पैण: पैण (ऋ) पैणृ r. 1st cl. (पैणति) 1 To go or approach. 2 To command or direct, (an act.) 3 To touch or embrace. 4 To pound or grind.
पैण्डिन्य: पैण्डिन्य n. (-न्यं) Mendicity, living upon alms. E. पिण्ड a ball of meat or rice, इनि poss. aff., यञ् aff. of condition.
पैतामह: पैतामह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Belonging or relating to the grandfather, inherited from him, (property, &c.) E. पितामह, and अण् aff.
पैतृक: पैतृक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Paternal, ancestral, belonging or relating to the father or to progenitors. E. पितृ a father, ठञ् aff.
पैतृकभूमि: पैतृकभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 Father-land, the country of one's ancestors. 2 A paternal estate. E. पैतृक, and भूमि land.
पैतृकष्वसेय: पैतृकष्वसेय m. (-यः) A paternal aunt's son. f. (-यी) The daughter of a paternal aunt. E. पितृ a father, स्वसृ a sister, aff. ढक्, whence the vowel of स्वसृ is rejected.
पैतृस्वस्रीय: पैतृस्वस्रीय mf. (-यः-या) The son or daughter of a father's sister. E. पितृ a father, स्वसृ a sister, छण् aff. whence the ऋ of स्वसृ is changed to री.
पैत्त: पैत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ती-त्तं) Biliary, bilious. E. पित्त, and अण् aff.
पैत्तिक: पैत्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bilious, biliary. E. पित्त, and ठञ् aff.
पैत्र: पैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Paternal, ancestral, relating or belonging to a parent or progenitor. n. (-त्रं) 1 The part of the hand between the thumb and forefinger, or according to some the root of the forefinger. 2 A year, month, day, &c. of the Pitṛs. E. पितृ a parent, aff. अण्.
पैत्राहोरात्र: पैत्राहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day and night of the Pitṛs, or progenitors, equal to a month of mortals. E. पैत्र relating to the manes, अहन् a day, and रात्रि night.
पैत्रिक: पैत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Paternal, ancestral. E. पितृ, and ठञ् aff. and the vowel changed.
पैल: पैल m. (-लः) A sage, the promulgator of the Ṛk Veda.
पैशाच: पैशाच mfn. (-चः-ची-चं) Infernal, demoniacal, relating or belonging to a Piśāca or goblin. m. (-चः) A mode of marriage, the ravishment of a girl by her lover. f. (-ची) A present to a friend, or to secure friendly regard made at a religious ceremony. E. पिशाच an imp, aff. अण्.
पैशुन: पैशुन n. (-नं) 1 Information, reporting evil of others. 2 Roguery. E. पिशुन a spy, &c. अण् aff.
पैशुन्य: पैशुन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Information, espionage, &c. 2 Depravity; wickedness. E. पिशुन a spy, a rogue, aff. यञ्.
पैष्ट: पैष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं) Ground or made up into a cake. f. (-ष्टी) Spirituous liquor distilled from meal. E. पिष्ट ground, अण् aff.
पैष्टिक: पैष्टिक n. (-कं) 1 A quantity of cakes. 2 Spirituous liquor distilled from meal. E. पिष्ट, and ठक् aff.
पोगण्ड: पोगण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Deformed, having a redundant or defective member. m. (-ण्डः) A boy, one from his fifth to his sixteenth year. E. अपि certainly, गडि to be a part of the cheek, अच् aff., the अ of the prefix is rejected, and the इ changed to ओ; otherwise, अप depreciative prefix, गम to go, and the deriv. irr.; also अपोगण्ड; in the second sense it also occurs पौगण्ड.
पोट: पोट m. (-टः) 1 The foundation of a house, &c. 2 Uniting, mixing. f. (-टा) 1 A woman having a beard. 2 A female servant or slave. (-टी) A large alligator. E. पुट to shine, aff. अच्.
पोटगल: पोटगल m. (-लः) 1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis, Rox.) 2 A sort of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 3 A fish. E. पोट uniting (with the wind), गल to go, aff. अच्, waving in the wind.
पोटलिका: पोटलिका f. (-का) A bundle or packet.
पोट्टली: पोट्टली f. (-ली) A bundle, a parcel.
पोडु: पोडु m. (-डुः) The lower surface of the parietal bones.
पोत: पोत mf. (-तः-ती) The young of any animal. m. (-तः) 1 A young elephant of ten years old. 2 A vessel, a ship, a boat. 3 The site of a house or dwelling. 4 Cloth. E. पूञ् to purify, तन् Uṇādi aff.
पोतकी: पोतकी f. (-की) A potherb, (Basella lucida.) E. पूत nominal verb, from पूत a stench, वुञ् aff., ङीप् fem. aff.
पोतज: पोतज m. (-जः) An animal that produces young at once without the intervention of any medium; elephants and some other animals being supposed in Hindu physiology to carry the young without the aid of an ovarium or uterus. E. पोत young, and जन to bear, aff. ड.
पोतबणिज्: पोतबणिज् m. (-णिक्) A voyaging merchant. E. पात a boat, and वणिक् a trader.
पोतरक्ष: पोतरक्ष m. (-क्षः) The rudder of a boat, or large oar used as one. E. पोत a boat, रक्ष to preserve, अच् aff.
पोतलकप्रिय: पोतलकप्रिय m. (-यः) One of the Jinas or Jaina deified teachers.
पोतवाह: पोतवाह m. (-हः) A rower, a boatman, a steersman, a towman, or one of the crew that keeps watch at the mast-head. E. पोत a boat, वह to bear, अण् aff.
पोताच्छादन: पोताच्छादन n. (-नं) A tent. E. पोत cloth, आच्छादन covering.
पोताधान: पोताधान n. (-नं) Small fry, a shoal of young fish. E. पोव, and आधान taking; being caught in bags.
पोतास: पोतास m. (-सः) A sort of camphor.
पोतिका: पोतिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.) E. पूत nominal verb, to stink, aff. वुन्, fem. aff. टाप्.
पोतृ: पोतृ m. (-ता) 1 One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. पू to make pure, aff. तृच्.
पोत्र: पोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The snout of a hog. 2 The share of a plough. 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. पू to make pure, ष्ट्रन् aff.
पोत्रायुध: पोत्रायुध m. (-धः) A hog. E. पोक्ष a snout, आयुध a weapon.
पोत्रिदंष्ट्राज: पोत्रिदंष्ट्राज m. (-जः) A gem, supposed to be found in the tooth of a hog. E. पोत्रि a hog, दंष्ट्रा a tooth, and ज born.
पोत्रिन्: पोत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A hog. E. पोत्र the snout, इनि aff.
पोत्रिरथा: पोत्रिरथा f. (-था) One of the Śaktis or female divinities of the Jainas. E. पोत्रि a hog, and रथ a vehicle.
पोथकी: पोथकी f. (-की) Red pimples on the eyelids.
पोपुव: पोपुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Purifying or cleansing much or repeatedly. E. पू to purify, intens. v., अच् aff.
पोल: पोल m. (-लः) 1 Magnitude, bulk. 2 A heap, a quantity. E. पुल to be great, घञ् aff.
पोलिका: पोलिका f. (-का) Flat cakes made of barley or wheat, &c.
पोलिन्द: पोलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A part of a boat supporting the deck, (the knees or ribs of a boat?) E. पोल magnitude, इदि to be supreme, aff. अच्.
पोष: पोष m. (-षः) Nourishing, cherishing. E. पुष to nourish, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. पोषण.
पोषण: पोषण n. (-णं) Nourishing, cherishing. E. पुष to nourish, aff. ल्युट्.
पोषणीय: पोषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cherished or protected. E. पुष to nourish, अनीयर् aff.
पोषयित्नु: पोषयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) Nourishing, cherishing. m. (-त्नुः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. पुष to nourish, in the causal form, इत्नुच् aff.
पोषितव्य: पोषितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cherished or protected. E. पुष, and तव्य aff.
पोष्टृ: पोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what nourishes, cherishes, &c. m. (-ष्टा) 1 Grey bonduc. 2 A protector, a cherisher. E. पुष to nourish, aff. तृच्.
पोष्टृवर: पोष्टृवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what nourishes best. E. पोष्टृ, and वर best.
पोष्य: पोष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be cherished or taken care of. E. पुष to nourish, यत् aff.
पोष्यत्व: पोष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Cherishing dependants. 2 Being taken care of. E. पोष्य, and त्व aff.
पोष्यपुत्त्र: पोष्यपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) An adopted son. E. पोष्य, and पुत्त्र a son.
पोष्यवर्ग: पोष्यवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of persons or objects to be cherished, as parents, children, guests, and the sacred fire. E. पोष्य, and वर्ग a class.
पौंश्चल्य: पौंश्चल्य n. (-ल्यं) Female incontinency, harlotry. E. पुंश्चली a lewd woman, यञ् aff.
पौंसवन: पौंसवन n. (-नं) One of the Saṃskāras or essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion; a religious observance, held when signs of a living conception take place. E. पुंसवन, q. v., with अण् pleonastic aff.
पौंस्न: पौंस्न mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Virile, manly, relating to or good for man. n. (-लं) Manhood. E. पुं man, स्नञ् aff.
पौण्डर्य: पौण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya. E. अण् added to पुण्डर्य्य.
पौण्डर्य्य: पौण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya. E. अण् added to पुण्डर्य्य.
पौण्ड्र: पौण्ड्र m. (-ण्ड्रः) 1 A country, extending from Rangpur across the Ganges to the Jangel Mehals and part of south Behar, including therefore the greater part of Bengal. 2 A sort of sugar-cane of a pale straw colour. E. पुण्ड्र the same, aff. अण्; also with कन् added पौण्ड्रक.
पौण्ड्रक: पौण्ड्रक m. (-कः) 1 The pale straw-coloured species of sugar-cane. 2 A man of a mixed caste, from the Vaiśya and female of the distiller caste, whose business it is to boil sugar. E. कन् added to पौण्ड्र.
पौण्ड्रवर्द्धन: पौण्ड्रवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A country, one of the divisions of central India, (Behar.) E. पौण्ड्र the sugar-cane, and वर्द्धन encreasing.
पौण्ड्रिक: पौण्ड्रिक m. (-कः) A pale straw variety of the sugar-cane. E. पुण्ड the same, aff. ठञ्.
पौतव: पौतव n. (-वं) Measure. E. पू to be made pure or correct, तन् aff. and अण् added; also यौतव.
पौतिनासिक्य: पौतिनासिक्य n. (-क्यं) Fœtor of the nostrils. E. पूतिनासिका a foul nose, and यञ् aff.
पौत्तिक: पौत्तिक n. (-कं) Honey of a pale colour. E. पूत्तिका a small bee, aff. अण्.
पौत्त्र: पौत्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं) Relating to a son. m. (-त्त्रः) A son's son, a grandson. f. (-त्त्री) A grand-daughter, either in the male or female line, though more usually implying a son's daughter. E. पुत्त्र or पुत्त्री a son or daughter, अण् aff. of descent.
पौत्त्रिक: पौत्त्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a son or a grandson. E. पुत्त्र or पौत्त्र, and ठञ् or ठक् aff.
पौत्त्रिकेय: पौत्त्रिकेय m. (-यः) A daughter's son. E. पुत्त्रिका, and ढक् aff.
पौत्त्रिन्: पौत्त्रिन् mfn. (-त्त्री-त्त्रिणी-त्त्रि) Having a grandson. E. पोत्त्र, and इनि aff.
पौनःपुनिक: पौनःपुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Repeated, reiterated, again and again. E. पुनर्, repeated, and ठञ् aff.
पौनःपुन्य: पौनःपुन्य n. (-न्यं) Reiteration, repetition. E. पुनर् again, repeated, aff. यञ्.
पौनरुक्त: पौनरुक्त n. (-क्तं) Tautology. E. पुनरुक्त, and अण् added.
पौनर्भव: पौनर्भव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Repeated, additional. m. (-वः) One of the sons or heirs admitted by the old Hindu law; the son of a twice married woman. E. पुनर्भव, aff. अण्.
पौर: पौर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) City, citizen, relating to or produced in a town or city. n. (-रं) A fragrant grass. E. पुर a city, aff. अण्.
पौरक: पौरक n. (-कं) A garden round a house. E. पौर citizen, and कन् added.
पौरजन: पौरजन m. (-नः) A citizen. E. पौर, जन person.
पौरव: पौरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of the race of Puru, descended from Puru. E. पुरु, and अण् aff.
पौरसख्य: पौरसख्य n. (-ख्यं) Connexion or equality by inhabiting the same city for ten years, fellow-citizenship. E. पौर relating to a city, सख्य friendship.
पौरस्त्य: पौरस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Prior, first, initial. E. पुरस् formerly, अण् aff. of relation, पौरस्, and त्यक् aff.
पौरस्त्री: पौरस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A woman residing in a town or city. E. पौरा, and स्त्री a female; also similar compounds, as पौरयोषित, पौराङ्गना, &c.
पौराण: पौराण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Relating to the Purāṇas. E. पुराण, and अण् aff.
पौराणिक: पौराणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to the Purāṇas, Paurānic. m. (-कः) A Brahman, well read in the Purāṇas. E. पुराल, and ठक् aff.
पौरुष: पौरुष mfn. subst. (-षः-षी-षं) The measure of a man, equal to the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated, and the fingers extended. adj. Manly, of or belonging to man. n. (-षं) 1 The property of manhood, virility, manliness. 2 Action, or action incidental to the state of humanity. 3 Semen virile. 4 Strength, power, vigour. E. पुरुष a man, aff. अण्.
पौरुषता: पौरुषता f. (-ता) Manhood, manly strength or spirit. E. तल् added to पौरुष; also with त्व, पौरुषत्व.
पौरुषेय: पौरुषेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made by, derived from, or relating to man, human, manly, virile, &c. m. (-यः) 1 A crowd, or number of men. 2 Manslaughter, murder. 3 Law, as affecting persons. E. पुरुष a man, and ढक् aff.
पौरोगव: पौरोगव mf. (-वः-वी) Overseer or superintendant of the kitchen. E. पुरुस् first, गौ the eye, aff. अण्.
पौरोडाश: पौरोडाश m. (-शः) A prayer recited upon making an oblation of clarified butter. E. पुरोडाश butter offered to fire, and अण् aff.
पौरोडाशिक: पौरोडाशिक m. (-कः) A priest who recites the prayer used in offering an oblation of clarified butter. E. पौरोडाश, and ठन् aff.
पौरोहित्य: पौरोहित्य n. (-त्यं) The character or functions of family priest. E. पुरोहित, and ष्यञ् aff.
पौर्णमास: पौर्णमास m. (-सः) A ceremony performed at the full of the moon, by persons maintaining a perpetual fire. f. (-सी) Day of full moon. E. पूर्णमास a rite, &c. aff. अण्.
पौर्णिम: पौर्णिम m. (-मः) An ascetic. f. (-मा) Day of full moon. E. पूर्णिमा, and अण् pleonasm.
पौर्तिक: पौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, ceremonial. E. पूर्त्त, and ठक् aff.
पौर्त्तिक: पौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, ceremonial. E. पूर्त्त, and ठक् aff.
पौर्व: पौर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Relating, or belonging to the past, to the east, &c. E. पूर्व्व, and अञ् aff.
पौर्व्व: पौर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Relating, or belonging to the past, to the east, &c. E. पूर्व्व, and अञ् aff.
पौर्वपदिक: पौर्व्वपदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the first member of a compound. E. पूर्व्वपद, and ठञ् aff.
पौर्व्वपदिक: पौर्व्वपदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the first member of a compound. E. पूर्व्वपद, and ठञ् aff.
पौर्वदेहिक: पौर्व्वदेहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a former body or existence. E. पूर्व्वदेह, and ठक् aff.
पौर्व्वदेहिक: पौर्व्वदेहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a former body or existence. E. पूर्व्वदेह, and ठक् aff.
पौर्वार्धिक: पौर्व्वार्द्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Dwelling or being in the eastern division of a town, &c. E. पूर्व्वार्द्ध eastern half or part, and ठञ् aff.; also with घञ्, पौर्व्वार्द्ध; and with यत्, पूर्व्वार्द्ध.
पौर्व्वार्द्धिक: पौर्व्वार्द्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Dwelling or being in the eastern division of a town, &c. E. पूर्व्वार्द्ध eastern half or part, and ठञ् aff.; also with घञ्, पौर्व्वार्द्ध; and with यत्, पूर्व्वार्द्ध.
पौर्वापर्य: पौर्व्वापर्य्य n. (-य्यं) Priority and subsequence. E. पूर्व्वापर first and last, ष्यञ् aff.
पौर्व्वापर्य्य: पौर्व्वापर्य्य n. (-य्यं) Priority and subsequence. E. पूर्व्वापर first and last, ष्यञ् aff.
पौर्वाह्णिक: पौर्व्वाह्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to or produced in the forepart of the day. E. पूर्व्वाह्ण forenoon, aff. ठञ्.
पौर्व्वाह्णिक: पौर्व्वाह्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to or produced in the forepart of the day. E. पूर्व्वाह्ण forenoon, aff. ठञ्.
पौर्विक: पौर्व्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Prior, primary, former. E. पूर्व्व, and ठक् aff.
पौर्व्विक: पौर्व्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Prior, primary, former. E. पूर्व्व, and ठक् aff.
पौलस्त्य: पौलस्त्य m. (-स्त्यः) 1 KUVERA. 2 RĀVAṆA. 3 Either of the brothers of RĀVAṆA, VIBHĪṢAṆA or KUMBHAKARṆA. f. (-स्ती) The sister of RĀVAṆA, ŚŪRPANAKHĀ. E. पुलस्त्य a saint so named, and अण् aff. of descent.
पौलि: पौलि mf. (-लिः-ली) Grain half dressed, or scorched or fried with Ghee, and made into a sort of cake. E. पौल a heap, इञ् aff., and ङीप् added for the fem.; also with कन added पौलिका.
पौलिका: पौलिका f. (-का) A sort of cake: see the last.
पौलोमी: पौलोमी f. (-मी) The wife of INDRA. E. पुलोमन् a saint, the father of the goddess, अण् and ङीप् affs.
पौष: पौष m. (-षः) The month Pauṣa, (December-January.) f. (-षी) Day of full moon in the month Pauṣa. E. पुष्य the asterism in which the moon is full in this month, and अञ् aff.
पौष्कर: पौष्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Relating to a pond, to a lotus, to fragrant Costus, &c. E. पुष्कर, q. v., अण् aff.
पौष्करिणी: पौष्करिणी f. (-णी) A large pond or reservoir. E. पुष्करिणी the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
पौष्टिक: पौष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Preservative, protective, nutritive, &c. 2 Nutritious, fattening. n. (-कं) A cloth worn when the ceremony of tonsure is performed. E. पुष्टि nourishing, and ठञ् aff.
पौष्ण: पौष्ण n. (-ष्णं) The last of the twenty-eight lunar asterisms; also REVATĪ. E. पूषन् the sun, in this name regent of the asterism, and अण् aff.
पौष्प: पौष्प mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पी-ष्पं) Flowery, floral, relating or belonging to flowers, &c. E. पुष्प, and अण् aff.
पौष्पक: पौष्पक n. (-कं) The oxid of brass, considered as a collyrium. E. पुष्पक the same, and अण् aff.
पौष्पी: पौष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A name of Palibothra. E. पुष्प a flower, अण् aff., and ङीप् fem. aff.
प्याट्: प्याट् ind. A particle of calling, ho! hola!
प्याय: प्याय (ओ) (ई) ओप्यायी r. 1st cl. (प्यायते) To grow or increase, to enlarge or swell.
प्युष: प्युष (इर) प्युषिर r. 4th cl. (प्युष्यति) 1 To burn. 2 To share or divide. r. 10th cl. (प्युषयति) To relinquish, to part with.
प्युस: प्युस r. 4th cl. (प्युस्यति) 1 To divide. 2 To burn.
प्यै: प्यै (ङ) प्यैङ् r. 1st cl. (प्यायते) To grow or increase.
प्र: प्र ind. A particle and prefix, implying, 1 Progressive motion, (forth, forward, away, &c.) 2 Excess or excellence, (very, much, exceeding.) 3 Appearance, manifestation. It corresponds with the Latin particles Pro and Prœ, as in प्रकर्त्तुं To do much or well; प्रक्रमितुं To go forth or over; प्रकर्षितुं To excel; प्रकाशितुं To display; प्रस्थातुं To go forth, set out; प्रकमम् Very willingly; प्रमृगभ् When the deer go forth (the time, &c.) See the following compounds. E. प्रथ to be famous, &c. aff. ड.
प्रकट: प्रकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Displayed, unfolded, manifest, apparent. E. प्र implying manifestation, and कटच् aff.
प्रकटित: प्रकटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Manifested, displayed. 2 Evident, apparent. 3 Opened, expanded. E. प्र before कट to go, aff. क्त.
प्रकटीकरण: प्रकटीकरण n. (-णं) Making visible or apparent, displaying, manifesting. E. प्रकट, and करण making, च्चि aug.
प्रकटीकृत: प्रकटीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made manifest, open, or visible. E. प्रकट, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
प्रकम्प: प्रकम्प m. (-म्पः) Shaking, trembling. E. प्र before कपि to tremble, घञ् aff.
प्रकम्पन: प्रकम्पन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling violently. m. (-नः) 1 Wind, air. 2 A hell. n. (-नं) Violent or excessive motion, great trembling. E. प्र implying excess, कम्पन trembling.
प्रकम्पमान: प्रकम्पमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking, trembling violently. E. प्र before कषि to tremble, शानच् aff.
प्रकम्पयत्: प्रकम्पयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Shaking, agitating. E. प्र before कपि to tremble, causal v., शतृ aff.
प्रकर: प्रकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what does much or well. m. (-रः) 1 A heap, a quantity. 2 A bundle of flowers, a nosegay. 3 Aid, assistance, friendship. 4 Usage, custom, continuance of a similar practice. 5 Respect. 6 Seduction, abduction. n. (-रं) Aloe wood, (Agallochum.) f. (-री) 1 Theatrical dress or disguise, as wearing a woman's garb, &c. 2 An episodical incident in a drama. 3 An open piece of ground, the meeting of four roads, or the proper site of any magical operations. E. प्र before कृ to make, aff. ट.
प्रकरण: प्रकरण n. (-णं) 1 An introduction, a prologue or prelude. 2 A poetical fiction or poem, in which the story and principal persons are wholly imaginary; the term is especially applied to a dramatic poem. 3 A chapter, a section, a book, a place of pausing or stopping. 4 Treating with respect. 5 Doing much or well. f. (-णी) A minor drama of the same character as the Prakaraṇa, but of less extent; also प्रकरणिका. E. प्र before कृ to make, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रकश: प्रकश m. (-शः) Hurting, killing. E. प्र, कश to hurt, aff. अच्.
प्रकर्ष: प्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Excellence, eminence, superiority. 2 Specialty, intensity, universality. 3 Absoluteness, definitiveness. 4 (In grammar,) The effect of the prefix प्र upon roots. E. प्र before कृश to attract, aff. घञ्.
प्रकर्षगमन: प्रकर्षगमन n. (-नं) Going absolutely or finally, departure. E. प्रकर्ष, and गमन going.
प्रकर्षण: प्रकर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Drawing, attracting. 2 Ploughing, drawing furrows. 3 Excellence, superiority. 4 Realizing by the use of a pledge more than the interest of the loan. E. प्र before कृष to attract, ल्युट् aff.
प्रकर्षित: प्रकर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drawn, drawn out. 2 Exceeded in profit, (the interest of the loan.) n. (-तं) Profit on a pledge beyond the interest of a loan. E. प्र before कृष to make furrows, क्त aff.
प्रकल्पित: प्रकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, made. E. प्र before कृप to be able, क्त aff.
प्रकाण्ड: प्रकाण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 The stem of a tree, the part between the root and the branches. 2 A branch, a shoot. 3 Excellence, happiness, (or used as an attributive without admitting variation of gender,) excellent, best, happy. E. प्र implying excess or superiority, कम to desire, aff. ड, and the penultimate vowel made long by special rule.
प्रकाण्डर: प्रकाण्डर m. (-रः) A tree. E. प्रकाण्ड a stem, रा to get, aff. ड.
प्रकामम्: प्रकामम् ind. Voluntarily, willingly. E. प्र implying much, very, काम desire, will.
प्रकार: प्रकार m. (-रः) 1 Difference. 2 Similitude. n. (-रं) 1 Sort, kind, species. 2 Way, mode, manner. E. प्र before कृ to do, aff. अण्.
प्रकाश: प्रकाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Like, resembling. 2 Open, manifest, blown, expanded. 3 Famous, celebrated. 4 Public. n. adv. (-शं) 1 Openly, publicly. 2 (In dramatic language), Aloud. m. (-शः) 1 Sunshine, lustre, light. 2 Expansion, diffusion, manifestation; the word being equally applicable to physical or moral subjects, as the blowing of a flower, diffusion of celebrity, the publicity of an event, or the manifestation of a truth. 3 A laugh, a smile. 4 Publicity. n. (-शं) White or bellmetal. E. प्र implying motion or eminence, काश to shine, aff. अच्.
प्रकाशक: प्रकाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What irradiates, what makes open or apparent, &c. m. (-कः) An illuminator, an expounder, an illustrator. E. प्रकाश to make light or evident, aff. वुन्.
प्रकाशकज्ञातृ: प्रकाशकज्ञातृ m. (-ता) A cock. E. प्रकाशक illuminator (the sun), and ज्ञातृ who knows.
प्रकाशता: प्रकाशता f. (-ता) 1 Manifestation, visibility. 2 Luminousness. E. प्रकाश, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रकाशत्वं.
प्रकाशन: प्रकाशन n. (-नं) 1 Illuminating, giving light. 2 Making clear or manifest. E. प्र before, काश to shine, ल्युट् aff.
प्रकाशमान: प्रकाशमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Splendid, brilliant, radiant. E. प्र before काश to shine, शानच् aff.
प्रकाशात्मन्: प्रकाशात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The sun. E. प्रकाश light, आत्मन् self; light itself.
प्रकाशित: प्रकाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Evident, apparent, manifest, visible. 2 Published, promulgated. E. प्रकाश manifestation, इतच् aff.
प्रकीर्ण: प्रकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Spread abroad, published, promulgated. 2 Expanded, opened. 3 Miscellaneous, mixed. 4 Scattered, dispersed. 5 Agitated, excited, wild. 6 Waved, waving. n. (-र्णं) 1 A Chowri, a cow-tail used as a fan. 2 A chapter, a section. 3 A collection of miscellaneous rules. E. प्र before कृ to throw or cast, aff. क्त.
प्रकीर्णक: प्रकीर्णक n. (-कं) 1 A Chowri, the tail of the Bos grunniens, used as a whisk or fan. 2 The section or chapter of a book. 3 Extent, length, especially of a stanza or book. 4 (In law,) A case not provided for by the Śāstras, and to be decided by the authority of the judge or king. 5 A miscellany. 6 Any collection of heterogeneous objects not arranged under any distinct classes or heads. m. (-कः) A horse. E. कन् added to प्रकीर्ण.
प्रकीर्ति: प्रकीर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Fame, celebrity. 2 Declaration. E. प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रकीर्त्ति: प्रकीर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Fame, celebrity. 2 Declaration. E. प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रकीर्तित: प्रकीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Declared, explained, said, revealed. 2 Celebrated, renowned. E. प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.
प्रकीर्त्तित: प्रकीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Declared, explained, said, revealed. 2 Celebrated, renowned. E. प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.
