प्रकीर्य: प्रकीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spread abroad or about, to be diffused, promulgated, expanded, or extended. m. (-र्य्यः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) E. प्र progressive motion, कॄ to throw or cast, aff. यक्.
प्रकीर्य्य: प्रकीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spread abroad or about, to be diffused, promulgated, expanded, or extended. m. (-र्य्यः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) E. प्र progressive motion, कॄ to throw or cast, aff. यक्.
प्रकुपित: प्रकुपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Enraged, incensed. 2 Disordered. E. प्र before कुप to be angry, क्त aff.
प्रकुर्वत्: प्रकुर्व्वत् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) 1 Behaving respectfully to, waiting upon, serving, honouring. 2 Doing much or well. E. प्र before कृ to do, शतृ aff.
प्रकुर्व्वत्: प्रकुर्व्वत् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) 1 Behaving respectfully to, waiting upon, serving, honouring. 2 Doing much or well. E. प्र before कृ to do, शतृ aff.
प्रकुर्वाण: प्रकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Attending, or behaving to with respect. 2 Doing much or well. E. प्र, and कृ to make, शानच् aff.
प्रकुर्व्वाण: प्रकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Attending, or behaving to with respect. 2 Doing much or well. E. प्र, and कृ to make, शानच् aff.
प्रकुल: प्रकुल n. (-लं) A handsome or excellent body. E. प्र excellent, कुल the body; also read प्रह्वल.
प्रकृत: प्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, completed, accomplished. 2 Commenced. 3 Continuing or engaged in what has been begun. 4 Wished, expected. 5 Important, interesting. E. प्र before कृत done.
प्रकृति: प्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Nature; in philosophy, the passive or material cause of the world, as opposed to the active or spiritual; and in mythology, a goddess, the personified will of the Supreme in the creation, identified with Māyā or illusion, and in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex; hence it is the same with the Śakti or personified energy or bride of a deity, as LAKṢMĪ, DURGĀ, &c. in some systems Prakṛti is considered the same with the Supreme Being. 2 The natural state or condition of any thing. 3 A radical form or predicament of being, as illusion, intelligence, consciousness, and the five elements, or Ākāśa, fire, air, earth, and water. 4 The five elements collectively. 5 Cause, origin. 6 A woman or womankind. 7 A mother. 8 An animal. 9 The male organ of generation. 10 The female organ of generation. 11 An uninflected word; the radical form of a word, before the affixes forming cases, &c. are subjoined. 12 A requisite of regal administration, of which seven are enumerated; the king, the minister, an ally, treasure, territory, fortresses, and an army: the corporations or companies of citizens are sometimes added, making an eighth class. 13 A form of metre, consisting of a stanza of four lines, each line containing twenty-one syllables. 14 (In arithmetic,) A given coefficient. (In anatomy,) Temperament, the predominance of one of the humours at the time of generation. E. प्र implying priority or precedence, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन् or क्तिच्; being the first step towards creation.
प्रकृतितरल: प्रकृतितरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Volatile, fickle. E. प्रकृति nature, and तरल changing.
प्रकृतिस्थ: प्रकृतिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Natural, genuine, unmixed. 2 Inherent, innate. E. प्रकृति, and स्थ what is.
प्रकृशित: प्रकृशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thin, emaciate. E. प्र before कृश to be thin, aff. क्त.
प्रकृष्ट: प्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Chief, principal, pre-eminent. 2 Remote, far, long (as a road). E. प्र eminently, कृश to attract, aff. क्त.
प्रकृष्टत्व: प्रकृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं) Eminence, superiority. E. प्रकृष्ट, and त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. प्रकृष्टता.
प्रकोप: प्रकोप m. (-पः) Irritation, provocation, enraging. E. प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v. घञ् aff.
प्रकोपणीय: प्रकोपणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be incensed or enraged. E. प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., अनीयर् aff. and the न optionally changed; also प्रकोपनीय.
प्रकोपन: प्रकोपन n. (-नं) Irritating, provoking. E. प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रकोपित: प्रकोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Irritated, provoked. E. प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रकोष्ठ: प्रकोष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The fore-arm. 2 Part of the frame of a door. 3 A court in a house, or open space surrounded by buildings. E. प्र before कुष to draw, स्थन् aff.
प्रक्खर: प्रक्खर m. (-रः) A horse's armour; also प्रखर and प्रक्षर.
प्रक्रन्तृ: प्रक्रन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) 1 Who proceeds or goes. 2 Conquering, overpowering, surpassing. 3 Who begins, a beginner. E. प्र before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
प्रक्रम: प्रक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Proceeding, going. 2 Leisure, opportunity. 3 Beginning. 4 Surpassing, overcoming. E. प्र first or most, क्रम to go, aff. अच्.
प्रक्रमणीय: प्रक्रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be gone or proceeded. E. प्र before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रक्रमितव्य and प्रक्रम्य.
प्रक्रममाण: प्रक्रममाण (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Proceeding. 2 Beginning. 3 Overcoming. E. प्र before क्रम to go.
प्रक्रान्त: प्रक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Gone, proceeded. 2 Gone beyond, surpassed. 3 Begun. E. प्र before क्रम to go, क्त aff.
प्रक्रिया: प्रक्रिया f. (-या) Bearing royal insignia. E. प्र principal, क्रिया business.
प्रक्रीडित: प्रक्रीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Playing, sporting. E. प्र before, क्रीड to play, क्त aff.
प्रकॢप्त: प्रकॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Made, prepared. 2 Mixed. E. प्र before कृप to make, क्त aff.
प्रक्लिन्न: प्रक्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Satisfied. 2 Wet, soaked. E. प्र excess, क्लिद to wet, aff. क्त.
प्रक्वण: प्रक्वण m. (-णः) The sound of the Vīṇā or lute. E. प्र principal, क्वण to sound, aff. अप्; also प्रक्वाण.
प्रक्वाण: प्रक्वाण m. (-णः) The sound of the Vīṇā or lute. E. प्र before क्वण to sound, aff. घञ्.
प्रक्षर: प्रक्षर m. (-रः) Iron armour for the defence of a horse or elephant. E. प्र best, क्षर to go, aff. अच्.
प्रक्षालक: प्रक्षालक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what washes. E. प्र before क्षल to cleanse, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रक्षालन: प्रक्षालन n. (-नं) Cleaning, washing. E. प्र thoroughly, क्षल r. 10th cl. to clean, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रक्षालित: प्रक्षालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Washed, cleansed. E. प्र before क्षल r. 10th cl. to clean, aff. क्त.
प्रक्षिप्त: प्रक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Thrown, cast, hurled. E. प्र before क्षिप to throw, क्त aff.
प्रक्षिप्तवत्: प्रक्षिप्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Throwing, having thrown. E. प्र before क्षिप to throw, क्तवतु aff.
प्रक्षीण: प्रक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Decayed, wasting. E. प्र before क्षि to waste, क्त aff.
प्रक्षीवित: प्रक्षीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Intoxicated. E. प्र before क्षीव to be drunk, क्त aff.
प्रक्षेप: प्रक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Throwing, casting. 2 Throwing into or upon. 3 Any thing added, or thrown in to drugs when in course of decoction. E. प्र before क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.
प्रक्षेपण: प्रक्षेपण n. (-णं) Throwing, casting. E. प्र before क्षिप to throw, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रक्ष्वेडन: प्रक्ष्वेडन mf. (-नः-ना) 1 An iron arrow. 2 Clamour, a loud indistinct noise. E. प्र especially, क्ष्विद to sound indistinctly, aff. ल्यु, deriv. irr.; otherwise प्रक्ष्वेदन.
प्रक्ष्वेदन: प्रक्ष्वेदन mf. (-नः-ना) 1 An iron arrow. 2 Calling aloud, clamour: E. see the last.
प्रक्ष्वेदित: प्रक्ष्वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Clamorous, shouting, making a loud indistinct noise. 2 Unctuous. E. प्र before, क्ष्विद to sound, क्त aff.; also read प्रक्ष्वेडित.
प्रक्ष्वेदितवत्: प्रक्ष्वेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Noisy. 2 Unctuous. E. प्र before क्ष्विद to make a noise, क्तवतु aff.
प्रखर: प्रखर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very hot or acrid. m. (-रः) 1 Iron armour, for the defence of a horse or elephant. 2 A dog. 3 A mule. E. प्र very much, खन to hurt, aff. रक, deriv. irr.; or प्र before खर an ass, or hot, sharp, &c.
प्रख्य: प्रख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Like, resembling, (in composition.) E. प्र before ख्या to say, aff. ड.
प्रख्यात: प्रख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Celebrated, famous, notorious. 2 Pleased, happy. 3 Bespoken, forestalled, claimed by right of preemption. E. प्र much, ख्यात famed.
प्रख्यातभाण्ड: प्रख्यातभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A commodity that is to be first offered for sale to some person, (as the Raja, &c.) E. प्रख्यात claimed, भाण्ड a vessel.
प्रख्यातवप्तृक: प्रख्यातवप्तृक m. (-कः) A gentleman, a Hidalgo, the son of some body. E. प्रख्यात known, वप्तृ a father, and कन् added.
प्रख्याति: प्रख्याति f. (-तिः) 1 Publicity, notoriety. 2 Praise, eulogium. 3 Fame. E. प्र pre-eminence, &c. and ख्याति reputation.
प्रख्यानीय: प्रख्यानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be celebrated or made known. E. प्र before ख्या to say, अनीयर् aff.
प्रगण्ड: प्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The upper arm, from the elbow to the shoulder. f. (-ण्डी) An outer wall or rampart. E. प्र principal, गण्ड part.
प्रगत: प्रगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separate, apart. 2 Gone with difficulty. E. प्र, and गत gone.
प्रगतजानु: प्रगतजानु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart. E. प्रगत separated, and जानु the knee.
प्रगतजानुक: प्रगतजानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart. E. प्र away, गत gone, जानु the knee, कन् aff.
प्रगदित: प्रगदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Speaking, beginning to speak. E. प्र before गद to speak, क्त aff.
प्रगमन: प्रगमन n. (-नं) 1 Progress, advance. 2 Difficult progress. 3 Going afar or apart. 4 Disputing, words. E. प्र, and गम to go, ल्युट् aff.
प्रगल्भ: प्रगल्भ mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं) 1 Bold, confident. 2 Prompt, ready. 3 Resolute, energetic. 4 Illustrious, eminent. 5 Strong, able. 6 Shameless, impudent, audacious. m. (-ल्भः) The fire used for oblations at the birth of a child. f. (-ल्भा) A woman who courts her husband's caresses, a bold or confident woman. E. प्र much, गल्भ to be proud, aff. अच्.
प्रगल्भता: प्रगल्भता f. (-ता) 1 Energy, resolution. 2 Confidence, boldness. 3 Audacity, arrogance. 4 Power, eminence, consequence. 5 Perverseness, wilfulness. E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to the last; also with त्व, प्रगल्भत्वं.
प्रगाढ: प्रगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Much, excessive. 2 Hard, difficult. 3 Hard, firm. n. (-ढं) Pain, privation, penance. n. adv. (-ढं) 1 Much, exceedingly. 2 Tightly, firmly. E. प्र before गाढ much, exceeding.
प्रगातृ: प्रगातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A capital singer. E. प्र excellent, and गातृ who sings.
प्रगीत: प्रगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, vocal. E. प्र, and गीत sung.
प्रगुण: प्रगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Straight. 2 Honest, upright, straight in morals. E. प्र excellent, and गुण quality.
प्रगुण्य: प्रगुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 More, exceeding. 2 Excellent. E. प्र before गुण a quality or quantity, and क्यप् aff.
प्रगृहीत: प्रगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Collected, strung together. 2 Accepted, admitted. E. प्र, and गृहीत taken.
प्रगृह्य: प्रगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be taken, accepted, admitted, &c. mn. (-ह्यः-ह्यं) The class of letters or syllables not subject to the rules of euphony, as the final ई or उ of the dual number, &c. as हरी एतौ, विष्णू इमौ, &c.
प्रगेतन: प्रगेतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating, or belonging to the morning. E. प्रगे morning, and द्यु aff., तन् inserted.
प्रगोपण: प्रगोपण n. (-णं) Protection, preservation, salvation. E. प्र especially, गोपन preserving.
प्रग्रह: प्रग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Confinement, restriction, restraint, captivity. 3 A prisoner, a captive, either man or beast in confinement. 4 A rein, a rope or halter for horses, and cattle. 5 The string suspending a balance. 6 Favour, kindness. 7 An arm. 8 A ray of light. 9 A sort of Cassia, (C. fistula.) E. प्र before ग्रह to take or seize, aff. अप्; otherwise with घञ्, aff. प्रग्राह.
प्रग्रहण: प्रग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Assuming. E. प्र before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् aff.
प्रग्राह: प्रग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Seizing. 2 Taking, taking up, bearing, carrying. 3 The string of a balance. 4 A rein, &c. E. प्र before ग्रह to take, घञ् aff.; see प्रग्रह.
प्रग्रीव: प्रग्रीव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 A window, a lattice, a balcony. 2 A summer house, a pleasure house. 3 A building on the top of a palace, a painted turret. 4 A wooden balustrade or fence on the edge of a building. 5 A stable. 6 The top of a tree. E. प्र excessive or excellent, and ग्रीवा a neck; the neck as it were of a house.
प्रग्ल: प्रग्ल mfn. (-ग्लः-ग्ला-ग्लं) Wearied, fatigued, exhausted. E. प्र before ग्लै to be weary, क aff.
प्रघटाविद्: प्रघटाविद् m. (-विद्) A general reader, but not a profound one. E. प्रघटा said to imply novelty, and विद् who knows.
प्रघण: प्रघण m. (-णः) 1 A terrace before a house. 2 A copper pot. 3 An iron crow or club. E. प्र before हन to strike, aff. अप्, and the radical letter changed; also प्रघाण.
प्रघन: प्रघन m. (-नः) 1 A covered terrace before a house. 2 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. प्र before हन to strike or hurt, aff. अप्.
प्रघस: प्रघस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Voracious. m. (-सः) 1 Eating much. 2 A Daitya, a demon. E. प्र much, घस for अद to eat, aff. अप् or अच्.
प्रघाण: प्रघाण m. (-णः) A covered terrace or small portico before the door of a house. E. प्र before हन to strike, (with the feet,) aff. अप्, and the radical vowel changed optionally; also प्रघण.
प्रघात: प्रघात m. (-तः) Combat, battle. E. प्र violently, घात striking; also प्राघात.
प्रघान: प्रघान m. (-नः) A covered terrace before the door of a house, a porch, a portico: see प्रघन, and प्रघण.
प्रघूर्ण: प्रघूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Turning round or rolling violently. 2 Wandering, roaming. m. (-र्णः) A guest, a visitor. E. प्र before घूर्ण to turn round, aff. अच्.
प्रघोषक: प्रघोषक m. (-कः) Sound, noise. E. प्र much, घोष sound, aff. कन्.
प्रचक्र: प्रचक्र n. (-क्रं) An army in motion, or as sometimes explained, foraging. E. प्र before चक्र a division.
प्रचक्षस्: प्रचक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) The regent of Jupiter, VṚHASPATI. E. प्र before चक्ष to speak, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.
प्रचण्ड: प्रचण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Excessively hot or burning. 2 Intolerable, insupportable. 3 Bold, confident, presuming. 4 Wrathful, passionate. 5 Violent, strong. m. (-ण्डः) A sort of Nerium with white flowers. f. (-ण्डा) One of DURGĀ'S emanations or attendants. E. प्र very, चण्ड hot, &c.
प्रचण्डमूर्ति: प्रचण्डमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. प्रचण्ड Nerium, and मूर्त्ति form.
प्रचण्डमूर्त्ति: प्रचण्डमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. प्रचण्ड Nerium, and मूर्त्ति form.
प्रचय: प्रचय m. (-यः) 1 A heap, a quantity, a number. 2 Gathering, (as fruit or flowers, but especially by means of a stick or other implement.) 3 Slight union or aggregation. E. प्र before चि to gather, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff., प्रचाय.
प्रचर: प्रचर m. (-रः) 1 A road, a path. 2 Usage, custom, currency. 3 Going well or widely. E. प्र before चर to go, aff. ट; also with घञ् aff., प्रचार.
प्रचरण: प्रचरण n. (-णं) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Circulating, being current. E. प्र before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
प्रचरत्: प्रचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going, well, quickly, widely, &c. E. प्र before चर to go, शतृ aff.
प्रचरित: प्रचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, going. 2 Pursued, practised, (as an art or business.) E. प्र before चर to go, क्त aff.
प्रचल: प्रचल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 What goes much or widely. 2 Current, circulating, customary. E. प्र before चल to go, अच् aff.
प्रचलत्: प्रचलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Going, proceeding far or much. 2 Prevailing, circulating, being customary or current. 3 Being recognised, (as authority or law, &c.) E, प्र before चल to go, शतृ aff.
प्रचलन: प्रचलन n. (-नं) 1 Moving, going much or widely. 2 Circulating, being customary or current. E. प्र before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.
प्रचलाक: प्रचलाक m. (-कः) 1 A peacock's tail. 2 Archery, shooting with arrows. 3 A snake. E. प्र before चल to go, aff. आकन्.
प्रचलाकिन्: प्रचलाकिन् m. (-की) 1 A snake. 2 A peacock. E. प्रचलाक a peacock's tail, and इनि aff.
प्रचलायित: प्रचलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling about, tossing, tumbling, (as in sleep.) E. प्र before चल to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
प्रचलित: प्रचलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone far or wide, wandering, roving. 2 Set in motion, shaken. 3 Current, customary, circulating, prevailing. 4 Recognised, received, (as authority or law, &c.) 5 Rolling (as the eye). E. प्र before चल to go, क्त aff.
प्रचाय: प्रचाय m. (-यः) Gathering any thing with the hand. E. प्र, चि to collect, घञ् aff.
प्रचाल: प्रचाल m. (-लः) The stick or body of the Vīṇā or lute. E. प्र before चल to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रचार: प्रचार m. (-रः) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Custom, usage. 3 Conduct. 4 Currency. 5 Appearance, manifestation. 6 Pasture ground. E. प्र before चर to go, घञ् aff.
प्रचित: प्रचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected, gathered together. n. (-तं) A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. प्र before चि to assemble, क्त aff.
प्रचुर: प्रचुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Much, many. E. प्र before चुर to steal, क aff.
प्रचुरपुरुष: प्रचुरपुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Abounding with men, populous, numerous. m. (-षः) A thief. E. प्रचुर, and पुरुष a man.
प्रचुरीकरण: प्रचुरीकरण n. (-णं) Adding to, augmenting, increasing. E. प्रचुर, and करण making, च्चि augment.
प्रचुरीकृत: प्रचुरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Augmented, in quantity or number. E. प्रचुर, and कृत make, च्चि augment.
प्रचेतस्: प्रचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Happy, delighted. m. (-ताः) 1 VARUṆA, the regent of water. 2 The name of a saint and lawgiver. m. plu. (-सः) The ten sons of PRĀCĪNAVARHIS by the daughter of VARUṆA, and the progenitors of DAKṢA. E. प्र best, first, चेतस् the heart.
प्रचेतृ: प्रचेतृ m. (-ता) A charioteer. E. प्र before चि to collect, (the reins,) aff. तृच्.
प्रचेल: प्रचेल m. (-लः) A yellow fragrant wood. E. प्र before चेल to go, aff. अच्.
प्रचेलक: प्रचेलक m. (-कः) A horse. E. प्र well, fast, चेल to go, वुन् aff.
प्रचोदन: प्रचोदन n. (-नं) 1 Saying, enjoining, prescribing. 2 Sending, directing. 3 A rule or law. E. प्र before चुद to direct, ल्युट् aff.
प्रचोदित: प्रचोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prescribed, directed. 2 Sent, directed. E. प्र thoroughly, चुद to direct, aff. क्त.
प्रचोदिनी: प्रचोदिनी f. (-नी) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. प्र before चुद to send, aff. ल्यु and ङीप्.
प्रच्युत: प्रच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen from, deviated from. E. प्र before च्यु to fall, क्त aff.
प्रच्छ: प्रच्छ (औ) प्रच्छौ r. 6th cl. (पृच्छति) 1 To ask or inquire. 2 To desire, to know.
प्रच्छणा: प्रच्छणा f. (-णा) Asking, addressing, inviting. E. प्रच्छ to ask, aff. युच्.
प्रच्छद: प्रच्छद m. (-दः) A cover, a wrapper. E. प्र completely, छद to cover, aff. अञ्च्.
प्रच्छदपट: प्रच्छदपट m. (-टः) A cover, a wrapper, either of a person or thing, as a cloak, a veil, a sheet, a curtain, &c. E. प्रच्छद a cover, and पट cloth.
प्रच्छन्न: प्रच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Covered, clothed. 2 Unavowed, disguised. 3 Private, concealed, secret. n. (-न्नं) 1 A private door within a house. 2 A lattice, a loop hole. 3 Any private door. E. प्र before च्छद to hide, aff. क्त, what is concealed or secret.
प्रच्छर्दिका: प्रच्छर्दिका f. (-का) Vomiting, sickness. E. प्र violently, छर्द to vomit, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रच्छादन: प्रच्छादन n. (-नं) 1 An upper or outer garment. 2 Covering, concealing. E. प्र completely, छद to cover, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रच्छादित: प्रच्छादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, clothed, hidden, concealed. E. प्र before छद to cover, aff. क्त.
प्रज: प्रज m. (-जः) A husband. E. प्र before जन to be born, ड aff. who is re-born in his children; see प्रजा.
प्रजन: प्रजन mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Impregnating, begetting. 2 Impregnation or pregnancy of cattle in general. 3 The season for a cow's taking the bull, &c. m. (-नः) A progenitor, an impregnator. E. प्र before जन to be born, घञ् aff.
प्रजनन: प्रजनन n. (-नं) 1 The vulva. 2 Birth, production. 3 Going well or quickly. E. प्र before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रजनार्थम्: प्रजनार्थम् adv. ind. For the sake of procreation. E. प्रजन, and अर्थ on account of.
प्रजनिका: प्रजनिका f. (-का) A mother. E. प्र before जन to be born, aff. वुन्.
प्रजनिष्णु: प्रजनिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Being born or produced. 2 Producing, generating. 3 Growing or standing, (as corn.) E. प्र before जन to be born, इष्णुच् aff.
प्रजल्प: प्रजल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Prattle, gossip. 2 Talking heedlessly to a lover. E. प्र, and जल्प talking.
प्रजव: प्रजव m. (-वः) Great speed. E. प्र before जव quickness.
प्रजविन्: प्रजविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Swift, speedy. m. (-वी) A runner, a courier, an express. E. प्र before जव speed, aff. इनि.
प्रजा: प्रजा f. (-जा) 1 Progeny, offspring. 2 People, subjects. E. प्र before जन to be born, aff. ड and टाप्.
प्रजाकाम: प्रजाकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of offspring. E. प्रजा, and काम desire.
प्रजागर: प्रजागर m. (-रः) Waking, watching. E. प्र before जागर wakefulness.
प्रजाता: प्रजाता f. (-ता) A woman who has borne a child. E. प्र before जात born, (from whom.)
प्रजाद: प्रजाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Who or what gives offspring. 2 What removes barrenness, (as a medicine, &c.) E. प्रजा, and द what gives.
प्रजादान: प्रजादान n. (-नं) Silver. E. प्रजा people, and दान gift.
प्रजाधर्म: प्रजाधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of children or of subjects. E. प्रजा, and धर्म्म duty.
प्रजाधर्म्म: प्रजाधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of children or of subjects. E. प्रजा, and धर्म्म duty.
प्रजानत्: प्रजानत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) 1 Sensible, intelligent. 2 Knowing, understanding. f. (-न्ती) A sensible woman. E. प्र before ज्ञा to know, aff. शतृ.
प्रजाप: प्रजाप m. (-पः) A king. E. प्रजा people, subjects, and प who protects, from पा with क aff.
प्रजापति: प्रजापति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The epithet common to the ten divine personages, who were first created by BRAHMA; they are also termed Brahmādikas, and their names are MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, PRACETAS, VASIṢṬHA, BHṚGU, and NĀRADA: some authorities make the Prajāpatis only seven in number, others reduce them to three, or DAKṢA, NĀRADA, and BHṚGU, and others make them twenty-one. 3 A king, a sovereign. 4 A father. 5 A son-in-law, a daughter's husband. 6 The sun. 7 Fire. 8 A name of VIŚVAKARMA. E. प्रजा people or the world, and पति master.
प्रजायिनी: प्रजायिनी f. (-नी) A mother, or bearer of children. E. प्र before जन to be born, णिनि aff.
प्रजावत्: प्रजावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having progeny. 2 Having subjects. f. (-ती) 1 A brother's wife. 2 The wife of an elder brother. 3 A mother. E. प्रजा offspring, and मतुप poss. aff.
प्रजावृद्धि: प्रजावृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Increase of progeny. E. प्रजा, and वृद्धि increase.
प्रजाहित: प्रजाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Favourable or good for children or subjects, &c. kind to them, useful to them, &c. n. (-तं) Water. E. प्रजा people, and हित friendly, useful.
प्रजीन: प्रजीन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. प्र before जि to surpass or overcome, क्त aff., form irr.
प्रजीवन: प्रजीवन n. (-नं) Livelihood, subsistence. E. प्र, and जीवन living.
प्रजुष्ट: प्रजुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Strongly attached to, devoted to, intent on. E. प्र, and जुष to serve, aff. क्त.
प्रजेश्वर: प्रजेश्वर m. (-रः) A king. E. प्रजा subject, and ईश्वर lord.
प्रज्ञ: प्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Wise, learned; also प्राज्ञ. 2 Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart: see प्रज्ञु. f. (-ज्ञा) 1 A clever or sensible woman. 2 Understanding, wisdom, knowledge. 3 The  goddess of arts and eloquence, SARASVATĪ. E. प्र before ज्ञा, to know, aff. क.
प्रज्ञप्ति: प्रज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) An appointment, an agreement, an engagement. (-प्ती) One of the Vidyā Devīs of the Jainas. E. प्र before ज्ञा to know, causal v., aff. क्तिन्.
प्रज्ञाकाय: प्रज्ञाकाय m. (-यः) A Bauddha saint; also MAÑJUGHOṢA. E. प्रज्ञा knowledge, कै to sound, अङ् aff.
प्रज्ञाचक्षुस्: प्रज्ञाचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. प्रज्ञा, and चक्षुस् the eye: being physically blind.
प्रज्ञात: प्रज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Famous, notorious. E. प्र, and ज्ञात known.
प्रज्ञान: प्रज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wise, learned. n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge, wisdom. 2 A mark, a sign, a token. E. प्र exceeding, ज्ञान knowledge.
प्रज्ञावत्: प्रज्ञावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wise, intelligent. E. प्रज्ञा, and मतुप् aff.
प्रज्ञाहीन: प्रज्ञाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Silly, unwise, ignorant. E. प्रज्ञा, and हीन void of.
प्रज्ञिन्: प्रज्ञिन् m. (-ज्ञी) A sage, a scholar, a wise or learned man. E. प्रज्ञा wisdom, aff. इनि.
प्रज्ञु: प्रज्ञु mfn. (-ज्ञुः-ज्ञुः-ज्ञु) Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart. E. प्र separate, जानु the knee, and ज्ञु substituted.
प्रज्वलित: प्रज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blazing, radiant. 2 Burnt. E. प्र implying excess, ज्वलित burning.
प्रज्वालित: प्रज्वालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, kindled. E. प्र before ज्वल to blaze, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रडीन: प्रडीन n. (-नं) 1 Flying rapidly, or flying in every direction. 2 Taking flight, beginning to fly. E. प्र intensitive, डीन flying.
प्रण: प्रण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Old, ancient. E. प्र substituted for पुराण, and न aff.
प्रणत: प्रणत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bending, bowed, stooping, inclined. 2 Skilful, clever. E. प्र before णम to bow, aff. क्त.
प्रणतवत्: प्रणतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Bowing, bent, bowed, E. प्र before णम to bow down, क्तवतु aff.
प्रणतशिरस्: प्रणतशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Inclined, stooping, having the head or top bowed. E. प्रणत, and शिरस् the head.
प्रणति: प्रणति f. (-तिः) Salutation, reverence, obeisance, courtesy. E. प्र before णम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
प्रणदित: प्रणदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, sounding. E. प्र before णद to sound, क्त aff.
प्रणमत्: प्रणमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Bowing to, saluting with reverence or respect. E. प्र before णम to bow, शतृ aff.
प्रणमित: प्रणमित wfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bending, bowing. E. प्र before णम to bow, क्त aff. with इट् inserted.
प्रणय: प्रणय m. (-यः) 1 Affection, friendly or fond regard. 2 Acquaintance. 3 Asking, begging. 4 Affectionate solicitation. 5 Final emancipation or beatitude. 6 Trust, confidence. 7 Reverence, obeisance. E. प्र before णी to get, aff. अच्.
प्रणयत्: प्रणयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Leading, conducting. 2 Dispensing. 3 Decreeing, awarding. E. प्र and णी to lead, शतृ aff.
प्रणयन: प्रणयन n. (-नं) 1 Leading, conducting. 2 Dispensing, distributing. 3 Sentencing, awarding. E. प्र before णी to guide, ल्युट् aff.
प्रणयमान: प्रणयमान m. (-नः) Loverś quarrels. E. प्रणय, and मान indignation.
प्रणयवत्: प्रणयवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Attached to, loving. E. प्रणय, and पतुप् aff.
प्रणयविहति: प्रणयविहति f. (-तिः) Denial, refusal, non-compliance. E. प्रणय requiring, विहति rejecting.
प्रणयिन्: प्रणयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 1 Affectionate, kind. 2 Intimate, familiar. m. (-यी) A husband or lover. f. (-यिणी) A wife or mistress. E. प्रणय affection, इनि poss. aff.
प्रणर्त्तन: प्रणर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing. E. प्र before वृत to dance, ल्युट् aff.
प्रणव: प्रणव m. (-वः) The mystical name of the Deity, or syllable Om. 2 A small kind of drum or tabor. E. प्र before णु to praise, aff. अच्.
प्रणवक: प्रणवक m. (-कः) The mystical name of the Deity. E. प्रणव, and कन् added.
प्रणश्यत्: प्रणश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) 1 Perishing, falling away. 2 Endeavouring to escape. E. प्र before नश to destroy, aff. शतृ.
प्रणष्ट: प्रणष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Destroyed, lost, annihilated. E. प्र, and नष्ट destroyed.
प्रणष्टविनय: प्रणष्टविनय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Uncivil, uncomplaisant, rude. E. प्रनष्ट, and विनय decorum.
प्रणाद: प्रणाद m. (-दः) 1 A loud noise, especially expressing approbation or delight, a huzza, a shout. 2 A low sound expressive of great pleasure, a murmur or sigh or rapture. 3 A disease of the ear, a noise or buzzing in the ear from thickening of the membranes, &c. E. प्र much, and नाद sound.
प्रणाम: प्रणाम m. (-मः) Respectful or reverential salutation, addressed especially to a Brahman or deity. E. प्र before णम to bow, aff. घञ्.
प्रणाय्य: प्रणाय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) 1 Devoid of passion or desire. 2 Disobedient, disagreeing. 3 Upright, straight, in rectitude. 4 Beloved. E. प्र away, णी to go, aff. ण्यत्.
प्रणाल: प्रणाल mf. (-लः-ली) An issue from a pond, a drain, a watercourse. E. प्र before नल to bind, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added in the fem. form प्रणालिका (-का.)
प्रणाश: प्रणाश m. (-शः) Loss, destruction. E. प्र before णश to be destroyed, घञ् aff.
प्रणाशिन्: प्रणाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Destroying. E. प्र before णश to be destroyed, causal v., घिणुन् aff.
प्रणिघ्नत्: प्रणिघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्) Preparing or threatening to strike. E. प्र and नि before हन to strike, aff. शतृ.
प्रणिंसित: प्रणिंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kissed. E. प्र, णिसि to kiss, क्त aff.; also read प्रनिंसित.
प्रणिंसितव्य: प्रणिंसितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be kissed, what may or ought to be kissed. E. प्र before णिशि to kiss, तव्य aff.; also read प्रनिंसितव्य.
प्रणिधान: प्रणिधान n. (-नं) 1 Great effort, stress, energy. 2 Profound religious meditation. 3 Access, entrance. E. प्र and नि prefixed to घा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रणिधि: प्रणिधि m. (-घिः) 1 A spy, a secret agent or emissary. 2 Asking, solicitation or request. 3 Care, attention. 4 A follower. E. प्र and नि before धा to have, aff. कि.
प्रणिनदत्: प्रणिनदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sounding deep or like thunder. E. प्र and नि before नद to sound, शतृ aff.
प्रणिनाद: प्रणिनाद m. (-दः) A deep sound, that of thunder or its like. E. प्र and नि before नद to sound, घञ् aff.
प्रणिपतन: प्रणिपतन n. (-नं) Saluting, bowing or doing homage to. E. प्र and नि before पत to go, ल्युट् aff.
प्रणिपतित: प्रणिपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed down in reverence, saluting. E. प्र and नि before पत to go, aff. क्त.
प्रणिपत्य: प्रणिपत्य ind. Having bowed down or in reverence, having saluted respectfully. E. प्र and नि before पत to go, ल्यप् aff.
प्रणिपात: प्रणिपात m. (-तः) Salutation, reverence, obeisance. E. प्र and नि before पत to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रणिहित: प्रणिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Delivered, entrusted, consigned. 2 Obtained, received, acquired. 3 Acknowledged, admitted. 4 Placed, fixed, deposited. 5 Prudent, advised, careful, wary. 6 Determined. E. प्र and नि before धा to have, aff. क्त.
प्रणीत: प्रणीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dressed (as food), cooked, &c. 2 Made, done, constructed. 3 Thrown, cast, sent. 4 Entered, approached. 5 Proper, fit. 6 Said, declared. 7 Delivered, given. 8 Decreed, sentenced, awarded. 9 Composed, written. m. (-तः) Fire, consecrated by prayers or mystical formulæ. f. (-ता) A vessel used at sacrifices, a sort of cup. E. प्र before णी to get, aff. क्त.
प्रणुत: प्रणुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, celebrated. E. प्र before णु to praise, aff. क्त.
प्रणुद्: प्रणुद् mfn. (-णुत् or णुद्) Enjoining, directing, who or what commands or enjoins. E. प्र before णुद् to command, क्विप् aff.
प्रणुन्न: प्रणुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Shaken, trembling. 2 Sent, dispatched. E. प्र before णुद to send, क्त aff.
प्रणेय: प्रणेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Docile, submissive, agreeable. E. प्र before णी to lead, aff. यत्.
प्रणोद: प्रणोद m. (-दः) 1 Directing, ordering. 2 Guiding, driving, (as horses.) E. प्र before णुद to send, घञ् aff.
प्रणोदित: प्रणोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ordered, directed. 2 Driven, guided. E. प्र before णुद to send, क्त aff.
प्रतति: प्रतति f. (-तिः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 A creeping plant. E. प्र before तन to spread, aff. क्विन्.
प्रतती: प्रतती f. (-ती) A creeping plant. E. ङीप् added to the preceding.
प्रतन: प्रतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Old, ancient. E. प्र prior, with द्युल् aff. and तन् augment.
प्रतनु: प्रतनु mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु) Thin, delicate, minute. E. प्र, and तनु thin.
प्रतर्कण: प्रतर्कण n. (-णं) Reasoning, discussion, doubt, logic. E. प्र before तर्क to reason, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतल: प्रतल m. (-लः) The open hand with the fingers extended. n. (-लं) One of the seven principal divisions of the lower regions. E. प्र exceeding, तल lowness, &c.
प्रतान: प्रतान m. (-नः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 A low spreading creeper. 3 A disease, fainting, epilepsy. E. प्र before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.
प्रतानिन्: प्रतानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Spreading, extending. f. (-नी) A spreading, creeper. E. प्र before तन to spread, aff. ल्युट्, and इनि and ङीप् added.
प्रताप: प्रताप m. (-पः) 1 Majesty, dignity, the possession of rank and power. 2 Spirit, energy. 3 Splendour, brilliancy. 4 Heat. E. प्र before तप to shine, aff. घञ्.
प्रतापन: प्रतापन m. (-नः) A hell. n. (-नं) 1 Inflicting pain or punishment, burning, consuming. 2 Paining, distressing. E. प्र before तप to heat, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतापवत्: प्रतापवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत) Majestick, glorious. E. प्रताप, and मतुप् aff.
प्रतापस: प्रतापस m. (-सः) A species of gigantic Asclepias, with white flowers. E. प्रताप heat, षो to destroy, aff. क.
प्रतापिन्: प्रतापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Shining, splendid. 2 Dignified, powerful. 3 Burning. 4 Distressing. E. प्रताप, and इति aff.
प्रताम्: प्रताम् mfn. (-तान्) 1 Desiring. 2 Being afflicted. E. प्र before तम to desire, क्वि aff.
प्रतार: प्रतार m. (-रः) Crossing over. E. प्र before तॄ to cross, अच् aff.
प्रतारक: प्रतारक m. (-कः) A cheat. E. प्र before तॄ to cross, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रतारण: प्रतारण nf. (-णं-णा) Fraud, cheating, deceit, overreaching, trick. E. प्र before तॄ to cross, aff. युच्.
प्रतारित: प्रतारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cheated, deceived, tricked. E. प्र before तॄ to pass over, (to overreach,) aff. क्त.
प्रति: प्रति ind. A particle and prefix, implying, 1 Substitution, (instead, in lieu;) as प्रद्युम्नःकेशवातप्रति. 2 Several order, (severally, each by each;) as वृक्षं प्रति षिञ्चति; प्रतिवेदं each Vedā; प्रतिदिनं every day; प्रतिछिद्रं each opening; प्रतिगर्भं every birth; प्रत्येक one by one. 3 Direction, designation, (to, towards, upon;) as वृक्षं प्रति विद्योतते विद्युत्. 4 Belonging to, (as a part or portion.) 5 Exchange, return, (again, back again, re) तिलेभ्यः प्रति माषान् यच्छति. 6 A little, &c. as शाकप्रति, सूपप्रति. 7 Opposition in place, as प्रतिसूर्य्यं against the sun, प्रतिवात against the wind. 8 With respect to, अनेकभार्य्यं, प्रत्याह. E. प्रथ to be famous, डति aff.; in the following compounds the final इ of प्रति is optionally long, before derivatives formed with घञ्, as प्रतिहार or प्रतीहार, &c.
प्रतिक: प्रतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worth sixteen Pans of Cowries. E. प्रति substituted for कार्षापण, and ठक् aff.
प्रतिकर्मन्: प्रतिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) 1 Dress, decoration, personal embellishment. 2 Retaliation, requital. 3 Remedy, redress. E. प्रति belonging to (the body), and कर्म्मन् business.
प्रतिकर्म्मन्: प्रतिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) 1 Dress, decoration, personal embellishment. 2 Retaliation, requital. 3 Remedy, redress. E. प्रति belonging to (the body), and कर्म्मन् business.
प्रतिकाय: प्रतिकाय m. (-यः) 1 A butt, a mark; the effigy of a man, for archers to practise at. 2 An effigy, an image, a picture. E. प्रति again, and काय the body; a repetition or reflection of the form.
प्रतिकार: प्रतिकार m. (-रः) 1 Revenge, retaliation. 2 Remedying, counteracting. E. प्रति again, against, and कार making; also प्रतीकार.
प्रतिकाश: प्रतिकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Like, resembling, (used in composition.) E. प्रति to or again, and काश or कास what shines; also प्रतिकास, प्रतीकास, &c.
प्रतिकास: प्रतिकास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Like, (in composition:) see the last.
प्रतिकुञ्चित: प्रतिकुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, curved. E. प्रति, and कुचि to be curved, क्त aff.
प्रतिकूप: प्रतिकूप m. (-पः) A moat, a ditch. E. प्रति implying little, and कूप a well.
प्रतिकूल: प्रतिकूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Contrary, adverse, cross-grained, reverse, inverted. 2 Contradictory, cross, perverse. E. प्रति for प्रतीप averted, and कूल a bank or shore.
प्रतिकूलता: प्रतिकूलता f. (-ता) Opposition, hostility. E. प्रतिकूल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रतिकूलत्वं.
प्रतिकृत: प्रतिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Requited, returned. 2 Counteracted. 3 Remedred. E. प्रति, and कृत made.
प्रतिकृति: प्रतिकृति f. (-तिः) 1 An effigy, a figure, an image, a picture, a reflection, a shadow, a reflected image. 2 Retaliation, return, revenge. 3 A substitute. E. प्रति again, &c. and कृति making.
प्रतिकृष्ट: प्रतिकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Inferior, low, vile. 2 Twice ploughed, or ploughed back again. E. प्रति against, and कृष्ट drawn.
प्रतिक्रिया: प्रतिक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Return, requital. 2 Retaliation. 3 Remedying, counteracting. 4 Embellishment, decoration. E. प्रति, and क्रिया act.
प्रतिक्षण: प्रतिक्षण adv. n. (-णं) Momentarily, every moment. E. प्रति several order, and क्षण an instant.
प्रतिक्षय: प्रतिक्षय m. (-यः) A guard, an attendant. E. प्रति against, क्षय injury.
प्रतिक्षिप्त: प्रतिक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं). 1 Dismissed, rejected, turned away. 2 Sent, dispatched. 3 Opposed, repelled, resisted. 4 Abused, reviled. 5 Calumniated, falsely accused. E. प्रति again, against, and क्षिप्त thrown, sent.
प्रतिक्षुत: प्रतिक्षुत n. (-तं) Sneezing, wheezing. E. प्रति repeatedly, क्षुत sneezing.
प्रतिगत: प्रतिगत n. (-तं) Flying backwards and forwards, wheeling in flight. E. प्रति repetition, and गत gone; going and coming.
प्रतिगर्जत्: प्रतिगर्जत् mfn. (-र्ज्जन्-र्ज्जन्ती-र्ज्जत्) Echoing, reverberating. 2 Murmuring or rebelling. E. प्रति before गर्ज्ज to growl, शतृ aff.
प्रतिगिरि: प्रतिगिरि m. (-रिः) Any inferior mountain, or any thing like a mountain. E. प्रति, and गिरि a hill.
प्रतिगृहीत: प्रतिगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken, accepted. E. प्रति, ग्रह to take, क्त aff.
प्रतिगृहीतृ: प्रतिगृहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who takes or accepts, an accepter, a receiver. E. प्रति before गृह to take, तृच् aff.
प्रतिगृह्य: प्रतिगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be taken, what may be accepted, &c. ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Bringing up the rear. E. प्रति, and ग्रह to take, क्यप् or ल्यप् aff.
प्रतिग्रह: प्रतिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Acceptance, assent. 2 Proper donation to Brahmans, whatever is a fit present to a Brahman at suitable periods. 3 The acceptance of such a gift. 4 A spitting pot. 5 The reserve of an army, a detachment posted with the general four hundred yards in the rear of the line. 6 The sun near the moon's node. E. प्रति again, &c. and ग्रह taking.
प्रतिग्रहण: प्रतिग्रहण n. (-णं) Receiving presents. E. प्रति, and ग्रहण taking.
प्रतिग्रहणीय: प्रतिग्रहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken or accepted. E. प्रति, ग्रह to take, अनीयर् aff.
प्रतिग्राह: प्रतिग्राह m. (-हः) 1 A spitting pot. 2 Accepting gifts. E. प्रति before ग्रह to take, ण aff.
प्रतिग्राह्य: प्रतिग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be accepted or taken. E. प्रति, and ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
प्रतिघ: प्रतिघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Adverse, inimical. m. (-घः) 1 Wrath, rage. 2 Mutual beating, combat, fighting. 3 Fainting. 4 An enemy. E. प्रति again, severally, and घ striking.
प्रतिघात: प्रतिघात m. (-तः) 1 A return blow, repulse, rebound. 2 Warding off a blow. 3 Preventing, prohibiting. E. प्रति before हन to kill, घञ् aff.
प्रतिघातन: प्रतिघातन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्रति mutually, हन to kill, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतिघातिन्: प्रतिघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Repelling, repulsing. 2 Hostile, opposed to. E. प्रतिघात, and इनि aff.
प्रतिघ्न: प्रतिघ्न n. (-घ्नं) The body. E. प्रति again, घ्न what destroys.
प्रतिघ्नत्: प्रतिघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्) 1 Opposing, impeding. 2 Destructive. 3 Hostile. E. प्रति before हन to kill, शतृ aff.
प्रतिचिन्तन: प्रतिचिन्तन n. (-नं) Thinking repeatedly, considering, meditating upon. E. प्रति, and चिति to think, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतिच्छन्द: प्रतिच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 A reflected image, any image, a picture, a statue. 2 A substitute. E. प्रति again, छदि to cover, aff. अच्; also with कन् added प्रतिछन्दक n. (-कं.)
प्रतिच्छाया: प्रतिछाया f. (-या) 1 An image, a statue, a bas-relief, a picture. 2 A reflected image, a shade or shadow. E. प्रति again, छाया a shadow.
प्रतिछाया: प्रतिछाया f. (-या) 1 An image, a statue, a bas-relief, a picture. 2 A reflected image, a shade or shadow. E. प्रति again, छाया a shadow.
प्रतिच्छेद: प्रतिछेद m. (-दः) Opposition, resistance. E. प्रति, and छेद cutting.
प्रतिछेद: प्रतिछेद m. (-दः) Opposition, resistance. E. प्रति, and छेद cutting.
प्रतिजङ्घा: प्रतिजङ्घा f. (-ङ्घा) The fore part of the thigh. E. प्रति before, and जङ्घा the thigh.
प्रतिजल्पक: प्रतिजल्पक m. (-कः) Reply in assent, respectful concurrence. E. प्रति, and जल्पक talking.
प्रतिजागर: प्रतिजागर m. (-रः) Attention, watchfulness. E. प्रति towards, and जागर watchful.
प्रतिजिह्वा: प्रतिजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) The uvula, or soft palate. E. प्रति again, or like, जिह्वा the tongue; also with कन् added in the fem. form, प्रतिजिह्विका (-का.)
प्रतिजीवन: प्रतिजीवन n. (-नं) Resuscitation. E. प्रति again, जीवन living.
प्रतिज्ञा: प्रतिज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) 1 Promise, agreement, engagement, assent. 2 Admission, acknowledgment. 3 (In logic,) The proposition, the assertion to be proved. E. प्रति mutually, ज्ञा to know, aff. क.
प्रतिज्ञात: प्रतिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Admitted, acknowledged. 3 Propounded, asserted. E. प्रति mutually, ज्ञात known.
प्रतिज्ञातव्य: प्रतिज्ञातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be promised. 2 To be assented to. E. प्रति before ज्ञा to know, तव्य aff.
प्रतिज्ञान: प्रतिज्ञान n. (-नं) Promise, agreement, assent. E. प्रति before ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिज्ञान्तर: प्रतिज्ञान्तर n. (-रं) A subsequent proposition on failure of the first, (in logic.) E. प्रतिज्ञा, and अन्तर difference.
प्रतिज्ञापचक: प्रतिज्ञापचक n. (-कं) A bond, a written contract. E. प्रतिज्ञा agreement, and पच a leaf, कन् added.
प्रतिज्ञाय: प्रतिज्ञाय ind. Having promised. E. प्रति before, ज्ञा to know, ल्युप् aff.
प्रतिज्ञाविरोध: प्रतिज्ञाविरोध m. (-धः) 1 Denial of a logical proposition. 2 Acting contrary to promise or agreement. E. प्रतिज्ञा, and विरोध opposition.
प्रतिज्ञाविवाहित: प्रतिज्ञाविवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Promised in marriage, betrothed. E. प्रतिज्ञा, and विवाहित married.
प्रतिज्ञासन्न्यास: प्रतिज्ञासन्न्यास m. (-सः) 1 A bandonment of the original proposition, (in logic.) 2 Breaking a promise. E. प्रतिज्ञा, and सन्न्यास quitting.
प्रतिज्ञाहानि: प्रतिज्ञाहानि f. (-निः) Giving up the argument. E. प्रतिज्ञा, and हाति abandoning.
प्रतिज्ञेय: प्रतिज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be promised or accepted. m. (-यः) The reciter or pronouncer of a panegyric, the proclaimer of rank and titles, a herald, a bard, a panegyrist. E. प्रति before ज्ञा to know, यत् aff.
प्रतितत्त्वसिद्धान्त: प्रतितत्त्वसिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Conclusion or notion adopted by each disputant severally. E. प्रति severally, तत्त्व truth, and सिद्धान्त conclusion.
प्रतितन्त्र: प्रतितन्त्र adv. n. (-न्त्रं) 1 According to each Tantra. 2 According to each opinion, &c. E. प्रति, and तन्त्र a doctrine.
प्रतिताल: प्रतिताल m. (-लः) A kind of air or melody. f. (-ली) The key of a door or padlock, or an instrument to open a door. E. प्रति relating to, ताल tune, or a lock, fem. aff. ङीप्.
प्रतिदान: प्रतिदान n. (-नं) 1 The return or re-delivery of a deposit. 2 Barter, exchange. 3 Giving back or in return for. E. प्रति again, दानं a giving.
प्रतिदारण: प्रतिदारण n. (-णं) War, battle. E. प्रति reciprocally, and दारण tearing.
प्रतिदिन: प्रतिदिन adv. n. (-नं) Every day, day by day. E. प्रति severally, and दिन a day.
प्रतिदिवन्: प्रतिदिवन् m. (-वा) 1 The sun. 2 A day. E. प्रति severally, दिव to shine, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्; also with the vowel lengthened, प्रतिदीवन्.
प्रतिदिशं: प्रतिदिशं adv. n. (-शं) Every where, all around. E. प्रति, and दिश a quarter.
प्रतिदेय: प्रतिदेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be returned, to be given back, or as an equivalent. n. (-यं) 1 A pledge, a pawn. 2 An article purchased and given back. E. प्रति again, देय to be given.
प्रतिद्वन्द्व: प्रतिद्वन्द्व n. (-न्द्वं) Opposition, hostility. E. प्रति against, द्वन्द्व a couple.
प्रतिद्वन्द्विन्: प्रतिद्वन्द्विन् mfn. (-न्द्वी-न्द्विनी-न्द्वि) Hostile, an enemy. E. प्रतिद्वन्द्व, and इनि aff.
प्रतिध्वनि: प्रतिध्वनि f. (-निः) Echo, an echo. E. प्रति, and ध्वनि sound.
प्रतिध्वान: प्रतिध्वान m. (-नः) Echo, reiterated or repeated sound. E. प्रति again, ध्वान sound.
प्रतिनप्तृ: प्रतिनप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A great grandson, a son's grandson. E. प्रति again, repeated, and नप्तृ a grandson.
प्रतिनव: प्रतिनव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) New, young, fresh, recent. E. प्रति intensitive prefix, and नव new.
प्रतिनाद: प्रतिनाद m. (-दः) Echo, resonance. E. प्रति, and नाद sound.
प्रतिनादित: प्रतिनादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Echoing, re-sounding. E. प्रतिनाद, and इतच् aff.
प्रतिनिधि: प्रतिनिधि m. (-धिः) 1 A resemblance of a real form, an image, a statue, a picture, &c. 2 A surety. 3 A substitute. E. प्रति again, धा to have, with नि prefix, कि aff.
प्रतिनिनद: प्रतिनिनद m. (-दः) An echo, a reverberation. E. प्रति, and निनद sound.
प्रतिनिवर्तन: प्रतिनिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning back or away from. 2 Returning. E. प्रति, and नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिनिवर्त्तन: प्रतिनिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning back or away from. 2 Returning. E. प्रति, and नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिनिवृत्त: प्रतिनिवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Turned away from, desisted from, leaving, withdrawn from. 2 Come back, returned. E. प्रति and नि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
प्रतिनिश: प्रतिनिश adv. n. (-शं) By night, every night. E. प्रति, and निशा a night.
प्रतिप: प्रतिप m. (-पः) A king of the lunar race, father of ŚANTANU, and grandfather of BHĪṢMA; also प्रतीप. E. प्रति severally, and प who cherishes.
प्रतिपक्ष: प्रतिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 An enemy. 2 A respondent, an opponent. 3 A defendant. E. प्रति against, and पक्ष a part, a party.
प्रतिपत्ति: प्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Fame, reputation. 2 Gaining, getting, obtaining, acquirement. 3 Action, worldly practice or activity, as opposed to religious contemplation. 4 Use, application, profit. 5 Arrogance, audacity, confidence. 6 Knowledge, determination, ascertainment. 7 Elevation, exaltation, promotion, acquirement of rank or dignity. 8 Acknowledgment, assent, admission. 9 Inspiring trust or confidence, satisfying, shewing in proof. 10 Respectful or affectionate behaviour to. 11 Purpose, design. 12 Comprehending, including. 13 Distribution, disposal. 14 Giving, presentation. 15 Blinding, misleading, deceiving. 16 Throwing Ghee on the fire, or images into a sacred stream, or any similar rite from which no advantage is expected. E. प्रति severally or towards, &c. पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रतिपत्तिपटह: प्रतिपत्तिपटह m. (-हः) A large drum; the state drum allowed only to chiefs of a certain rank. E. प्रतिपत्ति celebrity, and पटह a drum.
प्रतिपत्तिमत्: प्रतिपत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Active, prompt. 2 Celebrated. 3 High in rank. E. प्रतिपत्ति, and मतुप् aff.
प्रतिपत्तिपराङ्मुख: प्रतिपत्तिपराङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Obstinate, unyielding. E. प्रतिपत्ति, and पराङ्मुख averse.
प्रतिपत्तूर्य: प्रतिपत्तूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A kettle drum. E. प्रतिपट् rank, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
प्रतिपत्तूर्य्य: प्रतिपत्तूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A kettle drum. E. प्रतिपट् rank, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
प्रतिपद्: प्रतिपद् f. (-पद् or पत्) 1 The first day of a lunar fortnight, the first of the moon's increase or wane. 2 Understanding, intellect. 3 Rank, consequence. 4 A kettle drum. E. प्रति severally, पद to go, and क्विप् aff.
प्रतिपद: प्रतिपद ind. or n. adv. (-दं) Step by step, at each step. 2 Continually, every moment. E. प्रति, and पद step.
प्रतिपन्न: प्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Known, understood, ascertained, determined. 2 Promised, engaged, assented to, accepted. 3 Overcome, conquered, subdued. 4 Obtained, gained. 5 Done, effected, accomplished. 6 Undertaken. 7 Replied. E. प्रति again, and पद to go, aff. क्त.
प्रतिपाण: प्रतिपाण n. (-णं) 1 Stake, gage, the thing played for. 2 A counter pledge, the thing staked against another. E. प्रति, and पण to have price, घञ् aff.
प्रतिपादक: प्रतिपादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What produces effects, causes, &c. 2 Explanatory. E. प्रति, and पद to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
प्रतिपादन: प्रतिपादन m. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Ascertaining, determining, rendering clear or intelligible. 3 Action, worldly conduct or interest. 4 Accomplishing, effecting. 5 Producing, causing. E. प्रति severally, and पद to go, causal v., aff, ल्युट्.
प्रतिपादित: प्रतिपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Delivered, given. 2 Caused. E. प्रति before पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.
प्रतिपादुक: प्रतिपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Determining, ascertaining. 2 Making manifest or clear. 3 What causes or effects. E. प्रति before पद to go, causal v., उकञ् aff.
प्रतिपालक: प्रतिपालक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what protects or defends. m. (-कः) 1 A king. 2 A protector. E. प्रति before पाल to protect, वुन् aff.
प्रतिपालन: प्रतिपालन n. (-नं) 1 Protecting, defending, cherishing. 2 Following, practising. E. प्रति, and पाल to cherish, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिपालनीय: प्रतिपालनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be cherished or protected. 2 To be observed or followed. E. प्रति, and पाल to cherish, अनीयर् aff.
प्रतिपालित: प्रतिपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cherished, protected. 2 Practised, followed. E. प्रति before पाल to cherish, क्त aff.
प्रतिपाल्य: प्रतिपाल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) To be cherished or protected. E. प्रति before, पाल to cherish, यत् aff.; also प्रतिपालितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
प्रतिपुरुष: प्रतिपुरुष m. (-षः) A deputy, a substitute. n. adv. (-षं) Every man, man by man. E. प्रति, and पुरुष a man.
प्रतिपूजक: प्रतिपूजक m. (-कः) A reverer, one who does homage. E. प्रति, and पूजक who worships.
प्रतिपूजन: प्रतिपूजन n. (-नं) 1 Exchange of civilities, mutual obeisance or reverence. 2 Offering homage or respect. E. प्रति, and पूजन worshipping.
प्रतिपूजित: प्रतिपूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Treated with reverence or respect. 2 Exchanged as civilities. E. प्रति, and पूजित worshipped.
प्रतिपूज्य: प्रतिपूज्य ind. 1 Having offered homage to. 2 Having exchanged respectful salutations. E. प्रति, and पूज to worship, ल्यप् aff.
प्रतिप्रयाण: प्रतिप्रयाण n. (-णं) Return, retreat. E. प्रति, and प्रयाण who goes.
प्रतिप्रसव: प्रतिप्रसव m. (-वः) Precept for an act which under other circumstances is forbidden. E. प्रति, and प्रसव birth.
प्रतिप्रसूत: प्रतिप्रसूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Re-enjoined, after having been forbidden. E. प्रति, and प्रसूत born.
प्रतिफल: प्रतिफल n. (-लं) 1 An image, a shadow, a reflection. 2 Return, requital, retaliation. E. प्रति, and फल fruit.
प्रतिफलन: प्रतिफलन n. (-नं) 1 A reflected image. 2 Requital, return. E. प्रति, and फल to bear fruit, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिफलित: प्रतिफलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Represented, reflected, shadowed. 2 Requited, returned. E. प्रति, and फल to bear fruit, क्त aff.
प्रतिफुल्लक: प्रतिफुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flowered, having flowers. E. प्रति severally, फुल्ल blown, and कन् added.
प्रतिबद्ध: प्रतिबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Disappointed, thwarted, crossed, vexed. 2 Obstructed, opposed, prevented. 3 Set, inlaid. 4 Bound. 5 Connected with. E. प्रति against, and बद्ध bound.
प्रतिबधक: प्रतिबधक m. (-कः) An opposer, an injurer. E. प्रति, बध to kill, वुन् aff.
प्रतिबन्ध: प्रतिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 Disappointment. 2 Connexion. E. प्रति against, बन्ध a binding.
प्रतिबन्धक: प्रतिबन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Impeding, obstructing, an obstructor or opposer. m. (-कः) A branch, a shoot. n. (-कं) An impediment. E. प्रतिबन्ध obstacle, aff. कन्.
प्रतिबन्धकारिन्: प्रतिबन्धकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Who or what hinders, obstructs, &c. E. प्रतिबन्ध, and कारिन् who makes.
प्रतिबन्धन: प्रतिबन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Obstructing, impeding. 2 Binding, confinement. E. प्रति, and बन्ध to bind, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिबन्धि: प्रतिबन्धि m. (-न्धिः) Contradiction. E. प्रति, and बन्ध to bind, इन् aff.
प्रतिबल: प्रतिबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Able, adequate, powerful. 2 Of equal strength. E. प्रति intensitive prefix, and बल strong.
प्रतिबुद्ध: प्रतिबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Exalted, rendered prosperous or great. 2 Known, celebrated. 2 Wakened, awake. E. प्रति, and बुध to know, aff. क्त.
प्रतिबोध: प्रतिबोध m. 1 (-धः) 1 Waking, awaking. 2 Instructing. E. प्रति before बुध to know, घञ् aff.; also with ल्युट्, प्रतिबोधन.
प्रतिबोधित: प्रतिबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Instructed, taught. 2 Awakened. E. प्रति, and बोधित taught.
प्रतिभणित: प्रतिभणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Answered, replied. E. प्रति, and भणित said.
प्रतिभय: प्रतिभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Formidable, fearful, frightful. n. (-य) Fear. E. प्रति completely, and भय fear.
प्रतिभा: प्रतिभा f. (-भा) 1 Understanding, intellect, especially as opening or expanding. 2 Sharpness, brilliancy of conception. 3 Light, splendor. 4 Reflected light. 5 Audacity, boldness, confidence, consequence. E. प्रति before भा to shine, affs. ड and टाप्.
प्रतिभाग: प्रतिभाग n. (-गं) A share of small articles, as fruit, flowers, &c. paid daily to the Raja for household expenditure. E. प्रति, and भाग a share.
प्रतिभान: प्रतिभान n. (-नं) 1 Boldness, audacity. 2 Brilliancy. E. प्रति before भा to shine, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिभानवत्: प्रतिभानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Bold, prompt, audacious. 2 Bright, brilliant. E. प्रतिभान, and मतुप् aff.
प्रतिभान्वित: प्रतिभान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Confident, bold, audacious. 2 Acquiring knowledge or experience. E. प्रतिभा confidence, अन्वित joined.
प्रतिभामुख: प्रतिभामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Confident, arrogant. E. प्रतिभा consequence, मुख the face.
प्रतिभाव: प्रतिभाव m. (-वः) Corresponding character or disposition. E. प्रति, and माव quality.
प्रतिभावत्: प्रतिभावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Confident, bold. 2 Knowing, shrewd. 3 Bright, luminous. m. (-वान्) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. E. प्रतिभा light, lustre, मतुप् aff.
प्रतिभाववत्: प्रतिभाववत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Social. E. प्रतिभाव, and मतुप् aff.
प्रतिभाहानि: प्रतिभाहानि f. (-निः) 1 Loss or absence of knowledge, want of sense. 2 Dulness, darkness. E. प्रतिभा knowledge, and हानि abandonment.
प्रतिभिन्न: प्रतिभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Separated, divided. 2 Pierced. E. प्रति before भिद to break, क्त aff.
प्रतिभू: प्रतिभू m. (-भूः) A surety. E. प्रति implying substitution, भू to be, aff. क्विप्.
प्रतिभेदन: प्रतिभेदन n. (-नं) 1 Piercing, cutting, penetrating. 2 Separating, dividing. E. प्रति before भिद to break, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिम: प्रतिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Like, resembling, (in composition.) f. (-मा) 1 A resemblance, a figure, an image, a picture. 2 An idol. 3 The part of an elephant's head between the tusks. E. प्रति against, मा to measure, अङ् and टाप् affs.
प्रतिमता: प्रतिमता f. (-ता) Reflection, image, shadow. E. प्रतिम, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रतिमत्वं.
प्रतिमान: प्रतिमान n. (-नं) Resemblance, an image, a picture. 2 An idol. 3 The part of an elephant's head between the tusks. E. प्रति before मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतिमानभाग: प्रतिमानभाग m. (-गः) The part of an elephant's head between the tusks. E. प्रतिमान, and भाग part.
प्रतिमार्गक: प्रतिमार्ग्गक m. (-कः) The city of HARIŚCANDRA. E. प्रति contrary, मार्ग a road, and कन् aff., having come back part of the way to earth, after being raised to heaven.
प्रतिमार्ग्गक: प्रतिमार्ग्गक m. (-कः) The city of HARIŚCANDRA. E. प्रति contrary, मार्ग a road, and कन् aff., having come back part of the way to earth, after being raised to heaven.
प्रतिमाला: प्रतिमाला f. (-ला) An exercise analogous to capping verses, reciting verse for verse, as a trial of memory or skill. E. प्रति against, माला a garland.
प्रतिमुक्त: प्रतिमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Clothed, armed, accoutred. 2 Thrown mutually or at one another. 3 Loosed or liberated repeatedly. E. प्रति against, मुच to loosen, aff. क्त.
प्रतिमुख: प्रतिमुख n. (-खं) (In dramatic composition), A secondary plot or incident, calculated either to promote or obstruct the catastrophe. adv. n. (-खं) In front, before, in presence. E. प्रति, and मुख the face.
प्रतिमुखागत: प्रतिमुखागत m. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Come before, or in front of. 2 Run against. E. प्रतिमुख, and आगत come.
प्रतिमेन्दु: प्रतिमेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The image, reflection or resemblance of the moon. E. प्रतिमा, and इन्दु the moon.
प्रतिमूषिका: प्रतिमूषिका f. (-का) A kind of rat.
प्रतियत्न: प्रतियत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Active, vigorous, diligent, making effort or exertion. m. (-त्नः) 1 Desire, wish. 2 Taking prisoner, making captive. 3 Comprehension. 4 Acting well or properly. 5 Acquiring a new virtue or accomplishment. 6 Making complete or perfect. 7 A making or preparing. 8 Retaliating, recrimination, revenge. 9 Opposition, counteraction. E. प्रति much or against, and यत्न effort.
प्रतियातना: प्रतियातना f. (-ना) A resemblance of real forms, a picture, a statue, &c. E. प्रति against, यातना an applying.
प्रतियोग: प्रतियोग m. (-गं) 1 Opposition, contradiction, controversy. 2 Cooperation, association. 3 Existing, as the counterpart of any thing. E. प्रति against, युज् to join, aff. घञ्.
प्रतियोगिता: प्रतियोगिता f. (-ता) 1 Mutual co-operation. 2 Opposition. 3 Existence as a counterpart. 4 Dependant existence. E. प्रतियोगिन्, and तल् aff.
प्रतियोगिन्: प्रतियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who or what impedes or opposes. 2 What co-operates with. m. (गी) 1 An opponent. 2 A partner, an associate. 3 A counterpart. 4 Any thing or object dependant upon another and not existing without it. E. प्रतियोग, and इनि aff.
प्रतिरक्षण: प्रतिरक्षण n. (-णं) Preserving. E. प्रति, and रक्षण keeping.
प्रतिरम्भ: प्रतिरम्भ m. (-म्भः) Passion, rage, violent or passionate abuse. E. प्रति before रभि to sound, and अच् aff.
प्रतिराच: प्रतिराच n. (-त्रं) Every night. E. प्रति repeatedly, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
प्रतिरुद्ध: प्रतिरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Impeded, hindered. 2 Obstructed, opposed. 3 Surrounded, invested, blockaded. E. प्रति before रुध to oppose, क्त aff.
प्रतिरुरूषु: प्रतिरुरूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to speak or tell. E. प्रति, and रु to cry, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रतिरूप: प्रतिरूप n. (-पं) A picture, an image, the counterpart of any real form. E. प्रति against, रूप form; also with कन् added, प्रतिरूपक.
प्रतिरोद्धृ: प्रतिरोद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) Who or what opposes, hinders, prevents, &c. E. प्रति before रूध to obstruct, तृच् aff.
प्रतिरोध: प्रतिरोध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition, impediment. 2 An opponent. 3 Concealing, hiding. 4 Siege, blockade. 5 Theft. E. प्रति before रुध to oppose, and घञ् aff.; also with ल्युट्, प्रतिरोधन.
प्रतिरोधक: प्रतिरोधक m. (-कः) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 An obstacle. 3 An opponent. E. प्रति severally, रुध to obstruct, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रतिरोधिन्: प्रतिरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Who or what obstructs, opposes, impedes, controverts, &c. m. (-धी) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 An opponent. E. प्रति against, रुध to hinder, aff. धिणुन्.
प्रतिलम्भ: प्रतिलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Obtaining, getting. 2 Censure, reviling, abuse. E. प्रति before लभि to sound, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. प्रतिलम्भित.
प्रतिलोम: प्रतिलोम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Left, not right. 2 Reverse, inverted, contrary to the natural course or order, against the hair or grain. 3 Low, vile, base, depraved. 4 In law, contrary to caste. E. प्रति reverting, and लोमन् hair of the body, aff. अच्.
प्रतिलोमज: प्रतिलोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in the inverse order of the classes, as of a Kṣatriya father and Brahman mother, of a Vaiśya father and Kṣatriya or Brahman mother, &c. E. प्रतिलोम, and ज born.
प्रतिवचन: प्रतिवचन n. (-नं) 1 A reply, an answer, a rejoinder. 2 An echo. E. प्रति again, back again, and वचन speech.
प्रतिवचस्: प्रतिवचस् n. (-चः) 1 An answer, a reply. 2 An echo. E. प्रति again, and वचस् speech.
प्रतिवसथ: प्रतिवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. प्रति before वस to abide, अथच् aff.
प्रतिवाक्य: प्रतिवाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Answerable, admitting or requiring an answer. n. (-क्यं) A reply, an answer. E. प्रति before वाक्य a speech, or वाक् speech, and यत् aff.
प्रतिवाच्: प्रतिवाच् f. (-वाक्) An answer, a reply. E. प्रति again, वाच् speech.
प्रतिवाणि: प्रतिवाणि f. (-णिः) 1 An answer. 2 A rejoinder. E. प्रति before वाणि speech.
प्रतिवात: प्रतिवात n. adv. (-तं) To leeward, against the wind. E. प्रति, and वात wind.
प्रतिवाप: प्रतिवाप m. (-पः) Addition of substances to medicines, either during or after decoction. E. प्रति, and वप to sow, घञ् aff.
प्रतिवादिन्: प्रतिवादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant, a respondent. E. प्रति again, and वादिन् who speaks.
प्रतिवासर: प्रतिवासर n. adv. (-रं) Day by day. E. प्रति severally, and वासर a day.
प्रतिवासिन्: प्रतिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) A neighbour, neighbouring. E. प्रति near, about, and वासिन् who resides.
प्रतिविधान: प्रतिविधान n. (-नं) 1 Arrangement, array. 2 Subsidiary, or substituted ceremony. E. प्रति, and विधान precept.
प्रतिविम्ब: प्रतिविम्ब n. (-म्बं) A resemblance or counterpart of real forms, as a picture, an image, a shadow, &c. E. प्रति back again, and विम्ब an image.
प्रतिविम्बात: प्रतिविम्बात m. (-तः) A mirror. E. प्रतिविम्ब, अत what goes.
प्रतिविषा: प्रतिविषा f. (-षा) A plant, commonly Ataich or Atis, (Betula.) E. प्रति against, and विष venom; an antidote.
प्रतिविष्णु: प्रतिविष्णु ind. (-ष्णु) To or in place of VIṢṆU. E. प्रति, and विष्णु, the deity so named.
प्रतिविहित: प्रतिविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Arranged, arrayed. E. प्रति and वि before धा to have, क्त aff.
प्रतिवेश: प्रतिवेश m. (-शः) The residence of a neighbour, a neighbouring house or neighbourhood. E. प्रति against, विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
प्रतिवेशवासिन्: प्रतिवेशवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Neighbouring, a neighbour. E. प्रतिवेश, and वासिन् who dwells.
प्रतिवेशिन्: प्रतिवेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A neighbour, neighbouring. E. प्रतिवेश neighbourhood, इनि aff.
प्रतिशङ्कनीय: प्रतिशङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be ever held in fear or doubt. E. प्रति, and शङ्कनीय to be apprehended.
प्रतिशङ्का: प्रतिशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) Constant fear or doubt. E. प्रति, and शङ्का fear.
प्रतिशासन: प्रतिशासन n. (-नं) Sending a servant on a message, ordering or dispatching an inferior after calling him to attend. E. प्रति severally, शासन ruling; also प्रतिशास्ति f. (-स्तिः)
प्रतिशिष्ट: प्रतिशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Celebrated, famous. 2 Sent, ordered, dispatched. E. प्रति intensitive, and शिष्ट celebrated, &c.
प्रतिशीन: प्रतिशीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Melted, fluid, dropping, oozing. E. प्रति before श्यै to drop, क्त aff.
प्रतिश्या: प्रतिश्या f. (-श्या) Catarrh. E. प्रति before श्यै to go, to run, affixes अङ् and टाप्; also प्रतिश्याय.
प्रतिश्याय: प्रतिश्याय m. (-यः) Catarrh. E. प्रति before श्यै to go, to drop, aff. अच्.
प्रतिश्रय: प्रतिश्रय m. (-यः) 1 An assembly. 2 A house, a dwelling. 3 An asylum, a place of refuge. 4 A place of sacrifice, the room or building where the sacrifice is performed. 5 A place where food, &c. is given away. E. प्रति completely, श्री to serve, aff. अच्.
प्रतिश्रव: प्रतिश्रव m. (-वः) Promise, assent. E. प्रति before श्रु to hear, aff. अप्.
प्रतिश्रवण: प्रतिश्रवण n. (-णं) 1 Assenting to, listening to, with attention and obedience. 2 Promising. E. प्रति, श्रु to hear, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतिश्रुत्: प्रतिश्रुत् f. (-श्रुत्) 1 Repeated sound, echo. 2 Promise. E. प्रति before श्रु to hear, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
प्रतिश्रुत: प्रतिश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Promised, assented, agreed, accepted. E. प्रति mutually, श्रुत heard.
प्रतिषिद्ध: प्रतिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Forbidden, prohibited. E. प्रति against सिद्ध granted.
प्रतिषिद्धसेवन: प्रतिषिद्धसेवन n. (-नं) Doing what is prohibited. E. प्रतिषिद्ध, and सेवन following.
प्रतिषिद्धसेविन्: प्रतिषिद्धसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Following or doing what is forbidden. E. प्रतिसिद्ध, and सेविन् who serves.
प्रतिषेद्धृ: प्रतिषेद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) A prohibitor or prohibitive, prohibiting or forbidding. E. प्रति before सिद्ध to make complete, aff. तृच्.
प्रतिषेध: प्रतिषेध m. (-धः) Prohibition, forbidding, exception, contradiction. E. प्रति before सिद्व to be perfect, aff. घञ्.
प्रतिषेधक: प्रतिषेधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what forbids, preventive, prohibitive. E. प्रति before सिध to complete, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रतिषेधन: प्रतिषेधन n. (-नं) Prohibiting, inhibition. E. प्रति, सिद्भ to complete, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिष्क: प्रतिष्क m. (-ष्कः) A spy, an emissary. E. प्रति before कष to strike, aff. ड, and सुक् augment.
प्रतिष्कश: प्रतिष्कश m. (-शः) 1 A spy, a secret emissary, a Hurkaru. 2 A companion. 3 A leader, a preceder. 4 A whip, a leather thong. E. प्रति before कश to hurt or kill, अच् and सुट् augment; if it is used attributively to imply the application of a whip, the augment is not inserted, as प्रतिकशाश्वः a horse that is whipped on.
प्रतिष्कष: प्रतिष्कष m. (-षः) A whip, a leather thong. E. प्रति before कष to hurt, aff. अच् and सुट् augment.
प्रतिष्कस: प्रतिष्कस m. (-सः) A spy, a messenger, an emissary. E. प्रति before कस to go, aff. अच् and सुट् augment.
प्रतिष्टब्ध: प्रतिष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Obstructed, impeded, stopped. E. प्रति before ष्टभि to hinder, aff. क्त.
प्रतिष्टम्भ: प्रतिष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) Obstacle, impediment, opposition. E. प्रति before ष्टभि to hinder, aff. अच्.
प्रतिष्ठ: प्रतिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Famous. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 Fame, celebrity. 2 The earth. 3 The accomplishment of a religious ceremony or any set of rites, especially those instituted for the attainment of supernatural and magical powers. 4 A form of metre, consisting of a stanza of four lines, of four syllables each: it is also applied to a form of the Gāyatrī, being a triplet of 8, 7, and 6 syllable lines, making altogether 21 syllables. 5 Place, site. 6 Staying, standing, fixation. 7 Limit, boundary. 8 Accomplishment, completion, (in general.) 9 Consecration of a monument erected in honour of a deity, or of the image of a deity. 10 Endowment of a temple, portioning or marrying a daughter, &c. m. (-ष्ठः) The father of SUPĀRŚVA, the seventh Jaina pontiff. E. प्रति before स्था to stay or stand, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रतिष्ठान: प्रतिष्ठान n. (-नं) 1 Site, situation. 2 Celebrity. 3 The capital of the early kings of the lunar dynasty, opposite to Allahabad. 4 The capital of SĀLIVĀHANA in the Dekhin. E. प्रति, and स्थान place.
प्रतिष्ठापन: प्रतिष्ठापन n. (-नं) Fixing, placing, locating. E. प्रति before स्था to stay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिष्ठापित: प्रतिष्ठापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set up, located, fixed, erected. E. प्रति before स्था to stay, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रतिष्ठासु: प्रतिष्ठासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Wishing or intending to stay or remain. E. प्रतिं before स्था to stay, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रतिष्ठित: प्रतिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Completed, finished. 3 Consecrated. 4 Endowed, portioned. 5 Established in life, married, &c. 6 Placed, situated. 7 Established, fixed. 8 Applicable or applied to. 9 Comprised or included in. 10 Prized, valued. 11 Secured, acquired. E. प्रतिष्ठा as above, इतच् aff.
प्रतिष्णात: प्रतिष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pure, (as a thread.) E. प्रति before ष्णा to bathe, क्त aff., in any other sense प्रतिस्नात.
प्रतिसंहार: प्रतिसंहार m. (-रः) 1 Compression, diminution. 2 Comprehension. E. प्रति, and सम् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
प्रतिसंहृत: प्रतिसंहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Comprehended, included. 2 Compressed, reduced in bulk. E. प्रति, and संहृत collected.
प्रतिसन्धान: प्रतिसन्धान n. (-नं) 1 Self-command, suppression of feeling for a time. 3 Praise, panegyrick. E. प्रति and सम् before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रतिसमाधान: प्रतिसमाधान n. (-नं) A remedy, a cure. E. प्रति, सम and आङ् before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिसर: प्रतिसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A servant, servile, dependant. m. (-रः) 1 The rear of an army. 2 A garland, a wreath. 3 A bracelet. 4 Cicatrizing or healing, as a sore. 5 A form of magic or incantation. 6 Daybreak, morning. mn. (-रः-रं) 1 A string worn round the hand at nuptials, &c. 2 Ornament, adorning. 3 The junction of the frontal sinuses of an elephant. E. प्रति before सृ to go, aff. अप.
प्रतिसर्ग: प्रतिसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 The portion of a Purāṇa, which treats of the destruction and renovation of the world. 2 Secondary creation, or the creation of the world by the agency of BRAHMĀ, and other divine beings regarded as the agents of one Supreme Being. E. प्रति severally, सर्ग going.
प्रतिसव्य: प्रतिसव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Inverted, reverse. E. प्रति intensitive, and सव्य the left.
प्रतिसान्धानिक: प्रतिसान्धानिक m. (-कः) A bard, a panegyrist. E. प्रतिसन्धान praise, and ठक् aff.
प्रतिसारण: प्रतिसारण n. (-णं) 1 Repelling, repulsion. 2 Applying remedies to a wound. E. प्रति, सृ to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिसारित: प्रतिसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Repelled, repulsed. 2 Dressed, as a wound. E. प्रति before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रतिसीरा: प्रतिसीरा f. (-रा) An outer tent, a screen or wall of cloth. E. प्रति before षिञ् to bind, affs. रक् and टाप्, and the radical vowel made long.
प्रतिसूर्य: प्रतिसूर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A lizard, a chameleon. n. adv. (-र्य्यं) Opposite to the sun. E. प्रति before सूर्य्य the sun.
प्रतिसूर्य्य: प्रतिसूर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A lizard, a chameleon. n. adv. (-र्य्यं) Opposite to the sun. E. प्रति before सूर्य्य the sun.
प्रतिसूर्यक: प्रतिसूर्य्यक m. (-कः) 1 A lizard, a chameleon. 2 The sun's disk. E. प्रति before or about, सूर्य्य the sun, aff. कन्.
प्रतिसूर्य्यक: प्रतिसूर्य्यक m. (-कः) 1 A lizard, a chameleon. 2 The sun's disk. E. प्रति before or about, सूर्य्य the sun, aff. कन्.
प्रतिसृष्ट: प्रतिसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Celebrated. 3 Given. E. प्रति before सृज to create, &c. aff. क्त.
प्रतिस्कन्ध: प्रतिस्कन्ध n. adv. (-न्धं) Upon the shoulders. E. प्रति, and स्कन्ध shoulder.
प्रतिस्नात: प्रतिस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bathed, washed. प्रति before ष्णा to bathe, क्त aff.
प्रतिस्पन्दन: प्रतिस्पन्दन n. (-नं) Throbbing, vibration. E. प्रति, and स्पन्दन throbbing.
प्रतिस्पर्द्धा: प्रतिस्पर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) Emulation, rivalry, the wish or effort to excel or overcome. E. प्रति definitive prefix, and स्पर्द्धा emulation.
प्रतिस्पर्द्धिन्: प्रतिस्पर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) 1 Envious, emulous, a rival. 2 Refractory, rebellious. E. प्रतिस्पर्द्धा, and इनि aff.
प्रतिस्याय: प्रतिस्याय m. (-यः) Catarrh. E. प्रति before श्यै to drop, aff. अच्; see प्रतिश्याय.
प्रतिस्रोतस्: प्रतिस्रोतस् n. adv. Against the stream. E. प्रति, and स्रोतस् current.
प्रतिहत: प्रतिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disappointed. 2 Opposed, obstructed. 3 Fallen, overthrown. 4 Sent, dispatched. 5 Hated, disliked. 6 Tied, bound. 7 Struck, hurt, killed, especially in return or requital. 8 Repulsed, repelled. 9 Reflected. E. प्रति before हत hurt or killed.
प्रतिहतमति: प्रतिहतमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Averse to, hating, disliking. E. प्रतिहत, and मति mind.
प्रतिहति: प्रतिहति f. (-तिः) 1 Repulse, rebound, beating back or again. 2 Disappointment. E. प्रति, and हति striking.
प्रतिहनन: प्रतिहनन n. (-नं) Striking again, returning a blow, &c. E. प्रति, and हनन striking.
प्रतिहन्यमान: प्रतिहन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being foiled or disappointed. E. प्रतिहन to disappoint, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रतिहरण: प्रतिहरण n. (-णं) Avoiding, shunning. E. प्रति before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिहस्त: प्रतिहस्त m. (-स्तः) A deputy, a substitute. E. प्रति, and हस्त the hand; also with कन added प्रतिहस्तक.
प्रतिहार: प्रतिहार m. (-रः) 1 A door. 2 A door-keeper. 3 A juggler. 4 Trick, disguise. E. प्रति against, हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
प्रतिहारक: प्रतिहारक m. (-कः) A juggler. E. कन् added to प्रतिहार.
प्रतिहारण: प्रतिहारण n. (-णं) Entrance, permission to enter a door. E. प्रति before हृ to take, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रतिहास: प्रतिहास m. (-सः) 1 Returning a laugh, laughing with or at. 2 A shrub, (Nerium odorum.) E. प्रति intensitive, हस to smile, aff. घञ्, whence it is also प्रतीहास.
प्रतिहिंसा: प्रतिहिंसा f. (-सा) Retaliation, revenge. E. प्रति, and हिंसा injury.
प्रतीक: प्रतीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Contrary, adverse. 2 Inverted, reversed, against the natural order or state. m. (-कः) 1 A limb, a member. 2 A part, a portion. E. प्रति before ई to go, ईकन् aff.
प्रतीकार: प्रतीकार m. (-रः) 1 Revenge, retaliation. 2 Remedying, obviating, correcting. 3 Remedying, administering medicines. E. प्रति against (re), and कार making, re-action, the इ is made long in consequence of the aff. being घञ्.
प्रतीकाश: प्रतीकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Like, resembling, (in composition.) E. प्रति before काश to shine, aff. घञ्, it is also written प्रतीकाश.
प्रतीक्षक: प्रतीक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Expecting. 2 Looking at. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रतीक्षण: प्रतीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Looking to or at, considering, referring to. 2 Respecting. 3 Expecting, waiting for. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
प्रतीक्षणीय: प्रतीक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be had in view, to be considered or regarded. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.
प्रतीक्षा: प्रतीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Reference, regard to, consideration, looking to or at. 2 Hope, expectation. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
प्रतीक्षित: प्रतीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Contemplated, considered, had regard to. 2 Respected, honoured. 3 Expected, looked for, hoped. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
प्रतीक्षिन्: प्रतीक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Expecting, looking or waiting for. E. प्रतीक्षा, and इनि aff.
प्रतीक्ष्य: प्रतीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be considered, to be had regard to. 2 To be expected. ind. Having considered, having expected, &c. 3 Venerable, respectable. E. प्रति before ईक्ष to see, aff. ण्यत् or ल्यप्.
प्रतीघात: प्रतीघात m. (-तः) Warding off or returning as a blow. 2 Preventing, prohibiting. E. प्रतिघात, and the इ made long.
प्रतीची: प्रतीची f. (-ची) The west quarter: see प्रत्यच्.
प्रतीचीन: प्रतीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) West, western. E. प्रतीची the west, and खश् aff.
प्रतीच्य: प्रतीच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Western, west. E. प्रतीच for प्रत्यच् west, and यत् aff.
प्रतीत: प्रतीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated, renowned. 2 Known. 3 Glad, delighted, pleased. 4 Respectful. 5 Past, gone. E. प्रति before इ to go, aff. क्त.
प्रतीति: प्रतीति f. (-तिः) 1 Knowledge, understanding. 2 Fame, notoriety. 3 Respect. 4 Delight. E. प्रति before इ to go, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रतीप: प्रतीप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Turned away, having the face averted. 2 Backwards, following an order or course the reverse of natural, against the grain or stream. 3 Retrograde, coming back. 4 Disobedient, refractory, perverse. 5 Cross, contradictory. m. (-पः) The father of ŚANTANU, and grandfather of BHĪṢMA. n. (-पं) Comparing new objects with some established object, as with the moon, &c. inverse comparison. E. प्रति before अप् water, and the अ changed to इ by special rule.
प्रतीपदर्शिनी: प्रतीपदर्शिनी f. (-नी) A woman. E. प्रतीप turning the face away, and दर्शिनी looking.
प्रतीपवचन: प्रतीपवचन n. (-नं) 1 Contradiction. 2 A perverse or evasive answer, a speech to a third person without replying to a previous speaker. E. प्रतीप, and वचन speech.
प्रतीमान: प्रतीमान n. (-नं) A measure of capacity. E. प्रती, and मा to measure, ल्युट् aff. and the vowel of the prep. made long.
प्रतीयमान: प्रतीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being believed or trusted. E. प्रति before इ to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रतीयिवस्: प्रतीयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युसी-वस्) Coming back, returning. E. प्रति back, ईय to go, क्वसु aff.
प्रतीर: प्रतीर n. (-रं) A shore or bank. E. प्र beyond, तीर shore.
प्रतीवाप: प्रतीवाप m. (-पः) 1 Calcining or fluxing metals. 2 Throwing one substance into another to alter its form or state. 3 Adding any thing to a medicine during or after decoction. 4 A public danger or calamity, as a plague, &c. E. प्रति before वप to spread, aff. घञ्, whence the vowel of the prefix is lengthened.
प्रतीवेश: प्रतीवेश m. (-शः) A neighbouring residence, a neighbourhood: see प्रतिवेश.
प्रतीवेशिन्: प्रतीवेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिती-शि) A neighbour, living in the neighbourhood. E. प्रतिवेश a neighbourhood, and इनि aff.; also प्रतिवेशिन्.
प्रतीहार: प्रतीहार m. (-रः) 1 A door. 2 A porter, a warder. 3 An agreement for return of assistance, alliance, confederacy. f. (-री) A female door-keeper. E. प्रति severally, mutually, हृ to convey, aff. घञ्; also प्रतिहार.
प्रतीहास: प्रतीहास m. (-सः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.) E. प्रति before हस to smile, aff. घञ्.
प्रतुद: प्रतुद m. (-दः) A bird of game, a falcon, a hawk, or rather one that kills or strikes with his beak, including also the owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock, &c. E. प्र before तुद to torment, (with the beak,) and क aff.
प्रतुष्टुषु: प्रतुष्टुषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) 1 Wishing to praise. 2 Wishing to prepare or make ready. E. प्र before ष्टु to praise, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रतूणी: प्रतूणी f. (-णी) Pain shooting from the rectum along the bowels.
प्रतूर्ण: प्रतूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, fleet. प्र before त्वर to make haste, क्त aff.
प्रतोद: प्रतोद m. (-दः) A goad. E. प्र thoroughly, तुद to torment, aff. घञ्.
प्रतोली: प्रतोली f. (-ली) A high street, the principal road through a town or village. E. प्र before तुल to weigh, aff. अच्.
प्रतोलीक: प्रतोलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a high street, (a town.) E. कन् added to the last.
प्रत्त: प्रत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Given, presented. 2 Given in marriage, either betrothed or married. E. प्र before दा to give, aff. क्त, form special.
प्रत्तवत्: प्रत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving, presenting. E. प्र before दा to give, क्तथतु aff.
प्रत्न: प्रत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Old, ancient. E. प्र for प्रगे here said to mean old, त्न aff., and गे rejected.
प्रत्यक्: प्रत्यक् ind. 1 Subsequent, behind, following in time or place. 2 Western: see प्रत्यच्.
प्रत्यक्पर्णी: प्रत्यक्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. प्रत्यच् uniform, and पर्ण a leaf.
प्रत्यक्पुष्पी: प्रत्यक्पुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. प्रत्यच् uniform, पुष्प a flower.
प्रत्यक्श्रेणी: प्रत्यक्श्रेणी f. (-णी) 1 A plant, commonly Dantī. 2 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. प्रत्यक् western, and श्रेणी line or row.
प्रत्यक्ष: प्रत्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Perceptible, perceivable, present, cognizable by any of the organs of sense. E. अक्ष an organ of sense, with प्रति indicative prefix.
प्रत्यक्षतस्: प्रत्यक्षतस् ind. Evidently, perceptibly. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and तस् aff.
प्रत्यक्षदर्शन: प्रत्यक्षदर्शन m. (-नः) A witness, an eye-witness. E. प्रत्यक्ष what is present, and दर्शन seeing.
प्रत्यक्षप्रमाण: प्रत्यक्षप्रमाण n. (-णं) 1 Ocular or visible proof. 2 An organ or faculty of perception. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and प्रमाण proof.
प्रत्यक्षभूत: प्रत्यक्षभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, become visible. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and भूत become.
प्रत्यक्षभोग: प्रत्यक्षभोग m. (-गः) Enjoyment or use of any thing with the consciousness of the owner. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and भोग enjoyment.
प्रत्यक्षवादिन्: प्रत्यक्षवादिन् m. (-दी) A Bauddha. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and वादिन् who declares: admitting of no other evidence than actual presence.
प्रत्यक्षिन्: प्रत्यक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Seeing, perceiving, conscious of what is perceptible. E. प्रत्यक्ष perceptible, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यक्षीकरण: प्रत्यक्षीकरण n. (-णं) Making manifest or apparent. E. प्रत्यक्ष, करण making, च्वि aug.
प्रत्यक्षीकृत: प्रत्यक्षीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, displayed, made present or visible. E. प्रत्यक्ष, and कृत made, च्वि aug.
प्रत्यगाशापति: प्रत्यगाशापति m. (-तिः) A name of VARUṆA. E. प्रत्यक् west, आशा a quarter, पति regent or lord.
प्रत्यग्र: प्रत्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 New, fresh, recent. 2 Pure, purified. E. प्रति before अग्र first.
प्रत्यग्रता: प्रत्यग्रता f. (-ता) Newness, freshness. E. तल् added to प्रत्यग्र; also with त्व, प्रत्यग्रत्व.
प्रत्यग्रथ: प्रत्यग्रथ m. (-थः) A country; also अहिच्छत्र.
प्रत्यग्रवयस्: प्रत्यग्रवयस् n. (-यः) Youth. E. प्रत्यग्र, and वयस् age.
प्रत्यङ्ग: प्रत्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An organ of perception. n. adv. On the body, or the limbs severally. n. subst. (-ङ्गं) 1 A minor member of the body, as the chin, nose, ear, &c. 2 A subdivision of science, &c. E. प्रति belonging to, अङ्ग the body.
प्रत्यङ्गिरा: प्रत्यङ्गिरा f. (-रा) A form of DURGĀ, one of the goddesses of the Tāntrikas.
प्रत्यङ्मुख: प्रत्यङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Facing the west. E. प्रत्यञ्च, and मुख face.
प्रत्यच्: प्रत्यच् or प्रत्यञ्च् mfn. (प्रत्यङ् प्रतीची प्रत्यक्) 1 Behind or subsequent, following in time or place. 2 West, western. 3 Uniform, unmixed. E. प्रति before अञ्च to go, aff. क्विन्, the neuter form is used as a particle: see प्रत्यक्.
प्रत्यदन: प्रत्यदन n. (-नं) Eating, food. E. प्रति before अदन eating.
प्रत्यनन्तर: प्रत्यनन्तर n. adv. (-रं) Next in succession. E. प्रति, and अनन्तर without an interval.
प्रत्यनीक: प्रत्यनीक m. (-कः) An enemy. n. (-कं) Injuring one who cannot retaliate. E. प्रति against, अनीक an army.
प्रत्यन्त: प्रत्यन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Bordering, skirting, contiguous. m. (-न्तः) The country of the Mlecchas or savages. E. प्रति about, अन्त the end.
प्रत्यन्तपर्वत: प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A small hill near a mountain. E. प्रत्थन्त skirting, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत: प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A small hill near a mountain. E. प्रत्थन्त skirting, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
प्रत्यभिज्ञात: प्रत्यभिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recognised, known. E. प्रति and अभि before ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त.
प्रत्यभिज्ञान: प्रत्यभिज्ञान n. (-नं) Recognition, knowing, recognising. E. प्रति and अभि before ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यभिवाद: प्रत्यभिवाद m. (-दः) Returning a salute or obeisance, the benediction of a teacher. E. प्रति (re), अभिवाद salute; also प्रत्यभिवादनः.
प्रत्यभियोग: प्रत्यभियोग m. (-गः) A counter plaint or charge, an accusation brought against the accuser or plaintiff. E. प्रति against, अभियोग accusation.
प्रत्यय: प्रत्यय m. (-यः) 1 Trust, faith, belief, confidence. 2 Oath, ordeal. 3 Cause, motive. 4 Usage, custom, practice. 5 Fame, celebrity. 6 Certainty, ascertainment. 7 Knowledge, apprehension. 8 An affix to roots and words forming derivatives and inflections. 9 A dependant, a subject. 10 Instrument, means of agency, a helpmate or associate, applicable either to persons or things. 11 A householder who keeps a sacred fire. 12 Religious contemplation. 13 A hole. E. प्रति again, against, to or towards, इण् to go, aff. अच्.
