प्रत्ययकारिणी: प्रत्ययकारिणी f. (-णी) A seal, a signet. E. प्रत्यय confidence, and कारिणी causing.
प्रत्ययित: प्रत्ययित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, confidential. E. प्रत्यय confidence, and इतच् aff.
प्रत्ययिन्: प्रत्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Trusting, believing, having faith in. E. प्रत्यय, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यर्थ: प्रत्यर्थ n. (-र्थं) 1 A reply, an answer, a counter-representation. 2 Opposition, hostility. E. प्रति successive order, and अर्थ representation.
प्रत्यर्थिन्: प्रत्यर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 Hostile, inimical. 2 Opposing, contradicting, rejecting. m. (-र्थी) 1 An enemy. 2 (In law,) A defendant. E. प्रति again, against (re), अर्थ meaning, intention, &c. इनि aff.
प्रत्यर्पण: प्रत्यर्पण n. (-णं) The returning of a thing. E. प्रति back, अर्पण delivering.
प्रत्यर्पित: प्रत्यर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, restored, re-delivered. E. प्रति again, अर्पित delivered.
प्रत्यवमर्श: प्रत्यवमर्श m. (-र्शः) Counsel, advice, injunction. E. प्रति and अव before मृश to advise, घञ् aff.
प्रत्यवसान: प्रत्यवसान n. (-नं) Eating. E. प्रति and अव prefixed to षो to destroy, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रत्यवसित: प्रत्यवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. प्रति and अव before षो to destroy, aff. क्त.
प्रत्यवस्कन्द: प्रत्यवस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A special plea at law; admission of a fact, but qualifying or explaining it so as not to allow it to be matter of accusation. E. प्रति against, अव before स्कदि to go, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. प्रत्यवस्कन्दन.
प्रत्यवस्थातृ: प्रत्यवस्थातृ m. (-ता) An enemy. E. प्रति and अव before स्था to stay, to oppose or encounter, and तृच् aff.
प्रत्यवस्थान: प्रत्यवस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Former state or place, in statu quo. 2 Opposition, hostility. E. प्रति, and अवस्थान situation.
प्रत्यवाय: प्रत्यवाय m. (-यः) 1 Sin. 2 Disappearance, either of what exists, or non-production of what does not exist. 3 Reverse, contrary course or proceeding. 4 Disappointment. 5 Disarrangement. E. प्रति and अव before इण to go, aff. अच्.
प्रत्यश्मन्: प्रत्यश्मन् n. (-श्म) Red chalk. E. प्रति like, अश्मन् a stone.
प्रत्यहम्: प्रत्यहम् ind. 1 In the morning. 2 Day by day, every day. E. प्रति, implying succession, and अहन् a day.
प्रत्याकार: प्रत्याकार m. (-रः) A scabbard, a sheath. E. प्रति like, आकार form
प्रत्याकलित: प्रत्याकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Interposed. 2 Introduced, as a step in legal process. E. प्रति and आङ् before कल to go, क्त aff.
प्रत्याख्यात: प्रत्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Removed, set aside. 2 Informed, apprised. 3 Discouraged, prohibited, forbidden. 4 Denied, refused. 5 Celebrated, notorious. E. प्रति before आख्यात said, declared.
प्रत्याख्यान: प्रत्याख्यान n. (-नं) 1 Rejection, refutation, disallowance, disregard. 2 Denial, refusal. 3 Reproach. E. प्रति reverse, आङ् before ख्या to say, and ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्याख्येय: प्रत्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be declined or refused. 2 To be refuted, denied, &c. E. प्रति and आङ् before ख्या to speak, यत् aff.
प्रत्यागत: प्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Come back, returned. 2 Arrived at. E. प्रति again, आगत come.
प्रत्यागम: प्रत्यागम m. (-मः) 1 Return. 2 Arrival. E. प्रति, and आगम coming; also प्रत्यागमनं.
प्रत्यागार: प्रत्यागार m. (-रः) Former place or state. E. प्रति, and आगार mansion.
प्रत्यादिष्ट: प्रत्यादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Removed, set aside. 2 Informed, apprised. 3 Warned, cautioned. 4 Declared, (as from heaven.) E. प्रति before आदिष्ट shewn.
प्रत्यादेश: प्रत्यादेश m. (-शः) 1 Rejection, disallowance. 2 Information, apprising, informing. 3 Warning, caution. 4 Refusal, denial. 5 Heavenly annunciation or declaration. E. प्रति and आङ् before दिश to shew, aff. घञ्.
प्रत्यानयन: प्रत्यानयन n. (-नं) Bringing back. E. प्रति and आङ् before णी to lead, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रत्यानिनीषु: प्रत्यानिनीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous of bringing back. E. प्रति and आङ् before णी to bring, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रत्यानीत: प्रत्यानीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought back. E. प्रति and आङ् before नी to obtain, क्त aff.
प्रत्यालीढ: प्रत्यालीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Eaten. n. (-ढं) An attitude in shooting, the left foot advanced and right retracted. E. प्रति and आङ् before लिह to lick, aff. क्त.
प्रत्यावर्तन: प्रत्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back. E. प्रति and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यावर्त्तन: प्रत्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back. E. प्रति and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यावृत्त: प्रत्यावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Returned, come back. E. प्रति and आङ् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
प्रत्याशा: प्रत्याशा f. (-शा) Hope, expectation, desire. E. प्रति specific, and आशा hope.
प्रत्याशिन्: प्रत्याशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Hoping, expecting. E. प्रत्याशा, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यासङ्कलित: प्रत्यासङ्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Added to. 2 Ascertained, determined. E. प्रति and आङ् before सङ्कलित added.
प्रत्यासन्न: प्रत्यासन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Near, proximate, contiguous. E. प्रति before आसन्न near.
प्रत्यासर: प्रत्यासर m. (-रः) The rear of an army. E. प्रति and आङ् before सृ to go, अप् aff.
प्रत्यासार: प्रत्यासार m. (-रः) 1 The rear of an army. 2 A form of array. E. प्रति and आङ् before सृ to go, aff. घञ्; also प्रत्यासर.
प्रत्याहत: प्रत्याहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repelled, resisted, repulsed. E. प्रति, and आहत struck.
प्रत्याहरण: प्रत्याहरण n. (-णं) 1 Restraining the organs of sense. 2 Taking back. 3 Withholding. E. प्रति and आङ् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रत्याहरणीय: प्रत्याहरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be restrained or controlled. 2 Resumable, to be taken back. 3 To be withheld, &c. E. प्रति and आङ् before हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रत्याहर्त्तव्य and प्रत्याहार्य्य.
प्रत्याहार: प्रत्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Abstraction, insensibility, restraining the organs so as to be indifferent to disagreeable or agreeable excitement. 2 Abridgement, compendium. 3 (In grammar,) Combination of two or more letters of the alphabet to form a class of letters. 4 Substitution of one thing for another. 5 Withholding. 6 Taking back. E. प्रति and आङ् before हृ to seize or convey, aff. घञ्.
प्रत्याहृत: प्रत्याहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Withheld. 2 Restrained. 3 Resumed, &c. E. प्रति and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
प्रत्युक्ति: प्रत्युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Answer, reply. E. प्रति again, बच to speak, aff. क्तिन्, the semivowel changed to उ.
प्रत्युत: प्रत्युत ind. On the contrary, on the other hand, otherwise. E. प्रति, and उत whether.
प्रत्युक्त्रम: प्रत्युक्त्रम m. (-मः) 1 Act or effort tending to a main object. 2 First step or measure in any business. 3 Declaration of war. 4 Setting out to assail an enemy. E. प्रति and उत् before क्रम to go, aff. अच्; also प्रत्युक्त्रामण and प्रत्युक्त्रान्ति.
प्रत्युक्त्रान्ति: प्रत्युक्त्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Act, tending to a main object, &c., see the last. E. as above, see प्रत्युक्त्रम, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रत्युत्तर: प्रत्युत्तर n. (-रं) A rejoinder, a reply to an answer, an answer. E. प्रति again, उत्तर an answer.
प्रत्युत्थान: प्रत्युत्थान n. (-नं) Rising from a seat, as a mark of respect. E. प्रति and उत् before स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रत्युत्पन्न: प्रत्युत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Reproduced, regenerated. 2 Prompt, ready. 3 (In arithmetic,) Multiplied. n. (-न्नं) 1 Multiplication. 2 The product of a sum in multiplication. E. प्रति again, उत्पन्न produced, or प्रति and उत् before पन्न made, done.
प्रत्युत्पन्नजाति: प्रत्युत्पन्नजाति f. (-तिः) (In arithmetic,) Assimilation of fractional increase. E. प्रत्युत्पन्न, and जाति reduction.
प्रत्युत्पन्नमति: प्रत्युत्पन्नमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Confident, bold, arrogant. 2 Sharp, subtle, quick. E. प्रत्युत्पन्न prompt, and मति mind.
प्रत्युद्गत: प्रत्युद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Met. 2 Risen as from a seat. E. प्रति, उद्गत gone up.
प्रत्युद्गम: प्रत्युद्गम m. (-मः) 1 Rising, as from a seat. 2 Going to meet a guest, &c. E. प्रति and उद् before गम to go, अच् aff.
प्रत्युद्गमनीय: प्रत्युद्गमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be placed near, upon or before. 2 To be worshipped or reverenced. n. (-यं) A pair of bleached cloths, or the upper and lower garments, as worn at meals and sacrifices, &c. E. प्रति and उत् before गम to go, अनीयर् aff. of the future participle.
प्रत्युद्गमन: प्रत्युद्गमन n. (-नं) 1 Rising from a seat, as a mark of respect, &c. 2 Going forth or out, going to meet any one, &c. E. प्रति and उत् before गम to go, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट्, प्रत्युद्गमनं.
प्रत्युद्धरण: प्रत्युद्धरण n. (-णं) Recovering, re-obtaining. E. प्रति and उट् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्युद्धृत: प्रत्युद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recovered. E. प्रति and उट् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
प्रत्युपकार: प्रत्युपकार m. (-रः) Requital of aid or assistance, mutual assistance. E. प्रति, and उपकार aid.
प्रत्युपकारिन्: प्रत्युपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Requiting a favour or kindness. E. प्रत्युपकार, and इनि aff.
प्रत्युप्त: प्रत्युप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Set, inlaid, studded. 2 Sown. E. प्रति before वप to sow, क्त aff.
प्रत्युष: प्रत्युष m. (-षः) The morning, dawn, daybreak. E. see प्रत्यूष.
प्रत्युषस्: प्रत्युषस् n. (-षः) Morning. E. see प्रत्यूषस्.
प्रत्यूष: प्रत्यूष m. (-षः) 1 Morning. 2 One of the demigods called VASUS. 3 The sun. E. प्रति before ऊष to be sick, aff. क; also with उष to burn, प्रत्युष; and with असि aff. प्रत्यूषस्.
प्रत्यूषस्: प्रत्यूषस् n. (-षः) Morning, dawn. E. प्रति before ऊष to be sick, and अमि aff.; also प्रत्यूष and प्रत्यूषस्.
प्रत्यूह: प्रत्यूह m. (-हः) Obstacle, impediment. E. प्रति before ऊह to infer, aff. क.
प्रत्येक: प्रत्येक n. adv. (-कं) Singly, one by one, one at a time. E. प्रति, and एक one.
प्रत्येतृ: प्रत्येतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Believing, trusting, having confidence. E. प्रति before इ to go, तृच् aff.
प्रथ: प्रथ r. 1st cl. (प्रथते) To be famous or renowned. r. 10th cl. (प्राथयति) 1 To throw or cast. 2 To scatter, to spread. 3 To celebrate.
प्रथन: प्रथन n. (-नं) 1 Spreading, extension, scattering. 2 Throwing, projecting. 3 Celebrating. E. प्रथ to cast, ल्युट् aff.
प्रथम: प्रथम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 First, prior, initial. 2 Chief, principal. E. प्रथ to be famous, अमच् Uṇādi aff.
प्रथमसाहस: प्रथमसाहस m. (-सः) The first or lowest degree of fine or punishment. E. प्रथम, and साहस infliction.
प्रथयत्: प्रथयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Displaying, making manifest, famous, &c. 2 Seeing, beholding. 3 Casting, throwing. E. प्रथ to be famous, शतृ aff.
प्रथा: प्रथा f. (-था) Fame, celebrity. E. प्रथ to be famous, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रथित: प्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Made known, declared. 3 Spread, scattered. 4 Stretched. 5 Cast, thrown. 6 Intent upon, engaged in, occupied by, devoted to. E. प्रथा fame, aff. इतच्.
प्रथिति: प्रथिति f. (-तिः) Celebrity, notoriety. E. प्रथ to be famous, ति Uṇādi aff., and इट् aug.
प्रथिमन्: प्रथिमन् m. (-मा) Greatness, magnitude. E. पृथु large, इमनिच् aff. form irr.
प्रथिमिन्: प्रथिमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Large, great, having size or magnitude. E. प्रथिमा magnitude, and इनि aff.
प्रथिष्ठ: प्रथिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very large. E. पृथु large, इष्ठन् superl. aff.
प्रथीयस्: प्रथीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very large. E. पृथु large, and ईयसुन् aff.
प्रथुक: प्रथुक m. (-कः) The young of any animal. E. प्रथ to be famous, कुकन् aff.: see पृथुक.
प्रद: प्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A giver, giving, bountiful. f. (-दा) A gift, a donation. E. प्र before दा to give, and श aff. or अङ् and टाप्.
प्रदक्षिण: प्रदक्षिण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) Reverential salutation, by circumambulating a person or object, keeping the right side towards them. E. प्र before दक्षिण the right.
प्रदत्त: प्रदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, bestowed, conferred. E. प्र before दत्त given.
प्रदर: प्रदर m. (-रः) 1 Splitting, rending, tearing. 2 Fracture, a breaking. 3 A disease of women, (Mænorrhagia.) 4 An arrow. E. प्र intensitive, दृ to tear, aff. अप्.
प्रदर्शक: प्रदर्शक m. (-कः) 1 A teacher, an expounder. 2 A prophet. E. प्र before दर्शक who shews.
प्रदर्शन: प्रदर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Shewing. 2 Explaining generally, not exclusively. 3 Explaining or specifying. 4 Prophesying. E. प्र before दृश to see, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रदर्शित: प्रदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mentioned, specified. 2 Shewn. 3 Prophesied. E. प्र before दृश to see, and क्त aff.
प्रदल: प्रदल m. (-लः) An arrow. E. प्र before दल to tear, or the र of प्रदर changed to ल.
प्रदव: प्रदव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Who or what annoys, distresses, &c. E. दु to annoy, with प्र prefix, and अच् aff.
प्रदातृ: प्रदातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A donor, who or what gives. E. प्र before दा to give, तृच् aff.
प्रदान: प्रदान n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 A goad. E. प्र before दा to give, or दो to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रदिग्ध: प्रदिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed. m. (-ग्धः) A kind of sauce or gravy. E. प्र before दिग्ध smeared.
प्रदिश्: प्रदिश् f. (-दिक्) Intermediate point of the compass, or half quarter, as north-east, south-west, &c. E. प्र implying division, and दिश् a point or quarter.
प्रदिष्ट: प्रदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Appointed, directed. E. प्र before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
प्रदीप: प्रदीप m. (-पः) A lamp. E. प्र before दीप to shine, aff. घञ्.
प्रदीपन: प्रदीपन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Inflaming, illuminating. 2 Stimulating, exciting, who or what does so. n. (-नं) The act of inflaming, exciting, &c. m. (-नः) A sort of mineral poison, of a red colour, and caustic operation. E. प्र before दीप to inflame, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रदीप्त: प्रदीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Kindled, burning. 2 Excited, stimulated. E. प्र before दीप to inflame, क्त aff.
प्रदुह्: प्रदुह् mfn. (-घुक्) Who or what milks much or well. E. प्र before दुह to milk, क्विप् aff.
प्रदेय: प्रदेय n. (-यं) A gift. E. प्र before देय to be given.
प्रदेश: प्रदेश m. (-शः) 1 A place in general, a country, a district, &c. 2 A foreign country, abroad. 3 A short span, measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the forefinger. 4 A wall. E. प्र before देश place.
प्रदेशन: प्रदेशन n. (-नं) A gift, a present, a bribe or offering, any thing given to the gods, to superiors, or friends, &c. f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. प्र before दिश to show, aff ल्युट्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
प्रदेशिनी: प्रदेशिनी f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. प्र before दिश to shew, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीप्.
प्रदेह: प्रदेह m. (-हः) Unguent, unction. E. प्र before दिह to plaster, aff. घज्.
प्रदोष: प्रदोष m. (-षः) 1 Evening, the first part of the night. 2 Fault, offence, defect, transgression. E. प्र implying commencement, &c. and दोष fault.
प्रद्यु: प्रद्यु n. adv. (-द्यु) Heavenly, holy, securing heaven. E. प्र before द्यु for द्युस् heaven.
प्रद्युम्न: प्रद्युम्न m. (-म्नः) KĀMA, the Hindū CUPID, reborn as the son of KṚṢṆA. E. प्र pre-eminent, द्यम्न power.
प्रद्युतित: प्रद्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, irradiated. E. प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff. and the vowel unchanged; also प्रद्योतित.
प्रद्योत: प्रद्योत m. (-तः) 1 A ray of light. 2 Light, lustre. E. प्र excess, and द्योत shining.
प्रद्योतन: प्रद्योतन m. (-नः) The sun. n. (-नं) Blazing, shining, light. E. प्र excess, द्युत to shine, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रद्योतित: प्रद्योतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, lighted. E. प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff.; also प्रद्युदित.
प्रद्राव: प्रद्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat, running away. 2 Going, going quick or well. E. प्र before द्रु to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रद्राविन्: प्रद्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Who retreats, flies, goes, &c. E. प्र before द्रु to go, घिनुण् aff.
प्रद्विष्: प्रद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) Who hates or dislikes, hostile, inimical. E. प्र before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.
प्रद्विषत्: प्रद्विषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षती-षत्) Hating, hostile, an enemy. E. प्र, and द्विषत् a foe.
प्रद्वेष्टृ: प्रद्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who hates or dislikes. E. प्र before द्विव to hate, तृच् aff.
प्रध: प्रध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Who or what has or holds. E. प्र before षा to have, श aff.
प्रधन: प्रधन n. (-नं) 1 War, battle. 2 Tearing, rending, destroying. E. प्र before घा to have, aff. क्यु.
प्रधर्षित: प्रधर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Haughty, arrogant. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.
प्रधर्षितवत्: प्रधर्षितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Proud, arrogant. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्तवतु aff.
प्रधान: प्रधान n. (-नं) 1 Nature, the natural state of any thing, or the cause of the material world. 2 The SUPREME GOD. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 Chief, principal, (in this sense, it is always neuter and confined to the singular number.) mn. (-नः-नं) 1 The first companion of a king, his minister, his eunuch or confident, &c. a courtier, a noble. 2 An elephant-driver. E. प्र before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रधानतस्: प्रधानतस् ind. According to eminence or superiority. E. प्रधान, and तसि aff.
प्रधानता: प्रधानता f. (-ता) Excellence, superiority, supremacy. E. तल् added to प्रधान; also with त्व, प्रधानत्वं.
प्रधानधातु: प्रधानधातु m. (-तुः) Semen virile. E. प्रधान principal, and धातु radical part.
प्रधानमन्त्रिन्: प्रधानमन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) Prime minister. E. प्रधान, and मन्त्रिन् counsellor.
प्रधानाङ्ग: प्रधानाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The chief member of the body, the chief person of a state, branch of a science, &c. E. प्रधान, and अङ्ग limb.
प्रधानामात्य: प्रधानामात्य m. (-त्यः) Prime minister. E. प्रधान, and अमात्य minister.
प्रधानोत्तम: प्रधानोत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Warlike, braver. 2 Eminent, illustrious. E. प्रधान, and उत्तम best.
प्रधावन: प्रधावन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. प्र violently, घ to shake, aff. ल्युट.
प्रधि: प्रधि m. (-धिः) The periphery of a wheel. E. प्र principal, धा to have, कि aff.
प्रधिमण्डल: प्रधिमण्डल n. (-लं) The circumference of a wheel. E. प्रधि, and मण्डल a circle.
प्रधूपित: प्रधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heated, burnt. 2 Lighted, inflamed. 3 Afflicted. 4 Excited. f. (-ता) 1 A woman in trouble or affliction. 2 The quarter to which the sun is proceeding. E. प्र before धूप to heat, aff. क्त.
प्रधृष्ट: प्रधृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Proud, arrogant. 2 Treated with contumely. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.
प्रध्वंस: प्रध्वंस m. (-सः) Destruction, loss. E. प्र entirely, ध्वंस loss.
प्रध्वंसिन्: प्रध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Destroying, annihilating. E. प्र before ध्वंस to destroy, घिनुण् aff.
प्रध्वनयत्: प्रध्वनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to sound. E. प्र before ध्वन to sound, causal v., शतृ aff.
प्रध्मा: प्रध्मा mfn. (-ध्माः-ध्माः-ध्म) Blowing violently. E. प्र before ध्मा to blow, aff. विच्.
प्रध्रुह्: प्रध्रुह् mfn. (-क्) 1 Injurious, doing wrong or violence to. 2 Rebellious, refractory. E. प्र before द्रुह to seek to hurt, क्विप् aff.
प्रनर्तित: प्रनर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, set in motion. E. प्र before नृत to dance, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रनर्त्तित: प्रनर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, set in motion. E. प्र before नृत to dance, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रनाल: प्रनाल mf. (-लः-ली) A water-course, a canal. E. प्र before नल to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रनिघातन: प्रनिघातन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र and नि before हन to kill or hurt, ल्युट् aff., and the radical letters changed.
प्रपञ्च: प्रपञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 1 Reverse, opposition, reversion or inversion. 2 Extent, expanse. 3 Heap, abundance, quantity. 4 Delusion, deceit, trick or fraud. 5 Joke, jest. 6 Prolixity, copiousness, in style or composition. 7 Error, illusion. 8 The world. E. प्र before पचि to spread, aff. अच्.
प्रपञ्चित: प्रपञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expanded, diffused. 2 Erring, mistaken. 3 Tricked, deceived, beguiled. 4 Declared fully, explained, treated at length. E. प्रपञ्च prolixity, इतच् aff.
प्रपतन: प्रपतन n. (-नं) 1 Death, dying. 2 Destruction. 3 Falling. 4 Alighting. E. प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.
प्रपतित: प्रपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead. 2 Decayed. 3 Fallen. 4 Come down. E. प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.
प्रपथ: प्रपथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, enervated, relaxed. E. प्र before पथ to go, aff. अच्.
प्रपद: प्रपद n. (-दं) The point of the foot, the tip of the toes. E. प्र projecting, and पद the foot.
प्रपदीन: प्रपदीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Relating to the top of the foot, extending to it, fitting it, &c. E. प्रपद, and ख aff.
प्रपन्न: प्रपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Taking refuge with. 2 Reaching, arriving at. 3 Seeking, adhering to. 4 Effecting, producing. 5 Promised, assented to. 6 Attained, obtained, possessed of. 7 Poor. 8 Distressed. E. प्र before पद to go, क्त aff.
प्रपर्ण: प्रपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A fallen leaf. E. प्र before पर्ण leaf.
प्रपलायन: प्रपलायन n. (-नं) Flight, running away. E. प्र before पलायन flying.
प्रपलायित: प्रपलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Routed, defeated. E. प्र before पलायित the same.
प्रपलायिन्: प्रपलायिन् m. (-यी) A fugitive, one who deserts his cause. E. प्र before पलायिन् who flies.
प्रपवण: प्रपवण n. (-णं) Purifying. E. प्र before पू to purify, ल्युट् aff. न optionally changed, whence also प्रपवन.
प्रपवणीय: प्रपवणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be purified or cleansed. E. प्र before पू to purify, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रपवनीय.
प्रपश्यत्: प्रपश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Foreseeing. E. प्र, and पश्यत् seeing.
प्रपा: प्रपा f. (-पा) A place where water is distributed. E. प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रपाणि: प्रपाणि m. (-णिः) The palm of the hand. E. प्र prostrate, and पाणि the hand.
प्रपाणीय: प्रपाणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Drinkable. E. प्र before पा to drink, अनीयर् aff.
प्रपात: प्रपात m. (-तः) 1 A cliff, a precipice. 2 A cascade, or water-fall. 3 A bank, a shore. 4 Facing an enemy. E. प्र before पत to descend, aff. घञ्.
प्रपाथ: प्रपाथ m. (-थः) A road. E. प्र before पथ to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रपायिन्: प्रपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Who or what drinks. 2 Who or what protects. E. प्र before पा to drink, &c. घिनुण् aff. and आय inserted.
प्रपावन: प्रपावन n. (-नं) A grove, a pleasure garden. E. प्रपा a place of refreshment, and वन a wood.
प्रपितामह: प्रपितामह m. (-हः) 1 A paternal great grandfather. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-ही) A paternal great grandmother. E. प्र preceding, पितामह a grandfather.
प्रपित्सु: प्रपित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or intending to descend, alight, fall, &c. E. प्र before पत to go, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रपुनाड: प्रपुनाड m. (-डः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora:) see प्रपुन्नाड.
प्रपुन्नड: प्रपुन्नड m. (-डः) Cassia tora: see प्रपुन्नाड.
प्रपुन्ना: प्रपुन्ना f. (-न्ना) A sort of grass, (Hedysarum alhaji.)
प्रपुन्नाड: प्रपुन्नाड m. (-डः) A tree, (Cassia tora.) E. प्र excellently, पुपस् manking, and णल to smell, aff. अण्, the स of पुमस् is rejected, and the ल of the radical changed optionally to ड; the antepenultimate is occasionally short, and one of the conjunct न is sometimes rejected; whence the word is variously written, प्रपुन्नाल, or प्रपुन्नड, or प्रपुनाड, &c.
प्रपुन्नाल: प्रपुन्नाल m. (-लः) Cassia tora: see the last.
प्रपूरण: प्रपूरण n. (-णं) The drawing out of a bow string for the purpose of shooting.
प्रपूरिका: प्रपूरिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum Jacquini.)
प्रपौण्डरीक: प्रपौण्डरीक m. (-कः) A small herbaceous plant, used in medicine, and as a perfume, commonly Punderya; in medicine it forms the basis of applications to ulcers, and bad eyes. E. प्र excellent, पुण्डरीक the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
प्रपौत्र: प्रपौत्र m. (-त्रः) A great grandson. f. (-त्री) A great granddaughter. E. प्र preceding, पौच a son's son.
प्रप्यान: प्रप्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fat, bulky. E. प्र before प्याय to be fat, क्त aff.
प्रफुल्ल: प्रफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, as a flower. 2 Smilling. 3 Shining. 4 Glad, pleased. E. प्र before फुल्ल flowered.
प्रफुल्लनयन: प्रफुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having full or sparkling eyes. E. प्रफुल्ल, and नयन the eye.
प्रफुल्लवदन: प्रफुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a cheerful or smiling countenance, looking gay or happy. E. प्रफुल्ल, and वदन face.
प्रबन्ध: प्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Continuous application or action, continuance, uninterruptedness. 2 A connected discussion, or narrative. E. प्र before बधि to bind, aff. अच्.
प्रबन्धकल्पना: प्रबन्धकल्पना f. (-ना) A feigned story, a work of imagination, whether founded on fact or not. E. प्रबन्ध a connected narrative, and कल्पना a making.
प्रबल: प्रबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, powerful. m. (-लः) A sprout, a shoot. E. प्र before बल to be strong, aff. अच्.
प्रबाधमान: प्रबाधमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paining, afflicting, tormenting. E. प्र before बाध to pain, शानच् aff.
प्रबाल: प्रबाल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Coral. 2 A shoot, a sprout, a new leaf. 3 The neck of a lute. m. (-लः) 1 An animal. 2 A pupil. E. प्र before बल to be strong, and aff. घञ्; also प्रबालक.
प्रबालवत्: प्रबालवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having new leaves or shoots. E. प्रबाल, and मतुप् aff.
प्रबुद्ध: प्रबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Blown, expanded. 3 Wakened, awake, roused. E. प्र before बुद्ध to be wise, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रबोध: प्रबोध m. (-धः) 1 Vigilance, wakefulness, active or vigilant state of being. 2 Intellect, understanding. 3 Knowledge, wisdom. 4 Sense, consciousness. 5 Awaking either from ignorance or sleep. E. प्र before बुध to understand, aff. घञ्.
प्रबोधन: प्रबोधन n. (-नं) 1 Awakening, arousing, exciting, reviving. 2 Instructing. 3 Reviving the fragrance of a perfume, which had lost its scent. f. (-नी) The lunation on which VIṢṆU is supposed to wake from his sleep, the eleventh of the light half of Kartik; also प्रबोधिनी. E. प्र before बुध to know or understand, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रबोधित: प्रबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Aroused, awakened. 2 Instructed. E. प्र before बुध to know, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रबोधिता: प्रबोधिता f. (-ता) A species of the Atijagatī metre.
प्रभङ्ग: प्रभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breaking down, destroying. E. प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. घञ्.
प्रभञ्जन: प्रभञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Breaking, destroying. m. (-नः) Air or wind. E. प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. युच्.
प्रभव: प्रभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Superior, powerful. m. (-वः) 1 Generative cause, the basis or root of being or existence. 2 The operative cause, or immediate origin of being, as the father or mother, &c. 3 The place of receiving existence, or where an object is first perceived, as हिमवान् गङ्गा प्रभवः the Himavān mountain, (is) the place where Gaṅgā is first seen. 4 Birth, production. 5 The basis or origin of water, i. e. light. 6 The name of a Muni. 7 Strength, superiority, power. E. प्र superiority or manifestation, and भव being.
प्रभवन: प्रभवन n. (-नं) 1 Being born or produced. 2 Ruling, presiding. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रभविष्णु: प्रभविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Mighty, potent. 2 Born completely or well. E. प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff.
प्रभविष्णुता: प्रभविष्णुता f. (-ता) Consequence, importance, power, authority, supremacy. E. प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff., and तल् aug.
प्रभव्य: प्रभव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be born or produced. 2 Fit for rule. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. क्यप्; also प्रभवनीय and प्रभवितव्य.
प्रभा: प्रभा f. (-भा) 1 Light, radiance. 2 The city of KUVERA. 3 One of the wives of the sun. 4 A name of DURGĀ. E. प्र exceeding, भा to shine, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रभाकर: प्रभाकर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The moon. 4 The ocean. E. प्रभा light, and कर what makes.
प्रभाकीट: प्रभाकीट m. (-टः) The firefly. E. प्रभा light, कीट insect.
प्रभाज्: प्रभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Who or what shares or divides. E. प्र before भज to divide, and खि aff.
प्रभाञ्जन: प्रभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. प्रभा light, beauty, अञ्ज to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रभात: प्रभात n. (-तं) Morning, dawn, daybreak. E. प्र before भा to shine, aff. क्त.
प्रभान: प्रभान n. (-नं) Light, radiance, shining. E. प्र before भा to shine, ल्युट् aff.
प्रभानीय: प्रभानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be irradiated or lighted. E. प्र before भा to shine, अनीयर् aff.
प्रभाव: प्रभाव m. (-वः) 1 Majesty, dignity, magnanimity, high spirit. 2 Power, strength. 3 Spirit. 4 Tranquillizing, conciliation. E. प्र pre-eminence, भाव quality.
प्रभावज: प्रभावज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Proceeding from conscious majesty or power. E. प्रभाव, and ज born.
प्रभावत्: प्रभावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Luminous, radiant, splendid. f. (-ती) 1 The mother of MALLI the 19th of the Jinas or Jaina saints. 2 The lute of one of the demigods attendant on ŚIVA, or other principal deities. 3 A form of poetical metre. E. प्रभा light or splendour, and मतुप् poss. aff.
प्रभास: प्रभास m. (-सः) 1 A place of pilgrimage, in the west of India, 2 One of the eight VASUS. 3 One of the Gaṇādhipas of the Jainas. E. प्र before भास to shine, aff. अच्.
प्रभिन्न: प्रभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Well cut or detached. 2 Severed, separated. m. (-न्नः) A furious elephant, one in rut or from whose temples the juice is exuding. E. प्र much, भिन्न broken, or seized with fury.
प्रभु: प्रभु mfn. (-भु-भ्वी-भु) 1 Strong, able. 2 Always, eternal. 3 A superior, an owner, a proprietor, a master or mistress, &c. m. (-भुः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 Quicksilver. 4 Sound. E. प्र pre-eminent, भू to be, aff. क्विप्, and the final vowel made short.
प्रभुता: प्रभुता f. (-ता) Greatness, power, supremacy, lordship or sovereignty. E. प्रभु master, aff. तल्; also with त्व aff. प्रमुत्व n. (-त्वं.)
प्रभुभक्त: प्रभुभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Faithful, devoted. m. (-क्तः) A good horse. E. प्रभु a master, and भक्त worshipped.
प्रभूत: प्रभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Much, abundant. 2 Gone up or upwards. 3 Been, become, produced. 4 High, lofty. 5 Governed, presided over. 6 Mature, perfect. E. प्र principal, &c. भूत been.
प्रभूतता: प्रभूतता f. (-ता) Abundance, plenty. E. तल् added to the last; also प्रभूतत्वं.
प्रभूष्णु: प्रभूष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Strong, able. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. ष्णुच्.
प्रभृति: प्रभृति f. (-तिः) 1 Manner, kind. 2 Etcetera, others, rest, remainder, (in composition;) as गर्म्मुत्प्रभृतयःतृणं the grass called Garmut and other sorts; मुनयः सोमश्रवः प्रभृतयः the Munis, Somaśravas, and the rest; ततः प्रभृति thence, after that. E. प्र before भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रभेद: प्रभेद m. (-दः) Kind, sort, difference. E. प्र before भेद kind.
प्रभ्रश्यमान: प्रभ्रश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Falling down, being broken off or down. E. प्र before भ्रंश to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रभ्रष्ट: प्रभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Fallen, dropping, fallen off. 2 Broken. E. प्र before भ्रंश to fall, क्त aff.
प्रभ्रष्टक: प्रभ्रष्टक n. (-कं) A chaplet of flowers suspended from the middle lock of hair. E. प्र before म्रंश to fall or depend, aff. क्त and कन added.
प्रमग्न: प्रमग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Immersed, drowned. E. प्र and मग्न plunged in.
प्रमङ्गन: प्रमङ्गन mfn. (-नं) Going, proceeding. E. प्र before मगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रमङ्गित: प्रमङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, proceeded. E. प्र before मगि to go, क्त aff.
प्रमणस्: प्रमणस् mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Joyful, cheerful. E. प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind; also प्रमनस्, न being optionally changed to ण.
प्रमत्त: प्रमत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Careless, negligent. 2 Blundering, a blunderer. 3 Intoxicated. 4 Insane. E. प्र before मत्त mad.
प्रमथ: प्रमथ m. (-थः) 1 An attendant on ŚIVA. 2 A horse. f. (-था) 1 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 2 Pain, affliction. E. प्र excess, मथ to churn, (the enemies of ŚIVA,) aff. अच्.
प्रमथन: प्रमथन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Paining, distressing. 3 Agitating, churning. E. प्र before मथ to churn, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रमथालय: प्रमथालय n. (-यं) Hell. E. प्रमथ pain, and आलय an abode.
प्रमथाधिप: प्रमथाधिप m. (-पः) ŚIVA. E. प्रमथ a follower of ŚIVA, and अधिप master.
प्रमथित: प्रमथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well-churned. 2 Pained, distressed. 3 Trampled down. n. (-तं) Butter-milk without water. E. प्र before मथि to churn, क्त aff.
प्रमद: प्रमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Mad, intoxicated, figuratively with passion or literally with liquor. 2 Violent. 3 Careless. 4 Impassioned. m. (-दः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight, rapture. 2 Datura, (D. metel.) f. (-दा) A woman, a handsome woman. E. प्र before मद mad, drunk.
प्रमदकानन: प्रमदकानन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground. E. प्रमद pleasure, and कानन a wood.
प्रमदवन: प्रमदवन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground attached to the Haram. E. प्रमद pleasure, and वन a wood.
प्रमदाकानन: प्रमदाकानन n. (-नं) A royal garden. E. प्रमदा a woman, and कानन a wood: see the next.
प्रमदावन: प्रमदावन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground attached especially to the private apartments of the palace. E. प्रमदा a woman, and वन a grove.
प्रमनस्: प्रमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Happy, delighted. E. प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind.
प्रमन्यु: प्रमन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Distressed, sorrowful. E. प्र, and मन्यु grief.
प्रमय: प्रमय m. (-यः) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र before मी to injure, aff. अच्.
प्रमा: प्रमा f. (-मा) 1 True knowledge, or knowledge exempt from all error. 2 Consciousness, perception. E. प्र before मा to mete or measure, aff. अङ् and टाप्; that by which every object is measured or estimated.
प्रमाण: प्रमाण n. (-णं) 1 Cause, motive. 2 Limit. 3 Proof, testimony, authority. 4 A scripture, a work of sacred authority. 5 Measure, quantity. 6 A speaker of the truth. 7 Always, eternal. 8 A title of VIṢṆU. 9 Principal, capital. E. प्र before मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; that by which all is measured; this word is generally restricted to the singular number, as वेदाः-प्रमाणं the Vedas are the authority; it is also confined to the neuter gender, as पुत्त्रः प्रमाणं the boy is a witness; some exceptions occur however, as प्रमाणः पुरुषः, प्रमाणा स्त्री the man witness, the woman witness; and in the following rule, प्रत्यक्षानुभानोपमानशब्दाः-प्रमाणानि perception, inference, comparison, and sound, are proofs.
प्रमाणतस्: प्रमाणतस् ind. 1 According to proof or authority. 2 Agreeably to measure, to weight, &c. E. प्रमाण, and तसि aff.
प्रमाणपुरुष: प्रमाणपुरुष m. (-षः) An umpire, an arbitrator, a judge. E. प्रमाण, and पुरुष a man.
प्रमाणयत्: प्रमाणयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Receiving, admitting, or obeying, &c. as authority. E. प्रमाण, nominal v., शतृ aff.
प्रमाणाभाव: प्रमाणाभाव m. (-वः) Want or absence of proof or authority. E. प्रमाण, and अभाव non-existence.
प्रमाणिका: प्रमाणिका f. (-का) A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
प्रमाणीकरण: प्रमाणीकरण n. (-णं) Establishing or admitting as authority or proof. E. प्रमाण, and करण making, च्चि aug.
प्रमाणीकृत: प्रमाणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Admitted or established as proof or authority. E. प्रमाण, and कृत made, च्वि aug.
प्रमाणीभूत: प्रमाणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Proving, establishing. E. प्रमाण, and भूत become, च्वि aug.
प्रमातामह: प्रमातामह m. (-हः) A maternal great grandfather. f. (-ही) A maternal great grandmother. E. प्र before मातामह a grandfather.
प्रमातृ: प्रमातृ mfn. (-ता-बी-तृ) Proving, evidence, who or what is proof or authority. E. प्र before मा to measure, तृच् aff.
प्रमाथ: प्रमाथ m. (-थः) 1 Killing. 2 Paining, afflicting, torturing. 3 Violence. E. प्र before मथि to churn, घञ् aff.
प्रमाथिन्: प्रमाथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) 1 Afflicting, inflicting pain or sorrow. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 Breaking, cutting. E. प्र before मथ to churn, to grind, to pain, and घिनुण् aff.
प्रमाद: प्रमाद m. (-दः) 1 Inadvertence, carelessness, error, inaccuracy. 3 Intoxication. 4 Insanity. E. प्र before मद to be mad, aff. घञ्.
प्रमादवत्: प्रमादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Heedless, careless, incautious, inconsiderate, unreflecting. 2 Insane. 3 Intoxicated. E. प्रमाद carelessness, and मतुप् aff.
प्रमादिका: प्रमादिका f. (-का) 1 An imprudent or careless woman. 2 A deflowered girl. E. प्र before मद to be careless, ण्वुल् aff., fem. form.
प्रमादिन्: प्रमादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Careless, indifferent. 2 Insane. 3 Intoxicated. E. प्र before मद to be inebriate, and घिनुण् aff.
प्रमाद्य: प्रमाद्य n. (-द्यं) 1 Carelessness. 2 Insanity. E. प्र before मद to be mad, ण्यत् aff.
प्रमाद्यतस्: प्रमाद्यतस् ind. From carelessness. E. प्रमाद्य, and तसि aff.
प्रमापण: प्रमापण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र before मीञ् to hurt or kill, पुक augment, from its taking the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.; the न of the affix also being unchanged, the word is written प्रमापन n. (-नं.)
प्रमापिन्: प्रमापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Killing, destroying. E. प्र before मी to kill, causal v., णिनि aff.
प्रमित: प्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood, established, proved. 2 Measured. E. प्र before मा to measure, aff. क्त.
प्रमिताक्षरा: प्रमिताक्षरा f. (-रा) A species of the Jagatī metre.
प्रमिति: प्रमिति f. (-तिः) 1 True knowledge, or knowledge derived from the senses, inference, analogy or information. 2 Measuring. E. प्र before मा to measure, (by which,) क्तिन् aff., and radical vowel changed.
प्रमीढ: प्रमीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Thick. 2 Passed, passed as urine. E. प्र before मिह to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
प्रमीणत्: प्रमीणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Overcoming, subduing. 2 Injuring, killing. E. प्र before मी to hurt or kill, शतृ aff.
प्रमीत: प्रमीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, deceased. 2 Immolated, sacrificed. E. प्र before मी to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.
प्रमीला: प्रमीला f. (-ला) Lassitude, enervation, exhaustion from indolence or fatigue. E. प्र before मील to twinkle, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रमुख: प्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Chief, principal. 2 Best, most excellent. 3 First. m. (-खः) 1 A chief, a sage, any respectable man. 2 A heap, a multitude. 3 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) n. (-खं) Time being, the present. E. प्र before मुख the face, &c.
प्रमुखत्व: प्रमुखत्व n. (-त्वं) Superiority, predominance. E. प्रमुख, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्रमुखता.
प्रमुद्: प्रमुद् mfn. (-मुत्) Pleased, happy. E. प्र before मुद to be pleased, क्विन् aff.
प्रमुदित: प्रमुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, glad, content, happy. E. प्र excess, मुद to be pleased, aff. क्त.
प्रमूढ: प्रमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 A fool, foolish, stupid. 2 Bewildered, deceived. E. प्र, and मूढ a fool.
प्रमूढसंज्ञ: प्रमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Bewildered, infatuated. E. प्रमूढ, and सज्ञा sign of sense.
प्रमृत: प्रमृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, concealed, withdrawn or gone out of sight. 2 Dead. n. (-तं) Tillage, cultivation. E. प्र before मृ to die, क्त aff.
प्रमृष्ट: प्रमृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Polished, bright, clear. 2 Rubbed. E. प्र before मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, aff. क्त.
प्रमेदित: प्रमेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Greasy, unctuous. 2 Becoming or made unctuous. E. प्र before मिद to be unctuous, aff. क्त.
प्रमेदितवत्: प्रमेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Being or made unctuous. E. प्र before मिद to be unctuous, क्तवतु aff.
प्रमेय: प्रमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Proveable, what may or ought to be proved. 2 Measurable, finite. n. (-यं) The thing to be proved. In logic, the second head, or topic, including twelve objects, as the soul, body, &c. or the form and end of existence. E. प्र before मा to measure, य aff.
प्रमेह: प्रमेह m. (-हः) Urinary affection, as change in the colour, quantity, or consistence of the urine; twenty-one varieties are enumerated, including diabetes, gonorrhœa, &c. E. प्र implying change, मिह to pass urine, with घञ् aff.
प्रमोचन: प्रमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, setting free. E. प्र before मुच to liberate, ल्युट् aff. f. (-नी) A sort of cucumber: see गवाक्षी. E. प्र before मुच to loose, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रमोद: प्रमोद m. (-दः) Pleasure, happiness, delight. E. प्र before मुद to be pleased, aff. घञ्.
प्रमोदित: प्रमोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, delighted. m. (-तः) A name of KUVERA. E. प्रमोद happiness, इतच् aff.; or प्र before मुद to be happy, क्त aff., and the radical vowel changed.
प्रमोदिन्: प्रमोदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Happy, delighted. 2 Delighting, making happy. E. प्रमोद, and इनि aff.
प्रमोह: प्रमोह m. (-हः) 1 Fascination. 2 Fainting, insensibility. E. प्र before मुह to be bewildered, घञ् aff.
प्रम्लोचा: प्रम्लोचा f. (-चा) One of the Apsaras, or nymphs of heaven.
प्रयच्छन्: प्रयच्छन् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छती-च्छत्) Giving, presenting, bestowing. E. प्र before दा to give, शतृ aff.
प्रयत: प्रयत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well-governed, restrained, self-subdued. 2 Careful, prudent. m. (-तः) A holy or pious person, one purified by austerity and mortification. E. प्र intensely, यत to endeavour, aff. अच्.
प्रयतात्मन्: प्रयतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Devout, pious, of a holy spirit. E. प्रयत, and आत्मन् soul.
प्रयत्न: प्रयत्न n. (-त्नं) 1 Continued or persevering effort, exertion. 2 Act, action. 2 (In logic,) Active effort of three kinds, engaging in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it. 4 Caution, care. 5 Articulation of sounds. E. प्र intensitive, यत्न effort.
प्रयत्नतस्: प्रयत्नतस् ind. Particularly, especially, with especial effort, care or pains. E. प्रयत्न, and तसि aff.
प्रयत्नवत्: प्रयत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Active, zealous, enterprising, assiduous, persevering. E. प्रयत्न effort, and मतुप् aff.
प्रयस्त: प्रयस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Seasoned, dressed with sauces and condiments. E. प्र before यस to take pains, and क्त aff.
प्रयाग: प्रयाग m. (-गः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 A celebrated place of pilgrimage, the confluence of the Ganges and Jumna, with the supposed subterraneous addition of the Sarasvatī; the modern Allahabad. The term in composition is applied to many places of reputed sanctity, situated at the confluence of two rivers, as Deva-Prayāga, Rudra-Prayāga, Karṇa-Prayāga, and Nanda-Prayāga, in the Himāla mountains, which with Prayoga or Allahabad, constitute the five principal places so termed. 3 A name of INDRA. 4 A horse. E. प्र principal, यज to worship, and घञ् aff.; actual worship, or the place where worship is peculiarly efficacious; Allahabad is one of the places where BRAHMĀ is supposed to have consummated ten Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of the horse, in commemoration of his recovery of the four Vedas from ŚAṄKHĀSURA.
प्रयागभय: प्रयागभय m. (-यः) A name of INDRA. E. प्रयाग sacrifice, especially of the horse or Aśvamedha, and भय fear; INDRA being dethroned by the performance of a hundred such sacrifices.
प्रयाज: प्रयाज m. (-जः) 1 A principal ceremony or sacrifice. 2 A part of a sacrifice. E. प्र before यज to sacrifice, aff. घञ्, form irr.
प्रयाण: प्रयाण n. (-णं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Going forth or to a distance. 3 Departure. 4 Death. 5 March of an assailing force, attack, invasion. E. प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, प्रयाणक n. (-कं)
प्रयाणकाल: प्रयाणकाल m. (-लः) 1 Time of departure. 2 Death. E. प्रयाण, and काल time.
प्रयाणार्ह: प्रयाणार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worthy of death. E. प्रयाण, and अर्ह fit for.
प्रयात: प्रयात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Removed, gone away or to a distance. 3 Deceased. m. (-तः) 1 A name of BHṚGU. 2 A sleepy or lazy fellow. E. प्र before यत to endeavour, aff. घञ्.
प्रयापण: प्रयापण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, dispatching. 2 Expelling, driving away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.; also न being unchanged, यापन.
प्रयापणीय: प्रयापणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sent or sent away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also प्रयापनीय.
प्रयापित: प्रयापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Driven or sent away, made to go or pass away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रयापिन्: प्रयापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Causing to go, who or what sends, or sends away, &c. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., णिनि aff.
प्रयाप्यमाण: प्रयाप्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being sent or made to go, pass away, &c. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., pass v., शानच् aff.; also प्रयाप्यमान.
प्रयाम: प्रयाम m. (-मः) 1 Checking, restraining. 2 Scarcity, dearth. 3 Competition of buyers in consequence of scarcity. 4 Length, either of space or time. E. प्र before यम to refrain, aff. घञ्.
प्रयाम्य: प्रयाम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-य्यं) To be checked, controlled, &c. E. प्र before यम to check, ण्यत् aff.
प्रयास: प्रयास m. (-सः) 1 Trouble, labour, fatigue. 2 Desire for or pursuit of any object. E. प्र before यस to make exertion, aff. घञ्.
प्रयासभाज्: प्रयासभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Capable of exertion or fatigue, active, energetic. E. प्रयास, and भाज् sharing.
प्रयास्यत्: प्रयास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Going, about to go or depart. E. प्र before या to go, शतृ aff. to the fut. tense.
प्रयुक्त: प्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Endowed with, possessing as an attribute, &c. 2 Resulting from, consequential. 3 Appointed, nominated. 4 Associated or connected with. 5 Applied, employed. 6 Compact, closely united. 7 Done, to or for. 8 Abstracted, lost in meditation. 9 Lent, (as money.) 10 Asleep. n. (-क्तं) Cause. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. क्त.
प्रयुक्ति: प्रयुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Occasion, cause, main object or end. E. प्र before युज to join, and क्तिन् aff.
प्रयुज्: प्रयुज् mfn. (-युक्) Who or what joins or is connected with, literally or figuratively, as a cause, motive, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, क्विप् aff.
प्रयुज्य: प्रयुज्य ind. 1 Having acted or behaved to or towards. 2 Having connected. E. प्र before युज to join, ल्यप् aff.
प्रयुज्यमान: प्रयुज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being united or connected with. 2 Being used, employed, applied, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रयुञ्जान: प्रयुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Adding, joining. 2 Using, employing. 3 Appointing, deputing. 4 Performing, doing. E. प्र before युज to join, शानच् aff.
प्रयुत: प्रयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, combined, united. n. (-तं) Ten hundred thousand, a million. E. प्र before यु to join, aff. क्त.
प्रयुत्सु: प्रयुत्सु m. (-त्सुः) 1 A warrior. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 A name of the wind. 4 A ram. 5 An ascetic. E. प्र before युद्ध to contend, in the desiderative form, with उ aff.
प्रयुद्ध: प्रयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) War, battle. E. प्र before युद्ध the same.
प्रयुद्धार्थ: प्रयुद्धार्थ m. (-र्थः) War, battle, going to war or battle. E. प्र initiatory, युद्ध war, and अर्थ object.
प्रयोक्तव्य: प्रयोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Applicable, suitable, to be applied or employed. E. प्र before युज to unite, aff. तव्य.
प्रयोग: प्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Occasion, cause, motive, object. 2 Consequence, result. 3 Affair, matter. 4 Appointing, appointment. 5 Application, use, employment. 6 Ceremonial form, course of proceeding. 7 Magic, magical rites. 8 Subduing, fascinating. 9 Device, contrivance. 10 Example, comparison. 11 Act, action. 12 Dramatic action or performance. 13 Principal, loan bearing interest. 14 Lending money at interest. 15 Profits of usury or trade. 16 A horse. 17 Text, authority. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
प्रयोगतस्: प्रयोगतस् ind. 1 According to or in consequence of. 2 Actually, in action. E. तसि added to प्रयोग.
प्रयोगार्थ: प्रयोगार्थ m. (-र्थः) Act, tending to a main object. E. प्रयोग aim or end, and अर्थ purpose.
प्रयोगिन्: प्रयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Having some object in view, calculated for some particular purpose. E. प्रयोग object, and इनि aff.
प्रयोजक: प्रयोजक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Who or what causes or induces any act. 2 Who or what deputes or appoints. m. (-कः) 1 A founder or institutor of any ceremony. 2 A law-giver, a legislator. E. प्र before युज to join, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रयोजककर्तृत्व: प्रयोजककर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Acting as an instigator or promoter. E. प्रयोजक, and कर्त्तृत्व agency.
प्रयोजककर्त्तृत्व: प्रयोजककर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Acting as an instigator or promoter. E. प्रयोजक, and कर्त्तृत्व agency.
प्रयोजन: प्रयोजन n. (-नं) 1 Cause, occasion. 2 Motive, origin. 3 Purpose, object, intention, design. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रयोजनवत्: प्रयोजनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Designing, purposing. 2 Having a cause, caused, produced. E. प्रयोजन, and मतुप् aff.
प्रयोजयत्: प्रयोजयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Behaving to or towards, shewing, displaying. 2 Combining, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. शतृ.
प्रयोज्य: प्रयोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be set to work, to be appointed or directed. 2 To be used, practised, employed, &c. n. (-ज्यं) Capital, principal. m. (-ज्यः) A servant, a slave. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. ण्यत्.
प्ररुदित: प्ररुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wept, weeping. E. प्र before रुद to weep, क्त aff.
प्ररूढ: प्ररूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Rooted, fastened, growing or proceeding from a root. 2 Grown, increased. 3 Born, produced. m. (-ढः) The belly. E. प्र before रुह to grow, क्त aff.
प्ररोचन: प्ररोचन n. (-नं) 1 Stimulating, exciting. 2 Propitiating. f. (-ना) Praise of the author of a drama, &c. in the prelude, to secure the favour of the spectators. E. प्र before रुच to, be light, causal v., युच् aff.
प्ररोह: प्ररोह m. (-हः) A bud, a shoot. E. प्र before रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.
प्ररोहिन्: प्ररोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Budding, sprouting. E. प्ररोह, and इनि aff.
प्रलपत्: प्रलपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Speaking, talking. E. प्र before लप to speak, शतृ aff.
प्रलपित: प्रलपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken, declared. E. प्र before लप to speak, aff. क्त.
प्रलम्ब: प्रलम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Hanging down, depending from, pendulous. 2 Slow, dilatory. m. (-म्बः) 1 Depending, hanging on or from. 2 The new shoot or bud of a creeping plant. 3 A garland of flowers worn round the neck. 4 A branch. 5 The female breast. 6 Tin. 7 The name of a Daitya, killed by BALARĀMA. E. प्र before लवि to oppose, aff. घञ्.
प्रलम्बघ्न: प्रलम्बघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. प्रलम्ब a demon, killed by BALADEVA, and घ्न who kills; also similar compounds, as प्रलम्बभित्, &c.
प्रलम्बभिद्: प्रलम्बभिद् m. (-भित्) BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. प्रलम्ब, and भित् who destroys: see the last.
प्रलम्बाण्ड: प्रलम्बाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A man having large testicles. E. प्रलम्ब pendulous, and अण्ड testicle.
प्रलम्बित: प्रलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended, pendulous, hanging. E. प्रलम्ब hanging, इतच् aff.
प्रलब्ध: प्रलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Over-reached, cheated, deceived. E. प्र before लभ to gain, क्त aff.
प्रलम्भ: प्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Fraud, cheating. E. प्र before लभि to get, घञ् aff.
प्रलय: प्रलय m. (-यः) 1 The end of a Kalpa, or destruction of the world. 2 Death, dying, loss, destruction, dissolution, annihilation. 3 Fainting, syncope, loss of sense or consciousness. E. प्र before ली to destroy, aff. अच्.
प्रलाप: प्रलाप m. (-पः) 1 Unmeaning or incoherent speech. 2 Speaking. 3 Discourse, conversation. E. प्र before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
प्रलापिन्: प्रलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Talking much, or unmeaningly, chattering. 2 Speaking to, conversing with. E. प्र before लप to speak, घिनुण् aff.
प्रलिप: प्रलिप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what smears, plasters, &c. E. प्र before लिप to anoint, क aff.
प्रलीन: प्रलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Destroyed, annihilated. 2 Unconscious, insensible. E. प्र before ली to destroy, क्त aff.
प्रलीनता: प्रलीनता f. (-ता) 1 Destruction, annihilation. 2 The end of the universe. 3 Unconsciousness, loss of sense. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, प्रलीनत्वं.
प्रलेपक: प्रलेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what anoints, smears, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A plasterer. 2 A slow fever. E. प्र before लिप to smear, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रलोठित: प्रलोठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling, heaving, tossing. E. प्र before लुठ to roll, क्त aff.
प्रलोठन: प्रलोठन n. (-नं) Rolling on the ground, heaving, tossing, (as of the ocean.) E. प्र before लुठ to roll, ल्युट् aff.
प्रलोभ: प्रलोभ m. (-भः) Desire, cupidity. E. प्र before लुभ to covet, घञ् aff.
प्रलोभन: प्रलोभन n. (-नं) 1 Allurement, inducement. 2 Attraction, attracting, seducing. E. प्र before लुभ to desire, ल्युट् aff.
प्रवक: प्रवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what goes. E. प्रु to go, वुन् aff.
प्रवक्तव्य: प्रवक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be expounded or explained. E. प्र before वच to speak, तव्य aff.
प्रवक्तृ: प्रवक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who speaks or declares. m. (-क्ता) A teacher, an expounder. E. प्र before वच to speak, तृच् aff.
प्रवचन: प्रवचन n. (-नं) 1 A Veda, scripture. 2 Excellent speech or language, eloquence. 3 Teachinge, expounding. E. प्र principal, वचन speech.
प्रवचनीय: प्रवचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 A good speaker. 2 To be well or elegantly spoken. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. अनीयर्.
प्रवचनपटु: प्रवचनपटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Eloquent. E. प्रवचन, and पटु skilful.
प्रवट: प्रवट m. (-टः) Wheat. E. प्र before वट to divide, aff. अच्.
प्रवण: प्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Declivity, declining, steep. 2 Bent, bowed. 3 Attached or adhering to, filled with, possessed of, endowed with. 4 Curved, crooked. 5 Swift. 6 Generous. 7 Humble, modest. 8 Wasted, decayed. m. (-णः) A place where four roads meet. E. प्र before वन to sound, &c. aff. अच्.
प्रवदत्: प्रवदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Speaking to or with, conversing, addressing. 2 Speaking much or well. 3 Arguing, a disputant. E. प्र before वद to speak, शतृ aff.
प्रवपण: प्रवपण n. (-णं) Sowing. E. प्र before वप to sow, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवयण: प्रवयण n. (-णं) A goad. E. प्र before अज to go, वी substituted for the root, and aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवयस्: प्रवयस् m. (-याः) An old man. E. प्र past, and वयस् life or age.
प्रवर: प्रवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, most excellent. n. (-रं) 1 Offspring, descendants. 2 Family, race, kindred. 3 A black sort of kidney bean. 4 Covering, screening. 5 A Muni, who contributes to the continuation of, and credit of a particular caste or tribe of Brahmans. E. प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. अप्.
प्रवरललित: प्रवरललित n. (-तं) A species of the Aṣṭī metre.
प्रवर्ग: प्रवर्ग m. (-र्गः) Sacrificial fire. E. प्र before वृज to abandon, aff. घञ्.
प्रवर्ग्य: प्रवर्ग्य m. (-र्ग्यः) An officiating priest. n. (-र्ग्यं) A particular ceremony or sacrifice. E. प्रवर्ग, and यत् aff.
प्रवर्त: प्रवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Engaging in, undertaking. 2 Excitement, stimulus. E. प्र before वृत to be, घञ् aff.: see प्रवर्त्तन and प्रवृत्ति.
प्रवर्त्त: प्रवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Engaging in, undertaking. 2 Excitement, stimulus. E. प्र before वृत to be, घञ् aff.: see प्रवर्त्तन and प्रवृत्ति.
प्रवर्तक: प्रवर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Inciting, stimulating, inducing, who or what sets in action. m. (-कः) 1 The original instigator of any act, the author, the principal. 2 An arbiter, a judge. n. (-कं) The entrance of the first person of the drama on the close of the introduction. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रवर्त्तक: प्रवर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Inciting, stimulating, inducing, who or what sets in action. m. (-कः) 1 The original instigator of any act, the author, the principal. 2 An arbiter, a judge. n. (-कं) The entrance of the first person of the drama on the close of the introduction. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रवर्तन: प्रवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Action, business, worldly interest or activity as opposed to abstract contemplation. 2 Fixing, establishing. 3 Engaging in, (any work.) 4 Beginning. 5 Inciting, stimulating. 6 Directing, superintending. 7 Informing. 8 Revolving. f. (-ना) Order, permission, the sense of the precative, or qualified imperative tense. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. (-युच्,) fem. aff. टाप्.
प्रवर्त्तन: प्रवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Action, business, worldly interest or activity as opposed to abstract contemplation. 2 Fixing, establishing. 3 Engaging in, (any work.) 4 Beginning. 5 Inciting, stimulating. 6 Directing, superintending. 7 Informing. 8 Revolving. f. (-ना) Order, permission, the sense of the precative, or qualified imperative tense. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. (-युच्,) fem. aff. टाप्.
प्रवर्तमान: प्रवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Engaging in, practising, doing. 2 Being used or employed. E. प्र before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
प्रवर्त्तमान: प्रवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Engaging in, practising, doing. 2 Being used or employed. E. प्र before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
प्रवर्तित: प्रवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Informed, apprized. 2 Stimulated, excited, instigated. 3 Revolving, going round. 4 Made, rendered. E. प्र before वृत to be, क्त aff.
प्रवर्त्तित: प्रवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Informed, apprized. 2 Stimulated, excited, instigated. 3 Revolving, going round. 4 Made, rendered. E. प्र before वृत to be, क्त aff.
प्रवर्द्धन: प्रवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) What causes to grow or increase. n. (-नं) Increase, augmenting. E. प्र before वृध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवर्ह: प्रवर्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Chief, principal, first. E. प्र before वृह to increase, aff. अच्.
प्रवलाकिन्: प्रवलाकिन् m. (-की) 1 A snake. 2 One with a variegated girdle.
प्रवसत्: प्रवसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-मत्) Residing abroad. E. प्र before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
प्रवसन: प्रवसन n. (-नं) Going abroad, sojourning in a foreign country. E. प्र before वस to dwell, घञ् aff.
प्रवह: प्रवह m. (-हः) 1 Going forth, or from a town. 2 One of the seven Vāyus, or winds. 3 Wind, air. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. अच्.
प्रवहण: प्रवहण n. (-णं) A covered car, a litter or carriage for women. E. प्र forth, वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.
प्रवहत्: प्रवहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Bearing. 2 Receiving, enjoying. E. प्र before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
प्रवह्लि: प्रवह्लि f. (-ह्णिः-ह्णी) A riddle. E. प्र before वल्ह to speak, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added: see the next.
प्रवह्लिका: प्रवह्लिका f. (-का) A riddle, an enigma, a conundrum or charade, &c. E. प्र before वल्ह to speak or tell, aff. क्वुन्; the conjunct consonants of the root are transposed; also प्रवह्लि and प्रवह्ली, and with कन् added to the latter प्रवह्लीका.
प्रवाच्: प्रवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Eloquent, oratorical, speaking, a speaker. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्विप्.
प्रवाचक: प्रवाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Speaking well, eloquent. E. प्र before वच to speak, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रवाणी: प्रवाणी f. (-णी) A weaver's shuttle. E. प्र before वी to go, aff. ल्युट, fem. aff. ङीप्; also प्रवाणि.
प्रवाद: प्रवाद m. (-दः) 1 Rumour, report. 2 Discourse, conversation. 3 Mutual defiance, the conversation of antagonists prior to combat. E. प्र spreading, and वाद speech.
प्रवादिन्: प्रवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what speaks, reports, &c. E. प्र before वद to speak, घिनुण् aff.
प्रवापिन्: प्रवापिन् m. (-पी) A sower, one who sows seed. E. प्र before वप to sow, घिनुण् aff.
प्रवार: प्रवार m. (-रः) Covering, clothing. E. प्र before वृ to cover, aff. घञ्; also with अप् aff., and in other senses, प्रवर्.
प्रवारण: प्रवारण n. (-णं) 1 A desirable gift. 2 Prohibition, objection, opposition. E. प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवास: प्रवास m. (-सः) A temporary or foreign residence, a habitation away from home. E. प्र far or removed, and वास abode.
प्रवासत्: प्रवासत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Dwelling or being abroad or absent. E. प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., शतृ aff.
प्रवासन: प्रवासन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Dwelling abroad, sojourning, lodging. 3 Exile. E. प्र away, वस to dwell, or divide, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवासित: प्रवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, expatriated. E. प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रवासिन्: प्रवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) A traveller, a sojourner, one living away from home. E. प्रवास a foreign or strange habitation, and इनि aff.; or प्र before वस to dwell, and घिनुण् aff.
प्रवाह: प्रवाह m. (-हः) 1 Stream, flow, continuous passage. 2 Action, occupation, active life. 3 A pond. 4 A swift horse. f. (-ही) Sand. E. प्र continually, वह to bear, aff. घञ्.
प्रवाहक: प्रवाहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what bears or carries well. m. (-कः) An imp, a goblin. f. (-हिका) Diarrhoea. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्
प्रवाहकम्: प्रवाहकम् ind. 1 At the same time. 2 Above, over; also in this sense, प्रवाहिका ind.
प्रविकशत्: प्रविकशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Expanding, opening, blossoming. E. प्र and वि before कश to go, शतृ aff.
प्रविख्याति: प्रविख्याति f. (-तिः) Celebrity, reputation. E. प्र and वि prefixed to ख्या to say, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रवितत: प्रवितत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread out, expanded. 2 Dishevelled. E. प्र and वि before तन to spread, क्त aff.
प्रविदारण: प्रविदारण n. (-णं) 1 War, battle, combat. 2 Tearing, rending, breaking. 3 Tumult, crowd, confusion. 4 Bursting, budding. E. प्र and वि prefixed to दॄ to tear to pieces, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रविदारित: प्रविदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Torn, rent, severed. 2 Opened, expanded. E. प्र and वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
प्रविभक्त: प्रविभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Partitioned, divided, separated, shared. E. प्र, and विभक्त divided.
प्रविभाग: प्रविभाग m. (-गः) Division, a part. E. प्र, and विभाग division.
प्रविर: प्रविर m. (-रः) A yellow fragrant wood. E. प्र and वि before रा to get or be, aff. ड.
प्रविरल: प्रविरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Apart, separate. E. प्र, and विरल distinct.
प्रविलुप्त: प्रविलुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Lost, removed, fallen or rubbed off. E. प्र and वि before लुप to cut, क्त aff.
प्रविविक्त: प्रविविक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separated, detached. 2 Solitary. E. प्र, and विविक्त detached.
प्रविव्राजयिषु: प्रविव्राजयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or intending to banish. E. प्र before व्रज to go, causal desid. v., उ aff.
प्रविश्लेष: प्रविश्लेष m. (-षः) Separation, parting. E. प्र and वि negative prefix before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.
प्रविषण्ण: प्रविषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Sad, dejected, spiritless. E. प्र much, घिषण्ण dejected.
प्रविषा: प्रविषा f. (-षा) A plant, commonly Atis or Ataich. E. प्र against (anti), and विष poison.
प्रविष्ट: प्रविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered, gone in or into. 2 Entered upon, (as an affair,) engaged in. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
प्रवीण: प्रवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Skilful, clever, conversant. E. प्र implying excellence, and वीणा a lute, or वीण a nominal verb, to play on a lute, aff. अच् or घञ्.
प्रवीणता: प्रवीणता f. (-ता) Proficiency, skill. E. प्रवीण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रवीणत्वं.
प्रवीर: प्रवीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, most excellent. m. (-रः) 1 A hero, a warrior. 2 A chief, a person of rank or distinction. E. प्र preeminent, and वीर a hero.
प्रवृत्त: प्रवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Fixed, settled, determined, done. 2 Engaged in, undertaking, occupied by. 3 Begun, beginning. 4 Doing, acting. 5 Undisputed, (as dominion.) E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रवृत्तकर्मन्: प्रवृत्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any act the cause of being born again. E. प्रवृत्त, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्रवृत्तकर्म्मन्: प्रवृत्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any act the cause of being born again. E. प्रवृत्त, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्रवृत्तचक्रता: प्रवृत्तचक्रता f. (-ता) Absolute dominion. E. प्रवृत्त fixed, चक्र rule, and तल् abstract aff.
प्रवृत्ति: प्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Activity, occupation, active life, as opposed to contemplative devotion; or it is defined to consist of the wish to do, knowledge of the means of success, and accomplishing the desired object. 2 Prosecution, perseverance. 3 Addiction to, predilection for. 4 Practice, conduct. 5 Tidings, intelligence. 6 Continuous flow, stream, current. 7 The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples, when in rut. 8 Oujein, or any holy place. 9 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier. E. प्र before वृत to be or abide, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रवृत्तिज्ञ: प्रवृत्तिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An emissary, an agent, a spy. E. प्रवृत्ति news, and ज्ञ who knows.
प्रवृद्ध: प्रवृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Full grown. 2 Expanded, diffused, spread abroad or dispersed. 3 Swoln, (as a river.) 4 Full, deep, (as a sigh.) E. प्र before वृद्ध to increase or grow, aff. क्त.
प्रवेक: प्रवेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Chief, head, principal. E. प्र before विच to distinguish, aff. अच्.
प्रवेक्षण: प्रवेक्षण n. (-णं) Foressing. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
प्रवेक्षित: प्रवेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Foreseen, anticipated. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
प्रवेक्ष्यत्: प्रवेक्ष्यत् mfn. (-क्ष्यन्-क्ष्यन्ती-क्ष्यत्) Foreseeing, anticipating. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, शतृ aff. the first syllable made short.
प्रवेट: प्रवेट m. (-टः) Barley. E. प्र before विट to sound, aff. घञ्.
प्रवेणि: प्रवेणि f. (-णिः) 1 The hair twisted, and undecorated, as worn by women in the absence of their husbands. 2 An elephant's  housings. E. प्र before वेणृ to go, aff. इण्; also with डीप् added, प्रवेणी.
प्रवेणी: प्रवेणी f. (-णी) 1 Unornamented hair. 2 An elephant's housings. E. see the last.
प्रवेपण: प्रवेपण n. (-णं) Shaking, agitation, tremulous motion. E. प्र before वेपृ to tremble, ल्युट् aff.
प्रवेल: प्रवेल m. (-लः) The yellow variety of kidney bean. E. प्र before वेल to go, aff. अच्.
प्रवेश: प्रवेश m. (-शः) 1 Intentness on an object, engaging closely in a pursuit or purpose. 2 Entrance. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
प्रवेशक: प्रवेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what enters. m. (-कः) 1 An inferior actor who announces the entrance of the principal characters. 3 An entry. E. प्र before विश to enter, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रवेशन: प्रवेशन n. (-नं) 1 The entrance to a house, the principal door or gate. 2 Entering, entrance. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रवेशित: प्रवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called or sent in. E. प्र before विश to enter, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रवेश्य: प्रवेश्य ind. Having sent in, thrown in, or into, &c. E. प्र before विश to enter, causal v., ल्युप् aff.
प्रवेश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be entered, to be pervaded. E. प्र before विश to enter, यत् aff.; also प्रवेशनीय.
प्रवेष्ट: प्रवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 An arm. 2 The forearm, or wrist. 3 An elephant's gums. 4 An elephant's housings. E. प्र before वेष्ट to encompass, aff. अच्.
प्रवेष्टव्य: प्रवेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be entered, to be penetrated or pervaded. E. प्र before विश to enter, तव्य aff.
प्रव्यक्त: प्रव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Evident, apparent, manifest. E. प्र and वि before अञ्ज to spread, aff. क्त.
प्रव्यथित: प्रव्यथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained. E. प्र before व्यथ to pain, aff. क्त.
प्रव्रजित: प्रव्रजित m. (-तः) 1 An ascetic or mendicant. 2 The pupil, or attendant of a Jaina or Bauddha mendicant. f. (-ता) 1 A female devotee or ascetic. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi). 3 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī, (Sphoeranthus molis ?) E. प्र before व्रज to go, aff. क्त.
प्रव्रज्या: प्रव्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Roaming, travelling, wandering about, as a religious mendicant especially. 2 Abandonment of the world. E. प्र before व्रज to go, aff. यम.
प्रव्रज्यावसित: प्रव्रज्यावसित m. (-तः) An ascetic, who has broken his observance. E. प्रव्रज्या, and अवसित finished.
प्रव्राजन: प्रव्राजन n. (-नं) Banishment. E. प्र before व्रज to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रशंशन: प्रशंशन n. (-नं) Praising, eulogising: see प्रशंसन. E. प्र before शंश to praise, ल्युट् aff.
प्रशंशा: प्रशंशा f. (-शा) Praise, eulogium. E. प्र before शंश to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.: see प्रशंसा.
प्रशंसन: प्रशंसन n. (-नं) Praising, eulogising. E. प्र before शंस to praise, ल्युट् aff.; also प्रशंशन.
प्रशंसनीय: प्रशंसनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be praised, praise-worthy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, अनीयर् aff.
प्रशंसा: प्रशंसा f. (-सा) Praise, applause, flattery, commendation. E. प्र especially, शंस to praise, affs. अङ् and टाप्; the root is also read शंश, when this word and the analogous derivatives are read प्रशंशा, &c.
प्रशंसित: प्रशंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, eulogised. E. प्रशंसा, and इतच् aff.
प्रशंसितव्य: प्रशंसितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be praised, praise-worthy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, तव्य aff.
प्रशत्वन्: प्रशत्वन् m. (-त्वा) The ocean. f. (-री) A river. E. प्र before शद् to go, and क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff., र inserted before ङीप्.
प्रशमन: प्रशमन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Pacifying, tranquillising. 3 Quiescence, reposing. E. प्र before शम to pacify, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रशमित: प्रशमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Allayed, appeased, relieved, tranquillised, &c. E. प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., aff. क्त.
प्रशमय्य: प्रशमय्य ind. Having appeased. E. प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., ल्युप् aff.
प्रशम्यमान: प्रशम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pacified, quieted, appeased, flattered. E. प्र before शम to be at rest, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रशस्त: प्रशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Good, excellent, best. E. प्र before शंस to praise or commend, aff. क्त.
प्रशस्ति: प्रशस्ति f. (-स्तिः) 1 Excellence, eminence. 2 Eulogy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, क्तिन् aff.
प्रशाखिक: प्रशाखिक m. (-कः) A small branch or twig. E. प्र before शाखा a branch, ठक् aff.
प्रशान्त: प्रशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calmed, calm, tranquillised. 2 Ceased, discontinued, (as active effort.) 3 Ended. 4 Relieved. E. प्र before शम to be calm, क्त aff.
प्रशान्तचेष्ट: प्रशान्तचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Resting. E. प्रशान्त, and चेष्टा effort.
प्रशान्तात्मन्: प्रशान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Peaceful, calm, composed. E. प्रशान्त, and आत्मन् self.
प्रशान्तोज: प्रशान्तोज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Weakened, prostrate in strength. E. प्रशान्त, and ओजस् strength.
प्रशान्ति: प्रशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Calm, quiet, tranquillity, moral or physical. E. प्र before शम to be calm, क्तिन् aff.
प्रशाम्: प्रशाम् mfn. (प्रशान्) Quiet, tranquil. E. प्र before शम to be tranquil, क्विप् aff., and the penultimate long.
प्रशाम: प्रशाम m. (-मः) 1 Tranquility, quiescence. 2 Allaying, pacifying. 3 Laying, suppressing. E. प्र before शम to be at rest, अच् aff.
प्रशासन: प्रशासन n. (-नं) 1 Governing, ruling. 2 Enacting. E. प्र before शास to rule, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रशासित: प्रशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Governed, ruled. 2 Promulgated, enacted. E. प्र before शास to rule, क्त aff.
प्रशासितृ: प्रशासितृ m. (-ता) A ruler or governor. E. प्र before शास to govern, तृच् aff.
प्रश्च्योतत्: प्रश्च्योतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Sprinkling, scattering. E. प्र before श्च्युत to sprinkle, शतृ aff.
प्रश्न: प्रश्न m. (-श्नः) A question, a demand, an inquiry. f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. प्रच्छ to ask, aff. नङ्.
प्रश्नदूती: प्रश्नदूती f. (-ती) A riddle, an enigma, an intricate or enigmatical question. E. प्रश्न a question, and टूती playing.
प्रश्रथ: प्रश्रथ m. (-थः) Laxity, relaxation, flaccidity. E. प्र before श्रथ to be loose, aff. घञ्.
प्रश्रय: प्रश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Affection, affectionate regard or solicitation. 2 Respect. 3 Courtesy, civility. E. प्र before श्री to serve, aff. अच्.
प्रश्रवण: प्रश्रवण n. (-णं) 1 A fountain, a cascade, a water-fall. 2 Oozing, flowing. 3 A range of mountains in the south, part of the western Ghats. E. प्र before श्रु to ooze or drop, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रश्रित: प्रश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, humble, well-behaved. E. प्र before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.
प्रश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowing, oozing, issuing. E. प्र before श्रि to drop, aff. क्त.
प्रश्लथ: प्रश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, flaccid, loose, relaxed, unnerved. E. प्र before श्लथ to be loose, aff. अच्.
प्रष्टव्य: प्रष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be asked. E. प्रच्छ to ask, तव्य aff.
प्रष्टृ: प्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Asking, demanding, an asker or questioner. E. प्रच्छ to ask, तृच् aff.
प्रष्ठ: प्रष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 A leader, a conductor, one who goes first or before. 2 Prior, preceding. 3 Chief, principal, best. f. (-ष्ठी) The wife of a leader or chief. E. प्र pre-eminent, स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
प्रष्ठवाह्: प्रष्ठवाह् m. (-वाट्-वाड्) A young bull or steer, training for the plough, &c. E. प्रष्ठ a leader, and वह to bear, aff. ण्डि or विच.
प्रष्ठौही: प्रष्ठौही f. (-ही) A cow pregnant with her first calf. E. प्रष्ठ here said to be the first birth, and वह to bear, aff. ण्वि or विच, fem. aff. ङीप्, and व is changed to ऊ, which with the preceding vowel becomes औ by special rule.
प्रस: प्रस r. 1st cl. (प्रसते) 1 To spread or diffuse. 2 To bring forth young.
प्रसक्त: प्रसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Eternal, constant, continual. 2 Opened, expanded. 3 Obtained, gained, attained. 4 Attached to, devoted to, (person or thing,) engaged in. 5 United to, connected with, accompanying. 6 Applied to, used, employed. n. adv. (-क्तं) Continually, incessantly, eternally. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite or embrace, aff. क्त.
प्रसक्ति: प्रसक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union, connexion. 2 Adherence or attachment to. 3 Energy, perseverance. 4 Acquiring. 5 Inference, conclusion, deduction. 6 A topic, or subject of conversation. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite, क्तिन् aff.
प्रसङ्ग: प्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Introduction, insertion. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Addiction or attachment to. 4 Connected language or style. 5 Connected reasoning or argument. 6 Double or conjoint result, producing two effects, attaining two objects by one act. 7 Revealing a secret. 8 (In dramatic language,) A second or subsidiary incident or plot. E. प्र preceding, षञ्ज to join, aff. अच्.
प्रसञ्जन: प्रसञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Bringing into use, employing, applying, bringing to bear. 2 Combining, connecting. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite, ल्युट् aff.
प्रसत्ति: प्रसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Purity, cleanness, brightness, transparency. 2 Favour, graciousness, complacency. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रसत्वन्: प्रसत्वन् m. (-त्वा) 1 Virtue, piety. 2 BRAHMĀ. f. (-री) Acquisition, accomplishment. E. प्र before षद to go, क्वरप् Uṇādi aff.
प्रसन्न: प्रसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Clear, clean, bright, pellucid. 2 Pleased, delighted. 3 Complacent, gracious, favourable. f. (-न्ना) 1 Propitiating, pleasing. 2 Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. प्र principally, &c. सद to go, aff. क्त.
प्रसन्नता: प्रसन्नता f. (-ता) 1 Brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity. 2 Favour, kindness, being pleased with. E. प्रसन्न clear, and तल aff.; also with त्व, प्रसन्नत्व.
प्रसन्नमुख: प्रसन्नमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Agreeable looking, smiling, looking pleased. E. प्रसन्न, and मुख face.
प्रसन्नेरा: प्रसन्नेरा f. (-रा) Spirituous liquor. E. प्रसन्न clear, and ईरा wine.
प्रसभ: प्रसभ n. (-भं) Violence. adv. 1 Violently, forcibly. 2 Much, exceedingly. E. प्र gone, passed, सभा an assembly.
प्रसमीक्षण: प्रसमीक्षण n. (-णं) Considering, deliberating, discussing. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
प्रसमीक्षा: प्रसमीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Deliberation, judgment. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
प्रसमीक्ष्य: प्रसमीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be weighed, considered, discussed, &c. ind. Having considered. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
प्रसर: प्रसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what proceeds, projects, &c. m. (-रः) 1 Spreading, extending. 2 Space, room. 3 Occasion, opportunity. 4 Affectionate solicitation. 5 Speed, velocity. 6 Battle, war. 7 Multitude, assemblage. 8 An iron arrow. 9 A projection, a process. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. अप् or घ.
प्रसरण: प्रसरण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or round. 2 Surrounding an enemy. 3 Spreading over the country to forage. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरणी and प्रसरणि.
प्रसरणि: प्रसरणि f. (-णिः or णी) Surrounding an enemy. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.
प्रसरत्: प्रसरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Expanding, spreading, bursting. 2 Proceeding, projecting. E. प्र before सृ to go, शतृ aff.
प्रसर्पक: प्रसर्पक m. (-कः) An uninvited guest, an intruder. E. प्र before सृप to go, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रसर्पण: प्रसर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Spreading, stretching, expanding. 2 Going, proceeding. E. प्र before सृप to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रसर्पत्: प्रसर्पत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Advancing, proceeding. E. प्र before सृप to go, शतृ aff.
प्रसव: प्रसव m. (-वः) 1 Bringing forth, bearing, (as young.) 2 Birth, production. 3 Offspring, posterity. 4 Fruit. 5 A blossom, a flower. E. प्र before सू to bear, aff. अप्.
प्रसवक: प्रसवक m. (-कः) A tree, commonly Piyāl, (Buchanania latifolia). E. प्रसव a flower, aff. कन्.
प्रसवत्: प्रसवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Bearing. f. (-न्ती) A woman in labour. E. प्र before सू to bear, शतृ aff.
प्रसवबन्धन: प्रसवबन्धन n. (-नं) The footstalk of a leaf or flower, the petiole or peduncle. E. प्रसव a flower, and बन्धन a binding.
प्रसवस्थली: प्रसवस्थली f. (-ली) A mother. E. प्रसव, and श्यल place, ङीप् aff.
प्रसवितृ: प्रसवितृ m. (-ता) A father. f. (-त्री) A mother. E. प्र before सू to bear or have offspring, aff. तृच्.
प्रसविन्: प्रसविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Having or bearing young. E. प्रसव, and इनि aff.
प्रसव्य: प्रसव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Contrary, reverse, inverted, reverted. E. प्र inclined towards, सव्य the left or wrong side.
प्रसह: प्रसह m. (-हः) A beast or bird of prey. E. प्र before सह to be able, aff. अच्.
प्रसहन: प्रसहन m. (-नः) A beast or bird of prey. n. (-नं) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 Defeat. 3 Bearing, enduring. E. प्र before सह to bear, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रसह्य: प्रसह्य ind. 1 Forcibly, violently. 2 Exceedingly. E. प्र excessively, सह to be able, यप् aff.
प्रसह्यचौर: प्रसह्यचौर m. (-रः) A robber, a plunderer. E. प्रसह्य violently, and चौर a thief.
प्रसाद: प्रसाद m. (-दः) 1 Clearness, cleanness, brightness. 2 Favour, kindness, propitiousness, approbation. 3 Well being, welfare. 4 Composure, calmness of mind. 5 Poetry written in an elegant but an easy style. 6 Perspicuity. 7 Connexion, association. 8 Food that has been offered to an idol, or of which a spiritual teacher has partaken. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रसादन: प्रसादन n. (-नं) 1 Boiled rice. 2 Cleaning, freeing from soil or impurities. 3 Pleasing, gratifying. f. (-ना) 1 Service. 2 Worship. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्.
प्रसादयत्: प्रसादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Pleasing, propitiating. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. शतृ.
प्रसादस्थ: प्रसादस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Kind, propitious. 2 Happy. E. प्रसाद, and स्थ who or what is.
प्रसादित: प्रसादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, propitiated. 2 Worshipped. 3 Purified, cleansed. E. प्र before षद to go, क्त aff.
प्रसाधक: प्रसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what accomplishes or perfects. 2 Who or what cleanses or purifies. f. (-का) 1 Wild rice. 2 A dresser, a female attendant, one who decorates or adorns. E. प्र before साध to accomplish, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रसाधन: प्रसाधन n. (-नं) 1 Dress, decoration, embellishment. 2 Accomplishing, effecting. nf. (-नं-नी) A comb. f. (-नी) A drug, commonly Siddhi. E. प्र before साध to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रसाधित: प्रसाधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, decorated. 2 Accomplished, completed, done. E. प्र before साध to finish, aff. क्त.
प्रसाध्य: प्रसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Accomplishable, what may be done. 2 To be done for, destroyed, defeated. E. प्र, and साध to accomplish, यत् aff.
प्रसार: प्रसार m. (-रः) 1 Going about, spreading, extending. 2 Going to forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel. E. प्र afar, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रसारण: प्रसारण n. (-णं) 1 Going about, spreading. 2 Expanding, extending. 3 Unfolding. 4 Surrounding an enemy. 5 The dispersion of an army by detachments for that purpose, or for collecting forage. f. (-णी) A plant, (Pœderia foetida.) E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरण.
प्रसारित: प्रसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stretched, expanded, extended. 2 Laid out. E. प्र before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रसारिन्: प्रसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Going along gently, gliding, flowing, creeping. 2 Spreading, expanding. 3 Spreading around, or about. 4 Expanded, unfolded. E. प्र before सृ to go, घिनुण् aff.
प्रसित: प्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Diligent, attentive, adhering to, or engaged in. 2 Ingrossed by, devoted or attached to. 3 Bound, fastened. n. (-तं) Pus, matter. E. प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्त.
प्रसिति: प्रसिति f. (-तिः) 1 Ligament, fetters, binding, tye. E. प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रसिद्ध: प्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Adorned, ornamented. E. प्र before सिद्ध accomplished.
प्रसिद्धि: प्रसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Fame, celebrity, notoriety. 2 Ornament, decoration. 3 That which is notorious or known. E. प्र before षिध to go, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रसुप्त: प्रसुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sleeping, asleep, fast asleep. E. प्र, and सुप्त slept.
प्रसू: प्रसू f. (-सूः) 1 A mother. 2 A mare. 3 A spreading creeper. 4 The plantain. E. प्र before सू to bear, aff. क्विप्.
प्रसूका: प्रसूका f. (-का) A mare. E. कन् added to the last.
प्रसूत: प्रसूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, engendered. 2 Bearing, bringing forth, delivered. n. (-तं) A flower. f. (-ता) A woman who has borne a child, or one who is recently delivered. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, fem. aff. टाप्; also प्रसूतिका.
प्रसूति: प्रसूति f. (-तिः) 1 Bringing forth, (as young.) 2 Birth, production. 3 Offspring, children, a son or daughter. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रसूतिका: प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A woman who has had a child, or one who has been recently delivered. E. प्रसूता the same, pleonastic aff. कन्, fem. form.
प्रसूतिज: प्रसूतिज n. (-जं) Pain, affliction, mental or corporeal. E. प्रसूति birth, and ज produced; attending man from birth.
प्रसून: प्रसून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Born, produced. n. (-नं) 1 A flower, a bud, a blossom. 2 Fruit. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रसूनेषु: प्रसूनेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA. E. प्रसून a flower, and इषु an arrow.
प्रसृत: प्रसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dispersed, extended, spread abroad. 2 Stretched. 3 Long, lengthened. 4 Modest, humble. 5 Swift, quick. 6 Gone. 7 Attached to, engaged in, occupied. 8 Appointed. m. (-तः) The palm of the hand, hollowed as if to hold liquids. f. (-ता) The leg. n. (-तं) A measure of two Palas. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्त.
प्रसृति: प्रसृति f. (-तिः) The palm of the hand hollowed. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रसेक: प्रसेक m. (-कः) 1 Sprinkling, wetting. 2 Dropping, oozing. 3 Running or watering of the mouth and nose. E. प्र before सिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
प्रसेदिका: प्रसेदिका f. (-का) A small garden. E. प्र excellence, सद to go, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. aff. टाप्.
प्रसेदिवस्: प्रसेदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-टुषी-वस्) Pleased, propitiated, favourable. E. प्र before षद to go, क्वसु aff.
प्रसेव: प्रसेव m. (-वः) 1 Part of a lute: see the next. 2 A sack. E. प्र before षिव to tie or sew, aff. घञ्.
प्रसेवक: प्रसेवक m. (-कः) 1 A part of a lute, a wooden vessel covered with leather, placed under the neck to render the sound deeper. 2 A crooked piece of wood at the end of a lute. E. प्र before षेव to serve, aff. क्वुन्.
