प्रस्कन्दन: प्रस्कन्दन n. (-नं) Purging, diarrhœa. E. प्र before स्कन्द to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रस्कन्दिका: प्रस्कन्दिका f. (-का) Diarrhœa. E. प्र before खन्द to go, वुन् aff.
प्रस्कन्न: प्रस्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Fallen, dropped. m. (-न्नः) A sinner, an outcast, one who has violated the usages of his caste or order. E. प्र before स्कन्द to go, to drop, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रस्तर: प्रस्तर m. (-रः) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A jewel, a precious stone. 3 A couch, made of flowers or grass. 4 Any bed or couch. 5 A tabular form of representing the long and short vowels of poetical metre. 6 Notation of music. 7 A handful or bundle of Kuśa grass used at sacrifices. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप्.
प्रस्तार: प्रस्तार m. (-रः) 1 A jungle, a thicket or wood, overgrown with grass. 2 A bed made with blossoms, leaves, &c. 3 Any bed or couch. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्.
प्रस्ताव: प्रस्ताव m. (-वः) 1 Opportunity, occasion, season. 2 Occasional or introductory eulogium. 3 Subject matter of a composition. 4 A chapter, a section. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. घञ्.
प्रस्तावना: प्रस्तावना f. (-ना) 1 Commencement, introduction. 2 A dramatic prelude, an introductory dialogue, usually spoken by the manager and one of the actors. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. ल्युट्; the commencement of books, &c. being usually the praise of gods or princes.
प्रस्तावसदृश: प्रस्तावसदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Suited to the occasion, appropriate, seasonable. E. प्रस्ताव, and सदृश like.
प्रस्तिर: प्रस्तिर m. (-रः) A bed or couch made of blossoms, flowers, leaves, &c. E. प्र before स्तॄ to spread, aff. अच्, and इर substituted for अर.
प्रस्तीत: प्रस्तीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crowded, clustering. 2 Sounded, making a noise. E. प्र before स्त्यै to crowd, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रस्तीम: प्रस्तीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Crowded together, swarming, clustering. 2 Sounded. E. प्र before स्त्यै to crowd, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रस्तुत: प्रस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, revealed, propounded, declared. 2 Ready, prepared. 3 Praised, panegyrised. 4 Accomplished, done. 5 Happened, come to pass. 6 Made or consisting of. 7 Approached, proximate. 8 Done with effort or energy. 9 Expected, desired. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. क्त.
प्रस्तृत: प्रस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread. 2 Disappeared. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. क्त.
प्रस्थ: प्रस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Expanding, spread. 2 What stays well, firm, solid. 3 Who goes on a journey or march, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 A measure of quantity, four Kuḍavas, or forty-eight double handfuls. 2 Table land on the top of a mountain. 3 A level expanse. 4 A Prastha of any thing, or any thing measuring a Prastha. E. प्र before स्था to stand, aff. क.
प्रस्थपुष्प: प्रस्थपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of Tulasi, or basil with small leaves. E. प्रस्थ the top of a mountain, and पुष्प flower.
प्रस्थान: प्रस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Going forth, proceeding, departing. 2 March of an assailant. 3 March. 4 An inferior kind of drama, the personages of which are slaves and outcastes. E. प्र away, away from, स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रस्थानविघ्न: प्रस्थानविघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Non-attendance at a festival, impeding its taking place, &c. E. प्रस्थान proceeding, and विघ्न obstacle.
प्रस्थानिक: प्रस्थानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a departure. E. प्रस्थान, and ठक् aff.
प्रस्थापन: प्रस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Sending away. 2 Appointment on an embassy. 3 Harrying, carrying off cattle, &c. E. प्र before स्था to stay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रस्थापनीय: प्रस्थापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sent away. 2 To be carried or driven off. E. प्र before स्था to stay, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
प्रस्थापित: प्रस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Sent away, dismissed. E. प्र reverse, स्था to stay, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
प्रस्थायिन्: प्रस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Who or what goes, travels, marches, &c. E. प्र before स्था to stay, इनि Uṇādi aff.
प्रस्थित: प्रस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, departed, set forth, (on a journey, a march, &c.) E. प्र before स्था to stay, aff. क्त.
प्रस्थिति: प्रस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Going forth or away. 2 Journey. 3 March. E. प्र before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
प्रस्फुट: प्रस्फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Blown, expanded. E. प्र before स्फुट to blossom, क aff.
प्रस्फुरित: प्रस्फुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Swollen. 2 Budded. E. प्र before स्फुर to expand, क्त aff.
प्रस्फोटन: प्रस्फोटन n. (-नं) 1 A winnowing basket. 2 Striking, beating. 3 Expanding, budding, opening, blowing. 4 Winnowing corn. 5 Ripening. E. प्र before स्फट to blossom, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रस्मृति: प्रस्मृति f. (-तिः) Forgetfulness, forgetting. E. प्र privative, स्मृति recollection.
प्रस्रवण: प्रस्रवण n. (-णं) 1 A pool of water formed by dripping of springs in the mountains. 2 Dripping or fall of water, cascade, cataract. 3 Washing away of rocks, &c. by the dripping of water. 4 Oozing, leaking, dripping. m. (-णः) 1 Sweat, perspiration. 2 Pissing, urining. 3 A range of mountains in the peninsula; also Malayavān. E. प्र before स्रु to drop, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रश्रबण.
प्रस्राव: प्रस्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flowing, dropping. 2 Urine. E. प्र forth, स्रु to ooze, aff. घञ्.
प्रस्रुत: प्रस्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Oozed, issued, dropped. E. प्र before स्रु to drop, क्त aff.
प्रस्वान: प्रस्वान m. (-नः) A loud noise. E. प्र before स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.
प्रस्विन्न: प्रस्विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Perspiring, covered with perspiration. 2 Heated, sweated. E. प्र before स्विद to sweat, क्त aff.
प्रस्वेद: प्रस्वेद m. (-दः) Great or excessive perspiration. E. प्र intensitive, स्वेद sweat.
प्रस्वेदित: प्रस्वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perspiring, sweating. 2 Heated, sweated. 3 Hot, causing perspiration. E. प्र before स्विद to sweat, क्त aff.
प्रस्वेदितवत्: प्रस्वेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Suffering or producing perspiration. E. प्र before ष्विद to sweat, क्तवतु aff.
प्रहत: प्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, wounded, killed. 2 Repelled, repulsed, overcome, defeated. 3 Spread, expanded. 4 Contiguous, bounding, limitative. 5 Learned, accomplished. E. प्र again, and हत struck, injured.
प्रहर: प्रहर m. (-रः) A watch, an 8th part of the day, or a division comprising about three hours. E. प्र before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
प्रहरण: प्रहरण n. (-णं) 1 A weapon. 2 A covered car, a litter for women, or any litter, or small covered car for diversion. 3 War, battle. 4 Striking, killing. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रहरणकलिका: प्रहरणकलिका f. (-का) A species of the Śarkarī metre.
प्रहरिन्: प्रहरिन् m. (-री) A watchman, a bellman. E. प्रहर a watch, and इनि aff.
प्रहरिष्यत्: प्रहरिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Taking, intending or wishing to take. E. प्र, हृ to take, with a future sense, शतृ aff.
प्रहर्तृ: प्रहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Striking, a striker, a combatant. E. प्र before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
प्रहर्त्तृ: प्रहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Striking, a striker, a combatant. E. प्र before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
प्रहर्ष: प्रहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Delight, joy, rapture. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, घञ् aff.
प्रहर्षण: प्रहर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Happy, delighted. 2 Delighting. m. (-णः) The planet Mercury, or its ruler. f. (-णी) 1 Turmerick. 2 A form of metre. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रहर्षिणी: प्रहर्षिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Atijagatī metre.
प्रहर्षित: प्रहर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, very happy. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, क्त aff.
प्रहसत्: प्रहसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Laughing, laughing heartily. f. (-न्ती) Arabian jasmine. E. प्र before हस to smile, aff. शतृ; fem. aff. ङीप्.
प्रहसन: प्रहसन n. (-नं) 1 Loud, violent or hearty laughter. 2 Mirth, merriment. 3 Sarcasm, satire, as a branch of rhetorical composition. 4 Reproof, ridicule, irony. 5 A farce, a comedy. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रहसित: प्रहसित n. (-तं) Laughter, mirth. E. प्र and हस to laugh, क्त aff.
प्रहस्त: प्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) The open hand with the fingers extended. E. प्र exchanging, हस्त the hand.
प्रहापण: प्रहापण n. (-णं) Driving away, forced abandonment or departure. E. प्र before हा to quit, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रहार: प्रहार m. (-रः) 1 Striking, wounding, killing. 2 A blow. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
प्रहारण: प्रहारण n. (-णं) A desirable gift. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रवारण.
प्रहारार्त: प्रहारार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow. n. (-र्त्तं) Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim. E. प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.
प्रहारार्त्त: प्रहारार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow. n. (-र्त्तं) Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim. E. प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.
प्रहास: प्रहास m. (-सः) 1 Loud laughter. 2 Blowing, (as a flower.) 3 ŚIVA. 4 An actor, a dancer. 5 A place of pilgrimage; also सोमतीर्थ. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.
प्रहासिन्: प्रहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Laughing aloud. 2 Diverting, causing laughter. m. (-सी) A jester, a buffoon, a clown. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. णिनि.
प्रहि: प्रहि m. (-हिः) A well. E. प्र before हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and the final of the radical rejected.
प्रहित: प्रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Appointed, commissioned. 3 Stretched out, extended. 4 Placed. 5 Discharged, as an arrow from a bow. 6 Learned. 7 Suitable, appropriate. n. (-तं) Sauce, gravy, condiment. E. प्र before हित proper.
प्रहीण: प्रहीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Left, abandoned. m. (-णः) Removal, loss, waste, destruction. E. प्र before हा to quit, ल्युट् aff.
प्रहीणजीवित: प्रहीणजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, slain. E. प्रहीण, and जीवित life.
प्रहुत: प्रहुत n. (-तं) Offering articles of food to spirits or goblins. E. प्र before हुत the same.
प्रहृत: प्रहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seized. n. (-तं) Striking, killing. E. प्र, and हृत taken.
प्रहृष्ट: प्रहृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, delighted. E. प्र before हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त.
प्रहृष्टक: प्रहृष्टक m. (-कः) A crow. E. प्र before हृष्ट pleased, aff. कन्.
प्रहेणक: प्रहेणक n. (-कं) Victuals or sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.
प्रहेलक: प्रहेलक n. (-कं) Sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.
प्रहेलिका: प्रहेलिका f. (-का) An enigma, a riddle, a puzzling or enigmatical question. E. प्र before हिल to play, and ण्वुल् aff.
प्रह्राद: प्रह्राद m. (-दः) A prince: see प्रह्लाद. E. ल changed to र.
प्रह्लत्ति: प्रह्लत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Pleasure, happiness. E. प्र before ह्लद to be glad, क्तिन् aff.
प्रह्लन्न: प्रह्लन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Pleased, happy, glad. E. प्र before ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
प्रह्लन्नि: प्रह्लन्नि f. (-न्निः) Pleasure, delight. E. प्र before ह्लद to be happy, क्तिन् aff.
प्रह्लाद: प्रह्लाद m. (-दः) 1 Pleasure, joy, happiness. 2 Sound, noise. 3 The name of HIRAṆYĀKṢA'S pious son and regent of one division of Pātāla. E. प्र before ह्लाद gladness or sound.
प्रह्लादित: प्रह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejoiced, delighted. E. प्रह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
प्रह्व: प्रह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) 1 Bowed, bent, stooping. 2 Intent upon, engaged in, engrossed by. E. प्र before ह्वेञ् to call, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.
प्रह्वाञ्जलि: प्रह्वाञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Stooping or bowing with the palm of the hands joined, and put to the forehead in token of respect. E. प्रह्व, and अञ्जलि salute.
प्रह्वाय: प्रह्वाय m. (-यः) Calling, summoning, invocation. E. प्र before ह्वे to call, घञ् aff.
प्रह्वीकृत: प्रह्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered, won, subjected. 2 Bent, bowed. E. प्रह्व, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
प्रांशु: प्रांशु mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु) High, tall, lofty. E. प्र before अंशु a ray of light.
प्राक्: प्राक् ind. 1 Before, prior, preceding, in place or time. 2 East, eastern. 3 Past, gone. 4 First. 5 Between, amongst, amidst. 6 At dawn, early in the morning. E. see प्राच्.
प्राकषिक: प्राकषिक m. (-कः) 1 A catamite. 2 A dancer, but especially one who employs or hires the wives of others, one who gets his livelihood by another man's wife. E. प्र and आङ् prefixed to कष to go, Uṇādi aff. किकन्.
प्राकाम्य: प्राकाम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Irresistible will or fiat, one of ŚIVA'S eight attributes. 2 Wilfulness, following or obeying one's own will or inclination. E. प्र and आङ् before कम to desire, aff. ण्यत्.
प्राकार: प्राकार m. (-रः) An inclosure, a fence, a rampart, particularly a surrounding wall, &c. elevated on a mound of earth. E. प्र and आङ् implying initial, first, कृ to make, aff. घञ्; otherwise the prefix is considered as प्र only, the vowel being made long by the affix being घञ्.
प्राकारीय: प्राकारीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Walled, enclosed by a wall. 2 Of, belonging to, or fit for a wall. E. प्राकार, and छ aff.
प्राकृत: प्राकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Low, common, vulgar, thence especially applicable to a provincial and peculiar dialect of the Sanskrit language. 2 Natural. 3 Belonging to or derived from the philosophical Prakṛti, illusory, material, &c. m. (-तः) A low man or one following a degraded profession. n. (-तं) Any dialect not Sanskrit, it is especially spoken by the female characters and the inferior personages of plays. E. प्रकति nature, and अण् aff., or प्र pre-eminently, and अकृत not made.
प्राकृतज्वर: प्राकृतज्वर m. (-रः) Common or usual fever, occurring from affections of the wind, bile, and phlegm, severally, in as many seasons, or the rains, autumn, and spring. E. प्राकृत, and ज्वर fever.
प्राकृतप्रलय: प्राकृतप्रलय m. (-यः) The total dissolution of the world. E. प्राकृत material, and प्रलय destruction.
प्राकृतमानुष: प्राकृतमानुष m. (-षः) A man in general. E. प्राकृत, and मानुष man.
प्राकृतमिच: प्राकृतमिच m. (-त्रः) A natural friend or ally; as applied to a sovereign, it means one whose states are removed by an intervening kingdom from those to which it should be friendly, the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy is the chief of the intervening state, and the प्राकृतोदासीनः or natural neutral is the outer one of the four. E. प्राकृत natural, and मिच a friend.
प्राकृतिक: प्राकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to Prakṛti, nature or matter, material, natural, illusory, &c. E. प्रकृति, and ठक् aff.
प्राक्कूल: प्राक्कूल m. (-लः) The tip of Kusa grass placed to the east. E. प्राक्, and कूल point of grass.
प्राक्काल: प्राक्काल n. (-लं) Former age or time. E. प्राच्, and काल time.
प्राक्कालीन: प्राक्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Anterior, ancient, of a former time. E. प्राक्काल, and ख aff.
प्राक्तन: प्राक्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Prior, anterior, preceding, former. E. प्राक् formerly, द्युल् aff., and तन् aug.
प्राक्तनकर्मन्: प्राक्तनकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Fate, destiny. 2 Any act formerly done. E. प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राक्तनकर्म्मन्: प्राक्तनकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Fate, destiny. 2 Any act formerly done. E. प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राक्फल्गुणी: प्राक्फल्गुणी f. (-णी) The eleventh of the lunar asterisms: see पूर्व्वफल्गुण. E. प्राक् preceding, and फल्गुणी the asterism.
प्राक्फल्गुणीभव: प्राक्फल्गुणीभव m. (-वः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. प्राक्फल्गुणी, and भय born, born when the moon was in that mansion; also similar compounds, as प्राक्फल्गुणीय.
प्राक्फाल्गुण: प्राक्फाल्गुण m. (-नः) VṚHASPATI. E. प्राक्फल्गुणी, and अण् aff.
प्राक्सन्ध्या: प्राक्सन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) Dawn. E. प्राक् the first, सन्ध्य junction of the day.
प्राक्शिरस: प्राक्शिरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Facing the east. 2 Having the head to the east in burial. E. प्राच्, and शिरम the head, मच added.
प्राखर्य: प्राखर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Sharpness. 2 Pungency. 3 Wickedness. E. प्रखर, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्राखर्य्य: प्राखर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Sharpness. 2 Pungency. 3 Wickedness. E. प्रखर, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रागभाव: प्रागभाव m. (-वः) Antecedent privation, the non-existence of any thing which may yet be. In law, the non-possession of property that may be possessed. E. प्राक् prior, अ negative, and भाव being.
प्रागल्भ्य: प्रागल्भ्य n. (-ल्भ्यं) 1 Confidence, boldness, determination. 2 Arrogance, effrontery. 3 Importance, rank. E. प्रगल्भ confident, यञ् aff.
प्रागुदीची: प्रागुदीची f. (-ची) The north-east. E. प्राक् the east, and उदीची the north.
प्रागुदीची mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going before, a precursor. E. प्राच, and गामिन् who goes.
प्राग्ज्योतिष: प्राग्ज्योतिष m. (-षः) A country, Kāmarūpa, part of Asam. E. प्राक् formerly, ज्योतिष light; being the scene of BRAHMĀ'S penance.
प्राग्भार: प्राग्भार m. (-रः) The top or peak of a mountain. E. प्राक् first, भार burthen; also read प्राग्भाव.
प्राग्भाव: प्राग्भाव m. (-वः) 1 Prior existence. 2 Superiority, excellence. 3 The top of a mountain. E. प्राक्, and भाव being or nature.
प्राग्भावतस्: प्राग्भावतस् ind. From a prior state of being. E. प्राग्भाव, and तसि aff.
प्राग्रहर: प्राग्रहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Chief, principal. E. प्र and अग्र first, हर who surpasses.
प्राग्राट: प्राग्राट n. (-टं) Thin curds. E. प्र before अग्र the top, and अट what goes.
प्राग्र्य: प्राग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Chief, principal. E. प्र prefixed to अग्र्य chief.
प्राग्वंश: प्राग्वंश m. (-शः) 1 The room opposite to that which contains the materials for an oblation, and in which the family and friends of the sacrificer assemble. 2 A former dynasty or race. E. प्राक् before, and वंश a race, &c.
प्राघात: प्राघात m. (-तः) War, battle. E. प्र before हन to kill, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix optionally made long.
प्राघार: प्राघार m. (-रः) Dropping, oozing, trickling, aspersion, or pouring out of any oily substance. E. प्र before घृ to sprinkle or drop, aff. घञ्.
प्राघुण: प्राघुण m. (-णः) A guest, a visitor, one demanding hospitality. E. प्र and आङ् before घुण to turn round, aff. क.
प्राघूर्णिक: प्राघूर्णिक m. (-कः) A guest. E. प्र before घूर्ण going about, aff. ठक्.
प्राङ्ग: प्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of small tabor or drum. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go or be, aff. ग.
प्राङ्गण: प्राङ्गण n. (-णं) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A court, a yard. E. प्र before अगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्राङ्न्याय: प्राङ्न्याय m. (-यः) Plea of a former trial, special plea. E. प्राक् former, न्याय proper.
प्राङ्मुख: प्राङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Facing the east. E. प्राञ्च्, and मुख the face.
प्राच्: प्राच् or प्राञ्च mfn. (प्राङ् प्राची प्राक्) 1 East, eastern. 2 Before, in front. 3 Former, prior, first. 4 At top, above. f. (-ची) The east. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go, aff. क्विन्.
प्राचार: प्राचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Contrary to rectitude, deviating from the ordinary institutions and observances. E. प्र reverse, and आचार ordinance.
प्राचार्य: प्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A scholar, a pupil. E. प्र meaning प्राप्त obtained, and आचार्य्य a preceptor.
प्राचार्य्य: प्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A scholar, a pupil. E. प्र meaning प्राप्त obtained, and आचार्य्य a preceptor.
प्राचिका: प्राचिका f. (-का) 1 A musquito. 2 The female falcon.
प्राचीन: प्राचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 East, eastern. 2 Former, prior, ancient, old. 3 Placed towards the east. fn. (-ना-नं) A bound hedge, a fence, a wall. f. (-ना) 1 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना. E. प्राच् the east, aff. ख.
प्राचीनतिलक: प्राचीनतिलक m. (-कः) The moon. E. प्राचीन eastern, and तिलक mark.
प्राचीनपनस: प्राचीनपनस m. (-सः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. प्राचीन् eastern, and पनस the jack.
प्राचीनवर्हिस्: प्राचीनवर्हिस् m. (-र्हिः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A king. E. प्राचीन eastern, and वर्हिस् light; presiding over the eastern quarter.
प्राचीनामलक: प्राचीनामलक m. (-कः) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. प्राचीन eastern, आमलक myrobalan.
प्राचीनावीत: प्राचीनावीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial thread, worn over the right arm, and passing under the left, as at Śrāddhas. E. प्राचीन east, and आवीत hung.
प्राचीनावीतिन्: प्राचीनावीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman wearing his cord over his right shoulder, as at Śrāddhas. E. प्राचीतावीत, and इनि aff.
प्राचीपति: प्राचीपति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. प्राची the east, and पति master, regent.
प्राचीर: प्राचीर n. (-रं) A bound hedge, a fence, a wall, an inclosure, a rampart. E. प्र and आङ prefixed to चि to collect, aff. क्रन्, and the radical vowel made long.
प्राचेतस: प्राचेतस m. (-सः) VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. m. plu. (-साः) The ten sons of Prācīnavarhis. E. प्रचेतस, the father of the poet, and अण् aff.; it also occurs प्राचेतस् (-ताः.)
प्राच्य: प्राच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Eastern, easterly. m. (-च्यः) The eastern country, the country south or east of the SARASVATĪ, which flows from the north-east to the south-west. E. प्राच् the east, aff. यत्.
प्राच्छ्: प्राच्छ् m. (-प्राट) An inquirer, a questioner. E. प्रच्छ to ask, aff. क्विप्.
प्राजक: प्राजक m. (-कः) A coachman, a driver. E. प्र before अज to go, causal form, aff. वुन्.
प्राजन: प्राजन n. (-नं) A goad. E. प्र before अज to go, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
प्राजापत्य: प्राजापत्य m. (-त्यः) 1 A form of marriage, the gift of a girl, respectfully by her father to her lover. 2 A name of Allahabad or Prayāga. 3 The first of the persons, called Vāsudevas, by the Jainas. n. (-त्यं) 1 A sort of penance, eating once a day for three days in the morning, once in the night for three days, subsisting three days on food given as alms, and fasting three days more. 2 A particular sacrifice performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue in default of male heirs. 3 The asterism Rohiṇī. f. (-त्या) Giving away the whole of one's property before entering upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant. E. प्रजापति BRAHMĀ, and ण्यत् aff.
प्राजितृ: प्राजितृ m. (-ता) A coachman, a charioteer. E. प्र before अज to go, causal v., तृच् aff.
प्राज्ञ: प्राज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Patient in investigation. 2 Wise, clever, sensible. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned or wise man. 2 A skilful or clever man. f. (-ज्ञा) Knowledge, understanding. f. (-ज्ञा-ज्ञी) A clever or intelligent woman. f. (-ज्ञी) The wife of a Paṇḍita. E. प्र and आङ before ज्ञा to know, क aff.
प्राज्ञत्व: प्राज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Learning, wisdom. E. प्राज्ञ, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्राज्ञता.
प्राज्ञमान: प्राज्ञमान n. (-नं) Respect for learned men. E. प्राज्ञ, and मान respect.
प्राज्ञमानिन्: प्राज्ञमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Respecting men of learning. E. प्राज्ञमान, and इनि aff.
प्राज्य: प्राज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Much, many. E. प्र before अञ्ज to pervade, aff. क्यप्.
प्राञ्जल: प्राञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Honest, upright, sincere. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go, aff. अलच्.
प्राञ्जलि: प्राञ्जलि f. (-लिः) Putting the hands together to the forehead, a mark of respect. E. प्र, and अञ्जलि the same.
प्राड्विवाक: प्राड्विवाक m. (-कः) A judge, a magistrate. E. प्राट् who asks, and विवाक् who decides or discriminates.
प्राण: प्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Full, replete, filled. m. (-णः) 1 Air inhaled, inspiration, breath. 2 Air, wind. 3 Life, vitality. 4 A vital organ or part. 5 Strength, power. 6 Myrrh. 7 Poetical talent or inspiration. 8 A name of BRAHMĀ. 9 A title of BRAHMĀ, the supreme spirit. 10 An aspiration in the articulation of letters. m. plu. (-णाः) The five vital airs or modes of inspiration and expiration collectively. E. प्र before अन to breathe, aff. अच्.
प्राणक: प्राणक m. (-कः) 1 An animal or sentient being. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. प्राण life, कन् aff.
प्राणकर्मन्: प्राणकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Vital action. E. प्राण, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राणकर्म्मन्: प्राणकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Vital action. E. प्राण, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राणत्: प्राणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) Living, breathing. E. प्राण nominal v. to live, शतृ aff.
प्राणत्याग: प्राणत्याग m. (-गः) Abandoning life, dying, suicide. E. प्राण, and त्याग relinquishment.
प्राणथ: प्राणथ m. (-थः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A strong or powerful man. 3 A progenitor of mankind. 4 A place of pilgrimage. E. प्र before अन to breathe or be strong, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
प्राणद: प्राणद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives life. n. (-दं) 1 Water. 2 Blood. E. प्राण life, and द who gives.
प्राणधारण: प्राणधारण n. (-णं) Sustenance, supporting life. E. प्राण, and धारण upholding.
प्राणन: प्राणन n. (-नं) 1 Life, living. 2 The throat. E. प्र before अन to live or breathe, aff. ल्युट्.
प्राणनाथ: प्राणनाथ m. (-थः) A husband. E. प्राण life, and नाथ lord.
प्राणन्त: प्राणन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन. f. (-न्ती) 1 Sneezing. 2 Hickup. E. प्र before अन to breathe, Uṇādi aff. भच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
प्राणपरिग्रह: प्राणपरिग्रह m. (-हः) Life, existence. E. प्राण, and परिग्रह possession.
प्राणप्रद: प्राणप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Saving life, when in imminent danger. E. प्राण, and प्रद who or what gives.
प्राणप्रदा: प्राणप्रदा f. (-दा) A medicinal plant, commonly Ṛddhi. E. प्राण life, प्रद what gives.
प्राणबाध: प्राणबाध m. (-धः) Extreme peril or distress, fear for life. E. प्राण, and बाध obstruction.
प्राणभास्वत्: प्राणभास्वत् m. (-स्वान्) The ocean. E. प्राण life, भास्वत् the sun, the sun being produced or rising from the sea.
प्राणभृत्: प्राणभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Living, sentient. E. प्राण, and भृत् who has.
प्राणमय: प्राणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Living, breathing, endowed with breath or life. E. प्राण, and मयट् aff.
प्राणमयकोष: प्राणमयकोष m. (-षः) One of the cases or investitures of the soul, the vital or organic case. E. प्राणमय, and कोष a sheath.
प्राणयत्: प्राणयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rescuing, restoring to life. E. प्राण nom. v. caus. form, शतृ aff.
प्राणयात्रा: प्राणयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Support of life, subsistence. E. प्राण, and यात्रा proceeding.
प्राणव्यय: प्राणव्यय m. (-यः) Death, expenditure of life. E. प्राण, and व्यय expence.
प्राणसंयम: प्राणसंयम m. (-मः) 1 A peculiar religious exercise: see पाणायाम. 2 Suspending the breath. E. प्राण breath, सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अञ्.
प्राणसद्मन्: प्राणसद्मन् n. (-द्म) The body. E. प्राण vital air, and सद्मन् abode.
प्राणसमा: प्राणसमा f. (-मा) A wife. E. प्राण life, समा equal to, same.
प्राणहर: प्राणहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Destructive, taking away life. E. प्राण, and हर who or what takes.
प्राणहारक: प्राणहारक n. (-कं) Aconite. E. प्राण, and हारक what takes away.
प्राणहारिन्: प्राणहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Mortal, deadly. E. प्राण, and हारिन् what takes.
प्राणाद: प्राणाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fatal, deadly. E. प्राश, and अद what eats.
प्राणाधिनाथ: प्राणाधिनाथ m. (-थः) A husband. E. प्राण life, अधि over, नाथ lord.
प्राणान्त: प्राणान्त n. (-न्तं) Death. E. प्राण, and अन्त end.
प्राणान्तिक: प्राणान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Fatal, destructive of life. 2 Capital, (as punishment.) n. (-कं) Murder, assassination. E. प्राण, and अन्तिक final.
प्राणापहारिन्: प्राणापहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Deadly, fatal. E. प्राण, and अपहारिन् what takes away.
प्राणापान: प्राणापान m. du. (-नौ) 1 The Aśvinī kumāras. 2 Two of the vital airs. E. प्राण, and अपान the air expelled by the anus.
प्राणाबाध: प्राणाबाध n. (-धं) Any act injurious to life. E. प्राण, and आङ् before वाध to pain, अच aff.
प्राणायाम: प्राणायाम m. (-मः) Breathing in a peculiar way through the nostrils, during the mental recitation of the names or attributes of some deity; it is differently performed: the Vaidyas or followers of the Veda close the right nostril first with the thumb, and inhale breath through the left, then they close both nostrils, and finally open the right for exhalation: the followers of the Tantras close the left nostril first, and exhale also through it; these operations are severally called पुरक, कुम्भक, and रेचक. E. प्राण breath, आ before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
प्राणिणिषु: प्राणिणिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing for life. E. प्राण nom. v., desid. form, उ aff.
प्राणिद्यूत: प्राणिद्यूत n. (-तं) Cock fighting, ram fighting, setting animals to fight for wagers. E. प्राणि a living being, and द्यूत gaming.
प्राणिन्: प्राणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Living, breathing. m. (-णी) An animal, a sentient or living being. E. प्राण vital air, and इनि aff.
प्राणिपीडा: प्राणिपीडा f. (-डा) Cruelty to animals. E. प्राणिन्, and पीडा pain.
प्राणिमाता: प्राणिमाता f. (-ता) A mother. E. प्राणिन्, and मातृ mother.
प्राणिहिंसा: प्राणिहिंसा f. (-सा) Doing harm to any living creature. E. प्राणि, and हिंसा injury.
प्राणिहित: प्राणिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Favourable or good for living beings. f. (-ता) A shoe, a boot. E. प्राणि an animal, (man,) and हित suitable.
प्राणीत्य: प्राणीत्य n. (-त्यं) Debt. E. प्रणीत taken, यञ् aff.
प्राणेश: प्राणेश m. (-शः) A husband. f. (-शा) A wife. E. प्राण life, and ईश sovereign.
प्राण्यङ्ग: प्राण्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Any animal part or product, (as flesh, bone, milk, Ghee, &c.) E. प्राणिन, and अङ्ग a part.
प्रातःकृत्य: प्रातःकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Morning duty or ceremonies, worship, ablution, purification, &c. E. प्रातर, and कृत्य to be done.
प्रातःसन्ध्या: प्रातःसन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) 1 Dawn. 2 The morning sacrifice. E. प्रातर, and सन्ध्या part of the day.
प्रातःसमय: प्रातःसमय m. (-यः) Early morning, day break. E. प्रातर्, and समय season.
प्रातःस्नान: प्रातःस्नान n. (-नं) Morning ablution, bathing at sun-rise. E. प्रातर्, and स्नान bathing.
प्रातर्: प्रातर् ind. Morning, dawn. E. प्र initial, अत to go, अर् aff.
प्रातराश: प्रातराश m. (-शः) The morning meal, breakfast. E. प्रातर् morning, अश to eat, aff. घञ्.
प्रातराशित: प्रातराशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Breakfasted, having had the morning meal. E. प्रातर, and आशित eaten.
प्रातर्गेय: प्रातर्गेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sung or chanted in the morning. m. (-यः) A minstrel, a bard, but one who especially wakes the sovereign or prince by his morning chant. E. प्रातर् in the morning, गेय to be sung.
प्रातर्भोक्तृ: प्रातर्भोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who or what eats early. m. (-क्ता) A crow. E. प्रातर् morning, and भोक्तृ who eats.
प्रातर्भोजन: प्रातर्भोजन n. (-नं) Breakfast, the morning meal. E. प्रातर् morning, and भाजन food.
प्रातिकूलिक: प्रातिकूलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Opposed to, opposing. E. प्रतिकूल, and ठक् aff.
प्रातिकूल्य: प्रातिकूल्य n. (-ल्यं) Contrariety, contradiction, opposition. E. प्रतिकूल, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रातिजनीन: प्रातिजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for or suitable to dependants, family, &c. E. प्रतिजन, and खञ् aff.
प्रातिपक्ष: प्रातिपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) 1 Hostile, belonging to an enemy. 2 Adverse, contrary. E. प्रतिपक्ष, and अण् aff.
प्रातिपदिक: प्रातिपदिक n. (-कं) A crude noun, a noun before any of its inflections are formed with appropriate affixes. m. (-कः) Fire. E. प्र and अति before पद an inflected word, ठक् aff.
प्रातिपथिक: प्रातिपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Hostile, opposing. E. प्रतिपथ, and ठक् aff.
प्रातिभाव्य: प्रातिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) Security, the act of becoming bail or surety, or being answerable for the appearance of the debtor, for his being trust-worthy, or for the payment of his debt in case of his failing to do it. E. प्रतिभू, a security, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रातिलोम्य: प्रातिलोम्य n. (-म्यं) Inverted order. E. प्रतिलोम, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रातिवेश्य: प्रातिवेश्य m. (-श्यः) A next-door neighbour. E. प्रतिवेश, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रातिस्विक: प्रातिस्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Own, peculiar, proper. E. प्रति to or towards, स्व own, and ठक् aff.
प्रातिहर: प्रातिहर m. (-रः) A juggler. E. प्रतिहार the same, and अण् pleonastic: see the next.
प्रातिहारक: प्रातिहारक m. (-कः) A juggler. E. कन् added to प्रातिहार.
प्रातिहारिक: प्रातिहारिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjuror. E. प्रतिहार disguise, trick, aff. ठञ्.
प्रातीप: प्रातीप m. (-पः) A name of ŚĀNTANU. E. प्रतीप the father of this prince, and अण् aff. of descent.
प्रातीपिक: प्रातीपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Reverse, contrary, retrograde. E. प्रतीप, and ठक् aff.
प्रात्ययिक: प्रात्ययिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Trusty, confidential, having faith in. m. (-कः) A surety. E. प्रत्यय, and ठक् aff.
प्राथमकल्पिक: प्राथमकल्पिक m. (-कः) A student, one who has just commenced the perusal of the Vedas. E. प्रथम first, कल्प beginning, and ठक् aff.
प्राथमिक: प्राथमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) First, of the first, initial, initiative. E. प्रथम, and ठञ् aff.
प्राथम्य: प्राथम्य n. (-म्यं) Firstness, priority. E. प्रथम, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रादक्षिण्य: प्रादक्षिण्य n. (-ण्यं) Circumambulation. E. प्रदक्षिण, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रादुर्भाव: प्रादुर्भाव m. (-वः) Appearance, manifestation. E. प्राटुम्, and भाव quality.
प्रादुष्कृत: प्रादुष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, made apparent. E. प्राटुस, and कृत made.
प्रादुस्: प्रादुस् ind. 1 Evidently, apparently, manifestly. 2 Visible, apparent. 3 Name, appellation. 4 Existence. 5 Co-existence. E. प्र before अद to go, or eat, Uṇādi aff. उस्.
प्रादेश: प्रादेश m. (-शः) 1 The span of the thumb and forefinger. 2 Place, country. E. प्र before दिश to shew, aff. घञ्; whence the vowel of the prefix is optionally long: see प्रदेश.
प्रादेशन: प्रादेशन n. (-नं) Gift, donation. E. प्र and आङ् before दिश to give, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रादोष: प्रादोष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Belonging, or relating to the evening. E. प्रदोष evening, aff. अण्; also with ठञ् aff. प्रादोषिक.
प्राधान्य: प्राधान्य n. (-न्यं) Supremacy, superiority. E. प्रधान chief, ष्यञ् aff.
प्राधान्यतस्: प्राधान्यतस् ind. Chiefly. E. प्रधान्य, and तसि aff.
प्राधीत: प्राधीत m. (-तः) A Brahman who has finished his studies. E. प्र, and अधीत read over.
प्राध्ययन: प्राध्ययन n. (-नं) Reading, study. E. प्र before अधि to read through, ल्युट् aff.
प्राध्व: प्राध्व mfn. (-ध्वः-ध्वा-ध्वं) 1 Distant, remote, long, as a road or journey. 2 Bowed, bent. 3 Binding, confining. m. (-ध्वः) A car, a carriage. E. प्र before अध्वन् a road, aff. अच्.
प्राध्वम्: प्राध्वम् ind. 1 In conformity, conformably. 2 Crooked, crookedly, stooping. E. प्र and आङ् before ध्वन to sound, aff. डम्.
प्रान्त: प्रान्त m. (-न्तः) Edge, margin, border, end. E. प्र before अन्त end.
प्रान्ततस्: प्रान्ततस् ind. Bordering, marginally, along or upon the extremity. E. प्रान्त the edge, and तसि aff.
प्रान्तदुर्ग: प्रान्तदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A suburb or collection of houses out of the walls of the town, a Petta, &c. E. प्रान्त skirting, टुर्ग the fort.
प्रान्तर: प्रान्तर n. (-रं) 1 A long and unshaded road, a lonesome or tiresome path. 2 A forest. 3 The hollow of a tree. E. प्र considerable, अन्तर space.
प्रान्तरशून्य: प्रान्तरशून्य n. (-न्यं) A long and tiresome road. E. प्रान्तर spacious, and शून्य empty, void.
प्राप: प्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Watery, abounding with water. E. प्र, and अप water.
प्रापक: प्रापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Procuring, causing to obtain. 2 Obtaining, who or what obtains. E. प्राप to obtain, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रापण: प्रापण n. (-णं) Obtaining. E. प्र before आप to gain, ल्युट् aff.
प्रापणिक: प्रापणिक m. (-कः) 1 A trader, a dealer. 2 A retail dealer. E. प्र and आङ् before पण to deal, to transact business, किकन Uṇādi aff.
प्रापित: प्रापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Brought, placed. 2 Procured. E. प्र before आप to gain, causal v., क्त aff.
प्राप्त: प्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Obtained, gained, received, procured. 2 Fixed, placed. 3 Proper, right. E. प्र before आप to gain, aff. क्त.
प्राप्तकाल: प्राप्तकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fated, destined, one whose fated time has come. 2 Opportune, in season. E. प्राप्त, and काल time.
प्राप्तपञ्चत्व: प्राप्तपञ्चत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Dead, deceased. E. प्राप्त obtained, पञ्चत्व death.
प्राप्तबुद्धि: प्राप्तबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) 1 Enlightened, instructed, intelligent. 2 Recovering, becoming conscious, (after fainting.) E. प्राप्त, and बुद्धि understanding.
प्राप्तभार: प्राप्तभार m. (-रः) A draft ox or beast of burthen. E. प्राप्त, and भार load.
प्राप्तभाव: प्राप्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Wise. 2 Handsome. 3 Of a good disposition. m. (-वः) A bullock. E. प्राप्त gained, भाव disposition.
प्राप्तरूप: प्राप्तरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Learned, wise. 2 Handsome, pleasing. E. प्राप्त gained or proper, रूप form.
प्राप्तार्थ: प्राप्तार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-थं) Successful, having gained an object. E. प्राप्त, and अर्थ object.
प्राप्तापराध: प्राप्तापराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Offending, being in fault. E. प्राप्त, and अपराध offence.
प्राप्तावसर: प्राप्तावसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opportune, seasonable, taking or finding occasion. E. प्राप्त, and अवसर opportunity.
प्राप्ति: प्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Acquiring, getting, obtaining. 3 Improvement, success. 4 Rise, ascent. 5 Collection, assemblage, quantity. 6 Happy denouement, successful termination of a plot. 7 Guessing, discovering from a hint. 8 One of the eight superhuman faculties, the power of obtaining every thing. E. प्र before आप to get or obtain, aff. क्तिन्.
प्राप्य: प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Attainable, obtainable. E. प्र before आप to attain, aff. ण्यत्.
प्राबल्य: प्राबल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Power, vigour. 2 Predominance. E. प्रबल strong, ष्यञ् aff.
प्राबोधिक: प्राबोधिक m. (-कः) Dawn, daybreak. E. प्रबोध waking, and ठक् aff.
प्राभव: प्राभव n. (-वं) Superiority, pre-eminence. E. प्रभु a master, aff. अण्.
प्राभवत्य: प्राभवत्य n. (-न्यं) Power, authority. E. प्रभवन् being superior, ष्यञ् aff.
प्राभृत: प्राभृत n. (-तं) A present, an offering to a deity or sovereign, or a gift to a friend, a bribe, the Nezer of Hindustan. E. प्र and आङ् before भृ to nourish, aff. क्त।; also with कन् aff. प्राभृतक, n. (-कं)
प्रामाणिक: प्रामाणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Exercising or proceeding from some evidence or authority, &c. 2 Being of authority. m. (-कः) 1 A president, the chief or head of a trade, &c. 2 A learned man, one who supports his arguments by reference to books, &c. E. प्रमाण testimony, authority, aff. ठञ्.
प्रामाण्य: प्रामाण्य n. (-ण्यं) Authority, proof. E. प्रमाण, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रामाद्य: प्रामाद्य m. (-द्यः) A tree, (Justicia adhenatoda.) n. (-द्यं) Madness, frenzy, fury, intoxication. E. प्र before मद to delight, aff. अच् and ण्यत् added.
प्रामीत्य: प्रामीत्य n. (-त्यं) Debt. E. प्र and आङ् before मा to measure, क्यप् aff., and तुक aug.; also read प्राणीत्य.
प्राय: प्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Like, resembling, (used in composition.) 2 Exceeding, much. m. (-यः) 1 Fasting to death, as a religious or penitentiary act, and especially after abandoning all worldly goods, and desires. 2 Quantity, abundance. 3 Death, dying. 4 A state or condition of life, age, youth, &c. n. (-यं) Sin. E. प्र before इन् to go, अच् aff.
प्रायण: प्रायण n. (-णं) Death, voluntary death. E. प्र, and अयन going.
प्रायशस्: प्रायशस् ind. Usually, commonly, for the most part. E. प्राय, and शसि aff.
प्रायिक: प्रायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Common, usual. E. प्राय, and ठक् aff.
प्रायश्चित्त: प्रायश्चित्त m. (-त्तः) Expiation, penance. E. प्राय sin, चित्त or चित्ति reflection, and सुट् aug. hence also प्रायश्चित्ति, f. (-त्तिः.)
प्रायश्चित्तविधि: प्रायश्चित्तविधि f. (-धिः) Rules for penance or expiation. E. प्रायश्चित्त, and विधि rite.
प्रायस्: प्रायस् ind. 1 Frequently, generally, for the most part. 2 Abundantly, largely. E. प्र before इण् or अय to go, aff. असुच्.
प्रायुधेषिन्: प्रायुधेषिन् m. (-षी) A horse. E. प्र mostly, आयुध a weapon, इप् to wish, aff. णिनि.
प्रायोपवेशन: प्रायोपवेशन n. (-नं) Fasting to death. E. प्राय, and उपवेशन sitting down.
प्रायोपवेशनिका: प्रायोपवेशनिका f. (-का) Sitting down to die by fasting. E. प्राय, उपवेश sitting down, कन् added, fem. form.
प्रारब्ध: प्रारब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun, beginning. E. प्र and आङ् before रभ to begin, क्त aff.
प्रारब्धि: प्रारब्धि f. (-ब्धिः) 1 Beginning, commencement. 2 A rope or fastening for an elephant. E. प्र and आङ् before रभ to commence, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रारम्भ: प्रारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Beginning. E. प्र and आङ् before रभि to begin, घञ् aff.
प्रार्थक: प्रार्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Asking, an asker, a solicitor. E. प्र before अर्थ to seek, वुन् aff.
प्रार्थन: प्रार्थन nf. (-नं-ना) Asking, begging. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. युच्.
प्रार्थनीय: प्रार्थनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be asked or begged. n. (-यं) The third or Dvāpara age of the world. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, अनीयर् aff.
प्रार्थयितृ: प्रार्थयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who asks or solicits, a beggar, an inquirer, a solicitor. E. प्र before अर्थ to seek, तृच् aff.
प्रार्थित: प्रार्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Asked, begged, solicited. 2 Said, spoken. 3 Obstructed or opposed by an enemy. 4 Killed, hurt. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. क्त.
प्रार्थितवत्: प्रार्थितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Asking, begging. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, क्तवतु aff.
प्रालम्ब: प्रालम्ब n. (-म्बं) A garland hanging round the neck, and reaching to the breast. E. प्र and आङ् before लवि to hang or fall, aff. अच्; also with कन् added प्रालम्बक.
प्रालम्बिका: प्रालम्बिका f. (-का) A garland, a necklace. E. प्रालम्ब a garland, &c. कन् aff., fem. form.
प्रालेय: प्रालेय n. (-यं) Frost. E. प्र before लीच् to unite with, aff. अच्; प्रलय here said to mean a mountain, अण् aff. of derivation, and the penultimate vowel changed to ए.
प्रालेयांशु: प्रालेयांशु m. (-शुः) The moon. E. प्रालेय frost or cold, and अंशु a ray.
प्रावट: प्रावट m. (-टः) Barley. E. प्र and आङ् before वट to encompass. aff. अच्.
प्रावर: प्रावर m. (-रः) An inclosure, a fence, a hedge. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to surround, aff. अप्.
प्रावरण: प्रावरण n. (-णं) 1 An upper or outer garment. 2 Any covering. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to cover, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रावार: प्रावार m. (-रः) An upper or outer garment, a cloak, a mantle. E. प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, aff. घञ्.
प्रावारकीट: प्रावारकीट m. (-टः) A body louse. E. प्रावार the outward garment, and कीट an insect.
प्रावीण्य: प्रावीण्य n. (-ण्यं) Cleverness, skilfulness. E. प्रवीण, and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रावुर्वृषु: प्रावुर्वृषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to wear. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to wear, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रावृत: प्रावृत mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं) A veil, a wrapper, a cloak or mantle. adj. Covered, inclosed, encompassed. E. प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, to cover, aff. क्त.
प्रावृति: प्रावृति f. (-तिः) An inclosure, a fence, a bound hedge. E. प्र before वृ with आङ prefix, to inclose, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रावृष्: प्रावृष् f. (-वृट्) The rainy season, two months, about July and August. E. प्र before वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्विप् and the vowel of the prefix made long.
प्रावृषा: प्रावृषा f. (-षा) The season of the rains. E. प्रावृष् as above, and टाप् added.
प्रावृषायणी: प्रावृषायणी f. (-णी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. प्रावृष् the rains, फक aff.; growing in the rains.
प्रावृषिक: प्रावृषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in the rainy season. m. (-कृः) A peacock. E. प्रावृष the rains, aff. ठक्.
प्रावृषिज: प्रावृषिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the rains. E. प्रावृष् in the 7th case, ज born.
प्रावृषेण्य: प्रावृषेण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्य) 1 Produced in the rains. 2 Much, abundant. m. (-ण्यः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. प्रावृष the rains, and एण्य aff.
प्रावेशन: प्रावेशन n. (-नं) A manufactory, a workshop. E. प्र before आवेशन entering.
प्राशन: प्राशन n. (-नं) 1 Feeding, causing to taste or eat. 2 Tasting. E. प्र before अश to eat, intransitive or causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्राशित: प्राशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten, devoured. 2 Tasted, taken into the mouth without reaching to the throat. n. (-तं) Oblation to deified progenitors. E. प्र before अशित eaten.
प्राशित्र: प्राशित्र n. (-त्रं) Any edible article. E. प्र before अश to eat, इत्रन् aff.
प्राश्निक: प्राश्निक m. (-कः) 1 An assistant at a spectacle or assembly. 2 An inquirer, an asker. E. प्रश्न a question, aff. ठक्.
प्राश्य: प्राश्य ind. Having tasted or sipped. E. प्र before अश to eat, ल्यप् aff.
प्रास: प्रास m. (-सः) A bearded dart. E. प्र before अस to throw, aff. अच्.
प्रासक: प्रासक m. (-कः) A die, dice. E. प्र before अस to throw, aff. ण्वुल्.
प्रासङ्ग: प्रासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A yoke for cattle. E. प्र and आङ before सञ्ज to join, aff. घञ्.
प्रासङ्गिक: प्रासङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Proceeding from or belonging to any connexion or relation. 2 Relevant, belonging to any topic. 3 Inherent, innate. 4 Inseparably connected with. 5 Incidental, episodical. E. प्रसङ्ग, and ठञ् aff.
प्रासङ्ग्य: प्रासङ्ग्य m. (-ड्ग्यः) A beast of draught, an ox, yoked or in training. E. प्रासङ्ग a yoke, and यत् aff.
प्रासाद: प्रासाद m. (-दः) A temple, a palace, a building consecrated to a deity, or inhabited by a prince. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ, and the vowel of the prefix lengthened, or आङ् prefixed to the verb.
प्रासादकुक्कुट: प्रासादकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A pigeon. E. प्रासाद a palace, and कुक्कुट a cock.
प्रासादपृष्ठ: प्रासादपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A terrace or balcony on the top of a large house. E. प्रासाद, and पृष्ठ back.
प्रासादशृङ्ग: प्रासादशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A turret, a spire on a palace or temple. E. प्रासाद, and शृङ्ग a horn.
प्रासादीय: प्रासादीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a palace. E. प्रासाद्, and छ aff.
प्रासिक: प्रासिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with a dart or spear. E. प्रास a dart, and ठक् aff.
प्रास्त: प्रास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Thrown, thrown off or away. 2 Thrown into. 3 Expelled, turned out, banished. E. प्र before अस to throw, क्त aff.
प्रास्थिक: प्रास्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought for a Prastha, containing a Prastha, &c. E. प्रस्थ a certain measure, and ठञ् aff.
प्राह: प्राह m. (-हः) Instruction in the art of acting or dancing.
प्राह्ण: प्राह्ण m. (-ह्णः) The forenoon. E. प्र prior, अह्न the day.
प्राह्णे: प्राह्णे ind. In the morning, in the forenoon. E. the seventh case of the last word, used as a particle.
प्राह्णेतन: प्राह्णेतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging to the forenoon. E. प्राह्णे in the morning, aff. द्यु, and तुक aug.
प्राह्णेतमाम्: प्राह्णेतमाम् ind. Early in the day, in the forenoon. E. प्राह्णे with तमप् aff. and आमु added.
प्रिय: प्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Beloved, dear, desired. m. (-यः) 1 A husband, a lover. 2 A sort of drug, commonly Ṛddhi. 3 A sort of  deer. f. (-या) 1 A woman. 2 A wife or mistress. 3 Small cardamoms. 4 News, information. 5 Arabian jasmine. 6 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 7 A species of the Supratiṣṭhā metre. E. प्री to please, aff. क, and the vowel made short.
प्रियक: प्रियक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 4 A variegated or spotted deer. 5 A bee. 6 Saffron. E. कन् added to the preceding.
प्रियकार: प्रियकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Kind, favourable, affectionate, doing good to, or treating kindly. 2 Suiting, congenial. E. प्रिय, and कृ to do, अण् aff.
प्रियकृत्: प्रियकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Kind, friendly, a friend, a benefactor. E. प्रिय, and कृत् who does.
प्रियङ्कर: प्रियङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Amiable, exciting or attracting regard. 2 Acting kindly or affectionately to. E. प्रिय beloved, कृ to make, aff. खच्; also with अण् aff. प्रियकार.
प्रियङ्करण: प्रियङ्करण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Acceptable, grateful to. 2 Acting kindly to, who or what does so. n. (-णं) Gratifying, treating kindly, (the act.) E. प्रिय, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
प्रियङ्गु: प्रियङ्गु (-ङ्गुः) 1 A medicinal plant, and perfume, commonly known by the name Priyangu, and described in some places as a fragrant seed. 2 Panick seed, (Panicum italicum.) 3 Black mustard seed. 4 Long pepper. 5 A peculiar tree: see कटुकी. E. प्रिय desired, गम to go, aff. डुन् and मुम् aug.
प्रियतम: प्रियतम mfn. (-मः-मा-भं) Dearest, most beloved. m. (-मः) A tree, (Celosia cristata) E. प्रिय desirable, तमप् aff.
प्रियतर: प्रियतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear. E. प्रिय, and तरप् comparative aff.
प्रियता: प्रियता f. (-ता) Love, affection. E. प्रिय beloved, तस्न् aff.; also with त्व, aff. प्रियत्व n. (-त्वं.)
प्रियदर्शन: प्रियदर्शन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Handsome, lovely, good looking. m. (-नः) 1 A parrot. 2 A tree, (Mimusops kauki.) E. प्रिय beloved, and दर्शन appearance.
प्रियप्राय: प्रियप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Eloquent, well spoken, of pleasing speech. n. (-यः) Eloquence in language. E. प्रिय desired, प्राय abundance.
प्रियप्रेप्सु: प्रियप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सः-प्सुः-प्सु) Lamenting the loss or absence of any beloved object, wishing or grieving for it. E. प्रिय beloved, and प्रेप्सु desirous.
प्रियभाषण: प्रियभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking kindly. E. प्रिय, and भाष्ण speaking.
प्रियमधु: प्रियमधु m. (-धुः) BALARĀMA, the half brother of KṚṢṆA. E. प्रिय fond, मधु wine.
प्रियमाण: प्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Beloved, affectionate. E. प्री to please, शानच् aff.
प्रियम्बद: प्रियम्बद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sweet or pleasant speaking. m. (-दः) A sort of demigod or Vidyādhara. E. प्रिय kind, desired, वद to speak, aff. खश्.
प्रियम्भविष्णु: प्रियम्भविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become dear to, or beloved by. E. प्रिय, भू to be, खिष्णुच् aff.
प्रियम्भविष्णुता: प्रियम्भविष्णुता n. (-ता) Amiability, becoming beloved by. E. तल् added to the last.
प्रियम्भावुक: प्रियम्भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Become dear to, or beloved by. E. प्रिय, and भू to be, खुकञ् aff.
प्रियम्भावुकता: प्रियम्भावुकता f. (-ता) Amiability, becoming beloved, the state or condition. E. तल् added to the last.
प्रियवर्णी: प्रियवर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. प्रिय desired, वर्ण class.
प्रियवादिन्: प्रियवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sweet or pleasant spoken, flattering, a flatterer. E. प्रिय kind, and वादिन् who speaks.
प्रियसख: प्रियसख m. (-खः) A tree, (Khayar, or Mimosa catechu) f. (-खी) A female friend or companion, a confidante. E. प्रिय desired, सखि a friend, टच् aff.
प्रियसत्य: प्रियसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Pleasant, and true. n. (-त्यं) Eloquent, or pleasing, as well as true, (discourse.) E. प्रिय loved, and सत्य true.
प्रियसन्देश: प्रियसन्देश m. (-शः) A tree bearing a fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. प्रिय a friend, and सन्देश intelligence.
प्रियाख्य: प्रियाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Announcing good tidings. E. प्रिय, and आख्य who says.
प्रियाल: प्रियाल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, ROXBURGH'S catalogue, but the name is applied to different trees.) E. पृ to satisfy, aff. कालन् and the radical vowel changed to रि; also with कन् added प्रियालक m. (-कः) and with the vowel protracted, प्रियाल. m. (-लः) also as derived from पीय a Sautra root, पीयाल or पियाल, &c.
प्रियासु: प्रियासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Fond of life. E. प्रिय, and असु breath.
प्रियैषिन्: प्रियैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Friendly, affectionate, wishing to please. E. प्रिय, and एषिन् seeking.
प्रियोदित: प्रियोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or kindly spoken, pleasingly uttered. n. (-तं) Kindly or gentle speech. E. प्रिय kind, &c. and उदित said.
प्री: प्री(ङ्)प्रीङ् r. 4th cl. (प्रीयते) (ञ्) प्रीञ् r. 9th cl. (प्रीणाति प्रीणीते) and 1st and 10th cls. (प्रियति-ते प्राययति-ते or प्रीणयति) 1 To please, to delight, to satisfy. 2 To be pleased or satisfied. 3 To desire or love.
प्रीण: प्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Pleased, satisfied. E. प्री to please, aff. क्त, form irr.
प्रीणन: प्रीणन n. (-नं) Satisfaction, satisfying, satiety. E. प्री to please, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रीणयित्वा: प्रीणयित्वा ind. Having pleased or propitiated. E. प्री to please, क्त्वा aff.
प्रीत: प्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, happy, glad. 2 Pleased or satisfied with. 3 Gracious, kind, affectionate. 4 Beloved, dear to. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. प्री to please, aff. क्त.
प्रीतात्मन्: प्रीतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्मः) Pleased, satisfied, content. E. प्रीत, and आत्मन् self.
प्रीति: प्रीति f. (-तिः) 1 Joy, pleasure, happiness. 2 Love, affection, regard. 3 The wife of KĀMA, or Cupid. 4 The second of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas. E. प्री to please, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रीतिकर: प्रीतिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Pleasing, agreeable to. E. प्रीति, and कर making.
प्रीतिजुषा: प्रीतिजुषा f. (-षाः) The wife of ANIRUDDHA. E. प्रीति the wife of KĀMA, जुष to serve, affs. क and टाप्.
प्रीतिद: प्रीतिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Affectionate, inspiring love or regard. m. (-दः) A jester, a buffoon. E. प्रीति affection, pleasure, and द who gives.
प्रीतिदान: प्रीतिदान n. (-नं) A kind or friendly present. E. प्रीति affection, and दान giving.
प्रीतिदाय: प्रीतिदाय n. (-यं) A gift or token of affection. E. प्रीति, and दाय a gift.
प्रीतिपूर्व्वक: प्रीतिपूर्व्वक n. adv. (-कं) Through favour or kindness. E. प्रीति, and पूर्व्वक an antecedent.
प्रीतिमत्: प्रीतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Kind, affectionate. E. प्रीति, and मतुप् aff.
प्रीतिमनस्: प्रीतिमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 1 Content, happy. 2 Kind. E. प्रीति, and मनस् the mind.
प्रीतिवचस्: प्रीतिवचस् n. (-चः) Gracious or kindly speech. E. प्रीति, and वचस् speech.
प्रीयमाण: प्रीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being pleased or propitiated. E. प्री to please, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रु: प्रु(ङ्)प्रुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्रवते) To go, to move.
प्रुष: प्रुष r. 1st cl. (उ) प्रुषु (प्रोषति) To burn, to consume with fire. r. 9th cl. (प्रुष्णाति) To be unctuous or bland. 2 To sprinkle. 3 To fill. 4 To set free. 5 To be fond of or kind to.
प्रुष्ट: प्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt. E. प्रुष to burn, aff. क्त.
प्रुष्व: प्रुष्व m. (-ष्वः) 1 A season of the year, a period of two months. 2 The sun. f. (-ष्वा) A drop of water. E. प्रुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.
प्रेक्षक: प्रेक्षक m. (-कः) A spectator, a beholder, one of an audience. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
प्रेक्षण: प्रेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 The eye. 2 Any public show or spectacle, a sight. 3 A place where public exhibitions are held. nf. (-णं-णा) Seeing, viewing, looking at, regarding. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
प्रेक्षणिक: प्रेक्षणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Looking, who looks at. f. (-का) A woman fond of seeing shows. E. प्रेक्षण seeing, ठक् aff.
प्रेक्षणीय: प्रेक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Visible, apparent. 2 Looking or appearing like. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.; also with कन् added, प्रेक्षणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं.)
प्रेक्षमाण: प्रेक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at or on, beholding, regarding. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
प्रेक्ष्यमाण: प्रेक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being seen or looked at. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रेक्षा: प्रेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Intellect, understanding. 2 Dancing. 3 Seeing, viewing, observing. 4 Seeing a play or entertainment of dancing, &c. 5 The branch of a tree. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
प्रेक्षित: प्रेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld, looked at. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
प्रेङ्खण: प्रेङ्खण n. (-णं) 1 Going, wandering. 2 Entering. 3 Twinging. 4 A minor drama in one act. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रेङ्खत्: प्रेङ्खत् mfn. (-ङ्खन्-ङ्खन्ती-ङ्खत्) 1 Touching, being in contact with. 2 Scattering, diffusing. 3 Shaking, moving. 4 Wandering, roving. E. प्र before इखि to go, शतृ aff.
प्रेङ्खा: प्रेङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) 1 A swing, a sort of hammock or swinging cot, either for travelling or diversion. 2 Wandering, roaming, travelling about 3 A horse's going or motion. 4 Dancing. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. घञ्.
प्रेङ्खित: प्रेङ्खित mfn. (-तः-ता-नं) 1 Shaken, moving, set in motion, swung, &c. Joined to, being in contact with. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. क्त or प्रेङ्खा a swing, इतच् aff.
प्रेङ्खोलन: प्रेङ्खोलन n. (-नं) A swing, a swing cot or hammock. E. प्रङ्खोल to swing or shake, nominal verb, and ल्युट् aff.
प्रेङ्खोलित: प्रेङ्खोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agitated, shaken, swung, set in motion. E. प्रेङ्खोल nominal verb, to swing, aff. क्त.
प्रेत: प्रेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. m. (-तः) 1 A ghost, a goblin a sprite, an evil being, especially animating the carcases of the dead. 2 The spirit before obsequial rites are performed. E. प्र before इत gone.
प्रेतकर्मन्: प्रेतकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral or obsequial rites. E. प्रेत, and कम्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया, &c.
प्रेतकर्म्मन्: प्रेतकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral or obsequial rites. E. प्रेत, and कम्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया, &c.
प्रेतकार्य: प्रेतकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead. E. प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.
प्रेतकार्य्य: प्रेतकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead. E. प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.
प्रेतकृत्य: प्रेतकृत्य nf. (-त्यं-त्या) Obsequial rites. E. प्रेत, and कृत्य a ceremony; also प्रेतकर्म्म, &c.
प्रेतगृह: प्रेतगृह n. (-हं) A cemetery, a burying ground. E. प्रेत a sprite, and गृह abode.
प्रेतत्व: प्रेतत्व n. (-त्वं) The character or state of a departed spirit. E. प्रेत, and त्व aff.
प्रेतधूम: प्रेतधूम n. (-मं) The smoke of a funeral pile. E. प्रेत, and धूम smoke.
प्रेतनदी: प्रेतनदी f. (-दी) The river of hell. E. प्रेत a goblin, and नदी a river.
प्रेतनर: प्रेतनर m. (-रः) A ghost, a corpse. E. प्रेत, and नर a man.
प्रेतनिर्हारक: प्रेतनिर्हारक m. (-कः) 1 A man employed to carry forth dead bodies. 2 A kinsman who does so. E. प्रेत, निर् out, हृ to take, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रेतपक्ष: प्रेतपक्ष n. (-क्षं) The dark half of the month. E. प्रेत, and पक्ष a fortnight.
प्रेतपटह: प्रेतपटह m. (-हः) A drum played at the death of a person. E. प्रेत dead, and पटह a drum.
प्रेतपति: प्रेतपति m. (-तिः) YAMA, ruler of the dead. E. प्रेत dead, and पति master.
प्रेतपात्र: प्रेतपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel used in obsequial presentations. E. प्रेत, and पात्र a vessel.
प्रेतराज: प्रेतराज m. (-जः) YAMA. E. प्रेत, and राज king.
प्रेतलोक: प्रेतलोक m. (-कः) The region of disembodied spirits, in which they remain for one year, or until the obsequial rites are completed. E. प्रेत, and लोक region.
प्रेतवन: प्रेतवन n. (-नं) A burying ground, a cemetery, a place where bodies are burnt or buried. E. प्रेत a sprite, and वन a wood.
प्रेतवाहित: प्रेतवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed by a devil or fiend. E. प्रेत a sprite, and वाहित borne, actuated.
प्रेतशुद्धि: प्रेतशुद्धि m. (-द्धिः) Purification after the death of a kinsman. E. प्रेत, and शुद्धि purifying.
प्रेतहार: प्रेतहार m. (-रः) One who carries a corpse, a near kinsman. E. प्रेत, and हार who takes.
प्रेतान्न: प्रेतान्न n. (-न्नं) Food offered to the manes, or distributed on a person's death. E. प्रेत, and अन्न food.
प्रेतोद्देश: प्रेतोद्देश m. (-शः) An offering to the manes. E. प्रेत, and उद्देश object.
प्रेत्य: प्रेत्य ind. 1 In the next world. 2 Having died. E. प्रेत dead, and यत् aff,; or प्र before इ to go, ल्यप् aff.
प्रेप्सु: प्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous of obtaining. E. प्र before अप to obtain, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रेमन्: प्रेमन् mn. (-मा-म) 1 Affection, kindness, tender regard. 2 Pleasure, sport, pastime, joy. m. (-मा) 1 INDRA. 2 Air. E. प्र for प्रिय loved, इमनिच् aff.
प्रेमपर: प्रेमपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Affectionate, loving, constant. E. प्रेम, and पर attached to.
प्रेमपातन: प्रेमपातन n. (-नं) Rheum, tears. E. प्रेम tenderness, पातन falling.
प्रेयस्: प्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Dearest, most beloved, very dear. f. (-सी) A wife, a mistress. E. प्रिय dear, and ईयसुम् aff.
प्रेयोपत्य: प्रेयोपत्य m. (-त्यः) A heron. E. प्रेयस् dear, and अपत्य offspring.
प्रेरण: प्रेरण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, directing. 2 Ordering, commanding. 3 Passion, operation of the organs of sense. 4 The sense of the causal verb. E. प्र before ईर to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रेरित: प्रेरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, directed, dispatched. 2 Ordered. E. प्र before ईर to go, aff. क्त.
प्रेत्यभाव: प्रेत्यभाव m. (-वः) Being born again after dying. E. प्रेत्य, भाव nature.
प्रेन्वन: प्रेन्वन n. (-नं) 1 Pervading, spreading. 2 Satisfying. E. प्र before ईर to go, इवि to pervade, &c. ल्युट् aff.
प्रेर्त्वन्: प्रेर्त्वन् m. (-र्त्वा) The ocean. f. (-री) A river. E. प्र before ईर to go, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्, and तुट् aug.
प्रेष: प्रेष (ऋ) प्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (प्रेषते) To go, to move or approach.
प्रेष m. (-षः) 1 Sending, directing, dispatching. 2 Pain, affliction. E. प्र before इष to go or send, aff. अच्.
प्रेषण: प्रेषण n. (-णं) Sending, dispatching. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रेषित: प्रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sent, directed. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. क्त.
प्रेषितवत्: प्रेषितवत् mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्) Sent, having sent. E. प्र before इष to go, क्तवतु aff.
प्रेष्ठ: प्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Most or very dear. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 A wife. 2 The leg. E. प्रिय dear, aff. इष्ठन्, form irr.
प्रेष्य: प्रेष्य m. (-ष्यः) A servant. E. प्र before इष to go, or प्रेष to send, aff. ण्यत्; also प्रैष्य.
प्रैष: प्रैष m. (-षः) 1 Sorrow, distress, affliction. 2 Pain, suffering. 3 Sending, directing. 4 Phrenzy, intoxication, insanity. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. घञ्; also प्रेष.
प्रैष्य: प्रैष्य m. (-ष्यः) A servant, a slave. n. (-ष्यं) Service, servitude. E. प्र before इष to go, and ण्यत् aff.
प्रोक्त: प्रोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said, declared. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्त.
प्रोक्तवत्: प्रोक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or had said, was saying. E. प्र before वच to speak, क्तवतु aff.
प्रोक्षण: प्रोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Killing animals in sacrifice, immolation of victims. 2 Killing, slaughter. 3 Sprinkling with water, &c. 4 A text to be repeated when animals are offered. E. प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रोक्षणीपात्र: प्रोक्षणीपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for sprinkling water, &c. E. प्रोक्षण, and पात्र a vessel, च्चि aff.
प्रोक्षित: प्रोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Killed, slaughtered. 3 Offered in sacrifice. E. प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
प्रोच्छलत्: प्रोच्छलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्तो-लत्) Flowing, issuing, coming out or up. E. प्र and उत् before शल to go, aff. क्त.
प्रोच्छून: प्रोच्छून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swelled, swoln. E. प्र, and उच्छून swelled.
प्रोज्जासन: प्रोज्जासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र and उत् before जस to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रोज्झन: प्रोज्झन n. (-नं) Leaving, quitting, letting go. E. प्र before उञ्झ to leave, aff. ल्युट्.
प्रोज्झित: प्रोज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, shunned, avoided. E. प्र before उज्झित left.
प्रोत: प्रोत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sewn or stitched. 2 Tied, strung. 3 Set, inlaid. 4 Impaled. 5 Joined, connected. n. (-तं) Cloth, clothes. E. प्र before वे to weave or sew, aff. क्त.
प्रोतोत्सादन: प्रोतोत्सादन n. (-नं) A parasol, a Catta, an umbrella. E. प्रोत cloth, उत् over, सादन a house.
प्रोत्फल: प्रोत्फल m. (-लः) A sort of palm tree. E. प्र and उत् above, फल fruit.
प्रोत्सादन: प्रोत्सादन n. (-नं) Contriving, device. E. प्र and उत् before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रोत्सारण: प्रोत्सारण n. (-णं) Clearing away, getting rid of, expelling. E. प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रोत्सारित: प्रोत्सारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Relinquished, left, given up. 2 Got rid of, ejected, expelled. E. प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.
प्रोत्साह: प्रोत्साह m. (-हः) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Stimulus, incitement. E. प्र before उत्साह effort.
प्रोत्साहक: प्रोत्साहक m. (-कः) The instigator or adviser of any act, or, in law, of any crime. E. प्रोत्साह with कन् added.
प्रोत्साहन: प्रोत्साहन n. (-नं) Instigating, exciting, stimulating. E. प्र and उत् before सह to bear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रोत्साहित: प्रोत्साहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Incited, instigated, stimulated, encouraged. E. प्र and उत् before सह to bear, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
प्रोथ: प्रोथ (ऋ) प्रोथृ r. 1st cl. (प्रोथति-ते) 1 To be able, adequate or competent. 2 To be complete or ample. 3 To destroy, to subdue or overpower.

प्रोथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Travelling, wayfaring, a traveller. 2 Notorious, famous. 3 Placed, fixed. mn. (-थः-थं) The nose of a horse or the tip of it. m. (-थः) 1 The loins or hip. 2 Old clothes. 3 The embryo or fœtus. E. प्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
प्रोद्घुष्ट: प्रोद्घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Resonant, sounding well. 2 Making a loud noise. E. प्र, and उद्वुष्ट sounded.
प्रोद्घोषण: प्रोद्घोषण n. (णं) Sounding or crying aloud. E. प्र and उत् before घुष to cry, ल्युट् aff.
प्रोद्भिन्न: प्रोद्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Breaking forth, (as seeds, &c.) E. प्र, and उद्भिन्न put forth.
प्रोन्नत: प्रोन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Towering, very lofty. E. प्र, and उन्नत high.
प्रोम्भन: प्रोम्भन n. (-नं) Filling. E. प्र before उम्भ to fill, ल्युट् aff.
प्रोम्भित: प्रोम्भित mfn. (-त-ता-तं) Filled. E. प्र before उम्भ to fill, क्त aff.
प्रोर्णुनविषु: प्रोर्णुनविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to cover. E. प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. and the vowel changed.
प्रोर्णुनूषु: प्रोर्णुनूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to cover. E. प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. the augment इ omitted.
प्रोल्लाघित: प्रोल्लाघित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent. 2 Strong, robust. E. प्र and उत् before लाघ to be able, क्त aff.
प्रोल्लिखत्: प्रोल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) Marking, making lines, scratches, &c. E. प्र and उल्लिख to mark, शतृ aff.
प्रोल्लेखन: प्रोल्लेखन n. (-नं) Scratching, marking, drawing lines or marks. E. प्र and उत् before लिख to write, ल्युट् aff.
प्रोष: प्रोष m. (-षः) Burning. E. प्रुष to burn, aff. घञ्.
प्रोषित: प्रोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abroad, absent, away from home, sojourning in another country. E. प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त.
प्रोषितभर्तृका: प्रोषितभर्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband is absent. E. प्रोषित abroad, भर्तृ a husband, aff. कन् and टाप्.
प्रोषितमरण: प्रोषितमरण n. (-णं) Dying in a foreign country. E. प्रोषित absent, and मरण dying.
प्रोषितवत्: प्रोषितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Strange, a stranger, a sojourner. E. प्र before वस to dwell, क्तवतु aff.
प्रोष्ठ: प्रोष्ठ mf. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी) A sort of carp, (Cyprinus Pausius, HAM.) m. (ष्ठः) An ox. E. प्र before उष to burn, aff. थन्.
प्रोष्ठपदा: प्रोष्ठपदा f. (-दा) One of the constellations, the twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh, containing stars in the wing of Pegasus: see माद्रपदा. E. प्रोष्ठ here said to mean an ox, and पद a foot.
प्रोष्ठपाद: प्रोष्ठपाद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Born under the sign Proṣṭha padā. E. प्रोष्ठपद, and अण् aff. in this sense; in any other, the form is प्रोष्ठपद.
प्रोह: प्रोह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Skilful, clever. 2 Logical, reasoning, a reasoner, a disputant. m. (-हः) 1 An elephant's foot. 2 A joint, a knot. 3 The ancle of an elephant. E. प्र before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क.
प्रोहणीय: प्रोहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be reasoned or argued. E. प्र before ऊह to reason, अनीयर् aff.
प्रौढ: प्रौढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Full-grown. 2 Confident, bold, arrogant. 3 Impudent. 4 Full, (as the moon.) 5 Thick, heavy, (darkness, &c.). 5 Forward, (as the hand to seize any thing.) 7 Raised, lifted up. 8 Controverted. 9 Old. 10 Married. f. (-ढा) 1 A woman from thirty years of age to fifty-five. 2 A description of the Nāyikā or mistress, a woman whose feelings are violent or impetuous, or one who is not in any awe of her lover or husband. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. क्त.
प्रौढि: प्रौढि f. (ढिः) 1 Enterprise, zeal, confident or audacious exertion. 2 Investigation, controversy, discussion. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
प्रौढपाद: प्रौढपाद m. (-दः) One who sits with his feet upon a seat. E. प्रौढ raised, and पाद the foot.
प्रौर्णुवितृ: प्रौर्णुवितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Extending over, covering. E. प्र and ऊर्णु to cover, तृच् aff.
प्रौष्ठपद: प्रौष्ठपद m. (-दः) The month Bhādra, (August-September.) f. (-दी) Full moon in Bhādra. E. प्रोष्ठपदा the sign, and अण् aff.; when the moon is near the wing of Pegasus.
प्लक्ष: प्लक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Waved leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) 2 Another tree, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 3 The holy fig, (Ficus religiosa.) 4 One of the seven Dvīpas or continents, into which the world is divided. 5 A private or back door. E. प्लुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. स, and अ substituted for the penultimate vowel.
प्लव: प्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Who or what goes by leaps or jumps, leaping, jumping, a tumbler. m. (-वः) 1 Jumping, leaping, plunging, going by leaps or plunges. 2 Swimming, floating, diving. 3 A raft, a float. 4 A frog. 5 A monkey. 6 A sheep. 7 A diver, or bird so called, (Pelicanus fusicollis.) 8 A sort of duck. 9 A man of a low or degraded tribe. 10 Waved-leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) 11 The continuous protracted accent, the lengthened sound of vowels in poetry or the Vedas. 12 Protracting a sentence through several stanzas. 13 A declivity or shelving ground. 14 A piece of water. 15 A sort of basket or snare of basket work for catching fish. 16 An enemy. 17 Sending, directing. n. (-वं) 1 A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 Fragrant grass in general, or another sort. E. प्लु to go, aff. अप्.
प्लवक: प्लवक m. (-कः) 1 A tumbler, a dancer, a man who walks on the edge of a sword, a rope-dancer, &c. 2 An outcast. E. प्लव a tumbler, &c. and कन् aff.
प्लवग: प्लवग m. (-गः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A frog. 3 The charioteer of the sun. 4 A sort of bird, the diver. E. प्लव leaping, and ग who goes, from गम with ड aff.
प्लवगति: प्लवगति m. (-तिः) 1 A frog. 2 Going by leaps and jumps. E. प्लव leaping, and गति going.
प्लवङ्ग: प्लवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A monkey. 2 A deer. E. प्लव leaping, गम to go, aff. खच् with the power of ड, whence the nasal is inserted, and final syllable rejected; also प्लव, प्लवग, and प्लवङ्गम.
प्लवङ्गम: प्लवङ्गम m. (-मः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A frog. E. प्लव leaping, गम to go, aff. खच्.
प्लवन: प्लवन n. (-नं) 1 Jumping, leaping. 2 A deluge, an inundation. 3 Swimming, plunging into. E. प्लु to go, ल्युट् aff.
प्लवमान: प्लवमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Bounding, springing, leaping. 2 Swimming. E. प्लु to go, शानच् aff.
प्लवाका: प्लवाका f. (-का) A boat, a raft. E. प्लव tossing, अक what goes, टाप् fem. aff.; also प्लविका, from प्लु with वुन् aff. and fem. form.
प्लाक्ष: प्लाक्ष m. (क्षं) The fruit of the Hibiscus populneoides. E. प्लक्ष, and अण् added.
प्लाव: प्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Submersion. 2 Filling a vessel till it runs over. E. प्लु to go, causal v., घञ् aff.; also with ल्युट, प्लावनं.
प्लाव्य: प्लाव्य mfn. (व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be jumped, leaped, &c. 2 To be submerged or inundated. E. प्लु to go, ण्यत् aff.
प्लाविन्: प्लाविन् m. (-वी) A bird. E. प्लु to go, aff. घिनुण्.
प्लिह: प्लिह r. 1st cl. (प्लेहते) To go, to move or approach.
प्लिहन्: प्लिहन् m. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन्.
प्लिहा: प्लिहा f. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन्.
प्लीहघ्न: प्लीहघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.) E. प्लीह the spleen, (the disease, &c.) घ्न what removes.
प्लीहन्: प्लीहन् m. (-हा) The spleen; the organ or the disease of it, as in English; in the latter sense, however, it is equally applied to the enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c. E. प्लिह to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and the vowel made long; otherwise being प्लिहन्; and with क and टाप् affs., and the vowel long or short प्लिहा or प्लीहा.
प्लीहशत्रु: प्लीहशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A medical plant, commonly Rohera or Rohiṇī, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.) E. प्लीह for प्लीहन् the spleen, (the disease,) and शत्रु enemy; also प्लीहाशत्रु.
प्लीहारि: प्लीहारि m. (-रिः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. प्लीहा the spleen, and अरि enemy.
प्लु: प्लु(ङ)प्लुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्लवते) 1 To go, to approach. 2 To go by leaps, to jump, &c. With उत् prefixed, To leap up. With वि, To plunge in, to be submerged or inundated.
प्लुक्षि: प्लुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) Fire or its deity. E. प्लुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. सि
प्लुत: प्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Jumped, leaped, gone by leap or jump, &c. 2 Thrown or tossed up. m. (-तः) 1 Bounding, capering, one of a horse's paces. 3 Leaping, jumping, tumbling. mn. (-तः-तं) The third sound given to vowels; the protracted or continuous sound, being three times the length of the short vowel, and occupying three moments in its utterance. E. प्लु to go by leaps, aff. क्त.
प्लुष: प्लुष r. 1st cl. (उ) प्लुषु (प्लोषति) r. 4th cl. (ऌ) प्लुषॢ (प्लुष्यति) To burn r. 9th cl. (प्लुष्णाति) 1 To be unctuous. 2 To sprinkle. 3 To fill. 4 To set free. 5 To be fond of or kind to.
प्लुष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. क.
प्लुष्ट: प्लुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. क्त.
प्लुस: प्लुस(इर)प्लुसिर r. 4th cl. (प्लुस्यति) 1 To burn. 2 To share.
प्लेव: प्लेव(ऋ)प्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (प्लेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
प्लोष: प्लोष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. घञ्.
प्सा: प्सा f. (प्सा) Eating. E. प्सा to eat, aff. क्विप्.
प्सात: प्सात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. प्सा to eat, aff. क्त.
प्सान: प्सान n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food. E. प्सा to eat, aff. ल्युट्. फ
